31393.s: The bill abolishes the advisory mayoral referendum in the Municipalities Act: it removes articles 61 and 61e provisions on holding such a referendum and related references in 61 and 61c. Municipalities that already decided to include the referendum before entry into force keep the old rules.
31393.j: The memorandum argues the referendum wrongly suggested an election, the mayor has no own policy room, and the appointment procedure is exhaustively regulated and confidential, so the referendum should not continue.
q: On the basis of these considerations, the government is of the opinion that there is no reason to continue to maintain the mayoral referendum.
Op grond van deze overwegingen is de regering van oordeel dat er geen reden is om het burgemeestersreferendum nog langer te handhaven.
p: Removes article 61e, eliminating the advisory referendum on mayoral appointment, which gave citizens a consultative voice in the appointment procedure.

parties: Supports abolition as ending a form of pseudo-democracy and asks how councils may still consult citizens on mayoral appointments.
The CDA members welcomed the bill, which ends a form of pseudo-democracy.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel, dat een einde maakt aan een vorm van schijndemocratie.
Argues municipalities should be as free as possible to shape the process of nominating a mayor and asks for a representative survey of councils before abolition.
These concerns rest mainly on the view that, within the system of Crown-appointed mayors, municipalities should be as free as possible to shape the process of nominating a mayor.

Deze berusten vooral op de opvatting dat – met inachtneming van het systeem van door de Kroon benoemde burgemeesters – gemeenten zoveel mogelijk vrij zouden moeten zijn in het vormgeven van het proces om te komen tot de voordracht van een burgemeester.
Supports abolition but holds that the elected council, not the mayor, should have the last word locally and asks for study of an elected-mayor model.
They hold that in local politics the directly elected council, not the mayor, should have the last word.
Zij menen dat in de lokale politiek niet de burgemeester, maar de rechtstreeks gekozen gemeenteraad het laatste woord moet hebben.
Opposes abolition as a supporter of the directly elected mayor and wants a referendum with a choice among more candidates.
These members favour continuing the advisory citizens' referendum, in which at least a choice among more persons from two or more parties must be possible.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van het voortzetten van het raadplegend burgerreferendum, waarbij in ieder geval gekozen moet kunnen worden uit meer personen, van in ieder geval 2 of meer partijen.
Supports withdrawing the referendum, favouring representative over direct democracy while noting citizen involvement can be improved through consultation.
In the view of the ChristenUnie members, for this reason too primacy should lie with representative rather than direct democracy.
Naar de opvatting van de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie moet mede om die reden het primaat liggen bij de representatieve democratie en niet bij de directe democratie.
Welcomes the bill as meeting the earlier motion and asks whether the government plans further changes to mayoral candidacy rules.
The SGP members welcomed this bill.
Met instemming hebben de leden van de SGP-fractie kennis genomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

31519.s: The bill amends the Wet werk en bijstand, IOAW and IOAZ to give lone parents with a child under five a right to exemption from the work-integration obligation, with the exemption capped at six years and suspended in defined circumstances. It also adds a duty for municipalities to draw up a plan of action within six months and to fill the reintegration obligation for those without a starting qualification unless beyond their abilities.
31519.j: The memorandum justifies a more central, nationally uniform regulation of lone parents' rights and duties as anchoring good municipal practice, acknowledging it departs from the WWB system but is a limited, justified deviation.
q: Whereas under the current WWB exemption from the work obligation is a power of the municipal council, under this bill the lone parent with young children gets a right to exemption from the work obligation.

Daar waar in de huidige WWB de ontheffing van de arbeidsverplichting een bevoegdheid is van het college, krijgt de alleenstaande ouder met jonge kinderen op basis van onderhavig wetsvoorstel een recht op ontheffing van de arbeidsverplichting.
p: Converts the municipal discretion to exempt lone parents from work obligations into a legal right to exemption, narrowing executive discretion in favour of claimants, with a cap of six years and a plan of action requirement.

parties: Asks why the training deadline and the exemption are not more closely linked, and whether the six-year maximum applies in co-parenting situations.
These members therefore emphatically ask why the bill does not more explicitly link the deadlines for training or a reintegration track to the exemption from the job-search obligation.

Deze leden vragen dan ook met nadruk waarom in het wetsvoorstel de termijnen voor het volgen van een opleiding of een reintegratietraject en de vrijstelling van de sollicitatieplicht niet nadrukkelijker aan elkaar gekoppeld zijn.
Welcomes the proposal and asks about expected outcomes, the training waiting lists and how non-compliance with obligations is assessed.
The PvdA members are pleased that this proposal enables single parents with children under 5 to improve their starting qualifications.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn verheugd dat met dit voorstel alleenstaande ouders met kinderen tot 5 jaar in de gelegenheid worden gesteld hun startkwalificaties te verbeteren.
Supports a national rule to avoid arbitrariness among municipalities, but asks how unequal treatment of similar cases by municipalities is prevented and how the training duty is applied.
Questions the motivation for exempting single parents from the job-search obligation, which may increase distance from the labour market, and questions the training duty's practical results.

Since the government's aim is to raise benefit recipients' labour participation as much as possible, the motivation behind the proposal to exempt single parents from the job-search obligation is not entirely clear.

Aangezien het de doelstelling is van de regering de arbeidsparticipatie van uitkeringsgerechtigde zo veel mogelijk te verhogen is de motivatie achter het voorstel tot het ontheffen van de sollicitatieplicht voor alleenstaande ouders niet geheel duidelijk.
Argues that every benefit recipient who can work must work and that the work obligation for single parents with children under five should not be removed.
The PVV is therefore of the view that it is not advisable to remove the work obligation for single parents with children under five.
De PVV-fractie is derhalve van mening dat het niet raadzaam is de arbeidsverplichting voor alleenstaande ouders met kinderen tot vijf jaar te schrappen.
Welcomes the bill for offering choice in combining work and care, and asks about where exemption requests are filed and who registers duration.
They emphasise the importance of freedom of choice in combining work and care, especially for mothers in a vulnerable position.
Zij benadrukken het belang van keuzevrijheid in de combinatie van arbeid en zorg, juist voor moeders die zich in een kwetsbare positie bevinden.
Asks why exemption is capped at six years, whether co-parenting and new children are covered, and how municipalities will be guided in applying the co-parenting exemption to avoid large differences.
Municipalities may grant this exemption where there are urgent reasons. Can the government elaborate these urgent reasons so that large differences between municipalities do not arise?

Gemeenten krijgen de mogelijkheid deze ontheffing toe te kennen als daar dringende redenen voor zijn. Kan de regering deze dringende redenen nader uitwerken, zodat er geen grote verschillen zullen ontstaat tussen de verschillende gemeenten?

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft Wet verbetering arbeidsmarktpositie alleenstaande ouders, which would give single parents with a child under five a statutory right to exemption from job-search obligations, raising concerns about need, individual tailoring, assumptions about combining work and care, and unexplained financial effects. The State Secretary's reply accepts several points by adding justification to the explanatory memorandum, while maintaining the core of the bill and explaining why the proposed experiment cannot replace it.
concerns: The Council questions the need for the bill given existing discretion under Article 9 WWB and asks for justification of the problem; the reply supplements the explanatory memorandum but maintains the policy choice.

The Council argues that a generic statutory right ignores heterogeneity among single parents and that individual tailoring under existing rules should be retained; the reply argues the bill itself preserves maatwerk.

The Council says the assumption that work and childcare cannot be combined is not supported and that the age limit ignores kindergarten attendance from age four; the reply rejects the premise but adds explanation on co-parenting and the age limit.
The Council asks whether the planned part-time work experiment could suffice instead; the reply says the experiment pursues a different route and cannot achieve the same goal.

The Council asks for substantiation of the assumed around 1000 additional cases and clarification of claimed long-term savings given fewer municipal options for the group; the reply adds a justification to the financial section.

31528.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code so that landlords must contribute to tenants' moving costs when a tenant must move because of planned renovation, extending a rule that previously applied only to social landlords. It also requires landlords to pay moving-cost contributions when terminating a tenancy for own use after renovation or for a zoning plan purpose, with a minimum amount for independent dwellings, mobile homes and pitches set by ministerial regulation and indexed annually.
31528.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation by stating that the minimum amount equals the existing Bbsh amount and that indexation follows the consumer price index, so the amount can be adjusted without a new statute.
q: The minimum contribution to moving and furnishing costs for tenants of independent dwellings, mobile homes and pitches is set by ministerial regulation of the Minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration and may be changed annually in line with the consumer price index.

De minimumbijdrage in de verhuis- en inrichtingskosten voor de huurders van zelfstandige woningen als bedoeld in artikel 234, en woonwagens en standplaatsen als bedoeld in de artikelen 235 en 236, wordt bij ministeriële regeling van de Minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie vastgesteld
d: minimum moving and furnishing cost contribution for independent dwellings, mobile homes and pitches
minimum moving and furnishing cost contribution on termination of tenancy, with annual indexation
p: Landlords gain a duty to contribute to tenants' moving costs in renovation cases, with the amount fixed by ministerial regulation and offset against municipal allowances.

Courts' discretion over moving-cost compensation is replaced in part by a mandatory landlord contribution fixed by ministerial regulation, while the court retains power to set amounts and handle reasonableness disputes.

parties: Worries that the renovation/maintenance distinction will cause disputes and legal procedures, and asks whether maintenance-linked moves should also carry an allowance.

The PvdA members fear that the distinction between maintenance and renovation, and the right to compensation tied to it (right to compensation for renovation, no right for maintenance), will lead to much discussion and uncertainty about the nature of work on a dwelling.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vrezen dat het onderscheid tussen onderhoud en renovatie en het hieraan gekoppelde recht op een vergoeding (wel recht op vergoeding bij renovatie, geen recht op vergoeding bij onderhoud) zal leiden tot veel discussie en onduidelijkheid over de aard van werkzaamheden in en aan een woning.
Supports the bill but asks for stronger tenant protection: wants a 70% tenant-approval criterion for renovation regardless of landlord's own-use grounds, and notes court costs may deter tenants.
These members point out that going to court is an expensive matter for many tenants, which may form a considerable barrier to a fair settlement of the dispute.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat een gang naar de rechter voor veel huurders een kostbare aangelegenheid is, wat een flinke drempel op kan werpen voor een rechtvaardige afwikkeling van het geschil.
Questions whether imposing the same duties on private landlords as on social landlords is justified and how municipal contributions interact with the landlord's allowance obligation.
These members nevertheless question whether it is justified to impose the same duties on private landlords as on social landlords, who are in a different position.
Deze leden vragen zich echter af of het wel gerechtvaardigd is om particuliere verhuurders dezelfde plichten op te leggen als sociale verhuurders, die in een andere positie verkeren.
Asks why the BBSH scope (care homes with residents aged 65+) is narrowed and why the minimum allowance is not mandatory for major maintenance.
Furthermore, the GroenLinks members would like to ask the government to explain why the minimum allowance is not made mandatory for (major) maintenance.
Voorts zouden de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie de regering willen vragen of zij kan uiteenzetten waarom de minimumtegemoetkoming niet verplicht wordt bij (groot) onderhoud?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill giving tenants displaced by renovation a relocation cost allowance, but advises a reasoned justification for placing it in Book 7 BW, since article 220 sits among tenant obligations, and clarifying the 'zelfstandige woning' wording versus the Bbsh. The government's reply accepts the points: it adds a reasoned justification, extends the minimum contribution to woonwagens and standplaatsen, and adopts the editorial remarks.
concerns: The placement of the relocation-cost rule in Book 7 BW (article 220, among tenant obligations) needed a reasoned justification, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.

The term 'zelfstandige woning' is narrower than 'zelfstandige woongelegenheid' and would exclude woonwagens and standplaatsen from the minimum contribution; the text was adjusted to 'zelfstandige woningen, woonwagens en standplaatsen'.
Several editorial remarks on wording and cross-references (articles 220(5) and (7), 275(5)) were adopted in the bill.

31546.s: The bill amends the Tracéwet, Spoedwet wegverbreding and Wet ruimtelijke ordening so that the administrative court can issue an interim ruling giving the authority a deadline to remedy defects, and so that the minister or municipal council may adopt amending decisions while an appeal is pending. The aim is to allow definitive dispute resolution in a single proceeding.
31546.j: The memorandum justifies the procedure by efficiency gains in definitive dispute resolution, citing the A4 Burgerveen–Leiden case and earlier recommendations, and argues the amendment is limited to minor changes with a judicial safeguard.
q: The administrative body would then be enabled, via the interim ruling, to still reach a lawful decision, so that the administrative court could definitively settle the dispute with its final ruling.

Het bestuursorgaan zou dan via de tussenuitspraak in staat worden gesteld alsnog tot een rechtmatig besluit te komen, zodat de bestuursrechter met zijn einduitspraak het geschil definitief kon beslechten.
d: adopting amending decision to a route decision while appeal pending
adopting amending decision to a road adaptation decision while appeal pending
municipal council adopting amending zoning plan while appeal pending
p: Artikel 15a, eerste en derde lid (Tracéwet); artikel 9a (Spoedwet wegverbreding); artikel 8.4a (Wro)

Allows the executive or municipal council to amend decisions during pending appeals, excluding the general preparation procedure (Awb afdeling 3.4) for minor changes and the bezwaar requirement, with the amendment open to challenge in the same appeal.

Gives the administrative court power to issue an interim ruling and set a remediation deadline, with the authority required to report in writing on how defects were remedied and parties able to respond.

parties: Supports speeding up infrastructure projects and wants the benefits to cover Tw and Wro projects as well as Sww projects.
The CDA members can agree with the choice not to limit the benefits the bill intends to projects falling under the Sww, but also to projects under the Tw and Wro.
De leden van de CDA-fractie kunnen instemmen met de keuze om de voordelen die het wetsvoorstel beoogt niet te beperken tot projecten die onder het bereik van de Sww vallen.
Asks whether the bestuurlijke lus gives the judge too much power over the administrator and why a separate regime is preferred over a general Awb rule.

Worries the bestuurlijke lus lets administrations repair careless decisions while citizens get no equivalent repair opportunity for formal errors, and asks about costs and participation of appellants.
It nevertheless remains strange that an administrative body that acted carelessly is given a second chance, while citizens making formal errors are offered no possibility of repair.

Het blijft echter vreemd dat een bestuursorgaan dat onzorgvuldig gehandeld heeft een herkansing geboden krijgt, terwijl burgers bij het maken van vormfouten geen enkele mogelijkheid tot herstel wordt geboden.
Supports the proposed changes but asks who counts as an interested party and whether the bestuurlijke lus in appeal applies only when the judge chooses it.
Does this mean the bestuurlijke lus is only applied in appeal if the judge chooses to?
Betekent dit dat de bestuurlijke lus alleen wordt toegepast in hoger beroep als de rechter daarvoor kiest?
No objection to faster procedures but insists on careful procedure and unimpaired citizens' right to judicial review of decisions; asks for guarantees that interested parties are informed.
The right of citizens and civil society organisations to have decisions reviewed by the judge against, for example, air quality or nature laws may in no way be impaired.

Het recht van burgers en maatschappelijke organisaties om besluiten door de rechter te laten toetsen aan bijvoorbeeld wetten op het gebied van luchtkwaliteit of natuur mag op geen enkele manier aangetast worden.

Supports allowing interim repair of defects but asks for proportionality given citizens' interests, reasonable repair deadlines, limits on extensions, and possible undermining of the corrective effect of annulment.
The ChristenUnie members ask for the proportionality of the proposals to be further justified, since the citizen, who often has more interest in annulment, may be harmed in his interests.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de proportionaliteit van de voorstellen nader te beargumenteren, nu de burger, die veelal meer belang heeft bij vernietiging van een uitspraak, in zijn belangen kan worden geschaad.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill amending the Tracéwet, Spoedwet wegverbreding and Wet ruimtelijke ordening to speed up appeal procedures, raising concerns about the need for the proposed 'bestuurlijke lus', the lack of a problem analysis, unclear effectiveness, and the proposed ex-tunc exception. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points, deleted the provisions on repair decisions and new evidence, and defended the remaining provisions.
concerns: The Council found no problem analysis showing the bestuurlijke lus was needed and questioned its effectiveness; the reply added explanation on effectiveness but did not add a full analysis.
Provisions on repair decisions (herstelbesluit) raised concerns about publication, participation of appellants and legal certainty, and were deleted.
Ex-tunc exception allowing new motivation to be introduced in appeal would weaken the position of appellants; the provision was deleted.
Simplified amendment decision (vereenvoudigd wijzigingsbesluit) needed limits to avoid harming non-participating parties; the reply added a restriction.
Several redactional comments on wording and cross-references were adopted.
The Council advised reconsidering the bestuurlijke lus in view of the parallel initiative bill; the reply rejected postponing the proposal, citing the need for a timely sector-specific regulation.

31555.s: The bill implements EU framework decision 2006/783/JBZ on mutual recognition of confiscation orders by inserting a new chapter into the Dutch Wet wederzijdse erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke sancties, covering recognition and enforcement of foreign and Dutch confiscation decisions. It sets mandatory and optional refusal grounds, rules on conflicts, appeals to the Leeuwarden district court, asset sharing and cost sharing, with the Minister of Justice given discretion on cost sharing and asset distribution.
31555.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and discretionary powers by the need to implement the EU framework decision efficiently under the principle of mutual recognition, and by the practicality of cost and asset-sharing arrangements.
q: A substitute sanction may only be enforced if it was already imposed with the confiscation decision by the judge in the issuing Member State.
Een vervangende sanctie mag alleen ten uitvoer worden gelegd indien deze reeds bij de beslissing tot confiscatie door de rechter in de uitvaardigende lidstaat is opgelegd.
d: rules on distribution of confiscated assets
Artikel 25 / 24, lid 2 (lijst van feiten bij AMvB)
list of offences exempt from double criminality check
p: Artikel 28, lid 5 en 29 (minister en officier van justitie)
The Minister of Justice may agree with the issuing state to divide confiscated assets differently from the statutory rules, without parliamentary approval.
The Minister of Justice may consent to sharing enforcement costs with another state where costs are high or exceptional, a discretionary power.
Mandatory and optional refusal grounds protect persons against enforcement of foreign confiscation orders, subject to appeal to the court.

parties: Asks whether owners of confiscated property have effective legal remedies and whether refusal grounds can be applied reasonably.
These legal remedies cannot be lodged against the substantive grounds of the decision, but only against the decision on recognition and enforcement taken by the competent authority.

Deze rechtsmiddelen kunnen niet worden ingesteld tegen de materiële gronden van de beslissing, maar alleen tegen de door de bevoegde autoriteit genomen beslissing tot erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging ervan.
Questions the absolute exclusion of judicial review of the foreign judgment and the narrow, limitative refusal grounds leaving prosecutors little discretion.
The explanatory memorandum even states that the chamber of the court in no case enters into assessment of the judgment from the other Member State.
In de memorie van toelichting staat zelfs dat de raadkamer van de rechtbank in geen geval in de beoordeling van het vonnis uit de andere lidstaat treedt.
Asks who qualifies as an interested party, which deadlines apply to complaints, and whether the court can declare complaints manifestly unfounded.
Can the government indicate which time limits apply to filing a request or complaint?
Kan de regering aangeven welke termijnen er gelden ten aanzien van het indienen van een verzoek-/klaagschrift?

31564.s: The bill removes the facility services task (procurement and sale of weaponry, equipment and clothing for the police) from the Korps landelijke politiediensten by deleting article 38(1)(d) of the Politiewet 1993, effective 1 January 2009. The explanatory memorandum argues that existing regulatory instruments under article 49 already secure uniformity, quality and oversight of the state's monopoly on force.
31564.j: The memorandum justifies removing the task by saying that control over uniformity, quality and the monopoly on force is still ensured through the existing powers under article 49 of the Politiewet 1993.
q: Responsibilities for weaponry, clothing and equipment of the police of the Ministers of the Interior and of Justice, particularly regarding uniformity, quality and oversight of the monopoly on force, are and remain sufficiently guaranteed by the aforementioned powers under article 49 of the Police Act 1993.

De verantwoordelijkheden voor bewapening, kleding en uitrusting van de politie van de Ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie, met name ten aanzien van uniformiteit, kwaliteit en het toezicht op het geweldsmonopolie, zijn en blijven voldoende gewaarborgd

parties: Asks whether the vtsPN is ready for the transferred tasks, whether staff move over, whether forced dismissals occur, and what efficiency gains are expected.
However, these members ask whether the vtsPN is ready for this task.
Wel vragen deze leden of de vtsPN klaar is voor deze taak.
Supports optimal cooperation and efficiency gains, asks for the timing of the transfer and how gains will flow back into the organisation.
The VVD members support the aim of optimal cooperation and improving the joint functioning of police forces.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven het streven naar een optimale samenwerking en het verbeteren van het gemeenschappelijk functioneren van politiekorpsen.
Believes logistical and facility services of the KLPD should be outsourced to external parties as far as possible.
The PVV members are of the view that logistical and facility services of the KLPD should as far as possible be outsourced to external parties.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn van mening dat logistieke en facilitaire diensten van het KLPD zoveel mogelijk moeten worden uitbesteed aan externe partijen.

31700-III.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet (Kabinet der Koningin) and the Intelligence and Security Services Oversight Committee (CTIVD), totalling about EUR 64.1 million, EUR 2.3 million and EUR 1.1 million respectively, plus the Publiek en Communicatie agency budget. It also temporarily allows separate budget statements for the Royal Cabinet and the CTIVD and assigns budget management and operational responsibility for them to the Prime Minister for 2009, pending amendment of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
31700-III.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the temporary arrangement as an interim measure, in line with a prior letter to parliament, pending a future amendment of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
q: Article 4(4): Notwithstanding Article 19(5) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the Prime Minister is responsible for 2009 for managing the budget of the Royal Cabinet and of the Intelligence and Security Services Oversight Committee.

In afwijking van artikel 19, vijfde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 is Onze Minister-President, Minister van Algemene Zaken, voor het jaar 2009 verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de begroting van het Kabinet der Koningin en van de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
p: Makes the Prime Minister, rather than the usual minister, responsible for budget management and operations of the Royal Cabinet and the CTIVD for 2009, and disapplies certain Comptabiliteitswet provisions for the Royal Cabinet, a temporary arrangement limited to one budget year.

31717.s: The bill makes technical and editorial amendments to several Dutch tax laws, including the income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, VAT, collection and customs laws. Its main purpose, per the explanatory memorandum, is to bring many fiscal delegation provisions in line with the Jurgens motion, removing powers to deviate from statute by lower regulation.
31717.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the Jurgens motion, which asks government to stop using legislation that authorises lower legislators to make rules deviating from the statute, and states that no substantive change is intended.
q: In this bill, the vast majority of the identified delegation powers in fiscal legislation that allow deviation from the statute through lower regulation are amended.
In dit wetsvoorstel wordt het overgrote deel van de geïdentificeerde delegatiebevoegdheden in de fiscale wetgeving die afwijking van de wet bij lagere regelgeving mogelijk maken, aangepast.
d: content of public transport travel declarations
further rules on wage periods for certain employees
start and end of period for collection interest
Artikel XIV (art. 47 Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen)
hardship relief for groups of cases
Artikel XIII.3 (art. 14 lid 4 Wet belasting zware motorrijtuigen)
conditions for reduction of heavy vehicle tax

parties: Asks the government for an overview of remaining statutory delegation provisions that allow deviation from the law by lower regulation, and why they were not amended in this bill, in line with the Jurgens motion.
These members would like to receive an overview of these delegation provisions as well as an overview of upcoming bills in which these delegation provisions will be amended.
Graag ontvangen deze leden een overzicht van deze delegatiebepalingen alsook een overzicht van komende wetsvoorstellen waarbij deze delegatiebepalingen worden aangepast.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that several retroactive provisions in the Fiscale Onderhoudswet 2009 (tax maintenance bill) be removed, because they introduce burdensome obligations and penal provisions with retroactive effect. The State Secretary of Finance adopted the advice on all points and amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: Retroactive introduction of a penal provision linked to the employer's residence-status verification obligation is contrary to the legal system and should not take effect retroactively.
Retroactive extension of third-party recourse (derdenverhaal) and director liability under the Invorderingswet 1990 imposes burdensome obligations and should not take retroactive effect.
Technical and editorial improvements to the bill and explanatory memorandum were made, in line with the Council's general approach.

31726.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistraties adressen en gebouwen and the Kadasterwet to clarify object definitions, allow registration of unofficial addresses, buildings and moorings via official records of observed facts, and move several detailed rules from general administrative orders to ministerial regulations. It also assigns the Kadaster responsibility for the national facility for the address and building registers and sets its liability.
31726.j: The memorandum justifies the shift of detailed rules to ministerial regulation by their predominantly technical character and need for frequent amendment.
q: the rules to be given on this subject, insofar as necessary, will be predominantly of a technical implementation nature
de omtrent dit onderwerp, voor zover noodzakelijk, te geven regels overwegend van uitvoeringstechnische aard zullen zijn
d: administrative organisation of address and building registers
technical and administrative organisation of registrations
inspection and disclosure of register data
execution of municipal audits, cost reimbursement, criteria for auditing firms
division, establishment and allocation of residential places and their demarcation
p: Municipalities must ensure that official records are drawn up for observed factual situations, extending state registration reach over unregistered addresses and buildings in the public interest of registration quality.
Artikel I E (art. 10, lid 1 onder b)

Designated officials may record facts on site, such as unofficial use of addresses, unregistered buildings or moorings, as authoritative source documents without a formal permit, expanding administrative fact-finding powers over residents.
Artikel I P (art. 32, lid 1 onder b)
Access to the national facility is extended to administrative bodies and other recipients, with restrictions on personal data set by general order.
The Kadaster is made liable for errors in operating the national facility, with exclusion of liability for inaccurate third-party data, providing a remedy to affected citizens.

parties: Asks why the wetswijziging is so complex, whether buildings and addresses without source documents are subject to any supervision, and how the proces-verbaal relates to the schriftelijke verklaring and to the duty to give inspection to anyone.
Is there no supervision over this?
Is hier geen toezicht op gehouden?
Asks how the independent admission audit is composed and who appoints its members, and under what conditions other users may gain access to the national facility.
How is this independent admission audit composed? By whom are these persons appointed?
Hoe is deze onafhankelijke «toelatingsaudit» samengesteld? Door wie worden deze personen benoemd?

31735.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the 2007 EU-US agreement on the transfer of airline passenger name record (PNR) data to the US Department of Homeland Security, together with the accompanying exchange of letters and declaration. The explanatory memorandum assesses the agreement's consistency with privacy rights, data protection law and the Constitution, and records the Dutch government's intention to press for review mechanisms and clearer passenger information.
31735.j: The memorandum justifies approval by noting that the agreement creates obligations directly affecting the Netherlands, its airlines and passengers, and that a legal gap would otherwise arise, while relying on EU competence under Articles 24 and 38 TEU.
q: The Dutch Data Protection Authority (Cbp) is positive that the Netherlands intends to press the European Commission for multiple review points, rather than a single evaluation over the agreement's full seven-year term.

Het Cbp is positief over het feit dat Nederland zich bij de Europese Commissie wil inzetten voor meerdere toetsmomenten, in plaats van één evaluatiemoment gedurende de totale looptijd van de PNR-Overeenkomst 2007 (7 jaar).

parties: Accepts the value of PNR data against terrorism but questions the many open points, effectiveness, and how citizens can obtain redress and how the DHS use of data is monitored.
The CDA members regret that the PNR Agreement still contains a large number of uncertainties about the further elaboration of various elements and the interpretation of certain concepts.

De leden van de CDA-fractie betreuren het dat de PNR-Overeenkomst op dit moment nog een groot aantal onzekerheden kent over de nadere uitwerking van verschillende elementen en de invulling van bepaalde begrippen.
Considers the agreement has serious shortcomings in legal protection, undefined purposes and recipients, and wants clear evaluation and redress for passengers.
Nevertheless they believe the current treaty still has considerable shortcomings.
Toch zijn zij van mening dat het huidige verdrag nog flinke tekortkomingen heeft.
Sees purposes as far too broad, sensitive data handling unclear, passenger rights insufficient, and asks whether the government is faced with a fait accompli.
The SP members ask the government whether it sees itself confronted with this agreement as a fait accompli.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of zij zich met deze overeenkomst eigenlijk voor een voldongen feit geplaatst ziet.
Supports counter-terrorism cooperation but finds the agreement weaker and vaguer than the interim one, asking for concretisation of broad purposes and clarity on sensitive data and passenger rights.
The VVD members note that the present agreement is in several respects weaker and less clear than the interim agreement.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat voorliggende overeenkomst in een aantal opzichten zwakker en minder duidelijk is dan de interim-overeenkomst.
Sees the bill as a substantial curtailment of personal data protection under US pressure and questions the need for the long retention period and the purpose wording.
These members note that this bill means a broad restriction of personal data protection, brought about largely under US pressure.
Deze leden constateren dat dit wetsvoorstel een ruime inperking betekent van de bescherming van de persoonsgegevens, die in belangrijke mate tot stand komt onder druk van de VS.
Criticises the undemocratic process with limited parliamentary involvement, the unproven necessity of mass data collection, the open purpose formulation and weak legal protection of citizens.
In particular they regret the lack of parliamentary involvement in setting the negotiating mandate and in the negotiations.
Met name de gebrekkige betrokkenheid van het parlement bij het vaststellen van het onderhandelingsmandaat en de onderhandelingen betreuren zij.

v.summary: The Council of State advises on the bill approving the 2007 EU-US PNR agreement, criticising the lack of reciprocity and vague purpose limitations, retention and data-protection safeguards, and passenger rights. The government reply largely follows the advice on purposes, sensitive data, passenger rights and transfers, but rejects the call for independent oversight of dormant data and the addition to the explanatory memorandum on retention.
concerns: Purpose limitations for legal proceedings and other legally prescribed cases are too broad and undefined, undermining purpose limitation under data protection law.
The criterion 'exceptional case' for processing sensitive personal data is insufficiently defined to show necessity for a weighty public interest.
Passengers cannot directly derive rights from the agreement and enforceability of US privacy law for EU citizens is uncertain, so the level of passenger rights is inadequate.
Broad onward transfers to numerous US agencies and third countries, and undefined 'emergency situations', lack adequate justification and safeguards.
The eight-year dormant retention period effectively extends retention and should be subject to prior independent review of access in concrete cases.
The inclusion of all payment and billing data, including credit card and account numbers, lacks justification as necessary for the purpose.
The lack of reciprocity in the agreement is insufficiently justified given the stated importance of passenger data for counterterrorism, and the reciprocity obligation is too vague.
An early evaluation of the transfer of European PNR data to the US is necessary and should be pursued in EU channels.

31771.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2007/2/EC (INSPIRE) by requiring public bodies and designated third parties to create metadata, link spatial datasets and services to a national network, and make them accessible through a geoportal and national access point. It sets rules on interoperability, access restrictions, and fees, largely deferring technical detail to general administrative measures (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
31771.j: The memorandum justifies the broad use of general administrative measures by the difficulty of implementing the directive's wide scope and because implementing rules will not all be finalised by the entry-into-force date.
d: designation of thematic categories of spatial data covered by the act
categories of metadata and rules for drawing up and updating metadata
interoperability and harmonisation requirements for coupling datasets and services to the network
procedure and documents for third-party requests to couple data to the network
rules on network services and search criteria
rules on exchanging environmental spatial data between public bodies
further rules on fees and tariff systems for services
further rules on fees for exchanging data
designation of agencies to manage national access point and network
p: Allows public bodies to charge fees for certain data services where needed to maintain datasets, with the amount to be set by general administrative measure.
Makes application of the act to datasets subject to third-party intellectual property conditional on that party's consent.

parties: Asks whether fees for access could be passed on to users and how this fits the goal of low-threshold public access.
With the wording that it must be shown that the fee is necessary for managing the data, these costs could later be passed on to users.
Met de formulering:dat hierbij dient te worden aangetoond dat de vergoeding noodzakelijk is voor het beheer van de gegevens, kunnen deze kosten straks doorberekend worden aan gebruikers.
Questions whether the costs and efforts of digitisation and harmonisation outweigh the benefits, and asks for a cost-benefit analysis.
Is the government willing to carry out a societal cost-benefit analysis for this?
Is de regering bereid hiervoor een maatschappelijke kosten- en baten analyse uit te voeren?
Opposes regulating more than EU law requires unless truly necessary, and asks which provisions go beyond the directive and why.
The VVD members are generally not in favour of regulating more in Dutch law when implementing EC directives than those directives necessarily require, unless it is truly necessary.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn er in het algemeen geen voorstander van dat er bij de implementatie van EG-richtlijnen in de Nederlandse wetgeving meer wordt geregeld dan ingevolge die richtlijnen noodzakelijk is, tenzij het écht nodig is.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the INSPIRE implementation bill but advised clarifying access conditions for third parties in Article 7, specifying the environmental scope in Article 10, and tightening the fee-regulation power in Article 12. The minister's reply accepted these points, removed the extra conditions in Article 7, added the environmental limitation and missing international-body reference, and made the other adjustments.
concerns: Article 12(4) delegation to an AMvB on fees could not reasonably cover introducing a tariff system, so the wording was tightened and supplemented.
Redactional remarks in the annex, including deleting the article headings and adding 'ruimtelijke' in Article 2, were incorporated.
Clauses in Article 7 allowing extra conditions and withdrawal of third-party access in the interest of network functioning lacked a basis in the Directive and were removed.
The environmental limitation in Article 10 was missing from the statutory text and was added to specify the scope of the provision.

31780.s: The bill amends the Wajong disability benefit law to replace the old benefit for young disabled people with a work-and-support scheme (werk en arbeidsondersteuning), adding a new chapter 1A on participation plans, wage subsidies, workplace facilities, income support and stricter activation duties. It also gives UWV broad rule-making and control powers, with many details left to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
31780.j: The memorandum justifies new duties and controls by the rapid growth of Wajong claims and the aim of promoting work, and it notes that control rules must not exceed what is strictly necessary.
q: Control rules must not go further than strictly necessary for the correct implementation of this chapter.
Deze voorschriften gaan niet verder dan strikt noodzakelijk is voor een juiste uitvoering van dit hoofdstuk.
d: rules on work capacity and full incapacity assessment for groups
rules on determining income from work
rules on information duties and cooperation
categories of persons serving sentences outside prisons
subsidy conditions and subsidy ceiling for wage subsidies
rules on workplace and transport facilities
subsidies for training disabled people with serious barriers
exemption of groups from re-integration duties for a set period
temporary exemption from the duty to seek work
date from which duties apply to students
categories, amount and payment of supplementary allowance
date when maximum income support drops to 70% of minimum wage
p: Gives UWV broad power to demand information, summon, examine and require attendance from beneficiaries and employers.
Allows UWV to end entitlement on its own decision at the beneficiary's request without further safeguards.
UWV may set aside the residence exclusion where refusal would cause an unfair result of overriding nature.
Imposes broad activation and work-seeking duties with consequences set partly by UWV and partly by later rules.
Requires yearly UWV reassessment of fully incapacitated persons with low recovery chances.
UWV reassesses residual earning capacity after seven years of benefit and age 27.
UWV may suspend payments on suspicion alone, based on 'clear indications' or a 'reasonable suspicion'.
UWV can recover overpayments and impose sanctions, with reduced sanction options depending on fault.

parties: Asks how the boundary between the Wajong and school work-learning obligations is drawn and whether entry criteria are sharp enough to separate those with and without structural disability.

Is the criterion for admission to the Wajong (young person cannot independently earn 75% of the statutory minimum wage) sharp enough to distinguish young people with and without structural disability?

Is het criterium op grond waarvan toelating tot de Wajong plaatsvindt (jongere kan niet zelfstandig 75% van het WML verdienen) scherp genoeg om onderscheid te maken tussen jongeren mét en zonder structurele beperking?

Worries about the imbalance between rights and obligations for future Wajong beneficiaries, asks whether UWV must always impose sanctions without considering circumstances, and asks for quick resolution of objections and appeals.
The PvdA members ask the government why UWV must always impose a sanction without being allowed to take specific circumstances into account.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering waarom UWV altijd een sanctie moet opleggen, zonder dat rekening mag worden gehouden met specifieke omstandigheden.

Argues that sanctions and the participation agreement may be too harsh for people with intellectual or psychiatric disabilities and asks for independent expert assessment and prior consultation before sanctions, and that sanctions wait until objections are decided.
The SP members are of the view that a sanction may only be imposed after any objection has been rejected.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat een sanctie pas mag worden opgelegd nadat een eventueel bezwaar is afgewezen.

Asks whether a Wajong beneficiary can enforce a work or study offer through a court and how a judge would assess what is suitable, and questions the enforceability of the obligation given unfilled seasonal work.
Whether a Wajong beneficiary can, under this bill, demand that UWV make a suitable work or study offer.
Of een Wajonggerechtigde op grond van dit wetsvoorstel kan eisen dat het UWV een passend werk- of leeraanbod doet.
Asks who will decide who is eligible, how a clear line on work potential is drawn, and how psychiatric conditions are assessed, raising assessment-consistency concerns.
The PVV members ask who, under this amendment, will assess who is or is not entitled to a Wajong benefit or income support.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen wie met de invoering van deze wetswijziging beoordeelt wie wel of geen recht heeft op een Wajonguitkering of inkomensvoorziening.
Asks why a disabled young person must accept any generally accepted work and has little room to search for suitable work.

The GroenLinks members ask the government to explain why a disabled young person must, regarding suitable work, immediately accept generally accepted work and is given hardly any room to search for suitable work.

De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen de regering toe te lichten waarom de jonggehandicapte, als het gaat om passende arbeid, direct maatschappelijk algemeen aanvaard werk moet accepteren en nauwelijks zoekruimte krijg naar passende arbeid?
Worries that the bill's strict supervision and sanctions regime may backfire, and asks why no objection/appeal procedure or right to be heard is included.
The ChristenUnie members are also concerned about the rights of young people and ask the government why no objection and appeal procedure and right to be heard has been included in the bill.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie maken zich daarnaast zorgen over de rechten van de jongeren. Zij vragen de regering waarom er geen bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure en inspraakrecht is opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether existing beneficiaries should fall under the new law, and proposes a wage-supplement model to make work more rewarding; focus is on design rather than checks on the executive.
The SGP members ask whether this is not precisely an argument for bringing these Wajong beneficiaries under the new law.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of dit juist niet een argument is dat ervoor pleit om deze Wajonggerechtigden juist wel onder de nieuwe wet te laten vallen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Wajong disability benefits law aimed at promoting work participation of young disabled persons, supporting its aim but questioning the long transitional regime keeping the old scheme alive, the intake approach, the effectiveness of instruments, and risks of displacement and permanent state support. The government's nader rapport defends the transitional choice, the activation focus, and the periodic reassessment mechanism, and makes minor drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the lengthy parallel existence of old and new schemes and asked for a convincing motivation of the transitional regime, which the government expanded in the explanatory memorandum while keeping acquired-rights (eerbiedigende) effect.

The Afdeling doubted the effectiveness of the proposal given the generous benefit regime and the rising intake of people with mild disabilities, asking how intake could be reduced; the government responded that intake criteria should not be tightened but will review the mild-condition assessment practice.

The Afdeling raised concerns about overlapping subsidised-work instruments across Wajong and the Wet werk en bijstand and risks of displacement and permanent public support; the government argued these are matters for the broader WSW reform discussion and that jobcarving creates new jobs.

The Afdeling asked for periodic reassessment of people beyond age 27 rather than treating that assessment as final; the government pointed to existing professional re-assessment and possibility of re-assessment at UWV's or the claimant's request, and expanded the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling made several redactional comments in an annex, which the government adopted in the bill, including changes to articles on references and wording and removal of articles 5.8.16 and 5.8.17.

31816.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Reiderland, Scheemda and Winschoten into a new municipality called Oldambt, effective from the date of reorganisation. It makes consequential amendments to the judicial districts act, the police act and the safety regions provisions, and assigns transitional roles such as an interim council election to the former Winschoten.
31816.j: The memorandum states the reorganisation was initiated by the municipalities themselves and gives no justification for any delegation or new powers.
q: The reorganisation advice was initiated by the municipalities.
Het herindelingsadvies is door de gemeenten geïnitieerd.

parties: Asks whether the lack of objections means there is no opposition, whether alternatives were considered, and whether the merger is the last one for these municipalities.
May it be concluded from this that the proposed merger is broadly supported among the population, these members ask.
Mag hieruit de conclusie worden getrokken dat de voorgenomen herindeling onder de bevolking breed gedragen wordt, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether neighbouring municipalities' views were properly reported, in particular Menterwolde's, and whether the broader reorganisation criterion was applied.
It is not clear to the PvdA members, however, whether the neighbouring municipality Menterwolde responded and, if so, what its comments were.](clarification needed)
Het is de leden van de PvdA-fractie evenwel niet duidelijk of de buurgemeenten Menterwolde heeft gereageerd en zo ja, wat de opmerkingen van die gemeente waren?
Questions whether mergers are driven by residents' wishes or by decentralisation policy, doubts the measured support, and asks what happens if the expected savings fail.
Does it share these members' concern that mergers are not so much driven by the wishes of residents but by the government's chosen decentralisation policy?
Deelt zij de zorg van deze leden dat herindelingen niet zozeer worden ingegeven door de wens van de bewoners, maar door het door de regering gekozen beleid van decentralisering?
Questions how the government establishes that the merger is truly voluntary given the provincial advice to merge, and asks for transparent calculations of the allocation.

Given the advice from the Groningen provincial executive to merge, these members do wonder how precisely the government establishes whether there is genuinely voluntariness among the municipalities concerned.

Gezien de advisering door het college van GS van Groningen om te herindelen, vragen deze leden zich wel af hoe precies door de regering wordt vastgesteld of er wel echt sprake is van vrijwilligheid bij de betrokken gemeenten.

31870.s: The bill lowers the permitted blood alcohol limits for shipping in the Scheepvaartverkeerswet and makes several technical amendments to related shipping, port security, North Sea incident response and inland shipping capacity laws. It also lets the Minister designate supervisors beyond special investigating officers, removes the parliamentary pre-announcement procedure for AMvBs that only implement CCR decisions, and shifts the North Sea incident rules from royal decree to ministerial regulation.
31870.j: The memorandum justifies the supervisor designation power by the need for adequate supervision beyond the limited number of special investigating officers, and the CCR change by avoiding unnecessary delay for rules with no expected need for statutory regulation.
q: Therefore it is proposed, by amending article 52, first paragraph, to exclude from the operation of that paragraph a draft general administrative order containing only provisions implementing a CCR decision.

Derhalve wordt voorgesteld, door wijziging van artikel 52, eerste lid, een ontwerp van een algemene maatregel van bestuur die uitsluitend bepalingen bevat ter implementatie van een besluit van de CCR van de werking van dat artikellid uit te sluiten.
d: designation of supervisors other than special investigating officers
requirements on supervisors' knowledge and conduct of duties
designation of the applicable passenger ship safety directive
IV (Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee art. 11, lid 1)
rules for combating consequences of North Sea incidents, replacing royal decree
p: Removes the pre-announcement and parliamentary submission procedure for draft AMvBs that only implement CCR decisions.
IV (Wet bestrijding ongevallen Noordzee art. 11, lid 1)
Moves rules on North Sea incident response from royal decree to ministerial regulation, reducing formal government-level review.
Allows the Minister to designate non-police supervisors, including municipal, provincial and water board officials, but only on proposal of and in agreement with those authorities.

parties: Asks whether stricter cargo-declaration penalties and the lower alcohol limit can be enforced without straining other enforcement tasks, and why enforcement rather than penalties was not chosen.
Asks how Parliament can be involved in the making of CCR decisions and whether other CCR member states approved the stricter rules for small inland vessels.
These members want to know how the Chamber can be involved in the making of CCR decisions.
Deze leden willen graag weten op welke wijze de Kamer betrokken kan worden bij de totstandkoming van CCR-besluiten.
Opposes simplifying the codification of CCR decisions because it reduces national democratic control, input and transparency, and asks the government to press for more democratic input in the CCR.
Any reduction of national democratic control, input and transparency therefore certainly cannot count on the support of the SP members.
Het eventuele terugdringen van de nationale democratische controle, inspraak en transparantie kan daarom zeker niet op de steun van de leden van de SP-fractie rekenen.
Questions whether placing cargo-declaration and complaint duties under the Economic Offences Act is necessary and efficient, and doubts stricter penalties reduce violations.
These members therefore ask on what basis this amendment of the Economic Offences Act was chosen: is it necessary and, if so, what shows that?
Deze leden vragen daarom op grond waarvan voor deze wijziging van de Wet op de economische delicten is gekozen: is dit noodzakelijk en zo ja, waaruit blijkt dat?

31906.s: The bill lowers the annual subsidies that political parties receive under the Wet subsidiëring politieke partijen for 2009, 2010 and 2011 by specified percentages, and adjusts the financial reporting basis from cash accounting to accrual accounting. It also makes the amendment retroactive to 1 January 2009.
31906.j: The memorandum justifies the subsidy cuts by budget policy and notes that the Council of State advised considering retroactivity and the position of political parties, which led to the retroactive date being moved to 2009.
q: Following that advice, the retroactive effect of the proposal was adjusted and the subsidy cut planned for 2008 was dropped.
Naar aanleiding van dat advies is de terugwerkende kracht van het voorstel aangepast en is de voor het jaar 2008 voorziene subsidietaakstelling geschrapt.
d: annual indexation of subsidy amounts to budget wage and price adjustment

parties: Questions why a piecemeal subsidy cut is made instead of comprehensive party-financing rules, and asks for justification of the cut.
Would it not make more sense than an incidental, rather arbitrary cut?
Ligt dat niet meer in de rede dan een incidentele, nogal willekeurige bezuiniging?
Accepts the cut but wants a fundamental discussion on party positioning and regulation soon, and asks about timing of the new financing law.

They nonetheless feel, like the Council of State, the need for a more fundamental discussion between government and parliament, as soon as possible, on the position of political parties and the related regulation.

Wel voelen zij, net als de Raad van State, behoefte om zo snel mogelijk een fundamentelere discussie tussen regering en parlement te voeren over de positie van politieke partijen en de bijbehorende regelgeving.
Questions why a structural increase of EUR 500,000 for turnout activities is added at the same time as the subsidy cut, and why the 2008 cut was dropped.
Why does the government not share the view of these members that this decision to increase subsidies conflicts with the spirit and purpose of this amendment
Waarom deelt de regering niet de opvatting van deze leden dat dit besluit tot verhoging van de subsidies in strijd is met de geest en het doel van deze wetswijziging
Asks for clarification of the government's intention to treat the bill together with the new financing law, and how control over spending of the EUR 500,000 will take place.
How will the control over the spending of these funds take place?
Hoe zal de controle op de besteding van deze gelden plaatsvinden?
Argues that party subsidies should be abolished entirely because state funding undermines parties' independence and programmes.
The PVV members are of the view that political parties should not receive government subsidies.
De leden van de PVV zijn van mening dat politieke partijen geen overheidssubsidie mogen ontvangen.

Asks for justification of the cut against earlier arguments for raising subsidies, and for the impact on participation, research institutes and youth organisations; wants the new financing law handled promptly.
They ask the government to elaborate on the reduction of the subsidies in light of the earlier arguments for raising these subsidies.
Zij vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de verlaging van de subsidies in het licht van de eerdere argumentatie om deze subsidies juist te verhogen.
Asks why a recent substantial increase is partly reversed, what percentage general cuts are, and whether research supports the claim that party functioning is not at risk.
The SGP members ask how the government arrived at the claim that it may be assumed their functioning is not at stake.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen hoe de regering heeft kunnen komen tot de stelling dat aangenomen mag worden dat hun functioneren niet in het geding komt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises submitting the bill reducing party subsidies (cutting €12.1 million over 2008-2011) together with the planned replacement Wet financiering politieke partijen, and reconsidering its retroactive effect given the role of parties in democracy and GRECO criticism. The government's reply accepts removing retroactivity for 2008, leaves the bundling question to the Tweede Kamer, commits to re-submitting the revised Wfpp for advice, and adopts the drafting remark.
concerns: Retroactive effect of the bill should be reconsidered; the 2008 subsidy cut was removed in response.

Subsidy cut should be assessed in the broader context of the WSPP and the representative democracy, and submitted together with the replacement law; the government leaves this to the Tweede Kamer while agreeing to re-submit the revised Wfpp for advice.
Second sentence of article II, paragraph 2 should be deleted as redundant; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented accordingly.

31915.s: The bill amends the Dutch juvenile detention principles act and related laws to optimise enforcement of custodial youth sanctions, introducing a perspectief plan, changes to time-out, leave, scholarship/training programmes, complaint procedures, an experimentation power, and a mandatory post-detention aftercare framework for juveniles. It also shifts several decisions from the director to department heads and extends supervision and rules on children accompanying detained juveniles.
31915.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations on operational flexibility and efficiency, and the experimentation power on the need to allow new insights to be tested without immediate statutory change, with parliamentary control retained.
q: To maximally express the pedagogical character of the time-out measure and offer practice optimal clarity, I have chosen to provide the time-out measure with a specific statutory basis.

Om het pedagogische karakter van de time-outmaatregel maximaal tot uitdrukking te brengen en om aan de praktijk optimale duidelijkheid te bieden, heb ik er voor gekozen de time-outmaatregel van een specifieke wettelijke basis te voorzien.
d: director may authorise department heads to order exclusion from group and placement in isolation
further rules on placement and special purpose of institutions
rules on placement, transfer and procedure of juveniles and criteria for special units
temporary experimental rules departing from listed provisions of the Bjj
rules on nature and duration of aftercare supervision
rules on nature and scope of help and support to suspect under pre-trial detention
rules on keeping records of behaviour and incidents, with model
p: Allows the director to delegate decisions to exclude juveniles from groups and to place them in isolation to department heads, with notification of the director within fifteen hours.
Creates a power to depart temporarily by general administrative order from statutory protections for juveniles, subject to pre-consultation of parliament and a two-year limit.
Allows staff to exclude a juvenile from the group for up to one hour at a time, repeatedly up to two hours per day, with a register reviewed periodically with the supervisory commission.
Gives the Minister of Justice supervisory powers and access to records of juvenile detention facilities, including private ones.
Lists decisions subject to complaint procedure and adds a residual category, expanding legal protection for juveniles.
Extends mandatory aftercare for juveniles up to two years under conditions set administratively, with court review and possible return to a facility for up to one year on breach.

parties: Worries about possible arbitrary use of time-out measures given limited legal protection and asks for Inspectorate evaluation of the measure.
However, they share the concern voiced in several advisory opinions about possible improper or arbitrary use of the measure, given the more limited legal protection.
Daarbij delen zij echter de in enkele adviezen uitgesproken zorg over mogelijk oneigenlijk of willekeurig gebruik van de maatregel, mede gezien de beperktere rechtsbescherming.
Shares concerns that the time-out could become a disciplinary measure losing its pedagogical purpose and questions whether supervision is sufficient; asks why parents are not informed.
They do share the concerns of the Dutch Association for the Judiciary and the NOvA that the time-out could be used as a disciplinary measure, losing its pedagogical effect.

Wel delen deze leden de zorgen van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak (NVvR) en de NOvA dat de «time-out» gebruikt kan gaan worden als disciplinaire maatregel en dat hierbij het pedagogische effect verloren gaat.
Doubts that detention is a true last resort and questions the effectiveness of youth detention; also questions guarantees on the 77-hour norm and legal protection of youths.
The SP members doubt whether the government is sufficiently convinced that youth detention should be a last resort.
De leden van de SP-fractie betwijfelen of de regering voldoende doordrongen is van het feit dat jeugddetentie een ultimum remedium zou moeten zijn.
Asks how the safeguards that apply to order measures will be preserved for detainees when time-out is used more flexibly, and whether the complaints right offers protection.
They further want to hear to what extent and how the interests of the detainee remain safeguarded if the mentioned safeguards disappear.
Voorts willen zij graag horen in hoeverre en op welke wijze de belangen van de gedetineerde gewaarborgd blijven als de genoemde waarborgen verdwijnen.
Supports the legal basis for time-out but wants oneigenlijk use prevented and asks whether the register sufficiently shows its use.
These members ask the government to clarify whether the registration sufficiently shows for what reason the time-out measure was imposed and on whom, and whether improper use is really excluded.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten of de registratie voldoende inzichtelijk maakt waarvoor de time-out maatregel is opgelegd en aan wie en of daarmee oneigenlijk gebruik daadwerkelijk uitgesloten is.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill amending the Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen and related laws on execution of youth custodial sanctions, but advises clarifying the explanatory note on the residual complaint category in article 65(m), since serving a meal is factual conduct rather than a decision. The government reply accepts the advice, adjusts the explanatory note, and incorporates the editorial remarks, including reordering provisions on conditional termination.
concerns: The explanatory note on the residual complaint category in article 65(m) should be adjusted because the meal example describes factual conduct rather than a decision, which may cause confusion about scope.
Multiple editorial remarks on wording and cross-references in the bill text are proposed and were incorporated, with a minor deviation on terminology for conditional termination.

31924-IIA.s: This bill is a supplementary budget act (Slotwet) that adjusts the 2008 departmental budget of the Staten-Generaal (Parliament), setting realised expenditure and receipts against the original and supplementary estimates. The explanatory memorandum attributes the variances to delayed tenders, staffing shortages, higher parliamentary group costs and committee budget carry-overs.
q: The Eerste Kamer incurred lower costs in 2008 due to delays in the tender for the new security installation and website.
De Eerste Kamer heeft in 2008 minder kosten gemaakt als gevolg van de vertraging in de aanbesteding van de nieuwe beveiligingsinstallatie en website.

32123-III.s: The bill formally establishes the 2010 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the Public and Communication operating-enterprise), the Queen's Cabinet, and the Commission overseeing the intelligence and security services. It sets appropriations in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January 2010 or retroactively upon publication.
q: The present bill aims to establish the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Queen's Cabinet and the Commission overseeing the intelligence and security services for the year 2010.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om de begrotingsstaten van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken, van het Kabinet der Koningin en van de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten voor het jaar 2010 vast te stellen.

32176.s: The bill amends the primary, secondary, expertise-centre and adult/vocational education acts so that schools may use the personal identification number (persoonsgebonden nummer) of a pupil when exchanging enrolment, learning and support data, with the specific data to be set by general administrative order (AMvB). It also adjusts the BRON data-access provision in the Informatiseringsbank act, now moved into the education supervision act, to allow schools to obtain pupil data from the central education register.
32176.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for a continuous learning line and adequate care for pupils, and notes that the detailed data sets will be set by AMvB aligned with existing development projects.
q: By general administrative order the data referred to in the previous sentence may be specified.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen de gegevens, bedoeld in de vorige volzin, worden gespecificeerd.
d: Artikel I/II/III/IV (WVO 103b lid 7; WEB 2.3.6a lid 7 and 2.5.5a lid 9)
specification of learning and support data exchanged between schools
p: Artikel V/VI (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht 24f lid 1; former Wet verzelfstandiging Informatiseringsbank 9d lid 1)

Widens the categories of schools that may receive personal data from the central education register, extending access to data about pupils' earlier enrolments without a new consent requirement in the provision itself.

parties: Supports the legal basis but worries about privacy-sensitive data exchange and whether the open wording 'direct met het leren samenhangende begeleidingsgegevens' could be stretched; asks for more precise specification by law.
These caveats focus in particular on the exchange of privacy-sensitive information, a theme that is a constant concern of these members.
Deze kanttekeningen richten zich met name op de uitwisseling van privacygevoelige informatie, een thema dat de voortdurende zorg van de leden heeft.
Supports the bill but warns that the growing usefulness of the personal number raises misuse risks and wants expansion to be discussed with parliament first.
That is why it is good that expansion does not simply happen, but only after consultation with parliament.
Daarom is het goed dat uitbreiding niet zomaar gebeurt, maar dat dit alleen geschiedt nadat er overleg is geweest met het parlement.
Asks about security of networks and centrally stored data of minors under 18, and whether the government plans to store more such data centrally.
Is this government intending to centrally store even more data of young people under 18, the members ask.
Is deze regering voornemens nog meer gegevens van jongeren onder de 18 jaar centraal op te slaan, zo vragen de leden.
Asks about retention periods, parents' and pupils' rights to consent and access, and whether medical information is fully excluded.
However, the members ask whether medical information is fully excluded.
Wel vragen de leden of medische informatie volledig wordt uitgesloten.
Asks how pupil privacy is guaranteed, how the number is prevented from enabling exchange of information beyond the learning line, and whether parents can access and object to exchanged data.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill on using the personal identification number (persoonsgebonden nummer) for exchanging pupils' learning and guidance data is broadly supported but needs changes: clearer consent rules, a legal basis before data exchange starts, and a precise definition of guidance data in the delegation provisions. The government's reply largely accepts these points, adding a consent-evidence obligation, narrowing 'begeleidingsgegevens' to education-related guidance, and explaining data protection safeguards, while declining to write the consent requirement into the bill itself.
concerns: The Raad warned that expanding use of the personal number and linking data threatens privacy and the risk of unlawful use, and asked for an explanation of safeguards; the government explained the risks and safeguards in the explanatory memorandum but did not change the bill's approach substantially.

Data exchange of learning and guidance data was already occurring without the statutory basis required by article 24 Wbp; the Raad advised against proceeding until a legal basis existed, while the government chose to proceed given the limited and manageable privacy harm.

The Raad required the consent requirement to be concretely specified and enforceable, including how consent from pupils aged sixteen and over is handled; the government added a duty to retain a declaration of consent but did not write the consent requirement into the bill, relying on the Wbp.

The Raad found the term 'begeleidingsgegevens' too broad and privacy-sensitive for delegation to an AMvB without statutory specification; the government narrowed the term to guidance directly related to learning in the bill text.

The Raad suggested deleting a reference in article 43 of the Wet op de expertisecentra; the government did not adopt this editorial comment, explaining the extension to transfers to regular schools is desirable.
The Raad asked for the explanatory memorandum to explain the expanding use of the personal number and the privacy risks; the government revised the explanatory memorandum accordingly.

32185.s: The bill amends the Telecommunications Act to set the retention period for telecommunications data on internet access, internet e-mail and internet telephony at six months, with telephony data kept for twelve months. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: six months for data relating to internet access, internet e-mail and internet telephony
zes maanden voor gegevens in verband met internettoegang, e-mail over het internet en internettelefonie

parties: Prefers a longer retention period of at least twelve months for criminal investigations and considers the government's six-month justification not fully convincing.
The CDA members do not find the government's argument for a six-month retention period for internet providers entirely convincing.
De argumentatie van de regering voor een bewaartermijn van zes maanden voor aanbieders van internetdiensten achten deze leden niet geheel overtuigend.
Can agree with the six-month period for internet data for proportionality reasons but asks why the whole retention period was not reduced to six months, questioning the government's reasoning.
These members can agree with this proposal but would have preferred the entire retention period for all retained data to be reduced to six months.
Deze leden kunnen instemmen met dit voorstel maar hadden liever gezien dat de gehele bewaartermijn voor alle bewaarde gegevens naar 6 maanden zou worden gebracht.

Recalls that parliament never wanted the EU data retention directive and questions the effectiveness and necessity of retaining old internet traffic data, asking for evidence on whether data older than six months is needed.
The most important question is, in short, how many criminals are caught by retaining old data and whether there is in practice a need for data older than six months.

De belangrijkste vraag is toch, kort gezegd, hoeveel boeven worden gevangen door het bewaren van oude gegevens en of er in de praktijk wel of geen behoefte bestaat aan gegevens die ouder zijn dan zes maanden?

Opposes differentiating retention periods between fixed/mobile telephony and internet-based telephony and would prefer eighteen months, citing the need for twelve months in international investigations.
They are however not in favour of differentiating the retention period for data on fixed telephony and on internet, including internet telephony.
Zij zijn echter niet voor een differentiatie in de bewaartermijn voor gegevens met betrekking tot vaste telefonie en inzake internet, inclusief de internettelefonie.
Asks for clarification of the distinction between telephony types and why police make little use of internet communication data, and whether a shorter period could increase internet use by offenders.
Could the shorter retention period not precisely lead to a stronger increase in the use of internet?
Zou de kortere bewaartermijn van gegevens er niet juist toe kunnen leiden dat het gebruik van internet sterker zal toenemen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the draft amendment shortening the retention period for internet, email and internet telephony data to six months, versus twelve months for fixed and mobile telephony, be supplemented, since the rationale for the differentiation is unclear and the Erasmus study recommended equal periods. The government responded that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented, including on the operational position of internet providers, and that the point will be considered at the upcoming evaluation.
concerns: The Raad questioned why internet-based telephony data is retained for a shorter period than classic telephony data, noting the Erasmus study recommended equal periods and the explanatory memorandum gives no adequate justification.
The Raad advised supplementing the explanatory memorandum and noted that the provider-distrust argument is temporary and should be revisited at the upcoming evaluation.
