q: The Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen is designated as the central authority under Article 4 of the Convention and Article 49 of the Regulation.
Als centrale autoriteit als bedoeld in artikel 4 van het verdrag en artikel 49 van de verordening wordt aangewezen het Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen.

parties: Asks whether the Administrative Cooperation Working Group gives sufficient assurance that central authorities comply with the convention, given past problems with child abduction cases.
In the government's view, does the establishment of this Working Group provide sufficient guarantee of compliance with the convention by central authorities of the contracting parties?
Biedt naar het oordeel van de regering de instelling van deze Working Group voldoende waarborg op naleving van het verdrag door centrale autoriteiten van verdragspartijen?
Asks how compliance with procedural rules can be enforced, since the Raad voor de rechtspraak raised the absence of sanctions for failure to supplement documents.
Can the government indicate how compliance with the procedural rules can then be enforced in such cases?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe in bedoelde gevallen naleving van de procesvoorschriften dan wel kan worden afgedwongen?
Objects that foreign maintenance decisions cannot be challenged or even marginally reviewed for reasonableness, and asks why Nederland did not use the public-order reservation under article 24.
Why is there no possibility at all to review the reasonableness of a maintenance claim?
Waarom is er geen enkele mogelijkheid de redelijkheid van een alimentatieclaim te toetsen?

32626.s: The bill amends the Dutch energy-efficiency implementation act to extend its coverage from appliances and installations to energy-related products, aligning definitions with Directive 2010/30/EU. It adds powers for supervisory officials to ban or withdraw non-compliant products from the market and renumbers the act's title and provisions.
32626.j: The memorandum justifies the broadened delegation and the new ban power as needed to implement the directive, and notes the Netherlands pressed for attention to administrative burden in drafting delegated acts.
q: Part G of the bill implements the possibility that supervisory officials prohibit the marketing or use of products not complying with delegated acts, or order that they be withdrawn from the market.

Onderdeel G Onderdeel H implementeert de mogelijkheid dat de toezichthoudende ambtenaren verbieden dat producten die niet voldoen aan de gedelegeerde handelingen in de handel worden gebracht of in gebruik genomen worden, dan wel te bevelen dat deze uit de handel worden genomen.
d: ARTIKEL I, G (artikel 33, derde lid, onderdeel d)
supervisory officials prohibiting or ordering withdrawal of non-compliant product groups
p: ARTIKEL I, G (artikel 33, derde lid, onderdeel d)

Supervisory officials gain power to prohibit marketing or use of non-compliant energy-related products and to order their withdrawal, a market-regulation power with limited scope and no stated judicial or parliamentary check.

parties: Asks whether the legal scope of 'zaak' has been examined and whether the AMvB on administrative burdens will be submitted to Actal and presented to the House.

Is the government willing to submit the AMvB determining for which new energy-related products delegated acts will be drawn up to the Advisory Board on Administrative Burdens (Actal) for review and to send Actal's advice to the House of Representatives?

Is de regering bereid de AMvB die bepaalt voor welke nieuwe energiegerelateerde producten gedelegeerde handelingen worden opgesteld, voor toetsing voor te leggen aan het Adviescollege vermindering administratieve lasten (Actal) en het advies van Actal aan de Tweede Kamer te doen toekomen?
Asks under which conditions supervisory officials may prohibit products that do not comply with delegated acts, and what the government's position is on the scope of the labelling directive.
Under what conditions can supervisory officials decide to prohibit a product that does not comply with the delegated acts?
Onder welke voorwaarden kunnen toezichthoudende ambtenaren besluiten om een product dat niet aan de gedelegeerde handelingen voldoet te verbieden?
Sees the extension as potentially positive but insists on seeing the draft AMvB with delegated acts before further debate, and asks whether it will be submitted to the House.
The SP members would appreciate having the text of the amendment to the general administrative order referred to in the bill before further consideration takes place.

De leden van de SP-fractie zouden het op prijs stellen wanneer zij zouden beschikken over de tekst van de wijziging van de algemene maatregel van bestuur waar in het wetsvoorstel naar verwezen wordt, voordat de verdere behandeling plaatsvindt.

32752.s: The bill establishes rules on the administration, public disclosure and limits of contributions to political parties, and replaces the Wet subsidiëring politieke partijen with a new financing act. It sets subsidy criteria, reporting and audit duties, a ministerial supervision role with administrative fines, and related amendments to the Mediawet 2008.
32752.j: The memorandum justifies the minister's supervisory role by the objective, detailed nature of the rules leaving little policy discretion, and by avoiding state interference in party political judgement.
q: This implies that there is little or no policy discretion in supervising compliance with these rules.
Dit impliceert dat er bij het toezicht op de naleving van deze voorschriften niet of nauwelijks beleidsruimte is.
d: which goods or services count as in-kind contributions and valuation rules
further rules on recording debt details
requirements for subsidy application plans, budgets and membership counts
format of reports and scope and reporting of audits
further rules on the height of administrative fines
minister designates persons charged with supervision
p: The minister may impose administrative fines up to €25,000 on parties for violations, without involving prosecutors or courts, subject to appeal to the administrative court.
Supervisors may request information and documents and make copies under general administrative law powers, excluding the most intrusive powers in articles 5:18 and 5:19 Awb.
Subsidy is largely a bound power based on objective criteria, with the minister not judging content of party activities.

parties: Asks why supervision is placed with the minister rather than an independent body, and why thresholds, exemptions for branches and the disclosure rules are not stricter.
They ask the government to further justify why an independent body was not chosen.
Zij vragen de regering nader te motiveren waarom er niet is gekozen voor een onafhankelijke instantie.

Argues transparency should go further, including lower thresholds, disclosure of donations and the risk of influence at local level, and questions the minister's independence in supervising party finance.
They argue, however, that countering financial influence or its appearance requires more than transparency about the funds a party receives.
Zij zijn echter van mening dat het tegengaan van financiële beïnvloeding of de schijn daarvan om meer vraagt dat alleen transparantie rondom de financiële middelen die een politieke partij ontvangt.
Opposes mandatory disclosure of donor names, arguing it would deter donors who fear social or commercial consequences.
Sympathisers of the Party for Freedom who wish to donate are hindered if they may only do so under their full name.
Sympathisanten van de Partij voor de Vrijheid die geld willen doneren worden hierin belemmerd indien zij dat alleen onder naam en toenaam mogen doen.
Questions whether the problem is real given limited private funding, asks whether GRECO recommendations are met, and asks about the scope of in-kind contributions and the AMvB.
Does the government share the view that the regulations do need improvement, but not on the basis of established abuses in practice?
Deelt de regering de mening, dat de regelgeving op dit gebied weliswaar verbetering behoeft, maar niet op grond van geconstateerde misstanden in de praktijk?
Asks whether the rules will be extended to municipal, provincial and water board parties and how neveninstellingen might evade the law.

Is the government willing, the SP members ask, after possible adoption of this bill, to ask municipalities, provinces and water boards to create a similar regime for local, provincial and water board parties?

Is de regering bereid, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie, na eventuele aanname van dit wetsvoorstel gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen te vragen een soortgelijke regeling te maken voor lokale, provinciale en waterschapspartijen?

Supports the bill in general but doubts the choice of the minister as supervisor over the Kiesraad, questions the €4,500 disclosure threshold and the exclusion of local branches, and asks about administrative burden.
Like the government in the explanatory memorandum, they recall that GRECO advised establishing an independent supervisory body.
Zij roepen – evenals de regering in de MvT – in herinnering dat GRECO heeft geadviseerd een onafhankelijk toezichtsorgaan in te stellen.
Wants stricter integrity and transparency rules, including disclosure of gifts from €1,000 and coverage of movements without legal personality.
The main rule should be that political parties disclose gifts, which could otherwise create the appearance that internal decision-making is influenced.
Hoofdregel moet zijn dat politieke partijen inzicht geven in giften, waarmee de schijn gewekt zou kunnen worden dat daarmee interne besluit-vormingsprocessen kunnen worden beïnvloed.
Asks whether supervision by the minister creates an appearance of partisanship and whether it should go to the Kiesraad with clearer statutory norms, and asks about burdens on new and small parties.
They further ask whether it would not be preferable to place this responsibility with the Kiesraad, with clear statutory norms leaving no policy discretion to the Kiesraad.

Voorts vragen deze leden zich af of het niet de voorkeur verdient deze verantwoordelijkheid alsnog bij de Kiesraad neer te leggen waarbij er een duidelijke wettelijke normering komt die geen beleidsvrijheid toelaat voor de Kiesraad.
Questions whether public disclosure of donors infringes privacy and the secret ballot and whether the burden outweighs its benefit, and asks how the thresholds were set.

v.summary: The Council of State broadly supports the bill on financing of political parties but objects to the administrative fine power given to the Electoral Council and advises replacing it with criminal enforcement, plus several technical points on separation of powers, fine amounts, time limits, forfeiture of subsidy and candidate data. The government's reply largely rejects the criminal-law route, keeps the administrative fine capped at 25,000 euro, but adopts several points: separation of powers and time limits are dealt with via the Vierde tranche Awb, forfeiture is extended to terrorism convictions, and drafting remarks are incorporated.
concerns: The Council doubts the need and desirability of an administrative fine for political parties and advises criminal law instead, which the government rejects for minor administrative violations.
The Council advises legally separating the power to impose fines from the Electoral Council's supervisory role, and the government deems this addressed by the Vierde tranche Awb.
The Council asks that the rules on fine amounts be made mandatory by general administrative order; the government declines but notes the bill allows such rules and a cap is set.
The Council asks for a 13-week decision deadline for fines as in the Vierde tranche Awb, which the government considers covered by that act.
The Council asks that the forfeiture of subsidy also apply to convictions for terrorist offences, which the government adopted.
The Council's drafting remarks in the annex are incorporated in the amended bill.

32770.s: The bill tightens the rules on the living-away-from-home student grant under the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 by redefining eligibility around the student's registered address and adding supervision by DUO and municipal officials with entry powers via fysieke adrescontroles. It also introduces an administrative fine (up to 50% and, for repeat violations, 100% of the reclaimed amount) and allows the minister to stop student finance entirely.
32770.j: The memorandum justifies the new supervision and fining powers by pointing to an SIOD report showing DUO lacks effective sanctions and that misuse of the living-away grant is detected but not punished.
q: The fact that DUO can only carry out administrative checks and that, when misuse is found, DUO has no sanction powers, leads to insufficiently effective action against this misuse.

Het feit dat DUO slechts administratieve controles kan uitvoeren en dat DUO, indien misbruik geconstateerd wordt, geen sanctiemogelijkheden heeft, leidt tot onvoldoende effectief optreden tegen dit misbruik.
d: designation of supervising officials or persons by ministerial decision
designation of municipal officials for address checks by college of mayor and aldermen
rules on transfer of personal data and specification of data processed between supervisors
p: Gives the minister and municipal officials supervisory powers to conduct home address checks based on risk profiles and tip-offs, with publication in the Staatscourant but without the general administrative-law inspection powers of entry into homes without consent, though the explanatory memorandum says the Awb powers apply.

Lets the minister impose administrative fines of up to 50% and then 100% of reclaimed amounts, and permanently end student finance entitlement, with discretion to waive or moderate and with bezwaar and beroep available.

parties: Supports tougher action against fraud but asks whether the burden of proof on students and the enforcement checks will be workable and effective.
In the view of these members, expanding sanction powers has little effect if the chance of being caught is not also increased.
Het uitbreiden van sanctiemogelijkheden heeft in de ogen van deze leden weinig effect als niet ook de pakkans vergroot wordt.
Supports the bill but questions whether municipalities have the capacity and funding to carry out controls amid budget cuts, and asks about students unable to register due to landlords.
The members ask how this works out for municipalities in light of the many cuts being implemented locally, including in enforcement capacity.
De leden vragen hoe dit voor gemeenten uitpakt in het licht van veel bezuinigingen die lokaal worden doorgevoerd door gemeenten, ook op het gebied van handhavingscapaciteit.
Asks whether DUO will use information from schools and teachers as a signalling source and whether reporting duties were examined.
The members ask whether DUO will make use of information from education institutions.](#)
De leden vragen of DUO gebruik zal maken van informatie vanuit het onderwijs.
Supports deterrence through higher detection and fines but questions the yield of home checks and when the measure applies.
Can the government indicate how it views the yield of home checks, ask these members.
Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij het rendement ziet van de thuiscontroles, zo vragen deze leden.
Warns that students could be wrongly labelled fraudsters for a purely administrative breach and that permanent termination of studiefinanciering may be disproportionate.
Asks whether the sanction is proportionate, how the GBA data protection fits, and which appeal route is open to students.
Can the government explain how proportionality is guaranteed in this decision, ask the members.
Kan de regering aangeven hoe de proportionaliteit bij dit besluit wordt gewaarborgd, zo vragen de leden.
Supports fraud reduction but asks whether sanctions are deterrent enough and how non-attributable cases are kept out of court.
How is it prevented that such cases must go to court when non-attributability is clearly present?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat dergelijke zaken tot aan de rechter moeten worden behandeld, wanneer overduidelijk sprake is van niet-verwijtbaarheid?
Asks whether the measures actually solve enforcement difficulties and questions why fines depend on duration rather than a fixed amount.
The members believe that for reasons of fairness and deterrence it would be better for a fixed fine to be paid regardless of the duration of the fraud.
Deze leden menen dat het vanuit het oogpunt van rechtvaardigheid en de afschrikkende werking beter zou zijn dat ongeacht de duur van de fraude een vast bedrag aan boete betaald moet worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 to combat misuse of the living-away grant, raising objections on proof, proportionality and punitive sanctions, and suggesting simplifying the system instead. The minister's reply accepts several points (discretion, notification to VNG, joint sanctions) and rejects the proposal to abolish the distinction between living-at-home and living-away grants.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a weighing of the sanctions bill against simplifying the WSF 2000 by abolishing the living-at-home/living-away distinction; the government rejected simplification as undesirable.

The definition of living-away equates non-registration at the GBA address with fraud; the Afdeling asked that students be able to show they actually live away, which the government addressed partly via discretion and hardship clauses.
The Afdeling found the 50% fine lacked justification and that sanctions ignored culpability and were too severe; the government added discretion and maximum percentages but kept the 50% rate.
Because the sanctions are punitive, the Afdeling pointed to article 6 ECHR guarantees and the need for culpability-based discretion; the government accepted discretion in principle.
The Afdeling noted the minister had no discretion to refrain from sanctions and that concurrence with criminal prosecution required discretion; the bill was amended accordingly.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on the timing of review of studiefinanciering where parents and student share an address; the government said DUO checks this at application.
The Afdeling asked that VNG be consulted under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen; the VNG was consulted and agreed subject to cost compensation.

32806.s: The bill amends the Gas Act to implement EU Regulation 994/2010 on gas supply security, designating the Minister as the competent authority and assigning the Minister tasks under the regulation. It also gives the national regulator (NMa) supervision and enforcement of the regulation's provisions.
32806.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by saying the EU regulation needs national designation of a competent authority and supervision rules for compliance and enforcement.
q: This could in particular include designating a national competent authority for gas supply security and regulating supervision of compliance with and enforcement of the regulation.
Hierbij kan met name worden gedacht aan het aanwijzen van een nationale bevoegde instantie voor gasleveringszekerheid en het regelen van toezicht op de naleving en handhaving van de verordening.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel B (artikel 10a, eerste lid, onderdeel h)
tasks under the EU gas security regulation assigned by the Minister
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel F (artikel 52ab, lid 1 en 2)
Minister designated as competent authority and charged with tasks under regulation 994/2010
p: The Minister is designated as the competent authority and given responsibility for receiving proposals and requests under the EU regulation, expanding executive role without parliamentary involvement.
ARTIKEL I, onderdelen G, H en I (artikelen 59, 60, 60ac)
Supervision and enforcement of the regulation is assigned to the NMa, a supervisory body, extending its existing oversight remit to the EU regulation's provisions.

parties: Asks when and how the government will report the outcome of the first risk evaluation to parliament, and how the EU supply-security problem will be addressed.
When and how does the government expect to be able to report the outcome of the first risk evaluation back to the House?
Wanneer en hoe verwacht de regering de uitkomst van de eerste risico-evaluatie aan de Kamer terug te kunnen koppelen?

Supports the bill in general but seeks clarity on EU influence over national competent authority, possible overruling by EU decisions, the scope of the ministry's supporting tasks for the grid operator, and avoiding accumulated burdens while ensuring effective control.
In addition, the CDA members ask the government to what extent the EU can exert influence.](Note: the CDA also asks whether EU decisions could overrule national competent authority.)
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering in hoeverre de EU invloed kan uitoefenen.
Sees no reason to ask questions at this stage.
They see no reason at this time to ask questions.
Zij zien op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill implementing EU Regulation 994/2010 on gas security of supply but raises points on the supply standard (justifying the stricter national norm and a cost-benefit analysis) and on confidentiality of commercially sensitive data. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was expanded on the supply standard, cost-benefit analysis, financing, and confidentiality, and the Afdeling's editorial remark on entry into force was followed.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum failed to explain how the stricter national extreme-temperature supply norm relates to the conditions of Article 8(2) of the Regulation and why amending the Besluit is unnecessary.
A cost-benefit analysis of the stricter national supply norm, as advised by the NMa, should be carried out given the Regulation's bar on disproportionate burdens on gas companies.
The memorandum should state that information provided to the government in confidence is protected as business secrets and exempt from disclosure under the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
The explanatory note on the entry-into-force article should be supplemented to justify deviating from the government's fixed change dates.

32842.s: The bill adds a new criminal offence to the Opiumwet punishing preparing, selling, transporting or holding goods, vehicles, premises, money or data that one knows or has serious reason to suspect are intended for illegal cannabis cultivation, with up to three years' imprisonment or a fifth-category fine. It also makes this offence eligible for pre-trial detention under the Code of Criminal Procedure and adjusts cross-references in the Opiumwet.
32842.j: The memorandum justifies the new offence by the professionalised scale of illegal cannabis cultivation requiring decisive criminal-law action, and says it also allows prosecution of culpable naivety.
q: It is proposed to designate the offence in the new article 11a of the Opiumwet as a case for which pre-trial detention is permitted.
Voorgesteld wordt het misdrijf van het nieuwe artikel 11a Opiumwet aan te merken als een geval waarvoor voorlopige hechtenis is toegelaten
p: Criminalises a wide range of preparatory and commercial acts tied to suspicion of cannabis cultivation, lowering the threshold for prosecution based on knowledge or serious reason to suspect, which broadens prosecutorial discretion over ordinary businesses.
Makes the new offence eligible for pre-trial detention and wider investigative powers, expanding the state's coercive options against suspects.

parties: Asks whether the bill's criminalisation of facilitating acts could be interpreted ambiguously and how it would apply to legal sellers of lamps, fertiliser and other products, raising legal certainty and enforceability.
These members consider it of great importance for any law that its enforcement is possible and that its interpretation is not open to two readings.
Deze leden vinden het van elke wet van groot belang dat de handhaving van deze wet mogelijk is en dat de uitleg van de wet niet voor tweeërlei uitleg vatbaar is.

Doubts the effectiveness of the bill, questions whether existing criminal law truly falls short, and asks how bona fide sellers and individual growers will be distinguished, raising proportionality and evidentiary concerns.
It is still not clear to the PvdA members in what way the existing criminal law instruments in practice actually fall short.
Het is de leden van de PvdA-fractie nog steeds niet duidelijk waarin het bestaande strafrechtelijk instrumentarium in de praktijk daadwerkelijk tekort schiet.
Asks why the preparatory-acts offence is limited to cannabis rather than all List II substances, favouring a broader generic approach.
These members ask why not all preparatory acts for all List II substances have been included in this bill.
Deze leden vragen waarom niet alle voorbereidingshandelingen van alle lijst II middelen zijn meegenomen in dit wetsvoorstel.

Welcomes the bill as a response to a parliamentary motion targeting growshops, while questioning whether the enforcement burden will shift to coffeeshops and whether activities will simply relocate under other names.
That the cabinet wants to change this, these members see as a direct answer to that motion, and that answer can count on the CDA's approval.
Dat het kabinet hierin verandering wil brengen, zien deze leden als een rechtstreeks antwoord op genoemde motie en dat antwoord kan bij de CDA-fractie dan ook op instemming rekenen.

Objects that a suspicion-based standard could make bona fide garden centres and sellers liable, questions evidentiary feasibility, and asks how far the duty of vigilance for sellers extends, raising rights and due-process concerns.
This does raise the question of whether a considerable extension is being proposed too easily, which would also put bona fide garden centres and agricultural sellers in the dock.

Dit roept toch wel de vraag op of nu niet al te gemakkelijk een behoorlijke uitbreiding wordt voorgesteld, waarmee ook bonafide tuincentra en verkopers van landbouwartikelen in het verdachtenbankje terecht komen.
Supports treating illegal cannabis cultivation as a top priority and has no questions on the bill.
The aforementioned members currently have no questions about the bill.
Genoemde leden hebben op dit moment geen vragen over het wetsvoorstel.

Supports firm action against growshops but asks about the relationship with existing legislation, the differences between Article 10a and 11a, and whether broadening existing provisions would suffice.
However, they have various questions regarding the relationship to existing legislation.
Wel hebben zij diverse vragen in verband met de relatie tot bestaande wetgeving.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill criminalising preparatory acts for illegal commercial cannabis cultivation, but advises motivating the deviation from the general preparation offence in article 46 Sr (negligence-based 'serious reason to suspect' standard) and adding 'ruimten' to the new article 11a Opiumwet, plus explaining likely changes in growshop business practices. The minister's reply accepts the suggestion to add 'ruimten', explains the chosen standard in the explanatory memorandum, and adds an explanation of expected growshop changes.
concerns: The deviation from article 46 Sr, which requires intent, through a 'serious reason to suspect' standard should be motivated with concrete examples; the reply clarifies the choices in the explanatory memorandum without changing the standard.
The new article 11a should include the element 'ruimten' to cover cultivation in dedicated premises, which the minister accepted.
The explanatory memorandum should address expected changes in growshop business conduct and evidentiary consequences, which the reply added.
A redactional remark on the bill title and considerans was adopted.

33058.s: The bill introduces a statutory liability limitation for De Nederlandsche Bank and the Autoriteit Financiële Markten and their boards, supervisory bodies, and staff, so they are liable only for intentional improper performance or gross negligence in exercising supervisory tasks under the Wft (and the BES financial markets act). It also clarifies that the limitation does not apply retroactively to conduct before entry into force.
33058.j: The memorandum justifies the liability limitation by the supervisory dilemma faced by DNB and AFM, international alignment with peer supervisors, and the recommendation of the De Wit commission, arguing supervisors must act quickly without fear of liability.
q: An explicit statutory limitation of liability compared to the current liability regime is however desirable for the supervisory tasks of DNB and the AFM arising from the Wft.

Een expliciete wettelijke beperking van de aansprakelijkheid ten opzichte van het huidige aansprakelijkheidsregime is echter gewenst voor de toezichthoudende taken van DNB en de AFM die voortvloeien uit de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft).
d: entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: Artikel 1:25c Wft (Article I) and Artikel 1:13a Wfm BES (Article II)

Limits civil liability of financial supervisors to cases of intentional improper conduct or gross negligence, reducing citizens' ability to obtain damages for harm caused by supervisory action or inaction.

parties: Asks whether clients retain sufficient means to claim damages against a supervisor after liability is limited, and whether client interests are adequately safeguarded.
These members do ask, however, whether sufficient possibilities remain for clients to file a damages claim against a supervisor.
Deze leden vragen echter wel of er nog wel voldoende mogelijkheden overblijven voor klanten om een schadeclaim in te dienen tegen een toezichthouder.
Questions whether the liability limitation removes incentives for adequate supervision and whether remaining protection against misuse of supervisory powers is meaningful.
Does the government share the view that improper use of supervisory powers can cause major damage to persons and businesses?
Deelt de regering de mening dat het onjuist hanteren van toezichthouderbevoegdheden grote schade kan toebrengen aan personen en bedrijven.
Asks for past cases where a supervisor was successfully held liable and whether the proposed limitation would have changed the outcome.

The PVV members ask whether there are known past cases in which the supervisor was successfully held liable and in which the proposed liability limitation would likely have led to a different outcome.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er gevallen bekend zijn uit het verleden waarin de toezichthouder succesvol aansprakelijk is gesteld en waarin de voorgestelde aansprakelijkheidsbeperking naar verwachting tot een andere uitkomst had geleid.
Welcomes the bill but asks for examples of the supervisory dilemma and whether existing case law already addresses it, and questions the added value of codifying limited liability.
What exactly is the advantage of also regulating this de jure?
Wat is nu precies het voordeel om dit ook de jure te regelen?
Asks whether litigation will increase or decrease after the bill takes effect and questions why 'gross negligence' was not replaced by 'conscious recklessness', including how courts would assess it.
Can the government explain why the term 'gross negligence' was not changed to 'conscious recklessness', ask the SP members.
Kan de regering aangeven waarom de term «grove schuld» niet is aangepast in «bewuste roekeloosheid», zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.
Notes that expanded intervention powers combined with reduced liability could increase uncertainty, and suggests a statutory consultation step before intervening.
This bill and the mentioned bill together ensure that the powers increase considerably and liability decreases considerably.
Voorliggend wetsvoorstel en genoemd wetsvoorstel zorgen er tezamen voor dat de bevoegdheden flink toenemen en de aansprakelijkheid behoorlijk vermindert.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the amendment capping bonuses and wage rises at financial firms receiving stability-related state aid, but asks for clarification on effectiveness, the international context and the vague scope of contract clauses declared void. The government's reply accepts most points, adding transitional rules, clarifying the periods covered, explaining the scope of void clauses and adjusting the terminology to 'bestuurders'.
concerns: The vagueness of the clauses declared void under article 1:112(4) Wft creates legal uncertainty, which the government addressed by explaining the scope with an example in the explanatory memorandum.

The text does not exclude post-aid payment of variable pay for earlier periods, which could reduce the measure's effectiveness; the government clarified the covered periods in the explanatory memorandum and the provision.
Application to existing aid cases was not foreseeable; the government added transitional rules and retroactive effect to 6 October 2011, which the Council's remarks prompted in part.

The international context of pay in an international labour market was not explained; the government answered that the special situation of state aid justifies intervention, with limited added analysis.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division endorses the bill limiting the liability of DNB and AFM for acts under the Wft, but raises objections on motivation, limitation to a fixed amount, other supervisors, the liability exception wording, employer liability, and transitional law, advising adaptation. The government's reply accepts some points (motivation, 'opzet of grove schuld' wording with 'in belangrijke mate', employer liability clarified) and rejects others (fixed-amount limitation alternative and transitional law changes, and does not extend the limitation to other supervisory tasks beyond explaining the rationale).
concerns: The Afdeling advises stronger motivation of the necessity of liability limitation and why a fixed monetary cap per event was not chosen; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but kept the partial exclusion.
The Afdeling notes precedent risk for other supervisors such as the NMa and advises explaining why similar liability limits are not extended to them.

The Afdeling advises justifying why the liability limitation is not extended to DNB and AFM supervisory tasks under other financial laws such as the Pensioenwet and Wet op de trustkantoren; the government explained the rationale but did not extend it.

The Afdeling notes that 'grove schuld' is outdated and suggests 'bewuste roekeloosheid' or adding 'in overwegende mate'; the government kept 'opzet of grove schuld' and changed the wording to 'in belangrijke mate'.
The Afdeling advises clarifying employer liability under article 6:170 BW, which the government addressed by explaining that the limitation also covers employees and thus employer liability.
The Afdeling advises amending the transitional provision so that acts before entry into force but causing damage afterwards are covered; the government rejected this and kept the act-based cut-off.

33085.s: The bill amends the Remigration Act to abolish basic provisions, raise the age limit to 55, extend eligibility and residence durations, restrict remigration benefits to first-generation migrants, close the application window on 1 January 2025, and add a statutory framework for administrative fines, suspension, revocation and recovery of benefits by the Sociale verzekeringsbank. The explanatory memorandum justifies the sanction and suspension powers as necessary enforcement tools for compliance with reporting duties.
33085.j: The memorandum justifies suspension and revocation powers as needed to address unreturned control forms and to deter incomplete reporting, and frames the fine system as necessary because the agency's experience showed it was needed.
d: further rules on nationality application and reporting
p: Gives the Sociale verzekeringsbank power to impose administrative fines up to EUR 2,269 for failing reporting duties, with discretion to waive them for urgent reasons.
Obliges the agency to amend or revoke benefit decisions in listed situations, with discretion to refrain for urgent reasons and a duty to waive changes for past periods in certain cases..
Allows the agency to suspend benefit payments on a reasonable suspicion of entitlement loss or non-compliance, for a maximum of six months..
Requires recovery of undue payments, with discretion to waive recovery for urgent reasons or where the beneficiary reasonably could not understand the error..
Permits set-off of recovered amounts and fines against other benefits the person receives.
Imposes a broad duty on beneficiaries to disclose all relevant facts on request or on their own initiative.

parties: Asks how eligibility is checked, including whether re-integration cooperation is a condition, and how misuse and sanctions for breaches are handled.
When granting a remigration benefit, does the Social Insurance Bank (SVB) look not only at the benefit duration but also at whether the person has sufficiently cooperated with re-integration?

Wordt bij het eventueel toekennen van een remigratieuitkering niet alleen door de Sociale verzekeringsbank (SVB) gekeken naar de uitkeringsduur, maar wordt ook gekeken of de belanghebbende wel voldoende heeft meegewerkt aan re-integratie?
Questions the fairness of unequal treatment of former immigrants versus native Dutch benefit recipients, the government's cost reasoning, and the enforcement capacity for remigrants abroad.
Can the government defend treating native Dutch benefit recipients over 55 as potential workforce members while not applying that principle to former immigrants seeking the remigration scheme?

Kan de regering naar geboren Nederlanders wel verdedigen dat zij gezien worden als potentiële arbeidskracht als zij ouder zijn dan 55 en meer dan een jaar bijstandsgerechtigd, maar dat dat uitgangspunt niet geldt voor voormalige immigranten die gebruik willen maken van de remigratievoorziening?
Welcomes the bill as implementing a motion on the age limit and has no further questions.
For this reason these members have no further questions about the bill.
Daarom hebben deze leden verder geen vragen over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.

Supports the higher age limit and the goal of financial security, but questions the exclusion of later-arriving refugees, the indexation of benefits, and the removal of the travel and moving allowance.
These members note that this is not a first-generation migrant group and ask whether the government is willing to add additional rules for this group.
Deze leden constateren dat er hier geen sprake is van eerste generatie migranten en vragen de regering of zij bereid is om voor deze groep additionele regels toe te voegen.
Questions the arbitrary eight-year residence requirement, the basis for the age limit, the abolition of basic allowances, and why the evaluation led to policy change, citing the Raad van State.
These members believe this arrangement should be maintained for less financially capable remigrants.
Deze leden menen dat deze regeling in stand gehouden dient te worden voor minder draagkrachtige remigranten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a government bill to reform the Remigratiewet, raising major objections to abolishing the basic remigration allowance, to the link between integration and remigration, to the non-statutory definition of target groups, and to sanctions not being set out in the formal law. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adding the target group criteria and sanctions to the bill and justifying the rest in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling found the abolition of the basic allowance not convincingly justified given the law's goal of helping needy remigrants return, and advised keeping it; the government rejected this, arguing savings are not the aim and reasoning that remigrants can save.

The Afdeling noted the bill removes the incentive for remigration of those without prospects of integration and lost the investment-return effect without motivating this, and asked for a substantive justification; the government explained the restrictions are based on labour capacity and integration rather than finances.

The Afdeling advised that the criterion for designating target groups is a main element that must be in the formal law rather than in a ministerial regulation, and that the reference to the Awgb was insufficient; the bill was amended to include the target group criteria.

The Afdeling found the statutory basis for sanctions in article 6 insufficient and advised that sanctions for non-compliance be laid down in the formal law; the bill was amended to include fines, suspension, withdrawal and recovery.

The Afdeling's reference to equal treatment and non-discrimination standards was answered by the government with the view that the nationality distinction has objective justification under article 26 IVBPR and Protocol 12 ECHR.

33139.s: The bill approves several ministerial regulations adapting Dutch health and related laws to the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and amends the Public Health Act (Wet publieke gezondheid) to add a chapter giving island authorities (bestuurscollege, gezaghebber) public health powers such as movement bans on goods, measures on infected corpses, and designation of a laboratory. It also makes technical and terminological amendments to the Vergunningwet BES, the Gezondheidswet, the medical disciplinary law, the medicines supply law and the complaints law, with some provisions taking retroactive effect.
33139.j: The memorandum justifies the island-specific powers by the insular character of the bodies, making the governor's goods-entry power sensible, and the need to fill gaps in the transition legislation.
q: Article 68e, first paragraph, provides an additional power for the governor, beyond Article 47 of the Public Health Act, regarding bringing goods onto the territory of the public body.

Artikel 68e, eerste lid, regelt een aan artikel 47 van de Wet publieke gezondheid additionele bevoegdheid voor de gezaghebber inzake het op het grondgebied van het openbaar lichaam brengen van goederen.
d: qualification requirements for the infectious disease physician
vaccination programme to be offered by island authority
special grant to islands for public health tasks and conditions
space, light, ventilation requirements for premises
replacement of island ordinances and general measures by ministerial regulation
p: Island governor may ban bringing goods onto the island and take compulsory measures on infectious corpses, including taking blood and cremation, without a parliamentary statute.
Enforcement officials gain investigative powers and administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) with cost recovery via direct writ of execution.
Removes the word 'uitsluitend' so reports may also be used for the islands' euthanasia oversight, a minor widening of inspectorate information use.
Articles V, VI and VII(1) take retroactive effect to 10 October 2010 to cure possibly defective prior supervisory acts.

parties: Asks for an update on the feasibility of a joint infectious disease constructie involving Aruba, Curaçao and Sint-Maarten.
Can the minister further explain what the current state of affairs is and when more clarity will arise on the feasibility of this constructie?
Kan de minister nader toelichten wat op dit moment de stand van zaken is en wanneer meer duidelijkheid ontstaat over de haalbaarheid van deze constructie?
Supports involving RIVM but asks who calls on it, when, on what basis, and who bears responsibility, and asks who forms the euthanasia review committee and what powers Staatstoezicht officials have.
They do ask who calls on the help of the RIVM, when and on what basis.
Zij vragen wel wie de hulp van het RIVM inroept, wanneer en op basis waarvan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed approval of the Aanpassingsregeling BES-wetten VWS could not validly add the Vergunningslandsverordening retroactively under article 20(1) IBES, so the relevant articles should be moved into the bill itself with retroactive effect to 10 October 2010. The government's nader rapport reports that the bill was adjusted accordingly, the doubtful Raad voor de Volksgezondheid provision was dropped, and most redactional remarks were adopted.
concerns: Article 20(1) IBES does not allow amending the IBES via ministerial regulation, so the Vergunningslandsverordening cannot be added retroactively that way; the provisions were moved into the bill with retroactive effect.
Retroactive effect of the bill's amendments should run to 10 October 2010 to preserve the intended legal regime.
Doubt whether each public body has a functioning eilandelijke Raad voor de Volksgezondheid; the provision was removed as not feasible or opportune.

Several redactional remarks on the bill's considerans, article numbering, and cross-references were adopted, except one on Artikel 8 Wet publieke gezondheid which the government addressed differently.

33157.s: The bill makes a central final test in language and arithmetic/mathematics mandatory in primary and special education, and requires use of a pupil monitoring system with tests meeting an independent committee's quality standards. It assigns the test's development, item setting and norming to the College voor toetsen en examens and adds minimum learning-outcome requirements for special schools.
33157.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for uniform, independently set and normed tests, with the College voor toetsen en examens guaranteeing independence and the minister remaining responsible.
q: The independent establishment and control of the central final test called for in the motion is guaranteed by assigning this task to the existing, independent College voor examens (Cve).

De in de motie bepleite onafhankelijke vaststelling en controle van de centrale eindtoets, wordt gewaarborgd door in dit wetsvoorstel te regelen dat deze taak voor de centrale eindtoets primair onderwijs te beleggen bij het bestaande, onafhankelijke College voor examens (Cve).
d: pupil monitoring system tests and quality approval by independent committee
rules on test materials for the central final test
rules on measuring, norming and assessing learning outcomes
norms for learning outcomes and school-size threshold for special education
College for tests and examinations sets test levels, timing, items, scoring and tool rules
p: Test content, levels, scoring and administration are transferred to the College voor toetsen en examens, an official body, with limited schools' discretion over test use.
Schools may exempt pupils from the test on motivated grounds, and parents are informed of the level or reason for exemption.

parties: Asks whether the 2013 test results should count, whether a trial status is needed, and how financial sanctions linked to test scores will be phased in.
Is there a risk that in 2013 the test results will wrongly count in the assessment?
Bestaat het risico dat in 2013 de toetsresultaten onterecht meetellen in de beoordeling?
Warns that the test should serve child development rather than selection or accountability of schools, and asks about the Raad van State's warning on Cito's market position.

According to these members, testing must always primarily serve the ideal of upliftment and must not become an instrument mainly for pupil selection, let alone an accountability tool for primary schools at the expense of pupils.

Toetsing moet, volgens de leden, altijd in de eerste plaats het verheffingsideaal dienen en mag niet verworden tot een instrument overwegend voor de selectie van leerlingen, laat staan tot een afrekeninstrument voor basisscholen over de ruggen van de scholieren.
Supports the later test date and stresses the importance of language, arithmetic and world orientation, asking whether world orientation should be mandatory.
Supports better results and tracking systems but insists that education is more than cognitive skills and that tests are a means, not a goal; asks how school value added will be quantified.
Of course these members endorse the government's policy to improve education quality in the Netherlands, but these members see tests as a means and not as an end.
Uiteraard onderschrijven deze leden het beleid van de regering om de kwaliteit van onderwijs te verbeteren in Nederland, maar deze leden zien toetsen als een middel en niet als een doel.
Doubts that more testing raises quality, warns of teaching to the test and fraud, and asks how the government will prevent schools from becoming test factories.
The members do not want a school to be turned into a test factory.
De leden willen niet dat een school wordt omgevormd tot een toetsfabriek.
In principle supportive of the central test and tracking system but raises substantive questions on how the test and tracking data will be used and how weak-performing schools are supported.

The members are in principle in favour of introducing a central final test for Dutch language and arithmetic/mathematics and the pupil and education tracking system, but still have a number of substantive questions about this bill.

De leden zijn in principe voor het instellen van een centrale eindtoets voor Nederlandse taal en rekenen/wiskunde en het leerling- en onderwijsvolgsysteem, maar hebben nog wel een aantal inhoudelijke vragen over dit wetsvoorstel.
Sees the bill as an irresponsible expansion of testing that risks narrowing curricula, increasing stress on young children and widening gaps between schools.

By creating the illusion of full measurability, the members see a risk that lesson content will be impoverished, stress among young children will increase, and a gap will emerge between high- and lower-scoring primary schools.

Door de illusie te creëren van volledige meetbaarheid, bestaat volgens de leden het risico dat de lesinhoud verschraald, de stress bij jonge kinderen toeneemt en een kloof ontstaat tussen hoog en minder hoog scorende basisscholen.
Argues schools should be free to choose their own assessment, that the Cito test is too limited, and that centralised testing creates perverse incentives and an accountability culture.
Thirdly, too great an emphasis on testing fosters perverse effects, such as training for test moments instead of acquiring knowledge and promoting an accountability culture in education.

Ten derde werkt een te grote nadruk op toetsing perverse effecten in de hand, zoals het trainen voor toetsmomenten in plaats van het vergaren van kennis en het bevorderen van een afrekencultuur in het onderwijs.

Has serious reservations about infringing the freedom of organisation of denominational schools, arguing mandatory tracking plus testing is double work and that the less intrusive option should have been chosen.
They have serious reservations about the scale of the infringement on the freedom of organisation of special (denominational) education.
Zij hebben ernstige bedenkingen bij de omvang van de inbreuk op de vrijheid van inrichting van het bijzonder onderwijs.
Asks factual questions about pupils who skip the end test, whether the test favours knowledge over skills, and effects on late bloomers and pupils with language delays.
Is it true that the new end test, unlike the current test, is more focused on testing knowledge than skills?
Is het waar dat de nieuwe eindtoets, anders dan de huidige toets meer gericht is op het toetsen van kennis dan vaardigheden?

Doubts that more testing improves education, questions the government's dismissal of teaching-to-the-test risks, and asks how the Inspectorate weighs Cito scores and whether it is anticipating the law.
The members further note that the government takes the risk of excessive practice for the Cito test ('teaching to the test') not very seriously.
De leden constateren voorts dat de regering het risico dat er bovenmatig veel wordt geoefend voor de Cito-toets («teaching to the test») weinig serieus neemt.

Asks who will complain about a narrow curriculum, whether the test fits existing methods, the discrepancy between Cito and school advice, and about objectivity of test development and Cito's exclusive role.
Although the government rightly states that schools 'must give content to their statutory task', several parties expect this will not happen.
Hoewel de regering terecht stelt dat scholen «inhoud moeten geven aan hun wettelijke opdracht», wordt door meerdere partijen verwacht dat dit niet gaat gebeuren.
Asks whether the government implicitly discourages including controversial themes such as sexuality in the world-orientation test, and who will draw comparisons between test scores.
The members ask the government whether it implicitly discourages the College voor Examens from including sexuality and sexual diversity in the world-orientation test.
De leden vragen de regering of zij het College voor examens impliciet afraadt om seksualiteit en seksuele diversiteit op te nemen in de toets wereldoriëntatie.

Asks the government to confirm that teaching quality, not summed test scores, is decisive for inspection judgements, and questions why schools may not use an alternative test fitting their denominational basis.
Why does the government think the public interest is harmed when schools use an end test that meets the core-skills requirement but better fits the school's founding principles and views?

Waarom vindt de regering dat het publiek belang wordt geschaad wanneer scholen een eindtoets afnemen die voldoet aan de eis van toetsing van kernvaardigheden, maar tegelijkertijd beter aansluit bij de grondslag en opvattingen van de school, zo vragen zij.

Argues the bill burdens schools that use other assessments, questions the unclear responsibility division and whether the government's 'what' versus 'how' distinction risks hollowing out the goals, and questions objectification of performance requirements through a uniform test.
Why does the government depart from the general restrained approach so far regarding uniform tests, including where it concerns the funding condition for learning outcomes, the members ask.
Waarom wijkt de regering af van de algemene terughoudende lijn tot dusver met betrekking tot uniforme toetsen, ook waar het de bekostigingsvoorwaarde voor leerresultaten betreft, zo vragen de leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill introducing a mandatory central end-test (taal and rekenen) and a mandatory leerling- en onderwijsvolgsysteem in primary and special education, concluding the bill was unbalanced and that necessity of the detailed student tracking rules and special-education measures was not convincingly argued. The minister's nader rapport accepted the end-test, narrowed the student-tracking requirements, added explanations on sanctions, competition and special education, and postponed special-education application to 2015–2016 while rejecting several other objections.
concerns: Advice that the detailed prescription of how schools must use the leerlingvolgsysteem intrudes too far on school and teacher autonomy; the articles were adapted so the system is regulated much less specifically.

Concern that necessity of the end-test-related sanctions and of student-tracking for special education was insufficiently justified; the explanation was expanded and application postponed, but the government maintained the policy.

Concern that substantive educational norms and the tracking requirement go beyond what is necessary and proportionate, with risks of narrowing the curriculum and teaching to the test; the memorie was supplemented, while the government argued it limited requirements to a minimum.
Concern about the unexplained decline in schools using tracking systems and the unexplained relation between kerndoelen, referentieniveaus and the end-test; the explanation was added in the memorie.

Concern about unfair competition and competition/state-aid aspects of Cito developing the end-test and selling tracking systems; the government said Cito is not a state enterprise under the amendment and pointed to administrative agreements.
Request to explain the planned measurement of value added; the explanation was shortened and linked to pilots, without a statutory basis.

33166.s: The bill amends the Uitvoeringswet grondkamers to bring the land chambers under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, with exceptions for ministerial power to issue policy rules and annul decisions, and for appointment and personnel rules. It also makes several technical wording and cross-reference changes and repeals article 43.
33166.j: The memorandum justifies the exceptions by the semi-judicial character of the land chambers and their binding independent judgments, which make ministerial annulment and appointment inappropriate.
q: This applies to the minister's powers to set policy rules on the performance of duties and to annul decisions of the autonomous administrative body.
Dit geldt voor de bevoegdheden van de minister om beleidsregels te stellen met betrekking tot de taakuitoefening en besluiten van het zelfstandig bestuursorgaan te vernietigen
p: The land chambers are placed under the Kaderwet, but the minister's power to issue policy rules and annul their decisions under articles 21 and 22 is excluded, preserving their independence.

33175.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Dirksland, Goedereede, Middelharnis and Oostflakkee into a new municipality, Goeree-Overflakkee, and abolishes the four former municipalities. It also makes conforming amendments to judicial district, police region, safety region and electoral district provisions, and sets transitional rules for a by-election and the timing of regular council elections.
33175.j: The memorandum justifies the bill mainly through a financial study of the merger variants and does not justify any delegation or new powers.
q: A financial study was carried out on the reorganisation variants.
Er is een financieel onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de herindelingsvarianten.

parties: Asks whether enough was invested in bringing the parties together and why a similar merger is not proposed for the Krimpenerwaard.
These members note that the municipalities of Dirksland, Middelharnis and Oostflakkee unanimously support this merger, while the municipality of Goedereede does not agree.
Deze leden constateren dat de gemeenten Dirksland, Middelharnis en Oostflakkee unaniem voor deze herindeling staan, terwijl de gemeente Goedereede er niet mee instemt.
Questions the consistency of the government's decisions across merger files and whether the 3+1 variant was properly investigated.
The PvdA members ask the government whether it would not be better to make a clear choice for one policy framework and take into account the Chamber's wish to withdraw the new policy framework.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of het niet beter is een duidelijke keus te maken voor één beleidskader en daarbij rekening te houden met de wens van de Kamer om het nieuwe beleidskader in te trekken?
Argues that referenda or surveys should be held before merger and that public support was not properly measured, with only 90 people surveyed in three municipalities.
As the PVV members have also stated regarding other municipal mergers, they believe citizen referenda or surveys should always be held in municipal mergers.

Zoals de leden van de PVV-fractie ook met betrekking tot andere gemeentelijke herindelingen hebben aangegeven, dienen er naar hun mening bij gemeentelijke herindelingen altijd burgerreferenda of enquêtes gehouden te worden.
Seeks information on why the municipalities could not reach a joint solution, the performance of the joint cooperation body, and fishing sector concerns.
In the view of the CDA members, the municipalities appear unable to reach a joint solution to the identified problems.
Naar de mening van de leden van de CDA-fractie blijken de gemeenten niet in staat om tot een gezamenlijke oplossing voor de geconstateerde knelpunten te komen.
Argues the merger violates the principle that mergers must come from below, that the province took the initiative too early, and that Goedereede's clear 89% opposition is being ignored.
An important principle of this government, the SP members believe, is that mergers may only take place if they come about from the bottom up.
Een belangrijk uitgangspunt van deze regering, zo menen de leden van de SP-fractie, is dat herindelingen enkel plaats mogen vinden indien deze van onderop tot stand komen.
Supports swift merger but asks why it would succeed if the largest municipality opposes it, and calls for stricter government steering and a consistent agenda.
They wonder whether it is not necessary to exercise tighter steering and pursue a clear and consistent merger agenda.
Zij vragen zich af of het niet noodzakelijk is strakker regie te voeren en een duidelijke en consistente herindelingsagenda na te streven.
Questions which policy framework applies, the government's inconsistent handling of merger files, and whether the 'exceptional case' threshold is being stretched.
Based on the principle that mergers should be voluntary unless serious problems exist, questions whether a compulsory merger is necessary, especially for Goedereede.
Given their starting point that mergers should take place on a voluntary basis unless there are serious problems in a municipality, this bill raises many questions for these members.
Gezien hun uitgangspunt dat herindelingen op vrijwillige basis plaats dienen te vinden, tenzij er sprake is van grote problemen in een gemeente, roept dit wetsvoorstel bij deze leden veel vragen op.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division's opinion on the bill merging Dirksland, Goedereede, Middelharnis and Oostflakkee into Goeree-Overflakkee questions whether the province-initiated merger meets the exceptional-situation criterion, since Goedereede voted against and the 2006 capacity study found the municipalities still adequate. The minister's reply argues that regional challenges, weak future administrative capacity and a lack of realistic alternatives justify the merger, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the provincial merger proposal meets the exceptional-situation criterion of the Beleidskader, and the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum with the substantive necessity and urgency arguments.

33184.s: The bill amends the Wet personenvervoer 2000, the Wet wegvervoer goederen, the Wet bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur and the Wet op de economische delicten to implement EU Regulations 1071/2009, 1072/2009 and 1073/2009 on road transport operator access, cabotage and international coach and bus services. It sets reliability, professional competence and financial standing requirements for transport operators and managers, introduces integrity-based refusal and revocation of licences, and allocates enforcement and examination tasks to the Minister and the NIWO.
33184.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the EU regulations and to allow detailed rules on thresholds, fees, reliability criteria and rehabilitation, citing the need for uniform application and transparency.
d: exemptions from road transport regulation and requirements for non-bus passenger transport
thresholds for number of serious infringements affecting reliability
other rehabilitation measures and reliability rules
rules on when loss of reliability is a disproportionately severe sanction
exemption from ban on unlicensed transport to implement international organisation decisions
fees for licence applications and documents
rules on licence granting, refusal, revocation, conditions and reliability/competence standards
designation of applicable regulations and exemption from operator rules for minor domestic haulage
ban on cross-border or cabotage haulage and exemptions under bilateral treaties
rules on financial standing and professional competence
criteria for disproportionate sanction and alternative rehabilitation measures
rules on processing of personal data in the register
rules on professional competence and financial standing for examinations
appeal route against NIWO decisions on loss of reliability
p: The NIWO, an independent regulatory body, needs ministerial consent to find that loss of reliability would be disproportionately severe, shifting discretion to the Minister."}],
The Minister or NIWO may refuse, suspend or revoke a licence on integrity grounds under the Wet bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen, widening executive discretion over operators' market access."}],
Operators cannot appeal NIWO decisions on loss of reliability where ministerial consent is missing, narrowing judicial review in that case."}],

parties: Asks how long sanctions data is kept and for which offences a carrier loses access to the profession, seeking clarity on the sanctions register.
Can the government indicate whether it is correct that this data is not kept longer than two years?
Kan de regering aangeven of het klopt dat deze gegevens niet langer dan twee jaar worden bewaard?
Opposes EU involvement, fears the European sanctions register will be misused by member states to impose disproportionate fines on Dutch carriers, and asks about cabotage and enforcement priorities.
The members fear that establishing a European electronic register is a perverse incentive for certain member states to impose ridiculous sanctions for every trifle.
De leden vrezen dat het instellen van een Europees elektronisch register een perverse prikkel is voor bepaalde lidstaten om voor ieder wissewasje ridicule sancties op te leggen.
Asks what problems the transport manager solves, how the role works, and how cross-border offences by drivers are recorded in the sanctions register.
Can the government explain how this is recorded in the sanctions register?
Kan de regering ingaan op de manier waarop dit in het sanctieregister wordt vastgelegd?

Argues that whoever decides on failing the reliability requirement, the minister or NIWO, the affected carrier must be able to appeal to a court or college of appeal; also doubts that a national minister may deviate from a Commission decision.
whoever is affected by it must be able to appeal to a judicial body or a College of Appeal.
degene die daardoor wordt getroffen, moet in beroep kunnen bij een rechterlijke instantie c.q. een College van Beroep.
Attaches weight to the opinion of the College bescherming persoonsgegevens on registration of carrier data and wants registration without extra bureaucracy.
regarding registration of carrier data in the national and community registers, attach great value to the opinion of the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
hechten voor wat betreft de registratie van de gegevens van vervoerders in het nationale en communautaire register veel waarde aan het oordeel van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Has serious reservations that a national minister may override a Commission finding in favour of a national carrier, and asks what remedies the Dutch state retains.
have serious reservations about the premise that a national minister may deviate from a European Commission finding in favour of a national transport company.
hebben grote bedenkingen bij het uitgangspunt dat een nationale minister mag afwijken van een oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten faveure van een nationaal vervoersbedrijf.
Wants the House to be able to pronounce on the bill before any financial consequences arise, and wants ILT enforcement prioritised against foreign carriers.
The members therefore find it very important that the House must still be able to pronounce on what this bill regulates, before it has possible financial consequences.
De leden vinden het dan ook van groot belang dat de Kamer nog een uitspraak moet kunnen doen over hetgeen dit wetsvoorstel regelt, voordat dit mogelijk financiële consequenties heeft.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU regulations 1071/2009, 1072/2009 and 1073/2009 on road transport operators, raising concerns about personal data processing, appeal rights against refusal of good-conduct certificates, the scope of exemption powers, supervision of exam bodies, and the cabotage ban. The minister's reply accepted most remarks, amending the bill on data purposes, delegation, cabotage exemptions and appeal procedures, while defending the single-controller and certification approach.
concerns: The advisory division asked how the electronic sanctions register relates to privacy rights under the ECHR, EU Charter and the Wbp, and requested supplementary explanation, which the government largely provided.
The division found the purposes of personal data processing insufficiently specific and asked for a concrete purpose, which was added to the articles.

The division questioned why two controllers (minister and RDW) were designated, asking for one controller or a clear division of responsibilities; the government explained the RDW's role and added this to the explanatory memorandum.
The division found the delegation power for ministerial regulations on data exchange insufficiently justified and bounded; the government explained the need and kept the power.
The division advised consulting the College bescherming persoonsgegevens, which the government said would be done for the forthcoming implementing decree.

The division found the procedure for good-conduct certificates and appeal rights convoluted, with a possible appeal against both a ministerial refusal and a licence suspension, and advised simplification; the government defended appeal protection and added explanatory clarifications.
The division found the ground 'fair competition' too broad and suggested deleting or clarifying it; the government changed the wording to equal treatment.
The division noted that the exemption power in the Wp2000 exceeds the regulation's scope and lacks justification; the provision was aligned with the Wwg and the division's objection was resolved.
The division asked for supervision of the exam body as required by the regulation; the government said supervision follows directly from the regulation and needs no separate provision.
The division found the cabotage ban for third-country carriers not derived from the regulation and in need of separate justification; a bilateral treaty exemption was added to the bill.
The division noted an omission regarding suspension or withdrawal of driver attestations and that the transposition table was missing at submission; these were corrected.
The division noted the entry-into-force date would not match the 4 December 2011 deadline and asked for explanation; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

33229.s: The bill amends the Dutch Consumer Protection Enforcement Act to designate the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment as enforcer of EU Regulation 1177/2010 on passenger rights at sea and inland waterways, empowering the minister to impose administrative fines or penalty orders. The minister may mandate this power to the Inspectorate for Environment and Transport (ILT), and the enforcement regime is administrative rather than criminal.
33229.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to meet the enforcement obligations of articles 25 and 28 of the regulation, and notes the ILT's independence and experience with similar enforcement.
q: This means that passengers can directly invoke the provisions of the regulation and that the regulation imposes direct obligations on carriers and port terminal operators.

Dit betekent dat passagiers een direct beroep kunnen doen op de bepalingen uit de verordening en dat uit de verordening directe verplichtingen voortvloeien voor vervoerders en exploitanten van haventerminals.
d: mandating fine and penalty-order power to ILT inspector-general
p: The minister gains power to impose administrative fines and penalty orders for infringements of the EU regulation, which the minister may mandate onward to the ILT inspector-general.

parties: Asks whether the consumer rights are clear enough and whether the bill leaves room for interpretation that could lead to conflicts, citing the Sturgeon ruling of the European Court of Justice.
Is the government sufficiently convinced that the consumer rights in this bill are clearly laid down?
Is de regering er voldoende van overtuigd dat de rechten voor de consument in dit wetsvoorstel voldoende helder zijn neergelegd?
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Has no questions or remarks on the bill.
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Welcomes better passenger protection but asks whether the supervisor, which would not act as an appeal body for individual complaints, can perform that role and why not, given the regulation allows it.
The CDA members note that the supervisor does not act as an appeal body for individual complaints, although the regulation makes this possible.
De leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat de toezichthouder niet als beroepsinstantie optreedt voor individuele klachten, terwijl de verordening dit mogelijk maakt.
Has no questions on the bill.
currently have no need to ask questions
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen
Asks whether the enforcement costs are minimal given that the supervisor's tasks will be absorbed within existing capacity.
Can the members conclude from this that the costs are minimal and that virtually no effort will be needed, or are there other tasks that will be cut back?
Kunnen de leden hieruit concluderen dat de kosten minimaal zijn en dat er praktisch geen inspanningen nodig zullen zijn, of zijn er andere taken waar nu op bezuinigd zal worden?
Has no questions on the bill.
currently have no need to ask questions.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen.

33238.s: The bill amends the Dutch anti-money laundering and terrorist financing acts (Wwft and Wwft BES) to tighten customer due diligence, expand the reporting duty for unusual transactions, add politically exposed person checks for beneficial owners, and introduce rules for sharing supervisory information with other and foreign supervisors. It also grants liability protection to institutions that file reports and lets certain rules be set by ministerial regulation rather than general administrative order.
33238.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by Financial Action Task Force recommendations and evaluation findings that Dutch rules need tightening, and says ministerial regulation allows quick response to new developments.
q: To be able to respond quickly to new developments or insights, it is provided that categories of business relations and transactions carrying higher risk may be designated by ministerial regulation instead of by general administrative order.

Om op korte termijn te kunnen reageren op nieuwe ontwikkelingen of inzichten is voorzien dat categorieën zakelijke relaties en transacties die een hoger risico met zich brengen, kunnen worden aangewezen bij ministeriële regeling in plaats van bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: exemption from customer due diligence for listed trust offices and appraisers
categories of business relations and transactions carrying higher risk, including state of residence
exemption from politically exposed person rules for persons living in the Netherlands
Minister of Finance may grant time-limited exemptions from politically exposed person rules, with conditions
designation of states with strategic deficiencies and of institutions required to apply special measures
further measures to manage risks linked to designated states, by general administrative order
rules on personal data processing, linkage and retention by the Financial Intelligence Unit
supervisors decide whether foreign supervisors may use shared information for other purposes
Minister of Finance may delegate supervisory powers to officials
p: Supervisors may share confidential information with other and foreign supervisors, subject to purpose and confidentiality conditions.
Higher-risk categories tied to the customer's country of residence can now be set by ministerial regulation rather than general administrative order, allowing quicker changes.
Ministers may designate states and impose special measures on customers from them, including restriction or termination of transactions, with limited statutory criteria.
Institutions that report unusual transactions in good faith are shielded from civil liability to third parties.

parties: Asks whether the Netherlands can implement all FATF recommendations in time and how other member states are progressing, for a level playing field.
The VVD members ask whether the Netherlands can implement all recommendations and improvements in time within this short period.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of Nederland in dit korte tijdsbestek in staat is om alle aanbevelingen en verbeteringen op tijd door te voeren
Asks for the justification of the 25% substantial-interest threshold and whether more reports raise supervisory and enforcement costs for the Tax Authority and the Financial Supervision Office.
The PVV members ask whether an increase in the number of reports would not lead to higher supervision costs.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of een stijging van het aantal meldingen dan niet tot hogere toezichtkosten leidt.
Asks the government to explain precisely which FATF recommendations are translated into the bill and how, and whether other matters are regulated beyond them.
Can the government indicate what these FATF recommendations precisely are and how they are being converted into legislation?
Kan de regering aangeven wat deze aanbevelingen van de FATF precies zijn en op welke wijze deze worden omgezet in wetgeving?
Asks about the effectiveness of the Wwft, the amount of laundered money recovered, and the burden on appraisers and on people with dual nationality under the PEP rules.
Can the government, for example, give a number of results since the introduction of the Wwft?
Kan de regering bijvoorbeeld een aantal resultaten sinds de invoering van de Wwft geven?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the Wwft amendment implementing FATF recommendations but raised several technical points: unclear addressing of accountants, verification of straw men, the basis for exemptions from enhanced client due diligence, and the scope of linking FIU data with other databases. The government reply reports that the advice was followed in most points, with clarifications added to the explanatory memorandum and a redactional remark on an unnecessary mandate provision.
concerns: Unclear addressing of accountants versus their organisation risked uncertainty about who bears the obligation and liability; the norm addressee was limited to the independent accountant or accountancy organisation.
