How does this premise relate to the principle of legality, which requires that conduct may only be punished under a criminal provision existing at the time of the act?

Hoe verhoudt dit uitgangspunt zich tot het legaliteitsbeginsel dat vereist dat een gedraging slechts bestraft kan worden op grond van een op het moment van handelen bestaande wettelijke strafbepaling?
Asks how the directive's victim-protection rules relate to the suspect's right under Article 6 ECHR to question witnesses.
If the latter is the case, these members ask how this relates to the suspect's right under Article 6 of the ECHR to be able to question the victim as a witness.

Indien dat laatste het geval is vragen deze leden hoe zich dat verhoudt tot het in artikel 6 van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de Rechten van de Mens en de Fundamentele Vrijheden (EVRM) vastgelegde recht van de verdachte het slachtoffer als getuige te kunnen ondervragen.
Asks why existing Criminal Code sex-offence provisions are insufficient and requests the timing of the forthcoming implementing decree.
These members ask why the offences in the current sex-offences title of the Criminal Code do not provide sufficient protection to guarantee the obligations under the EU directive?
Deze leden vragen waarom de strafbaarstellingen uit de huidige zedentitel van het Wetboek van Strafrecht niet voldoende bescherming bieden de verplichtingen uit de EU-richtlijn te waarborgen?
Questions whether the narrower Dutch wording on exploiting a child's vulnerable position implements the directive fully, and whether the Dutch host-server takedown obligation is met.
That seems to be a narrower implementation than the EU directive prescribes, since under the chosen wording the abuse of the vulnerable position must be proven.
Dat lijkt toch een beperktere implementatie dan de EU-richtlijn voorschrijft, nu op grond van de gekozen formulering het misbruik maken van de kwetsbare positie bewezen moet worden.
Asks whether higher maximum penalties were considered and how enforcement of employment-screening rules across member states is ensured.
These members ask the government how it is ensured in the EU member states that these measures are actually enforced.
Deze leden vragen de regering op welke wijze in de EU-lidstaten zeker wordt gesteld dat deze maatregelen daadwerkelijk worden gehandhaafd.
Asks how victim privacy and proper treatment during prosecution are guaranteed and how data protection safeguards apply to cross-border data exchange.
How is the privacy of the victim guaranteed?
Hoe wordt de privacy van het slachtoffer gewaarborgd?
Raises the presumption of innocence in exchanging information after a technical dismissal (sepot) and asks for the legal framework of such exchange.
They recognise the need to exchange information, but see a tension with the presumption of innocence, particularly regarding technical dismissals (sepot).
Zij onderkennen de behoefte informatie te wisselen, maar zien met name inzake het technisch sepot een spanningsveld met de presumptie van onschuld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion (8 February 2013) supports the bill implementing Directive 2011/93/EU on child sexual abuse and exploitation but raises concerns about incomplete implementation (policy-based implementation, unclear criminalisation of sexual acts, guardian for child victims, disclosure duty, victim protection, suspect access to programmes), the penalty for abuse of authority, and amending an AMvB by act. The minister's nader rapport largely rejects or reframes the objections, but accepts changes on several points (transposition table, MvT additions, dropping the penalty increase, moving the Besluit amendment to a separate decree).
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that policy measures and general legal context fully implement the directive's binding obligations, and the minister partly accepts this by clarifying the MvT and transposition table while defending reliance on existing practice.

The Afdeling finds the use of 'seksuele handelingen' and the mix of ontucht and seksueel binnendringen insufficiently justified, while the minister argues the directive leaves the term to member states and adds MvT text.
The Afdeling says a court-appointed guardian for child victims in criminal proceedings should be provided under Book 1 BW, but the minister declines, arguing existing BW and Sv provisions suffice.

The Afdeling notes the Wjz disclosure exemption covers only abuse within dependency relationships, whereas the directive is broader; the minister argues Art. 53(3) Wjz covers the purpose and adds MvT explanation.

The Afdeling questions whether victim protection measures during investigation and trial are adequately secured, and the minister commits to aligning the Aanwijzing with the directive and adjusting the transposition table.
The Afdeling asks how suspects' access to intervention programmes is secured without adverse procedural effects, and the minister adds MvT and table text.
The Afdeling finds the proposed increase of the penalty for ontucht met misbruik van gezag unnecessary because existing provisions already meet the directive, and the minister drops the change.
Amending an AMvB (Besluit justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens) by act is undesirable, and the minister accepts moving the amendment into a separate decree.

Exchanging data on prosecutorial dismissals (sepot) goes beyond what the directive requires and lacks a legal basis and justification; the minister accepts consulting the CBP and will reconsider the scope in the separate decree.
The Afdeling suggests Titel XIV has too many overlapping specific offences and penalty aggravations, but the minister sees no reason for a broader revision of the sex-offence title.

33640-V.s: The bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) and of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), adjusting expenditure and commitment amounts in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2013. It is a supplementary budget adjustment under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, with the explanatory memorandum justifying the deviations against the prior budget.
33640-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 requirement to explain significant differences between the original and current estimates.
q: In accordance with the Government Budget Rules and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, notable differences between the original and current estimates must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de oorspronkelijke en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

33661.s: The bill requires secondary schools to use a student monitoring system tracking pupils' progress in Dutch, English, mathematics and arithmetic, and to administer a mandatory diagnostic interim test at the end of the lower years based on national interim attainment targets. It also obliges selected schools to take part in international comparative research and amends the laws on secondary education, the College voor toetsen en examens and the expertise centres accordingly.
33661.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that the detailed rules on the test, attainment targets and quality requirements will be set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation, which it says respects the constitutional freedom of education.
q: Further rules on the diagnostic interim test, the elaboration of the attainment targets and the quality requirements a student monitoring system must meet will be set by (or pursuant to) a general administrative order.

Verdere regels over de diagnostische tussentijdse toets, de uitwerking van de tussendoelen en de kwaliteitseisen waaraan een leerlingvolgsysteem dient te voldoen, zullen bij (of krachtens) algemene maatregel van bestuur worden vastgesteld.
d: quality requirements for student monitoring systems
interim attainment targets for the diagnostic test
rules on content, conduct, timing and exemptions of the diagnostic test
decision on which international comparative studies are mandatory
College voor toetsen en examens sets test tasks, norms and tool rules
phased introduction of the diagnostic test
p: Detailed rules on the diagnostic test and its attainment targets are left to a general administrative order rather than the statute itself.

parties: Asks how parents' position and right to dispute the test level are secured, and how public accountability use of test results is prevented.
How does the government intend to prevent this from becoming a public accountability instrument, these members would like to know.
Hoe wil de regering voorkomen dat hiermee een publiek verantwoordingsinstrument ontstaat, zo vernemen deze leden graag.
Asks how student privacy is protected given the broad scope of data that a learner tracking system may record.
How does it intend to prevent schools from filling in the learner tracking system so broadly that students' privacy suffers in the long term?
Hoe wil zij echter voorkomen dat scholen het leerlingvolgsysteem zo breed invullen dat de privacy van leerlingen op lange termijn daaronder gaat lijden?
Questions the need for mandatory tracking systems and the mandatory test and international studies, fearing teaching to the test and a narrowed curriculum.
These members urge the government very firmly to revise its plans in this respect.
De leden dringen er bij de regering zeer dwingend op aan haar plannen hiertoe te herzien.
Strongly opposes the mandatory diagnostic test and mandatory international studies, citing Raad van State criticism and risks of teaching to the test.
These members are extremely critical of the mandatory introduction of a diagnostic test and participation in international comparative studies.
Deze leden staan uitermate kritisch ten opzichte van de verplichte invoering van een diagnostische toets en deelname aan internationale vergelijkende onderzoeken.
Positive on the tracking system but asks the government to withdraw the mandatory diagnostic test, fearing teaching to the test and school rankings.
They are positive about the points on the learner tracking system, but ask the government to withdraw the proposal on the diagnostic interim test.
Zij zijn positief over de punten met betrekking tot het leerlingvolgsysteem, maar vragen de regering het voorstel met betrekking tot de diagnostische tussentijdse toets in te trekken.
Opposes more state steering and obligations, citing the Onderwijsraad and Raad van State that centralised mandatory testing may hinder school quality.
They reject more government steering and more obligations in education, because it will be more obstructive than promotive for school quality.
Zij wijzen meer overheidssturing en meer verplichtingen in het onderwijs af, omdat het eerder belemmerend dan bevorderend zal werken voor de kwaliteit van scholen.

Objects that the bill imposes three mandatory interventions on professional freedom and disregards the government's recent respect for schools' didactic choices, questioning proportionality and necessity.
The bill however contains coercive interventions in professional freedom in the form of a triple obligation.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat echter dwingende ingrepen in de professionele vrijheid in de vorm van een driedubbele verplichting.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill introducing a learner tracking system, a diagnostic interim test and mandatory participation in international comparative research in secondary education, but warns against rigid quality control, recommends not mandating international research participation, and asks for consultation and differentiation for the Caribbean Netherlands. The government's reply accepts the emphasis on school autonomy and clarifies the memorandum, but keeps the mandatory participation in a limited number of international studies and commits to a later, consulted introduction on the BES islands.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the mandatory learner tracking system and diagnostic test be sufficiently motivated against the risk of rigid quality control and loss of school autonomy; the government clarifies the memorandum but keeps the instruments.

The Afdeling advises against mandating participation in international comparative research as too severe an instrument; the government maintains mandatory participation in a limited number of studies.

The Afdeling asks that the consultation obligation toward the BES island public bodies be observed and that differences between secondary education in Europe and the BES islands be addressed; the government confirms consultation and adds text but defers implementation timing.

33715.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen (WNT) on pay caps for top officials in the public and semi-public sector, mainly removing general-benefit (ANBI) institutions from its scope, narrowing some subsidized institutions, and making technical changes such as excluding social insurance premiums from the pay definition and clarifying transitional rules. It also amends several bijlagen (annexes) and makes retroactive effect from 1 January 2013 with an enforcement and reporting clarification.
33715.j: The memorandum justifies the annex-amending powers as allowing technical updates without a new statute, since names and institutions change over time.
q: However, it is desirable that for a future amendment on this point the formal route of a legislative procedure need not be followed.
Het is echter gewenst dat bij een volgende wijziging op dit punt niet de formele weg van een wetsprocedure gevolgd hoeft te worden.
d: amending annex of institutions subject to WNT by general administrative order
amending annex of education associations by general administrative order
amending annex of institutions subject to second regime by general administrative order
amending annex of institutions subject to third regime by general administrative order
deviation from pay norms for supervisory board members
fixing a part-time factor for supervisory board members
p: Ministers are assigned which minister is responsible for enforcement across several categories of institutions, clarifying the executive's supervisory role.
I.1.A.7 and I.1.B (art. 1.3 lid 2 and 3, scope)

Removal of general-benefit institutions (ANBI) from the pay-cap regime reduces external pay oversight of those bodies, while the executive gains power to amend annexes by administrative order without statute.

parties: Asks whether pay conditions for ANBIs can be attached as eligibility requirements and whether municipalities and provinces can set additional pay rules for subsidised bodies.
Does the government agree that if institutions receiving government subsidies may be subject to requirements on top incomes, this should also be possible for ANBIs?
Deelt de regering de mening dat als aan instellingen, die overheidssubsidies ontvangen, eisen mogen worden gesteld ten aanzien van de topinkomens, dat ook in het geval van anbi's zou moeten kunnen?
Objects that retroactively removing ANBIs ignores the House's deliberate amendment and questions reliance on self-regulation and convenants without enforcement.
Why does the government not simply implement the law as the House adopted it?
Waarom voert de regering de wet niet gewoon uit zoals deze door de Kamer is vastgesteld?
Asks for the status of the sector code and whether self-regulation justifies removing ANBIs from the Wnt, and requests clarity on who the pay-restricted governing body is.

Based on the information the government has provided, the CDA members are not yet convinced that the instrument mentioned makes statutory measures unnecessary and justifies removing ANBIs from the Wnt.

Op grond van de informatie die de regering verstrekt, zijn de leden van de CDA-fractie er nog niet van overtuigd dat het genoemde instrument de wettelijke maatregelen overbodig maakt en het schrappen van anbi's uit de Wnt rechtvaardigt.
Asks whether larger ANBIs could stay under the Wnt, whether enforcement alternatives such as spot checks were considered, and urges quick action on letting municipalities set additional pay rules.
These members ask whether consideration was given to bringing ANBIs of substantial size under the scope of the Wnt.
Deze leden vragen of is overwogen om anbi's van substantiële omvang onder de reikwijdte van de Wnt te brengen.

33733.s: The bill amends the Wet personenvervoer 2000, the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 and Book 8 of the Civil Code to implement EU Regulation 181/2011 on bus and coach passenger rights. It designates the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment as enforcement authority (with inspection via ILT), allows the Minister to designate terminals and grant temporary exemptions, and routes individual complaints first to the carrier and then to a complaints commission.
33733.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the EU regulation's requirements for member-state designation of enforcement bodies, the practical nature of terminal designation and exemptions, and the need for ILT to supervise efficiently.
q: Because designating terminals and granting exemptions is more a matter of policy than of implementation, these powers will not be mandated to ILT.
Omdat de aanwijzing van terminals en de verlening van vrijstellingen veeleer een zaak van beleid dan van uitvoering is, zullen deze bevoegdheden niet aan ILT worden gemandateerd.
d: further definition of car in ministerial regulation
Minister designates bus terminals under EU regulation
Minister grants temporary exemptions from regulation
Minister designates persons to supervise compliance
further rules on implementing the regulation
p: The Minister is empowered to impose administrative enforcement orders (last onder bestuursdwang) to enforce the regulation and the Act's obligations on carriers.
Passengers' complaints about EU-regulation infringements must first go to the complaints commission, a procedural step before the enforcement authority.
The Minister may impose administrative fines or penalty orders for intercommunautarian infringements of the regulation.

parties: Asks whether the regulation adds administrative burden for carriers and whether it is needed to ensure proper driver training.
Members of the VVD group read in the Explanatory Memorandum that the bill creates no administrative burden for citizens or businesses.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD lezen in de Memorie van Toelichting dat het wetsvoorstel geen administratieve lasten oplevert voor burgers of het bedrijfsleven.
Asks whether doubts about the regulation's effectiveness were resolved, whether decentralised governments were involved in consultation, and requests more frequent enforcement reporting by the ILT.
Members of the PvdA group ask why a biennial enforcement report by the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) was chosen.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom er voor een tweejaarlijks handhavingsverslag van de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) wordt gekozen.

Asks for a comparison with airline passenger rights, the expected pace of phasing in provisions, and clarification of overlapping responsibilities for accessibility, including with regional authorities.
Members of the D66 group read that an overlap may arise regarding responsibilities for accessibility for persons with disabilities and reduced mobility.
De leden van de D66-fractie lezen dat er een overlap kan ontstaan met betrekking tot de verantwoordelijkheden voor toegankelijkheid voor personen met een handicap en beperkte mobiliteit.

33742.s: The bill amends the Wet overdracht tenuitvoerlegging strafvonnissen to set out a detailed procedure for the direct enforcement in the Netherlands of custodial sentences imposed abroad, under article 43. The Minister forwards requests to the Advocate-General and a special chamber of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court, which assesses and adjusts the sentence before the Minister decides.
33742.j: The explanatory memorandum is absent, so no justification is given for the delegation or new powers.
q: the enforcement or further enforcement of a custodial sanction imposed in a foreign state may take place in the Netherlands on the Minister's designation, outside the application of sections A, B and C

kan op aanwijzing van Onze Minister de tenuitvoerlegging of verdere tenuitvoerlegging van een in een vreemde staat opgelegde vrijheidsbenemende sanctie in Nederland plaatsvinden buiten toepassing van de afdelingen A, B en C
d: direct enforcement of foreign custodial sentences outside standard procedures, per designation of the Minister
p: The Minister may order enforcement outside the usual procedures where a treaty expressly allows it, bypassing the standard court-based steps, though a special court chamber still assesses the request.

parties: Asks whether the government can always refuse transfer, worries that known transfer options encourage drug courier crime, and raises costs and whether transfers should be funded by the offender.

These members attach importance to the government always being able to refuse a transfer, for example because the return of a particular detainee could be harmful to public order or cause social unrest.

Voornoemde leden hechten eraan dat de regering een overdracht altijd kan weigeren, bijvoorbeeld omdat terugkeer van een bepaalde gedetineerde nadelig kan zijn voor de openbare orde of maatschappelijke onrust kan veroorzaken.
Supports transfer of sentences, asks about the scope for substantive assessment versus formal rejection, and asks why the court's role is limited to a marginal test.
Is it not precisely for the judge, as an independent party, to make a careful (substantive) assessment?
Is het niet juist aan de rechter als onafhankelijke partij, om een zorgvuldige (inhoudelijke) afweging te maken?

Questions why the government rather than a judge decides on admission and early release, asks about legal protection against government decisions, and asks for a statutory fix for too-short remaining sentences.
These members ask this in particular because this assessment and decision rest with the government and not with the judge.
Deze leden vragen dit met name ook omdat deze beoordeling en beslissing aan de regering toekomt en niet aan de rechter.
Asks why there is a judicial and then an administrative phase, what remedies exist against refusals, and why the government may deviate from a positive court opinion but not a negative one.
Why in the past was there never a separate review by the government when the court gave a negative opinion?
Waarom is er in het verleden bij een negatief advies van het Hof nimmer een aparte toets door de regering uitgevoerd?
Welcomes alignment with practice but argues for case-by-case flexibility on the six-month threshold and asks about the Ombudsman's findings on systematic rejections.
These members are not convinced, however, that a sentence of a few months would offer no possibility for this.
Deze leden zijn er echter niet van overtuigd dat een straf van enkele maanden daartoe geen enkele mogelijkheid zou bieden.

33750-IIB.s: This bill fixes the 2014 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat and the Governors' cabinets (IIB), in thousands of euros, for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the cabinets of the Governors of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. The explanatory memorandum covers the policy articles and budget effects, including the Rutte II cost-cutting target for the Raad van State.
33750-IIB.j: The memorandum explains budget figures and the Rutte II cost-cutting target without justifying any delegation or new powers.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2014 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33805-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statute of the States General (Staten-Generaal, IIA) by adjusting appropriations across its policy and non-policy articles, as set out in the attached amended budget table. It takes effect on 1 December 2013, with retroactive effect if published on or after 1 June.
q: Amended budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2013
Gewijzigde begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2013

33841.s: The bill transfers responsibility for social support (participation, self-reliance, sheltered living and shelter) for people with disabilities or chronic psychological problems from national schemes to municipalities, setting out their duties, eligibility rules, quality requirements, data processing and cost recovery. It also gives municipalities regulatory power via municipal ordinances and grants the executive broad powers to set rules by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation.
33841.j: The memorandum justifies delegations by the need for a uniform system of income-based contributions across all municipalities and for keeping the policy framework workable, while stressing that municipalities retain broad policy space.
q: The bill makes the providers contracted by municipalities directly responsible for delivering good-quality support.
Het wetsvoorstel maakt de door gemeenten gecontracteerde aanbieders direct verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van ondersteuning van goede kwaliteit.
d: rules on client contributions for support and personal budgets
income and assets basis for contributions, with draft sent to parliament before adoption
municipal ordinance on eligibility criteria, quality, budgets and fraud rules
working procedures and expertise of domestic violence reporting points
further rules on price and quality balance for services
additional quality requirements for providers where service level requires
elements a mandatory reporting code must contain
categories of non-lawfully resident foreigners eligible for support, possibly departing from the Aliens Act
designation of areas and forms of inter-municipal cooperation
data to be supplied to the minister and reporting timetables
p: Income and asset-based client contributions are set by general administrative order, with a waiting period and parliamentary approval procedure for asset rules.
Government may by AMvB extend support to categories of unlawfully resident foreigners and deviate from the Aliens Act, without parliamentary involvement.
Municipalities conduct needs assessments and may refuse support or withdraw it, including for non-cooperation.
Municipalities may revise or revoke support decisions on several grounds.
Providers must share personal and special category data with supervisors, including professionally confidential data, without consent when the client cannot consent.
Municipalities may refuse a personal budget on several conditions and the general administrative law title on the budget is disapplied.

parties: Asks the government to list all delegation provisions in the bill and justify why they are not in the statute itself, while supporting broad municipal discretion.
The bill uses delegation in several places, for example via an order in council (amvb).
In het wetsvoorstel wordt op verschillende plekken gebruik gemaakt van delegatie, bijvoorbeeld een amvb (mogelijkheid).
Supports the reform but asks how vulnerable citizens without networks are protected from being overlooked and how to prevent unwanted variation between municipalities.
Which citizens run the greatest risk of being overlooked by municipalities, so that they do not receive the support they need?
Welke burgers lopen het meeste risico dat zij over het hoofd gezien worden door gemeenten, zodat zij niet de ondersteuning krijgen die zij wel nodig hebben?
Fears loss of legal entitlement to care, replacement of the compensation principle by a result obligation, fragmentation across 408 municipalities, and budget cuts forcing rationing.
Does the law not thus become a law without rights, where people's rights are lost in a race to the bottom?
Verwordt de wet zo niet tot een rechteloze wet waarbij de rechten van mensen in de race naar de bodem teloor gaan?
Sees the bill as dismantling home care and leaving citizens between wal and schip; asks how municipal discretion can be squared with guarantees and quality supervision by the same municipality.
Does tension not arise between municipal policy freedom and quality supervision?
Ontstaat er geen spanning tussen de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten en het toezicht op de kwaliteit?
Argues the existing Wmo offers legal protection and that the bill turns rights into duties and a 'no, unless' regime, questioning whether municipalities can carry the task given the cuts.

According to the CDA members, the current Wmo works well in practice, functions well for municipalities, and offers a degree of legal protection to the participating citizen and his request for support.

Volgens de leden van de CDA-fractie werkt de huidige Wmo in praktijk goed, is deze goed werkzaam voor gemeenten, en biedt hij een bepaalde mate van rechtsbescherming aan de participerende burger en zijn vraag om ondersteuning.

Supports the direction but regrets the lack of clarity on the link with the Wlz and Zvw, asks about democratic legitimacy of regional cooperation bodies and the legal basis for procurement exemptions.
How is the democratic legitimacy of the regional cooperation bodies safeguarded?
Op welke wijze wordt de democratische legitimiteit van de regionale samenwerkingsverbanden geborgd?
Asks whether the preconditions for a 1 January 2015 start are solid enough and how citizens will be informed clearly about changes in support and financial contributions.
For these members, clear, honest, understandable and complete communication about this comes first.
Voor deze leden staat heldere, eerlijke, begrijpelijke en complete communicatie hierover voorop.
Worries that the 1 January 2015 start is too short, that cuts will push people into institutions or overburden informal carers, and that uncertainty about the linked laws remains.
The entry-into-force date of 1 January 2015 is too short a notice to make a careful transition.
De inwerkingstredingsdatum van 1 januari 2015 is te kort dag om een zorgvuldige omslag te maken.
Supports the vision but finds guarantees of freedom of choice, personal control and carer support insufficiently elaborated, and asks for a timetable for the related laws and AMvBs.
On parts important to them they find the elaboration of the bill limited; for example the safeguarding of freedom of choice and personal control and support for informal carers.
Op voor hen belangrijke onderdelen vinden zij de uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel beperkt; te denken valt aan de borging van de keuzevrijheid en de eigen regie en de ondersteuning van mantelzorgers.
Considers the implementation period too ambitious given three decentralisation laws and asks for postponement to 1 January 2016.
Because these laws concern vulnerable groups, they argue that if the law is adopted, this date should be postponed by one year to 1 January 2016.
Omdat deze wetten kwetsbare groepen betreffen, pleiten zij dat bij aanname van de wet, deze datum een jaar wordt opgeschoven naar 1 januari 2016.
Asks whether the compensation principle versus the maatwerkvoorziening is correctly understood and how municipal regulations are prevented from narrowing individual tailored support.
Does the government agree with the VVD members that the investigation and support a municipality can provide must always start from the client's request?
Is de regering het met de leden van de VVD-fractie eens dat het onderzoek en de ondersteuning die een gemeente kan leveren altijd moeten beginnen met de vraag van de cliënt?
Asks whether the model regulation can be tested against the law and why the outcome of an investigation is not treated as a decision open to objection, affecting citizens' legal position.
Why can the result of the investigation, or the decision not to proceed, not be treated as a decision against which a citizen can object?
Waarom kan het resultaat van het onderzoek of het afzien hiervan niet als besluit worden gezien, waartegen een burger een bezwaar kan maken?
Criticises the removal of an individual right to care, questions citizens' ability to object and appeal, and doubts that the complaints procedure adequately protects rights.
Is the complaints right not an insufficient guarantee that people can enforce their rights, given that the right to care in the Wmo 2015 is insufficiently safeguarded?
Is bovendien het klachtrecht niet een onvoldoende waarborg dat mensen hun recht kunnen halen, omdat het recht op zorg in de Wmo 2015 onvoldoende is gewaarborgd?
Urges a careful parliamentary process, postponement of the start date, and a costing of the effects for income groups, arguing that municipal capacity and the rollout are not yet clear.
Does the government share the view of these members that responsible introduction of this bill stands or falls with that?
Deelt de regering de opvatting van deze leden dat verantwoorde invoering van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel hiermee staat of valt?
Argues the government's picture is too rosy and based on assumptions, and objects that municipalities could direct people into institutions and that gemeenten are judging their own supervision.
That is the butcher judging his own meat!
Dit is dus wel de slager die zijn eigen vlees keurt!
Asks for the financial assumptions behind the 1.2 billion cut and when the implementing AMvB's will be submitted to parliament.
When will the government submit the related AMvB(s)/implementing decree(s) to the House?
Wanneer zal de regering de hiermee samenhangende AMvB(’s)/uitvoeringsbesluit(en) aan de Kamer voorleggen?

Asks whether consultation with clients and their representatives required by the UN disability convention is sufficiently anchored in the statute, and that the pgb choice must be an equal alternative to care in kind.
For the GroenLinks members, the principle is that the choice between a pgb and care in kind must be an equal choice.
Voor de leden van de GroenLinksfractie staat voorop dat de keuze tussen het pgb en zorg in natura een gelijkwaardige keuze dienen te zijn.
Questions the definitions of algemene voorzieningen and maatregelen, the lack of a statutory definition, the gap for youth between Wmo and Jeugdwet, and whether aanbesteding is required by law.
Why does the explanatory memorandum say tendering is not mandatory, but this is not explicitly included in the statute at article 2.6.4?
Waarom wordt wel in de toelichting genoemd dat er geen aanbesteding verplicht is, maar wordt dit niet expliciet opgenomen in de wet bij artikel 2.6.4?
Expresses concern that a maatwerkvoorziening is offered only as a last resort after informal networks and general provisions.
This means that only once all resources
Dit betekent dat pas als alle hulpbronnen z

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (decentralising part of AWBZ long-term care to municipalities), finding the proposal needs further consideration on the scope of the persoonlijke verzorging transfer, delineation, implementation timeline, mandatory cooperation, eligibility, quality/supervision and data processing. The minister's nader rapport accepted most points, adding budget, narrowing dual supervision, clarifying data safeguards, and rejecting some objections (e.g. the mantelzorg article and the regresrecht were largely retained with justification).
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether moving persoonlijke verzorging to the Zvw undermines the cost-containment and integrality goals, and asked for a substantive justification; the government explained the choice on care-content grounds but did not fully resolve the cost concern.

The Afdeling doubted the feasibility of the 1 January 2015 implementation date and the strict transitional law; the government added EUR 200 million transition budget and structural extra funds from 2016.
The Afdeling asked for concrete criteria delineating Zvw and Wmo care; the government pointed to clearer statutory descriptions of the verzekerd recht and amended the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling found mandatory inter-municipal cooperation unnecessary as a first step; the government kept the power as a fallback and separated it into a new article.

The Afdeling flagged privacy intrusions from processing (bijzondere) persoonsgegevens of clients and their social network, lacking purpose limitation, necessity criteria, retention rules and voluntary consent; the government narrowed purposes, added criteria, a retention provision and clarified consent and SHG limits.

The Afdeling said the universal entitlement to apply for support cannot be upheld given budget limits and suggested considering the financial position of applicants; the government refused an income or assets test, leaving income-dependent contributions to the rules.

The Afdeling found the melding and onderzoek procedure unclear, risking that the outcome of an investigation is treated as a decision; the government amended the article so an application requires a prior investigation and clarified the legal status of the weergave.
The Afdeling asked clarification on gebruikelijke hulp, including non-resident children and financial help; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum accordingly.

The Afdeling found diffuse responsibilities for quality standards between municipalities, the legislature and the Zorginstituut and questioned dual supervision with the IGZ; the government placed quality and supervision fully with municipalities and removed the dual supervision.
The Afdeling said the PGB should not be treated as a subsidy under Awb titel 4.2; the government restored the exclusion of titel 4.2 Awb for persoonsgebonden budgetten.
The Afdeling asked the zorgplicht in article 2.1.1 to include beschermd wonen and opvang; the government reformulated the article and the explanatory memorandum to cover these.
The Afdeling said article 1.2.3 gives no concrete delineation of persoonlijke verzorging; the government deleted the provision as unnecessary.
The Afdeling advised deleting article 2.1.6 on a yearly mantelzorg waardering as unnecessary; the government kept it to secure recognition of informal carers.

The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of the regresrecht and collectivisation of damages in article 2.4.3-2.4.4; the government kept it with brief justification, citing the cost-consciousness goal.

33850.s: The bill establishes the Centrale Verwerking Openbaar Ministerie (CVOM) as a separate prosecution office within the public prosecution service, regulating its staff and leadership in the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie. It also makes conforming amendments to the Sv on appeal jurisdiction, the Wrra on civil service status, and the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens.
33850.j: The memorandum justifies the separate CVOM positioning by the need for its own prosecutors and active personnel policy, replacing secondment arrangements, and notes the Raad van State advice that a delegation via AMvB was unnecessary.
q: By positioning the CVOM as a separate office in the Wet RO, the CVOM can appoint its own public prosecutors and no longer needs secondment arrangements.

Door de CVOM als afzonderlijk parket in de Wet RO te positioneren, kan de CVOM «eigen» officieren van justitie aanstellen en behoeft niet langer gebruik te worden gemaakt van detacheringsconstructies.
p: The head of the CVOM is given power to issue general and specific directions to staff working in the office on the exercise of its tasks and powers.

parties: The SP accepts the need for a statutory basis for the CVOM but worries that the ZSM fast-track may sacrifice care, extend to unsuitable cases, and weaken timely legal assistance for suspects.

These members point to the risk that speed comes at the expense of care, the types of cases eligible for ZSM handling, the (deficient) involvement of the legal profession in the project, and the importance of timely legal assistance.

Zij wijzen op het risico dat de snelheid ten koste gaat van de zorgvuldigheid, het type zaken dat voor ZSM-afhandeling in aanmerking komt, de (gebrekkige) betrokkenheid van de advocatuur bij het project en het belang van tijdige rechtsbijstand.

33904.s: The bill amends the Railways Act and the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to simplify the permit regime protecting main railway infrastructure, add rules for special (bijzonder) railways, and allow the minister to grant exemptions and set residence bans around public transport facilities. It also makes various technical changes, shifting many detailed rules into ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
33904.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of detailed rules to ministerial and general administrative orders as providing legal certainty, flexibility for special railways, and alignment with EU directives, while stating that the residence ban is needed to address persistent nuisance around public transport.
q: It has become clear that because the existing statutory text lacks a primary assessment framework, considerable uncertainty can arise in implementation practice.
Gebleken is dat door het in de bestaande wetstekst ontbreken van een primair toetsingskader, in de uitvoeringspraktijk aanmerkelijke onzekerheden kunnen rijzen.
d: Artikel I, A/B (art. 1, 8 lid 4 and 7 Spoorwegwet)
exemptions from main railway technical specifications and rules on eligible main railways
rules for keeping and publishing the railway infrastructure register
exemptions from permit requirement and additional obligations for activities near main railway, within boundaries set by ministerial regulation
boundaries (begrenzingen) within which the permit requirement applies
rules on protection of main railway infrastructure and use
exemptions for rolling stock testing and use; procedures for exemption granting
Artikel I, W/X (art. 50 lid 4, 51c lid 3 Spoorwegwet)
rules on medical/psychological assessments and approval of examiners
exemptions for train drivers and which railways/vehicles they apply to
safety rules for special railways, including categories that may be exempted from the Act
cost-covering fees for acts required by directly binding EU regulations
rules on duration of residence bans at public transport facilities
p: Permit requirements and boundaries for activities near main railways are moved from statute into ministerial and general administrative rules, with the explicit fixed-distance criterion removed and open-ended conditions added.
Buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren, employed by carriers, may impose residence bans and use force to exclude persons from transport facilities, with duration to be set by general administrative order.
Special railways may be excluded from most of the Act by general administrative order, with safety regulation largely delegated.
Administrative versus criminal sanctioning of violations is left to be determined per offence by general administrative order.
Minister may grant exemptions from driver certification requirements within limits set by EU directive and ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks the government to specify the duration of the stay ban in law rather than leaving it to transport operators, fearing loss of government control.
Is the government not afraid that by lacking direction it will lose its grip on this, these members ask.
Is de regering niet bang dat ze door het gebrek aan richting de grip hierop kwijtraakt, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether additional requirements can be imposed on drivers from other member states and whether station gates are considered under the EU regulation.

These members ask whether the mentioned European regulation also sets specific requirements for this.](Note: translation: These members ask whether the mentioned European regulation also sets specific requirements for this.)
De leden van deze fractie vragen of de genoemde Europese verordening 1 hier ook nog specifieke eisen aan stelt.
Asks why the statutory maximum duration of the stay ban is not set in law, as the Raad van State considered necessary, and prefers a legal criterion over delegation to the minister.

These members believe a statutory criterion is preferable to the possibility in the bill that the State Secretary sets rules on the duration of a stay ban by or pursuant to a general administrative order.

De leden van deze fractie menen dat een wettelijk criterium de voorkeur verdient boven de nu in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen moge lijkheid dat de Staatssecretaris bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur regels stelt over de duur van een verblijfsverbod.
Objects to delegating the boundaries of rail corridors and the maximum stay-ban duration to delegated regulation, and proposes statutory spatial reservation zones and a statutory maximum duration.
Given the nature of this penalty, which directly restricts the right to freedom of movement, the members of this group request further justification for why no maximum is laid down in the law.

Gezien de aard van deze straf, die het recht op bewegingsvrijheid rechtstreeks beperkt, vragen de leden van deze fractie een nadere onderbouwing over waarom er geen maximum in de wet wordt vastgelegd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill on simplifying the main-line railway permit regime, rules for special railways, and a ban on staying in public transport facilities, but raises objections on proportionality and the freedom of movement, the lack of a maximum duration, broad sub-delegation, derogation by ministerial regulation, the absence of an evaluation clause, and external safety of coupling-up manoeuvres. The government reply accepts most points: it adds explanation on freedom of movement, limits delegation and the derogation power to an AMvB, adds a transitional clause, and keeps the power in the bill while rejecting the statutory evaluation clause and the maximum duration.
concerns: The ban on staying in public transport facilities restricts freedom of movement under the ECHR and ICCPR, which the explanatory memorandum did not address; the government added an explanation but did not change the bill.
A maximum duration for the stay ban should be set in law because the scope of conduct is wide and breach is a criminal offence; the government declined, citing practice and proportionality.
Several ministerial-regulation delegations are too open-ended and must be tested against sub-delegation conditions and narrowed; the government narrowed them.
The transitional-law delegation in article 19(7) is redundant given article 19(5) and should be deleted; the government kept it but redrafted it.
Derogation from statutory provisions for special railways should be possible only by AMvB, not by ministerial regulation; the government adopted this.
The bill should include a statutory evaluation clause; the government rejected this, saying the monitoring is ongoing and does not require legislative change.
External safety gaps for coupling-up manoeuvres under case law are unresolved; the government explained the basisnet framework and interim policy but did not change the bill.
Redactional remarks on terminology, cross-references and conforming amendments to other laws were largely adopted.

33913.s: The bill implements EU Energy Efficiency Directive 2012/27/EU by amending the Wet implementatie EU-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie, Elektriciteitswet 1998, Gaswet and Warmtewet, adding requirements on cold-metering, energy cost estimates, invoicing and smart meter customer information. It also creates a statutory basis allowing rules on heat invoicing, data and metering prices to be set by general administrative order (AMvB) and lets the ACM enforce the new obligations.
33913.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB powers as needed to implement the directive and to intervene only if the market for individual meters works insufficiently, while noting ACM supervision already applies.
q: However, the intention is to use this possibility only if the market for these meters does not work sufficiently and no good price formation arises.
Echter, het ligt in de bedoeling uitsluitend van deze mogelijkheid gebruik te maken indien de markt voor deze meters onvoldoende werkt en er geen goede prijsvorming tot stand komt.
d: rules on heat energy-cost estimates, invoice format and frequency, data provision, and access costs
rules on energy cost estimates, invoicing and information to customers
ARTIKEL I, B (art. 2 lid 10 Wet implementatie)
alternative cost-efficient method for measuring cold consumption
p: ARTIKEL II, A-F; ARTIKEL III; ARTIKEL IV
Establishes a statutory basis for an AMvB to set metering and invoicing price and cost rules, with the memorandum stating such rules would be used only if the market fails.

parties: Asks how earlier critical input shaped the directive, whether it could have been prevented, and about the Energy Agreement and future revisions.
They therefore ask the government how their critical input is reflected in the directive.
Zij vragen daarom aan de regering hoe hun kritische inbrengen terug zijn te vinden in de richtlijn.
Asks about Commission approval of the Dutch alternative approach, timing of implementation, and how the Chamber will be involved in lower regulation.
In what way will the Chamber be involved in this?
Op welke manier wordt de Kamer hier bij betrokken?
Asks how targets and results will be monitored and when the Chamber will be informed, and questions legal correctness of excluding CHP from the target.
The SP members ask how the targets and results will be monitored.
De leden van de SP fractie vragen hoe de doelstellingen en resultaten gemonitord gaan worden.
Opposes additional EU obligations and costs for industry, SMEs and households and asks what would be gained by abandoning energy-efficiency obligations.
The members believe we should not burden industry, business and households with more regulation and costs, but with less.
De leden zijn van mening dat we onze industrie, bedrijfsleven en huishoudens niet op moeten zadelen met meer regelgeving en lasten, maar juist met minder.
Supports full implementation but asks for detailed justification of measures deemed already implemented and for an evaluation of implementation.
Furthermore, these members would like to hear how the evaluation of the implementation of the REE will be shaped.
Bovendien horen deze leden graag hoe evaluatie van de implementatie van de REE wordt vormgegeven.
Asks about timing of lower-level regulation, the 1.5% saving target, consumer barriers, CHP and the meaning of the energy cost estimate.
The ChristenUnie members ask when the elaboration of the implementation of the Directive in lower regulation will take place.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen wanneer de uitwerking in lagere regelgeving van de implementatie van de Richtlijn plaatsvindt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing Directive 2012/27/EU on energy efficiency lacks a proper legal basis for certain obligations, since the Wet milieubeheer and the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht rather than the Activiteitenbesluit should carry them, and the transposition table should be amended. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the legal basis and the transposition table was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the transposition of Article 14 obligations on cost-benefit criteria and individual exemptions is placed in general AMvBs that cannot impose permit requirements or grant individual exemptions, so the correct statutory basis should be explained.
The Afdeling advises amending the transposition table to reflect the correct implementing instruments for the directive's provisions.

33930-IIB.s: This bill is a 2013 Slotwet that adjusts the departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. It sets the final budget outcomes and amends the appropriations for the year 2013, effective retroactively to 31 December of that budget year.
q: to make changes to the departmental budget statement of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the Nationale ombudsman
wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman

33940-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statute of the Dutch States General (parliament), the first supplementary budget, adding about EUR 4.7 million mainly to the Tweede Kamer's legislation and oversight budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 June 2014 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the budget statute of the States General (IIA) for the year 2014.
Wij ... hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2014.

34000-IV.s: The bill formally establishes the 2015 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties), setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes planned evaluations, guarantee and oversight arrangements for Caribbean Netherlands and the autonomous countries, and funding of police, judiciary and coast guard support.
q: That the Kingdom has the authority to act within the guarantee function strengthens the institutions of the countries in their task of realising the principles of the democratic constitutional state.

Dat het Koninkrijk de bevoegdheid heeft in het kader van de waarborgfunctie op te treden, sterkt de instituties van de landen in hun taak om de beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat te realiseren.

34000-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the operating budgets of its agencies (DJI, CJIB, NFI, IND, Justis), in thousands of euros. It also clarifies that the minister is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Council for the Judiciary.
34000-VI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the clarified allocation of responsibility by pointing to the new division of competences under the Judiciary Organisation Act and the principle of integrated management of the courts.
q: Referring to Article 21 of the Comptability Act 2001 in conjunction with Articles 23 and 91 of the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Minister of Security and Justice is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar het bepaalde in artikel 21 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

34039.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code and the Extradition Act to implement the Council of Europe Istanbul Convention on violence against women and domestic violence, extending extraterritorial jurisdiction and extradition coverage to listed offences such as forced marriage, genital mutilation, forced abortion and luring a person abroad for exploitation. It sets entry into force by royal decree and makes no broad delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
34039.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to meet obligations under the Istanbul Convention and notes that a general administrative order under Article 6 Sr will be supplemented to establish extraterritorial jurisdiction.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether Dutch policy already meets European standards and whether the Convention forces measures that are not necessary.
In addition, these members ask to what extent the convention obliges the Netherlands to implement measures that are in fact not or less necessary.
Daarnaast vragen deze leden in hoeverre het verdrag Nederland verplicht tot het uitvoeren van maatregelen die feitelijk niet of in mindere mate noodzakelijk zijn?
Asks whether the criminalisation of preparatory acts for forced marriage is enforceable and whether it has improved prosecution.
To what extent does the government expect that the criminalisation of preparatory acts can be effectively enforced?
In hoeverre verwacht de regering dat de strafbaarstelling van voorbereidingshandelingen goed handhaafbaar is?
Asks why the bill refers to an existing article rather than a specific offence and whether penalties and prosecutorial capacity are adequate.
Is the penalty under article 284 of the Criminal Code sufficient given the nature of forced marriage?
Is de strafmaat van artikel 284 Sr voldoende gezien de aard van huwelijksdwang?
Supports the measures but asks how the government will objectively determine 'luring' of a person, given the vagueness of the definition in article 285c.
However, these members ask how the government thinks it can objectively establish when there is 'luring' of a person.
Echter, vragen deze leden vragen op welke wijze de regering objectief denkt te kunnen vaststellen wanneer er sprake is van het «lokken» van een persoon.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing the Istanbul Convention on violence against women and domestic violence, but raises objections on prosecuting economic violence (which the Convention's definitions cover, while marital property offences are excluded from prosecution) and on phased entry into force, and advises revising the bill. The minister's reply rejects the first point, arguing the Convention's offence obligations do not require criminalising economic violence, and adopts the second by removing phased entry into force.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the marital-relationship exclusion from prosecution of property offences (art. 316 Sr) sits uneasily with the Convention's aim to prosecute all forms of domestic violence including economic violence; the minister replies that the Convention's offence articles do not require criminalising economic violence.

The Afdeling advises removing the phased entry-into-force provision since the implementing rules should take effect together with the treaty ratification law; the minister amended the bill accordingly.

34075.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Bussum, Muiden and Naarden and merges them into a new municipality, Gooise Meren, and also moves the boundary with Weesp. It sets transitional rules on taxes, shared arrangements, staff, archives, electoral and court districts, and an additional grant for the financially weak Muiden.
34075.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the need for administrative strengthening and notes that the Raad van State advised on alternatives such as intermunicipal cooperation.
q: When handling the article 12 application, the Minister of the Interior will act in line with an amendment adopted by the House of Representatives.
Bij het afwikkelen van de artikel 12-aanvraag zal de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties handelen in lijn met een door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks the government to clarify the size of the KNSF claim, whether the settlement agreement is binding, and how the Amendment-Van Beek compensation would apply.
What amount is involved in that claim?
Welk bedrag is met die claim gemoeid?
Asks for maximum certainty on the new municipality's finances and for the government to compensate the full extra costs of the claim, not only those not attributable to Muiden's fault.
What the government should mainly ensure, in the view of the PvdA members, is maximum certainty about the financial situation of the new municipality.
Waar de regering naar de mening van de leden van de PvdA-fractie met name voor zou moeten zorgen is maximale zekerheid over de financiële situatie van de nieuwe gemeente.
Expresses serious doubts about the need for the merger and the new municipality's financial future, and asks for figures on the claim and the Article 12 risks before debate continues.
They do have pressing questions about the necessity of this merger and the financial future of the new municipality.
Wel hebben zij indringende vragen over de noodzaak van deze herindeling en de financiële toekomst van de nieuwe gemeente.
Questions whether the Amendment-Van Beek still applies, asks for government guarantees and compensation for Muiden, and questions the wording on fault in the settlement.
Is the government prepared to issue a state guarantee for the amounts the dissolved municipality of Muiden must pay under the settlement agreement?

Is de regering bereidt een garantstelling van het Rijk af te geven voor de bedragen die de op te heffen gemeente Muiden moet betalen in verband met de vaststellingsovereenkomst, al dan niet na beëindiging daarvan?
Supports the merger as a step toward stronger governance but asks the government to clarify and limit the financial consequences of a possible damages claim.
Finally, is the government willing to clarify the bill by including that the financial consequences of a possible damages claim are limited?
Tot slot, is de regering bereid om het wetsvoorstel te verduidelijken door daarin op te nemen dat de financiële gevolgen van een mogelijke schadeclaim beperkt worden.
Asks how the risk to voluntary municipal cooperation is assessed given the claim, requests scenarios for the legal procedure, and asks for examples of earlier Article 12 mergers.
They ask for the various scenarios linked to the legal procedure currently under way to be outlined.
Zij vragen om de verschillende scenario's te schetsen die zijn verbonden aan de juridische procedure die op dit moment doorlopen wordt.
Shares concerns that the KNSF settlement must not burden the public services and residents of the new municipality, and asks how the government assesses proposed changes to Article 7.

It must not be the case that this settlement, reached with support from the province and national government, comes at the expense of public services in Gooise Meren and/or the residents of the new municipality.

Het mag niet zo zijn dat deze afwikkeling, die met steun van provincie en rijk tot stand is gekomen, ten koste gaat van de publieke voorzieningen in Gooise Meren en/of de inwoners van de nieuwe gemeente.
Asks whether the merger is necessary and voluntary, questions the financial soundness of the new municipality and asks whether the Article 12 grant decision can precede the bill.
What they consider most important is whether the merger is necessary, not imposed, arrived at from the bottom up, and supported by the municipalities involved.
Zij vinden het vooral van belang of er sprake is van een herindeling die noodzakelijk is, niet opgedrongen en van onderaf tot stand gekomen, waarbij er draagvlak is bij de betrokken gemeenten.

34084.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act (Wet luchtvaart) to implement EU regulations on air navigation charges, performance schemes and accident investigation. It sets the Minister's role in annually fixing unit rates and charge modulation, adds supervision and enforcement powers for the Minister over EU rules, and creates administrative enforcement and fine powers for emergency plans.
34084.j: The memorandum justifies the Minister's charge-setting and supervision powers as necessary for implementing the EU regulations, which it describes as having a highly technical character.
q: The supervision of the implementation of the emergency plan obligation by airlines must, however, still be secured in law.
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van de noodplanverplichting door de luchtvaartmaatschappijen moet wettelijk echter nog geborgd worden.
d: unit rates for local air navigation services and incentive measures via regulation
p: The Minister may decide to modulate air navigation charges as provided in the EU regulation, a discretionary power with limited specificity in the bill.
Extends the Minister's administrative enforcement powers to cover the accident investigation regulation, with bestuursdwang and fines for emergency plans.

parties: Asks whether the bill's overlap with the directly applicable EU accident investigation regulation can be avoided and whether charge modulation will be used, with criteria.

Why was it not chosen to include an exception provision in the bill for those parts of the Kingdom that fall under the investigation regulation, in order to avoid overlap of provisions, these members ask.

Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om in het wetsvoorstel een uitzonderingsbepaling op te nemen voor die delen van het Koninkrijk die onder de onderzoeksverordening vallen, om zo samenloop van bepalingen te voorkomen, zo vragen deze leden.
Has no further questions or comments on the proposal.
These members have no further questions or comments on this proposal.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen en opmerkingen over dit voorstel.
Questions whether harmonised charges are needed for optimal airspace use, and calls the EU long-term capacity, safety and cost targets unrealistic, questioning airport growth.

Tripling the airspace capacity, improving safety by a factor of ten, reducing the environmental burden by ten percent and then reducing air traffic control costs by 50 percent is, according to these members, pure fantasy.

Het verdrievoudigen van de capaciteit van het luchtruim, het verbeteren van de veiligheid met een factor tien, het verlagen van de milieubelasting met tien procent en vervolgens het verminderen van de kosten voor de luchtverkeersleiding met 50 procent is volgens deze leden pure luchtfietserij.

Asks how many airlines could face enforcement or fines over emergency plans, whether Netherlands is ahead of other member states, and requests a timeline and details on post-MH17 measures including passenger rights.
These members would like an explanation of each of these points.
Graag zien deze leden een toelichting op elk van deze punten.

Supports the Single European Sky but asks whether the charges regulation could harm safety and how the EU regulations relate in hierarchy, and asks about the status and scope of the aviation emergency plan.
For example, does the charges regulation, which obliges member states to introduce financial schemes to stimulate cost efficiency and optimal capacity use, not lead to a negative effect on safety?

Leidt bijvoorbeeld de vergoedingenverordening, die lidstaten verplicht tot het invoeren van financiële regelingen om kostenefficiëntie en een optimaal capaciteitsgebruik te stimuleren, niet tot een negatief effect op de veiligheid?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Wet luchtvaart amendment implementing three EU regulations should drop the air-accident investigation rules duplicated in the Rijkswet OVV (the regulation applies directly) and extend supervisory powers to the charges and performance regulations. The government replied that it keeps the OVV rules for coherence and for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, and it accepted the extension of article 11.1 of the Wet luchtvaart.
concerns: Air-accident investigation rules in the Rijkswet OVV duplicate directly applicable EU Regulation 996/2010 and should be restricted in scope; the government kept them for coherence and for ICAO obligations in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
Supervisory powers for enforcing the charges and performance regulations were missing from article 11.1 of the Wet luchtvaart and should be added, which the government did.
Several redactional points, including citation of Regulation 391/2013 and updating of ministerial references, were incorporated.

34129.s: The bill restructures police education by making the Politieacademie a public-law body led by a single director with a deputy, creating a police education council and a national police qualification framework, and transferring staffing and resources to the national police corps. It also abolishes the Wet op het LSOP en het politieonderwijs and adjusts related complaint, ombudsman and transitional rules.
34129.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to keep civil diploma recognition and alignment with regular education while keeping police practice connected to education, and by the need for the minister to retain steering tools under the Kaderwet.
q: The college of governors of the Politieacademie is replaced by a director.
Het college van bestuur van de Politieacademie wordt vervangen door een directeur.
d: Artikel I, C (art. 25, eerste lid, onder b en c Politiewet 2012)
designation of police-related matters previously set by ministerial regulation
designation of functions or categories of persons subject to complaint rules
Artikel I, L (art. 77, eerste lid; art. 76)
rules on the director and deputy director of the Politieacademie
organisation and working method of the police education council
functions or categories of persons placed at disposal of the education council
Artikel I, L (art. 82, tweede lid; art. 83, derde lid)
designation of police education programmes and qualification framework
minister sets strategic research agenda at least every four years
requirements on staff and resources placed at the Politieacademie
financial management rules for the Politieacademie
rules on regular quality assessment of the Politieacademie
existing decrees and regulations transferred to new statutory bases
p: The Politieacademie is placed under a director appointed by royal decree with powers over staffing, resources and budget, and the minister keeps steering instruments under the Kaderwet, including annulment and intervention powers.
The minister sets the qualification framework and strategic research agenda by ministerial regulation, with advice from the police education council."

parties: Asks how the bill ensures staff and resources aren't redirected to operational police work and how training needs are met.
The VVD members ask what happens to current lecturers and other staff of the Police Academy after this bill takes effect.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wat er gebeurt met de huidige docenten en overige medewerkers die werkzaam zijn aan de Politieacademie na inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks which bodies are consulted on the AMvB setting requirements for staff and facilities, and how the director's consent right works.
These members would like to know which bodies will be asked for advice when drafting the AMvB.
Deze leden willen graag weten bij welke instanties advies gevraagd wordt bij het opstellen van de amvb.
Doubts that a director and deputy director as a ZBO can counterbalance the large police organisation; raises risks of staff control, research interference and self-censorship.
These members ask whether the government recognises the identified risks and what it will do to prevent them from materialising in practice.
Voornoemde leden vragen de regering of zij de gesignaleerde risico’s onderkent en wat zij gaat doen om te voorkomen dat dit risico zich in de praktijk voordoet.
Questions whether the independence of the academy is sufficiently guaranteed given the thin ZBO structure criticised by the Raad van State and the Algemene Rekenkamer.
These members ask the government to respond to the criticism that this separation is insufficiently worked out and therefore insufficiently safeguarded in the bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering te reageren op de kritiek dat deze scheiding in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel onvoldoende uitgewerkt en dus onvoldoende gewaarborgd is.
Worried that abolishing the supervisory board and the minister setting the research agenda undermine independence and oversight.
Does the government acknowledge that the Minister of Security and Justice setting the strategic agenda could hamper research freedom?
Erkent de regering dat de vaststelling van de strategische agenda door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie de vrijheid van het onderzoek zou kunnen bemoeilijken?
Asks how independence is safeguarded given the influence the national police can exert on training duration, entry requirements and staffing.
In what way is the independent function of the Police Academy sufficiently safeguarded?
Op welke wijze wordt de onafhankelijke functie van de Politieacademie voldoende gewaarborgd?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill integrating the Police Academy into the national police lacks sufficient safeguards for the academy's independence, notably staff positioning, the director's personnel policy powers, and ministerial framing of research, and asked for reconsideration. The government's reply accepted the staffing and personnel points by adding a recommendation right, rejected the view that the chain of command is weak, defended single-director governance and the research agenda, and amended the bill on the Politieonderwijsraad composition and redactional points.
concerns: Advice that Police Academy staff should be employed by the academy itself to protect its independence; the government rejected employment transfer but added a recommendation right for the director and stressed functional authority over staff.
Concern that the director lacks legal powers to shape personnel policy, undermining independence; the government added an active recommendation right alongside the existing consent right.
Concern that single-director governance without a board or supervisory council makes the academy vulnerable; the government justified the change and added a deputy director.
Concern that the minister's power to set a strategic research agenda may restrict research freedom; the government clarified that academic freedom outside the themes is preserved.
Concern that the Politieonderwijsraad's required material expertise is not specified in the bill; the government specified the composition in the bill.

34138.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure to simplify and digitise appeal and cassation procedures, starting all appeals with a single procesinleiding filed electronically. It also sets fixed time limits for appeals, lodging grounds, and judgments, and gives the appellate judge a stronger case-management role.
34138.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as simplifying and digitising civil procedure, speeding up appeals, and giving judges case-management tools in line with the coalition agreement.
q: The bill builds on the earlier proposal concerning first-instance procedures.
Het wetsvoorstel bouwt voort op het eerder ingediende voorstel dat betrekking heeft op procedures in eerste aanleg.
p: Artikel I, onderdelen Q, S, X, Z
The appellate judge gains discretion to decide whether to hold an oral hearing and to pronounce oral judgments, with parties given a right to be heard on request.
A single-judge chamber handles all appeal cases and decides whether to refer them to a multi-judge chamber.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill simplifying and digitising civil appeal and cassation procedure, raising objections on oral hearings in appeal review procedures, oral judgments, refund of court fees, and the structure of the bill. The minister's reply largely rejected the oral hearing and structure objections, accepted clarification on oral judgments, and accepted the proposed refund regime and the structural and drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that oral hearings should remain the starting point in pure request procedures (personal/family law, BOPZ, debt rescheduling), which the minister rejected to preserve harmonisation and judicial case management.

The Afdeling asked for justification why oral judgments in appeal cannot be followed by a written judgment within fourteen days; the minister explained the design and amended the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the refund of court fees on withdrawal be clarified and addressed in the accompanying bill; the minister referred to the draft refund scheme of two-thirds in the Invoeringswet and supplemented the memorandum.
The Afdeling raised structural concerns about the title of the seventh title and the placement of the fourth section on request procedures, which the minister adopted by amending the heading.
Redactional comments on various articles were incorporated in the bill and the explanatory memorandum.

34147.s: The bill approves the Decree of 16 October 2014 on levies related to animal health care (Besluit heffing bestrijding dierziekten), as required by article 110a of the Animal Health and Welfare Act within three months of that decree's entry into force. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is cited as the Goedkeuringswet Besluit heffing bestrijding dierziekten.
34147.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as a statutory requirement to submit an approval law for the levy decree within three months, with no further justification of delegated power.
q: This bill aims to approve the Decree on levies for combating animal diseases.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe het Besluit heffing bestrijding dierziekten goed te keuren.

parties: Asks when the new financing convenant for disease control is expected to be concluded.
However, these members ask how things stand with the new convenant on financing disease control.
Wel vragen deze leden hoe het staat met het nieuwe convenant financiering bestrijding.

Asks whether the levy was included in the ministry's benefit calculations, requests cost comparisons with former productschappen, and asks whether the evaluation of the convenant and avian influenza outbreak has been or will be shared, raising accountability questions.
The CDA members read in the explanatory memorandum that the decision leads to a reduction in regulatory burden.
De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen in de memorie van toelichting dat het besluit leidt tot een verlaging van de regeldruk.
Asks whether branch organisations under EU regulation 1308/2013 also impose disease control levies and what role they played in the decree.
The D66 members ask whether the branch organisations established under Regulation (EU) No 1308/2013 also impose levies for combating animal diseases.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de brancheorganisaties, die zijn opgericht onder Verordening (EU) Nr. 1308/2013, ook nog heffingen opleggen ten behoeve van de bestrijding van dierziekten.

34219.s: The bill establishes an independent Autoriteit Nucleaire Veiligheid en Stralingsbescherming (ANVS) as a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan, transferring licensing, supervision and rule-making powers for nuclear safety and radiation protection from the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment and other ministers to it. It restricts the minister's oversight of the authority to appointments, budget, approval of its internal rules, annulment of decisions only for conflict with law, and intervention where it seriously neglects its duties.
