Het lid Klein zet vraagtekens bij deze huidige gang van zaken en vraagt in hoeverre de regering de huidige verplichting tot het opstellen van een dergelijke rapportage een «dode letter» acht, daar er momenteel helemaal geen sancties staan op het niet opstellen van een dergelijk rapport.

34453.s: The bill replaces the municipal preventive building-plan check under the Woningwet and Wabo, for designated building categories, with mandatory quality assurance by private instrument providers and licensed quality assurers, overseen by a new approval body (toelatingsorganisatie kwaliteitsborging bouw). It also strengthens the private-law position of clients, including limits on waiver of contractor liability for hidden defects and disclosure of insurance or security.
34453.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as allowing gradual introduction and category designation by general administrative order, responding to market and municipal concerns about a dual system.
q: To still allow gradual introduction, the bill provides a basis to designate by general administrative order categories of buildings that fall under the quality assurance system.

Om alsnog een geleidelijke invoering mogelijk te maken, voorziet het wetsvoorstel in een grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur categorieën bouwwerken aan te wijzen die onder het stelsel van kwaliteitsborging voor kwaliteitsborging vallen.
d: designation of building categories subject to quality assurance
minimum rules for quality assurance instruments
procedure and deadlines for admission applications
further rules on tasks of the approval body
Artikel II A, art. 2.10 lid 3 sub b
designation of other building categories exempt from permit
approval body sets fees and payment method
p: Designation of building categories subject to private quality assurance is left to a general administrative order, removing municipal preventive review for those categories.
Municipalities lose the preventive check on technical building rules for designated categories, which are replaced by reliance on private instruments and a presumption of compliance.
Approval body supervises instrument providers, with suspension and withdrawal powers and a public register providing transparency.
Contractor liability for hidden defects after delivery is strengthened, with waiver restricted for natural-person clients and limited for business clients.

parties: Asks whether alternative plans were involved in the consultation, and questions the independence of the quality assurer and the design of the authorisation body as an autonomous agency, including whether it could be a counterweight to government as client.
Is the separation of functions between ministries not precisely aimed at providing a counterweight?
Is de functiescheiding van de ministeries niet juist gericht op het kunnen bieden van tegenwicht?

Doubts the bill makes the right choices, questions whether private quality assurance guarantees 100% conformity, and argues municipalities should keep a final assessment role and that appeal rights must remain available to end users.

Asks how duplication of tasks between municipalities and private parties is prevented, how liability of municipalities is arranged when they cannot test, and how monument quality and transparency of municipal fees are safeguarded.
Can the government indicate how duplication of tasks is prevented, these members ask.
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dubbeling van taken wordt voorkomen, zo vragen deze leden.

Stresses the importance of protecting consumers in building projects and asks questions on monuments and the integration of building and heritage assessment, as well as on combined entry into force with the Omgevingswet.
These members consider protecting the consumer in building projects very important, and believe a good legal framework is necessary for this.
Deze leden achten het beschermen van de consument bij bouwprojecten zeer belangrijk, en menen dat dit hiervoor een goed wettelijk kader noodzakelijk is.

Asks how a proliferation of non-transparent quality systems is prevented, questions the reduced room for adjustments during construction for monuments, and asks about liability when permits were based on flawed calculations.
These members ask how it will be prevented that a proliferation of systems arises that are not transparent to the consumer.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat er een wildgroei ontstaat van systemen die voor de consument niet inzichtelijk zijn.

Asks how the knowledge of professional groups is involved in approving instruments, whether the Raad voor Accreditatie supervises the authorisation body, and how the bill divides handhaving between the municipality and the authorisation body.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in July 2015 that the bill on quality assurance for construction (Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen) should not proceed to the House until its main elements, effectiveness, enforcement during and after construction, toezicht powers, financing, Services Directive compliance and transitional law are addressed. The minister's reply of April 2016 accepted most points, adjusting the bill, reformulating delegation, adding enforcement provisions and financing changes, while defending the private-led model.
concerns: The bill lacks the essential elements of the quality assurance system in statute; the government added them to the bill and clarified the roles and sanctions.

The effectiveness of the system is not sufficiently demonstrated and the phased introduction is unclear; the government added monitoring and an evaluation within three years but kept the private-led model.
Enforcement during and after construction is unclear and the municipality needs explicit powers; the government clarified its remaining supervisory and enforcement role.
The toelatingsorganisatie should have the supervisory powers of Awb title 5.2 or a narrower defined set; the government now designates supervisors under that framework.
Financing the toelatingsorganisatie through a tariff system conflicts with the principle that supervision serves the general interest; the government added a public contribution and a fee-based part.
The regulatory burden estimates lack quantitative backing; the government commissioned a Sira study and an MKBA and reported ranges.
The authorisation procedure falls under the Services Directive and needs a stronger proportionality justification; the government added motivation in the memorie.
Pending applications under the old law should be handled under the old rules, including appeals; the government adopted this in the transitional provisions.
The contractor's information duty on insurance lacks an effective sanction; the government clarified contractual and civil-law remedies including termination.

A dispute settlement scheme should be mandatory for instrument providers to strengthen the client's position; the government explained that disputes are governed by civil law and the instrument's rules.

34462.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 655/2014 on the European account preservation order in the Netherlands by designating the bailiff as competent authority and information body, and the district court's preliminary-relief judge as the court issuing orders. It sets procedures for appeals, requires lawyer representation for certain remedies, and fixes court fees and bailiff tariffs by reference to existing rules.
34462.j: The memorandum justifies the fee delegation by stating that the fee must match the work of the bailiff and cannot exceed the cost of an equivalent national order, as the regulation requires.
q: This article follows Article 42 of the regulation, which provides that court costs for a European account preservation order may not exceed the costs of an equivalent national order.

Dit artikel sluit aan bij artikel 42 van de verordening waarin is bepaald dat de gerechtskosten voor een Europees beslagbevel niet hoger mogen zijn dan de kosten van een gelijkwaardig nationaal bevel.
d: bailiff fees for account preservation and information

parties: Asks how courts assess sufficiency of evidence and whether national courts apply equal criteria to avoid legal inequality.
According to these members it is very important to prevent each national court from setting its own substantive conditions before issuing an attachment order.
Het is volgens deze leden van groot belang dat wordt voorkomen dat elk nationaal gerecht haar eigen inhoudelijke voorwaarden stelt voordat wordt overgegaan tot het afgeven van een beslagbevel.
Asks why the debtor is not heard and how the debtor's position is taken into account, and whether remedies suffice given weaker judiciaries in some member states.
The debtor himself is not heard.
De schuldenaar wordt zelf niet gehoord.
Asks for guarantees that divorce and matrimonial property claims are excluded and raises concern about differing civil law application in Eastern European states.
The members ask whether the government recognises the concern that civil law may be applied and interpreted differently, especially in Eastern European countries, than in the Netherlands.
De genoemde leden vragen of de regering de zorg (h)erkent dat vooral in Oost-Europese landen het burgerlijk recht op dit punt anders kan worden toegepast en uitgelegd dan in Nederland.
Asks whether the regulation is necessary and whether the current national procedures work, and what advantages the EU procedure offers.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing the EU regulation on the European order for account preservation should proceed, but that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented to explain how conditional or optional provisions of the regulation are implemented, plus several drafting remarks. The government's nader rapport explains that conditional provisions need no implementing rules because existing Dutch law applies, adds an annex, and adopts the drafting remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum explain whether and how conditional or optional provisions of the regulation are implemented, which the government answered by explaining these need no implementing rules and adding an annex.
Several redactional remarks on the bill text, such as wording and cross-references, were adopted by the government.
The Afdeling asked for clarification that appeal to the court of appeal is possible against refusal of a national attachment order, which the government clarified in the memorandum.

34471.s: The bill modernises the Dutch casino regime by ending the state monopoly on casino games and allowing up to sixteen time-limited, non-transferable licences awarded by auction, subject to geographic spread and strict conditions. It also imposes integrity, governance, CCTV and responsible-gambling obligations on licence holders, enforced by the Kansspelautoriteit.
34471.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegations as flexibility needed to implement geographic spread and detailed operational rules through lower regulation.
q: Ultimately the geographic spread will be given form in a general administrative order that offers some flexibility as a regulatory instrument.
Uiteindelijk krijgt de geografische spreiding zijn beslag in een algemene maatregel van bestuur die als reguleringsinstrument enige flexibiliteit biedt.
d: geographic spread, permitted games, size, licence duration and transfer rules
further rules on licence withdrawal and suspension
further rules on ownership, legal form and continuity
operational requirements, certification bodies and consumer protection
method for establishing integrity of licence holder and persons
expertise requirements for management and key staff
fair play rules and excluded categories of persons
rules on camera surveillance equipment and viewing rooms
slot machine approval rules that may depart from the general regime
rules on slot machines in casinos
one-off alternative licensing procedure set by joint ministerial regulation
p: The licensing body may grant licences without an auction when fewer than two applications exist, and ministers may set a one-off alternative procedure, departing from the statutory auction rule.
Licence refusal may follow from the auction outcome, and admission to the auction is at the regulator's discretion, widening administrative discretion over market entry.[...]

parties: Asks whether the competition authority's dominance advice requires changes to the bill and how anti-money-laundering and addiction-prevention standards will be guaranteed after privatisation.
In its advice of 1 April 2015 the ACM expresses its concern whether a long-term dominant position for Holland Casino is not being created.
In haar advies van 1 april 2015 spreekt de ACM haar zorg uit of er geen langdurige dominante positie voor Holland Casino wordt gecreëerd.
Objects that much is left to lower regulation and wants to see the concrete content of implementing rules before the bill enters into force.
These members are of the view that the bill may not enter into force without insight into that lower regulation.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het wetsvoorstel niet in werking mag treden zonder inzicht in die lagere regelgeving.
Worries that addiction prevention and control will not be safeguarded under private operators with profit motives and questions the need for privatisation at all.
They are very critical of the changes made to enable the privatisation of Holland Casino.
Zij staan zeer kritisch tegenover de wijzigingen die genomen worden teneinde de privatisering van Holland Casino mogelijk te maken.
Questions the broad delegation to lower regulation, ancillary activities next to casinos, the handling of an illegal operator, and the timing of the gambling reform.
the lack of clarity about how important objectives of gambling policy will remain upheld given the degree of sub-delegation and the chosen timetable for gambling policy.

de onduidelijkheid over de wijze waarop belangrijke doelstellingen van het kansspelbeleid overeind zullen blijven gelet op de mate van subdelegatie en het gekozen tijdpad ten aanzien van het kansspelbeleid.
Values strict safeguards for a legal, reliable and controllable offer and asks questions about the responsibilities placed on operators and staff.

Furthermore they attach value to a legal, responsible, reliable and controllable offer, in which strict safeguards regarding gambling addiction, consumer protection and combating fraud and crime are weighed.

Voorts hechten zij waarde aan een legaal, verantwoord, betrouwbaar en controleerbaar aanbod, waarin strikte waarborgen met het oog op kansspelverslaving, de bescherming van de consument en het tegengaan van fraude en criminaliteit worden meegewogen.
Questions whether expanding casinos is responsible given the addiction risks and whether operators will genuinely prevent addiction and report fraud under competitive pressure.
They ask whether this choice is a responsible one.
Zij vragen of deze keuze wel een verantwoorde keuze is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill to modernise the casino regime and privatise Holland Casino, but asked for better justification on competition, EU law compatibility (free movement and state aid), licensing procedure, privacy balancing, and the extent of sub-delegation. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adding justifications, a privacy assessment, clarified transitional rules and a licensing fallback, while declining to put the delegation grounds into the statute itself.
concerns: Advised further justification of the restriction on free movement of services and establishment under EU law, including the 15-year licence period and transitional restrictions; government added a motivation in a new section.

Doubted whether the 16-licence, regional model would achieve genuine competition and kanalisatie and whether a private monopoly or uncovered regions could arise; government defended the design and deferred uncertainties to the evaluation.

Asked that core elements such as licence validity, decision period and grounds for refusal be set in the statute; government largely declined, citing need for flexibility, but added a general framework on sub-delegation.

Flagged the absence of analysis on state aid risks from the privatisation and the allocation of licences; government added a state-aid section and concluded no notification under Article 108 TFEU was needed.
Requested a proportionality and subsidiarity balancing for the processing of personal data under the right to privacy; government added a privacy assessment.

Pointed out missing statutory rule for granting a licence when only one application remains and missing verification procedure for Holland Casino's buyer; government added a provision and clarified the explanatory note.
Asked for explanation of consistency of Dutch gambling policy across sub-markets (lotteries, slot halls, online); government added a section and committed to strengthen horizontal consistency.

34480.s: The bill implements EU Payment Accounts Directive 2014/92/EU by giving consumers lawfully residing in the EU a statutory right to a basic payment account at Dutch banks, with grounds for refusal, termination and complaint procedures. It also adds a supervisory and enforcement basis for the AFM and amends the municipal debt assistance act.
34480.j: The memorandum justifies the switching service and fee information measures as implementing obligations of the directive under the general duty of careful treatment of consumers.
q: Secondly, financial undertakings must provide consumers with certain information on the (tariffs of the) services linked to a payment account. This obligation will be implemented by general administrative order.

Ten tweede dienen financiële ondernemingen bepaalde informatie te verstrekken aan de consument over de (tarieven van de) aan een betaalrekening verbonden diensten. Deze verplichting zal bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden geïmplementeerd.
d: fee and cost information on payment accounts
p: Banks may check with other Dutch banks whether an applicant already holds an account and may ask for a signed declaration of no other account.

parties: Questions why the EU adopted the directive despite the cabinet's subsidiarity objection and asks about the scope of exclusion grounds and the AFM's supervisory costs.
Why is this EU directive in place after all? Why did the adoption of this directive proceed?
Waarom ligt deze EU-richtlijn er dan nu toch? Waarom is er doorgegaan met het vaststellen van deze richtlijn?
Supports the bill but questions how banks share information on existing accounts and whether past offences can justify refusal, given rehabilitation.
These members ask how the government views this possibility of refusing access to a basic payment account in light of the rehabilitation of offenders.
Deze leden vragen zich af hoe de regering deze mogelijkheid om de toegang tot een basisbetaalrekening af te wijzen beschouwd in het licht van de rehabilitatie van de pleger.
Asks how compliance with the reasonable-cost standard is checked and whether a maximum fee should be set, and for how long offence-based exclusion can last.
These members ask the government whether it would not be better to agree a maximum amount that may be charged for a basic payment account.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering of het niet beter is om een maximumbedrag af te spreken dat mag worden gevraagd voor een basisbetaalrekening?
Questions the need for the bill given existing Dutch arrangements, the statutory basis for the switching service, and the reporting obligation to the Commission.
Why is there a reporting obligation to the EC, while the AFM in the Netherlands already ensures enforcement of this bill?
Waarom is er een rapportageverplichting aan de EC, terwijl de AFM in Nederland al zorgdraagt voor de handhaving van onderhavig wetsvoorstel?
Asks why the directive needed EU action, why two points are regulated by AmvB rather than statute, and how the comparison website will be provided.
The PVV members would welcome an explanation of why those two points are also not regulated through the statute.
Graag ontvangen de leden van de PVV-fractie een toelichting waarom die twee punten ook niet via de wet worden geregeld.
Supports the directive's three objectives and asks for clarity on proof of genuine interest and on possible EU-wide comparison use.
The members support the three objectives of the directive: making it easier for consumers to switch to another bank, improving access to payment services and improving comparability of fees.
De leden ondersteunen de drie doelstellingen van de richtlijn om het voor consumenten gemakkelijker te maken om over te stappen naar een andere bank.
Asks why transparency and switching duties are set by AmvB rather than statute, and how banks assess genuine interest and the maximum cost of a basic account.
Why was this chosen and not implementation by statute, ask the members mentioned.
Waarom is hiervoor gekozen en niet voor een implementatie bij wet, vragen de genoemde leden.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised the Finance Minister to supplement the bill implementing Directive 2014/92/EU on payment account fees and basic payment accounts, because it had not fully implemented the comparison website obligation (Article 7) and the access rules for basic payment accounts (Articles 15 and 16). The government's reply states it adopted these points, adding a comparison website provision (Article 4:71j) and supplementing the access provisions, and also accepted the redactional remarks.
concerns: The bill failed to implement Article 7 of the directive on comparison websites, so the obligations could not be enforced in Dutch law without implementation.

The bill did not explicitly implement the access requirements for basic payment accounts (non-discrimination, internet-only accounts, consumers without fixed address) in Articles 15 and 16 of the directive.
Redactional corrections were needed, including aligning the two-year versus one-year period and the cross-reference, and adding the word intentionally in Article 4:71i.

34507.s: The bill modernises and simplifies the Dutch Wet basisregistraties adressen en gebouwen by moving detailed registration contents, authenticity designations and register requirements from statute into lower regulation, and replacing procedural rules and periodic external inspections with quality standards and annual internal self-checks by municipalities. It also drops several statutory deadlines in favour of time limits to be set by general administrative order and schedules a single further evaluation.
34507.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by arguing that detailed attribute lists and procedures should be adjustable without statutory amendment to keep pace with developments in the registration system.
q: The reason for this is the desired ability to change the set of data the BAG offers, for example in connection with developments in the system of basic registrations, without the law having to be amended.

Reden hiervoor is gelegen in de gewenste mogelijkheid om bijvoorbeeld in verband met ontwikkelingen binnen het stelsel van basisregistraties, wijzigingen aan te brengen in de set van gegevens die de BAG biedt, zonder dat de wet daarvoor behoeft te worden gewijzigd.
d: designation of source documents and officially appointed documents
permanent retention of source documents by mayor and aldermen
rules on maintaining the basic registration
system description including data standards and quality requirements
list of registered data at attribute level and which data are authentic
time limits for follow-up to reports and decisions on corrections
elements and rules for annual internal self-check
p: Key content of the registration, including which data are authentic and which source documents count, is moved from statute to general administrative order, so Parliament no longer decides these details directly.
Periodic external inspection of municipalities is replaced by annual internal self-checks reported to the minister, reducing independent external oversight of registration quality.
Statutory deadlines for handling reports and correction requests are replaced by time limits set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks how the six action points from the 2014 BAG evaluation, including inspection approach and feedback mechanisms, have been incorporated into the bill.
The VVD members ask for an explanation of how the six action points from the 2014 evaluation of the BAG have been incorporated into the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen een toelichting op de wijze waarop de zes aandachtspunten uit de evaluatie van de BAG uit 2014 in het wetsvoorstel zijn verwerkt.

Objects that many details are delegated to AMvBs and ministerial regulations without limits, that parliament would not be able to weigh in on future changes, and that the evaluation is replaced by a one-off report, so parliament should keep its controlling role and get a proper evaluation.
Many elements are regulated through this bill by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation (MR) without a real limit being specified.
Veel onderdelen worden via dit wetsvoorstel geregeld worden bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) en Ministeriële Regeling (MR) zonder een echte begrenzing aan te geven.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions.
The CDA members have taken note with interest of the present bill. They have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel. Zij hebben geen nadere vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the BAG bill to parliament but asked that the statutory four-yearly evaluation obligation be kept or at least one further evaluation be provided, since quality improvements and the shift to internal supervision still need assessment. The minister's reply accepted the point and added a single post-implementation evaluation report to the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the evaluation obligation in the Wet BAG be retained or at least one further evaluation be provided because the effects of the amended quality and supervision regime are not yet known.
The Afdeling asks that article I, part F, clarify in the first paragraph of article 8 that the provision concerns geometric data of buildings and residential objects, now that article 7 is deleted.

34516.s: The bill proposes adding an unnumbered general provision at the start of the Constitution stating that the Constitution guarantees democracy, the rule of law and fundamental rights. The explanatory memorandum argues this makes explicit the constitutional anchoring of these core principles, in line with international and foreign constitutional practice, without delegating any rule-making power.
34516.j: The memorandum justifies the provision by pointing to the Constitution's guarantee function, the interdependence of democracy, rule of law and fundamental rights, and parallels in international law and other national constitutions.
q: The Constitution guarantees democracy, the rule of law and fundamental rights.
De Grondwet waarborgt de democratie, de rechtsstaat en de grondrechten.

parties: Asks whether the general provision could be tested by courts or by parliament and what legal status it would have, and whether it could be interpreted in multiple ways.
Does it concern the current representative democracy or does this wording also leave room for direct forms of democracy, such as referendums?
Gaat het om de huidige representatieve democratie of biedt deze formulering ook ruimte voor directe vormen van democratie, bijvoorbeeld referenda?
Supports the provision and notes that courts could test government decisions against it, while asking about possible consequences for banning political parties.
Once the constitutional amendment is a fact, the judge can test government decisions and generally binding rules against the general provision.
Als de grondwetswijziging een feit is, kan de rechter overheidsbesluiten en algemeen verbindende voorschriften toetsen aan de algemene bepaling.

Asks about the legal consequences of the provision and whether it would be merely declaratory and symbolic, given the Council of State's view that courts could adopt a more substantive reading of democracy.
If these legal consequences do not exist, does this general provision not become, as the Council of State also outlines, merely 'declaratory-symbolic'?
Als deze juridische consequenties er niet zijn, wordt deze algemene bepaling dan niet, zoals de Raad van State tevens schetst, slechts «declaratoir-symbolisch»?

Is not convinced the provision adds normative value to a sober constitution and questions whether it changes the balance between legislature and judiciary, asking what it adds to citizens' rights or state duties.
Adding a new provision to the Constitution is only desirable if it leads to a normative strengthening of the Constitution.
Het opnemen van een nieuwe bepaling in de Grondwet is alleen wenselijk als die leidt tot een normatieve versterking van de Grondwet.

Criticises the wording's departure from the State Commission's proposal, notes that constitutional review of formal laws by courts is still not possible, and questions whether fundamental rights are adequately protected without material limitation requirements.

Without material limitation requirements, such as subsidiarity and proportionality, which are necessary in a democratic society, it is not entirely certain that the Constitution actually guarantees fundamental rights.

Zonder materiele beperkingsvereisten, zoals subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit, die in een democratische samenleving noodzakelijk zijn, is het niet zonder meer zeker dat de Grondwet grondrechten ook daadwerkelijk waarborgt.

Sees the provision as a valuable addition that could gain meaning if constitutional review is introduced, and asks whether it would block parliament from enacting laws contrary to the democratic rule of law.
Can the government indicate whether this general provision is a barrier to that?
Kan de regering aangeven of deze algemene bepaling daartoe een hinderblok is?
Questions the added value of the provision and asks why separation of powers and human dignity are not mentioned, and which conception of democracy is meant.
The SGP members wonder why the separation of powers is not explicitly included in the general provision.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af waarom de scheiding van machten niet uitdrukkelijk in de algemene bepaling is opgenomen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the proposal for a general constitutional provision ('De Grondwet waarborgt de democratie, de rechtsstaat en de grondrechten') to parliament until its concerns about the provision's normative meaning, scope, status and fit within the existing constitution were addressed, and suggested considering a preamble instead. The government's reply largely rejects the objections, clarifies the provision's interpretive and guarantee function, adds explanations to the explanatory memorandum, but keeps the wording unchanged.
concerns: The normative meaning, legal status and scope of the general provision are insufficiently explained; the government clarified its interpretive and guarantee function but did not expand the wording.
The provision does not clearly fit the existing sober constitution and its concrete, binding character; the government considers it sufficiently concrete and binding.
The provision may shift the balance between legislator and judge and increase judicial review; the government does not expect a change in that relationship.

The use of definite articles and the grondwetgever as sole addressee may imply completeness and exclusivity; the Council suggested the Staatscommissie wording 'Nederland is een democratische rechtsstaat', which the government did not adopt.
The Council advised considering a preamble instead if the normative content cannot be clarified; the government declined to weigh that option since a general provision was requested by motion.

34525.s: The bill amends the Tracéwet, the Wet milieubeheer and the Wet geluidhinder to widen the possibility of correcting errors in the noise register and to clarify several noise-ceiling and noise-measure provisions. It also lets the minister set aside noise-protection duties for dwellings with temporary zoning exemptions and allows lower-level rules to exempt certain cases from noise-mitigation obligations.
34525.j: The memorandum justifies the exemptions by avoiding costly noise measures for temporarily zoned dwellings and by ensuring consistency in the noise register, without elaborating on the scope of the delegated rule-making.
q: To prevent the road or railway manager from having to take such measures in these situations, the exceptions of article 2.12, first paragraph, under a, under 2° or 3°, of the General Provisions Environmental Law Act are added to articles 11.40 and 11.57, second paragraph.

Om te voorkomen dat de beheerder van een weg of spoorweg in deze situaties dergelijke maatregelen zou moeten nemen, worden aan de artikelen 11.40 en 11.57, tweede lid, de uitzonderingen van artikel 2.12, eerste lid, onder a, onder 2° of 3°, van de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht toegevoegd.
d: deadline for taking measures after noise-ceiling change for errors
rules on determining the area where ceiling compliance is suspended
cases where noise-mitigation measures need not be taken
Artikel II, N (art. 11.42, eerste lid, slotzin Wm)
cases where linked sanation is not required after ceiling change
cases where noise-mitigation measures for sanation objects are not taken
p: Responsibility for certain procedural acts under the Wet geluidhinder moves from municipal mayor and aldermen to the national minister.

parties: Asks about cumulative noise effects, consequences for noise-reduction goals, who pays if extra measures for noise-sensitive objects are required, and whether the bill speeds up route decisions.
The VVD members would like an explanation of the extent to which this bill addresses the consequences of cumulative noise.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zouden graag toelichting willen zien op de vraag in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel toeziet op de gevolgen van cumulatie van geluid.
Asks whether the proposed changes could lead to higher noise levels or more nuisance for residents and why the government considers the step necessary.
The PvdA members ask the government whether the changes proposed in this bill could in any way lead to a higher noise level and/or more nuisance.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of de wijzigingen die in dit wetsvoorstel worden voorgesteld op enige wijze kunnen leiden tot een hoger geluidsniveau en/of meer overlast.

Argues the changes seem aimed at making things easier for implementers while actual nuisance felt by residents is secondary, and asks whether experienced noise nuisance is considered, whether windturbines are covered, and how protection of residents is ensured.
These members see a very technical approach and ask to what extent noise nuisance actually experienced has also been considered.
Deze leden zien een erg technische benadering, zij vragen in hoeverre ook is gekeken naar geluidshinder die men daadwerkelijk ervaart.
Asks for examples of temporary structures deviating from zoning plans, their possible functions, and whether temporary structures can become permanent.
The CDA members ask the government to give examples of structures that deviate from the zoning plan.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om voorbeelden te geven van bouwwerken die afwijken van het bestemmingsplan.

Asks which scientific studies justify the claim that health effects of noise appear only over time, asks why no internet consultation was held, and questions the claim of no significant effects on citizens, municipalities and businesses.
The D66 members ask which studies the government relies on when it states that most health effects of noise, unlike nuisance, do not occur immediately but manifest over time.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke studies de regering zich baseert wanneer zij stelt dat de meeste gezondheidseffecten van geluid – anders dan hinder – niet direct optreden, maar zich na verloop van tijd manifesteren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Tracéwet, Wet milieubeheer and Wet geluidhinder, mainly on excluding temporary structures from noise protection and on a simplified procedure to correct errors in the noise register. The Council asked for better justification of the temporary-structures exclusion and clarification of the simplified procedure, and the government's reply removed the new simplified procedure and widened the existing one in part while addressing the temporary-structures point by adding exemptions tied to land-use deviations and a general administrative measure.
concerns: The exclusion of temporary structures from noise protection was not justified for all cases, including schools or hospitals used in temporary buildings, and needed reasoning or adaptation.
The simplified amendment procedure for noise production ceilings was unclear on whether underlying decisions could be changed, and was removed in the reply.
The simplified procedure was worded differently from the existing one, creating duplication, which the government addressed by deleting the new provision.

34543.s: The bill creates a statutory framework for anti-doping policy in the Netherlands and establishes the Dopingautoriteit as a public-law independent administrative body (zbo) responsible for doping controls, whereabouts obligations for top athletes, data processing, intelligence activities, and education. It also sets rules on data sharing, financing via fees, and ministerial supervision that excludes the power to annul the authority's decisions.
34543.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to effectively combat doping in sport while protecting athletes' health and privacy, with data processing grounded in a public-law task rather than consent.
q: Assigning a public-law task to the Dopingautoriteit results in the creation of an administrative body.
Het opdragen van een publiekrechtelijke taak aan de Dopingautoriteit heeft tot gevolg dat een bestuursorgaan in het leven wordt geroepen
d: publication of the World Anti-Doping Code and amendments
procedures for nominating board members and joint job profiles
fee-setting for Dopingautoriteit services, including maximum amounts
further rules on processing of personal data by the Dopingautoriteit
p: Excludes the minister's power to annul decisions of the Dopingautoriteit, limiting ministerial oversight of individual decisions affecting athletes.
Grants the Dopingautoriteit broad powers to process personal and health data, collect whereabouts data and gather information from open and other sources about athletes and their entourage.
Allows data sharing with the prosecutor, the public health inspectorate and foreign anti-doping organisations, limited by necessity and proportionality tests.

parties: Questions whether the authority's board members nominated by sports organisations are sufficiently independent and asks for guarantees of its independence.
Argues the bill only partly protects athletes' privacy because athletes cannot freely refuse data sharing and no legal basis covers sports federations' data processing.
The bill does not provide a legal basis for the processing of personal data by sports federations.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet niet in een wettelijke grondslag voor de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door sportbonden.
Doubts that athletes' consent to data processing is voluntary and asks about the right of objection and the limits of privacy intrusion.
Does the government recognise how intrusive it is for well-meaning athletes to have to constantly report where they are staying?
Erkent de regering hoe ingrijpend het voor goedwillende sporters is om steeds te moeten melden waar men verblijft
Questions the scope of the bill, the independence of the authority and the basis for information exchange with prosecutors, customs and police.
Why is cooperation with customs being regulated by general administrative order rather than in the statute itself?
Deze leden vragen waarom de samenwerking met de douane wordt geregeld bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Notes that athletes' consent cannot be truly free given the sanctions for refusal and asks how the power balance between athlete, federation and authority is safeguarded.
How does the government safeguard the power balance between athlete, sports federation and Dopingautoriteit?
Hoe waarborgt de regering de machtsverhouding tussen sporter, sportbond en Dopingautoriteit?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against sending the anti-doping bill (establishing a Dopingautoriteit) in its current form, arguing it does not achieve its aim because sporters' consent remains the basis for data processing and the minister lacks steering instruments. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice, revises the bill toward a public-law framework with explicit powers, duties and safeguards, adds steering powers under the Kaderwet, and asks that the revised bill be sent to parliament.
concerns: Consent of sporters is an inadequate legal basis for processing personal data in doping controls, and the bill must provide a sound legal basis instead.
The bill does not create the powers or the rights and duties of sporters needed to achieve its goal, so it misses its aim.
The minister lacks sufficient steering instruments over the Dopingautoriteit, and the bill must provide them; the government adds general policy-rule power but excludes annulment of decisions.
Ministerial accountability for the independent Dopingautoriteit is not effectively exercisable under the bill as drafted.

Privacy and bodily integrity of sporters require adequate safeguards; the government adds a right of objection and privacy protections while rejecting extra safeguards in the sporter-federation relationship.
Compliance with the EU data protection directive and transfers abroad (Article 25) is not established in the explanatory memorandum; the government adds clarifications and grounds for transfers.
The Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen does not apply because the body lacks public authority, and transitional arrangements from the foundation are unclear; both are addressed in the revision.

34552.s: This Dutch tax bill (Belastingplan 2017) adjusts income tax brackets and allowances, changes rules on the innovation box, wage tax and corporate tax, and reshapes the dividend and VAT rules for 2017 onward. It mainly sets tax rates and thresholds in statute and delegates technical detail on the innovation box, wage tax de minimis calculation and dividend tax refunds to general administrative orders or ministerial regulations.
34552.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as allowing technical details, such as de minimis calculation and innovation box rules, to be set flexibly and amended quickly in line with case law.
q: In addition, rules may be set by ministerial regulation on applying the third and fourth paragraphs to sectors not covered by the de minimis regulation referred to in the fourth paragraph.

Op basis van deze delegatiebepaling kunnen bij ministeriële regeling tevens regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de toepassing van het derde en vierde lid voor sectoren die niet onder het bereik van de in het vierde lid genoemde de-minimisverordening vallen.
d: ARTIKEL II, onderdeel B (art. 12a lid 10 Wet LB 1964)
rules on calculating de minimis ceiling for wage tax support
ARTIKEL IV, onderdeel C (art. 12bf Wet Vpb 1969)
further rules for innovation box and calculation of qualifying benefits
ARTIKEL IX, onderdeel C (art. 10a lid 6 Wet DB 1965)
rules on dividend tax refund request and calculation of notional income tax
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel M (art. 10.6bis lid 1 Wet IB 2001)
setting the forfaitair voordeel percentage for savings and investments
amending tax laws to correct errors from overlapping legislation
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel O (art. 10a.7 Wet IB 2001) and ARTIKEL XIV
Retroactively removes the attribution stop for private asset holding entities, reducing taxpayer protection from attribution of assets to them, with retroactive effect to 20 September 2016.
Allows the minister to amend tax laws by ministerial regulation to correct errors caused by overlapping legislation, with no explicit parliamentary involvement.

parties: Argues that more rigorous measures against shell companies and tax avoidance are needed and asks why the Raad van State's fraud warnings on the toerekeningsstop were ignored until now.
To counter this, assets placed in a VBI remain taxed in box 3 if they return to box 3 within 18 months.](Note: this quote is the PvdA evidence sentence.)
Om dit tegen te gaan blijft vermogen dat in een VBI is ondergebracht belast in box 3 als dit binnen 18 maanden weer terugkomt naar box 3.

Questions the retroactive effect of the VBI measures and asks whether the legal protection of taxpayers against individual RVO officials' rejections of innovation box access is adequate, suggesting objective judicial review.
Taxpayers who had already submitted a VBI application before the public announcement also fall under it.
Belastingplichtigen die voor de publieke aankondiging al een aanvraag voor een VBI hebben ingediend, vallen er ook onder.
Asks the government to explain the choice of retroactive effect and how the counter-evidence rule for zakelijke reden will work for taxpayers.
Can the government explain how the counter-evidence rule is shaped, and what a taxpayer must present to prove there was a business reason to move assets back to box 3?

Kan de regering toelichten hoe de tegenbewijsregel wordt vormgegeven, wat moet een belastingplichtige aandragen om te bewijzen dat er een zakelijke reden was om het vermogen terug te verplaatsen naar box 3?
Welcomes the anti-avoidance steps but argues that the Raad van State's 2009 advice to abolish the toerekeningsstop altogether should be followed, and that other shelter routes remain open.
In these members' view, one particular loophole allowing box 2 tax avoidance is now closed, but other loopholes remain.
Naar de mening van deze leden is één bepaalde sluiproute waarmee box 2-heffing kan worden ontlopen nu gedicht maar blijven andere sluiproutes bestaan.
Asks detailed technical questions about the scope and EU-law compatibility (freedom of capital movement, Lasteyrie du Saillant and National Grid Indus) of the exit taxation in the VBI measures.
Is it possible to limit the settlement to moves to jurisdictions outside the EU, ask the VVD members.
Is het mogelijk om de afrekening te beperken tot verplaatsingen naar jurisdicties gelegen buiten de EU, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2017 bill, raising major concerns about retroactive effect for VBI and APV measures, the innovation box ticket scope, the undefined 'samenwerkende groep' rule, the start-up payroll measure and the VAT sports exemption. The government reply largely rejected the retroactivity and clarity objections, partly adopting some changes (drafting, delegation, VAT sports exemption deferred).
concerns: Retroactive effect of VBI and APV measures is a burdensome measure lacking sufficient justification; the Council asks to drop it unless substantively motivated.
The 'samenwerkende groep' rule is vaguely defined and the Council asks for a binding decision option by the inspector; the government declines, pointing to pre-consultation instead.

Innovation box ticket choice (medicines versus plant protection products and biocides) needs better motivation; the government added the supplementary protection certificate and aligned with the OECD list.
Start-up payroll measure needs justification under the Budget Toetsingskader and clear evaluation criteria; government added general explanation and evaluation criteria.
VAT sports exemption remains inconsistent with EU case law on member and non-member services and sports terrain; the government defers amendment due to budgetary constraints.
Delegation provision for the start-up payroll measure was broadened to allow ministerial rules for sectors excluded from de minimis aid.

34570.s: The bill overhauls the levy system that funds the Animal Health Fund for controlling contagious animal diseases and zoonoses, moving the framework from the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren into the Wet dieren. It defines levy bases, payers and rates, lets the executive designate additional animal species and activities by general administrative order (subject to a subsequent approval law), and sets ceilings and reserve levels by decree.
34570.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order delegations by the need to respond quickly to veterinary risks, since a statutory amendment for each new species or activity would take too long, and keeps a parliamentary approval law requirement to safeguard the constitutional role of parliament in levies.
q: A statutory amendment needed to designate the animal species or activity would take too much time.
Een voor de aanwijzing van de diersoort of de handeling benodigde wetswijzing neemt dan teveel tijd in beslag.
d: designating additional animal species subject to the levy
designating additional species kept outside a business
threshold numbers below which no levy applies
rules for counting animals kept per species or category
alternative counting methods using administrative data where reliable data is lacking
designating further activities (e.g. slaughter, trade, feed preparation) subject to the levy and their bases
counting rules for eggs placed in incubators
five-year ceiling amounts for levy-funded expenditure per species
size of the crisis reserve (up to 40% of ceiling amount)
annual levy tariffs per species, category or activity
minister sets rules requiring payers to supply data and documents
p: New species or activities can be levied by decree, but a subsequent approval law is required and the decree must be withdrawn and undone if parliament rejects it.
Gwwd art. 91k / Wet dieren art. 9.23 and art. 9.28-9.29
Tariffs and reserve levels are set by general administrative order with statutory criteria, and the 2018-2019 tariff ceilings are fixed in the statute itself.
Statute fixes maximum levy yields for 2018-2019 per species, constraining executive tariff-setting.
Minister may require payers to provide data and documents and may impose provisional levies enforceable by writ of execution.

parties: Asks whether the proposed changes truly deliver the intended transparency and whether implementation costs undo the gains, and whether the bill is consistent with the convenant.
Objects that profits accrue to the sector while the costs of a major outbreak fall on society, and asks about budgetary risks of the state and the cost ceilings.
Asks for justification of the 40% maximum crisis reserve, pointing to the Raad van State advice, and for an overview of deviations from the convenant.
Following the Council of State's Advisory Division, they ask for a justification of the maximum size of the crisis reserve of 40%.
In navolging van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State vragen zij om een onderbouwing van de maximum omvang van de crisisreserve van 40%.
Asks how the Chamber will be involved in changes to the crisis reserve and how future levy-paying limits are guaranteed, and seeks clarity on calculation rules set by ministerial regulation.
In what way will the Chamber be involved in changes to the level of the crisis reserve?
Op welke manier wordt de Kamer betrokken bij wijzigingen van de hoogte van de crisisreserve?
Argues the sector should bear all costs and that the state's contribution to the fund is unacceptable, and calls for a fundamental change in intensive livestock farming.
Does the government find it acceptable that taxpayers must bear the costs caused by livestock farming?
Vindt de regering het acceptabel dat de belastingbetalers moeten opdraaien voor de kosten die de veehouderij veroorzaakt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill reforming the Diergezondheidsfonds levy system can proceed, but that the proposed maximum size of the crisis reserve (40%) must be justified and that the approval-by-law provisions for AMvB-set levy bases must be extended to a cross-reference. The government's reply (nader rapport) added the justification for the 40% maximum and clarified the alternative-basis provisions, and dropped the Comptabiliteitswet-related amendments.
concerns: The maximum crisis reserve of 40% was not justified and the explanatory memorandum needed supplementing, including the relation to sector covenants with much lower reserve amounts.
The approval-afterwards-by-law provisions did not cross-refer to the alternative levy-basis provisions in the Gwwd and Wet dieren, which needed to be added.
The provisions on determining animal numbers when reliable registration data are missing were mislabelled as an alternative basis and were clarified.

34633.s: The bill extends the Temporary Experimental Act on ballot papers and central vote counting by three years, moving the expiry date from 1 January 2018 to 1 January 2021. It also amends the evaluation clause so that the experiment is evaluated before 1 January 2018 rather than three months before expiry.
34633.j: The memorandum justifies the three-year extension by the need for at least one more experiment with a new ballot model and time for evaluation and a possible permanent amendment of the Kieswet before the 2019 European elections.
q: It is desirable to experiment at least once more with a new ballot for voters abroad before deciding whether these rules can be incorporated into the Kieswet.
Het is wenselijk in ieder geval nog één keer te experimenteren met een nieuw stembiljet voor kiezers buiten Nederland voordat kan worden besloten of deze regels in de Kieswet opgenomen kunnen worden.

parties: The VVD asks the government to justify the need for new experiments with the new ballot paper, given the Tweede Kamer rejected a similar bill, and whether funds would be better spent on internet voting for expats and electronic aids.
Can the government explain the usefulness and necessity of new experiments with the new ballot paper?
Kan de regering nut en noodzaak van nieuwe experimenten met het nieuwe stembiljet uiteenzetten?

The CDA asks whether the extension anticipates the evaluation of past experiments, what the government means by keeping experiments possible, and whether it plans new central vote counting experiments despite earlier statements.
These members ask whether the government, with the proposal to extend the duration of the Temporary Experiments Act, is not anticipating the evaluation of the experiments held.
Deze leden vragen, of de regering met het voorstel tot verlenging van de werkingsduur van de Tijdelijke experimentenwet niet vooruitloopt op de eva-luatie van de gehouden experimenten.

34642.s: The bill modernises and technically revises the planning rules for secondary education (voorzieningenplanning) in the Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs, its BES counterpart, and the primary education acts, shifting permitting of new schools and locations toward regional cooperation and clarifying the concept of 'richting'. It also introduces transitional rules and small amendments to the Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
34642.j: The memorandum justifies the new regional planning and delegated ministerial rules by pointing to local knowledge of regional schools and the aim of reducing administrative burden and disputes.
d: conditions for establishing schools arising from splitting
Artikel 74b, eerste lid, onderdeel g and h
conditions for vbo profiles and agricultural education offerings
detailed rules for implementing the planning provisions
conditions for mixed learning pathway education
p: Removes the Minister's discretionary power to approve a school combination below the establishment norm, making recognition a bound competence.
Shifts planning of educational provision toward regional cooperation of school boards, with the Minister deciding applications within defined refusal grounds and appeal available.

parties: Asks what role municipalities and provinces should have in regional education plans and whether provinces can require choices different from those agreed in a RPO.
They ask the government to indicate whether municipalities and/or provinces should assume a role that goes beyond the school boards.
Zij vragen de regering aan te geven of de gemeenten en/of provincies een schoolbestuur overstijgende rol zouden moeten aanne men.

Welcomes limited technical changes but notes municipalities and provinces minimally fulfilled their role and asks what concrete action followed the evaluation; misses an evaluation clause in the bill.
However, they miss an evaluation provision in the statutory text.
Zij missen echter in de wetstekst een evaluatiebepaling.
Asks for clarification on the scope of amendments following Raad van State criticism on the definition of richting and funding of non-viable schools, and how the Onderwijsraad will test this.
Finally, they ask how the Onderwijsraad will test all of this.
Tot slot vragen zij op welke wijze de Onderwijsraad dit allemaal gaat toetsen.
Asks about the tension between the government's required restraint in defining 'richting' and the formal ministerial role the bill gives it under article 67.
The Minister is given a formal role in determining whether all directions involved in the application are reflected in the school's education.
De Minister krijgt een formele rol in het bepalen of alle bij de aanvraag betrokken richtingen in het onderwijs van de school aan bod komen.

Questions the absence of procedural safeguards such as an independent chair and dispute rules, the different thresholds for municipal versus parent-initiated schools, and risks of fictitious richtingen and frustration of plans.
These members ask why the government does not consider it necessary to include, for example, a sober arrangement regarding an independent chairmanship.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering het niet noodzakelijk acht bijvoorbeeld een sobere regeling met betrekking tot een onafhankelijk voorzitterschap op te nemen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill on voorzieningenplanning in secondary education but asked for better justification of regional cooperation and the BES changes, and for a narrower definition of 'verlangde richting'. The government's reply accepted the core of the richting advice by adding conditions on combined denominations and a five-year statute requirement, and defended the other points with reasoning and minor redactional fixes.
concerns: The Council asked for a justification of regional cooperation in light of cross-policy integration, and the government added a passage on the 2013 evaluation but declined to broaden the analysis.

The Council asked that 'verlangde richting' be defined more narrowly to stop the dilution of the richting concept, and the government extended the rules for combined denominations with statute and advisory conditions.

The Council found the need to change the BES education legislation insufficiently demonstrated and asked for a supporting motivation, which the government provided by expanding paragraph 4 of the explanatory memorandum.
The Council's redactional remarks on cross-references in articles I D, E and N were adopted in the amended bill.

34651.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2016/881 on mandatory automatic exchange of country-by-country tax reports by adding article 6e to the international tax assistance act, obliging the Minister to forward reports to other member states. It also amends the Dutch corporate tax act on designating group entities to file reports, notification duties, and the language of reports, with some details left to ministerial regulation.
34651.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation powers as a way to set practical details of form and language of reports in lower regulation, following the OECD standard.
d: ARTIKEL III A.4 (art. 29c lid 6 Wet Vpb 1969)
form and content of notification on designated group entity
ARTIKEL III B.4 (art. 29d lid 4 Wet Vpb 1969)
form and content of notifications under art. 29d
ARTIKEL III C.2 (art. 29e lid 2 Wet Vpb 1969, via deletion of second sentence)
form, content and language of country-by-country report

parties: Supports exchange of tax information to tackle aggressive tax planning and asks about EU/OECD alignment, implementation and administrative burden without raising checks on the executive.

These members are in favour of the exchange of fiscal information between tax authorities, such as the exchange of country-by-country reports, because it facilitates the detection of aggressive tax planning.

Deze leden zijn voorstander van de uitwisseling van fiscale informatie tussen belastingdiensten, zoals de uitwisseling van landenrapporten («country-by-country-reporting»), omdat hiermee het opsporen van agressieve belastingplanning wordt vergemakkelijkt.
Supports the bill but asks whether companies can choose which country hosts their master file, raising risk of jurisdiction shopping.
To what extent does this invite shopping between countries, choosing the country with which the best arrangements can be made?
In hoeverre nodigt dit uit tot het «shoppen» tussen landen, waarbij wordt gekozen voor het land waarmee het beste afspraken valt te maken?
Asks whether the tax authority has the capacity and safeguards to actually perform risk selection and request further information on the country reports.
Furthermore, these members ask what guarantee there is that tax authorities actually carry out a risk selection and request further information where necessary.
Voorts vragen deze leden welke waarborg er is dat belastingdiensten ook daadwerkelijk een risicoselectie uitvoeren en indien nodig nadere informatie opvragen.
Asks how implementation has started and whether the tax authority can override the group's choice of reporting entity.
Or can the Tax and Customs Administration also overrule the group's choice?
Of kan de Belastingdienst de keuze van de groep ook overrulen?
Asks how the parent entity is defined, when deviation from the main rule is possible, and whether the Dutch tax authority can request reports if another authority fails to act.
Can it always request the country report from a group, for example if the tax authority in the country of the ultimate parent entity fails to act?
Kan zij van een groep altijd het landenrapport aanvragen, bijvoorbeeld als de belastingdienst in het land van de uiteindelijkemoederentiteit in gebreke blijft?

34723.s: The bill amends the Warmtewet (Heat Act) to change its scope and regulatory system, including new rules on heat supply contracts, storage compensation, price ceilings, meters, a third-party complaints commission, experiments, and access to heat networks. It shifts some rule-making to lower regulation and the Autoriteit Consument en Markt, while removing the requirement for an approved enforcement plan.
34723.j: The memorandum justifies the experiment power by the rapid technological change in heat supply and the need to avoid regulation blocking promising initiatives.
q: Given the rapid (technological) developments in heat supply, it is desirable to provide this room.
Gezien de snelle (technologische) ontwikkelingen op het gebied van warmtelevering is het wenselijk om deze ruimte wel te bieden.
d: installations excluded from definition of afleverset voor warmte
rules on serious outages and compensation amounts
elements and calculation of maximum heat price
meter requirements, maximum connection tariff, equipment categories
requirements and timing for producer access requests
p: Allows the Minister to grant experimental exemptions from statutory provisions, subject to a voorhang procedure and a report to the Tweede Kamer after each experiment.
Removes the requirement that the ACM enforcement plan be published and approved by the Minister, reducing transparency over enforcement priorities for heat suppliers.
Excludes the building owner's duty to reimburse storage compensation from ACM supervision, leaving enforcement to civil courts.
Permits suppliers to offer tariffs above the statutory maximum if a maximum-price option is also offered, with details left to lower regulation.
Exempts suppliers from storage compensation for short outages or extreme circumstances, with the scope of extreme situations left to ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks that consumers are protected, that tariffs reflect actual costs, and that consumers are not sent back and forth between landlord and supplier over storm compensation.
The consumer must not be sent from pillar to post, and the VVD members therefore believe the point of contact for the compensation scheme should be the heat supplier.

De consument moet niet van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd worden en de leden van de VVD-fractie zijn dan ook van mening dat het aanspreekpunt voor de compensatieregeling bij de warmteleverancier ligt.
Asks whether experiments require an ACM review and questions the transparency of supplier costs and returns for the regulator.
These members ask whether experiments may only be granted to a network operator and supplier after a review by the ACM against the conditions set out in the bill and implementing rules.

De leden van de CDA fractie vragen of experimenten slechts kunnen worden toegekend aan een netbeheerder en leverancier na een toets van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) aan de in het wetsvoorstel en nadere regels bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur te noemen voorwaarden.
Asks for reasons and limits on exemptions and experiments, and whether unequal rights arise for connected users, including appeal routes against supplier decisions.
In addition, these members want to know which legal steps must be taken if a connected party objects to the supplier's decision not to set up the connection.
Bovendien willen deze leden weten welke (juridische) stappen moeten worden gezet indien een aangeslotene bezwaar heeft tegen het besluit van de leverancier om de aansluiting niet op te zetten.
Asks how consumers are protected on tariffs and connection fees, and why network operators cannot also request experiments.
How is it ensured that there is no lack of clarity for the consumer?
Hoe wordt ervoor zorggedragen dat er geen onduidelijkheden bestaan bij de afnemer?
Objects that tenants lose access to the low-threshold Huurcommissie dispute body and must go to civil courts, and asks why the Warmtewet's independent dispute route is dropped.
Under what is now proposed, tenants will have to turn to the civil courts for all conflicts other than those over the cost of heat supply.
Door wat nu voorligt, zullen huurders zich bij alle conflicten anders dan die over de kosten van levering van warmte moeten gaan wenden tot de burgerlijk rechter.
Asks how tenants are protected against unreasonable heat prices and fixed charges, and whether consumers are protected against excessive fixed tariffs.
These members ask whether the bill also protects consumers against paying excessively high fixed charges for heat supply.
Deze leden vragen of het wetsvoorstel afnemers ook beschermt tegen het betalen van te hoge tarieven voor vastrecht bij warmtelevering.
Asks why the regulation exempting landlords was narrowed and about the consequences for tenants of falling back on tenancy law.

The SGP members would like to know why the government did not choose to keep the provision from the consultation version limiting the exemption to heat-supplying landlords for whom heat supply forms part of the lease.

De leden van de SGP-fractie horen graag waarom de regering er niet voor heeft gekozen om de bepaling uit de consultatieversie te handhaven waarin de vrijstelling beperkt wordt tot de warmte leverende verhuurders bij wie de warmtelevering onderdeel uitmaakt van de huurovereenkomst.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the Warmtewet amendment bill but asked for a fuller explanation of the planned heat-transition steps, the financial consequences for consumers and suppliers, the exclusion of large business consumers, the storage-outage exemption, the experiment clause and the emergency supplier regime. The minister's nader rapport accepted most remarks by supplementing the explanatory memorandum and amending the bill, while keeping the 100 kW scope and the 24-hour outage exemption.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for more concrete steps and timeline for the heat transition and how the Niet-Meer-Dan-Anders principle will be handled; the government expanded the explanation in the energy agenda context.
The Afdeling asked for insight into the financial consequences of the tariff change for consumers and suppliers; the government added explanation but gave no full quantified analysis.
The Afdeling asked for justification of why business consumers above 100 kW are not brought within the scope of tariff protection; the government kept the 100 kW limit with reasons.
The Afdeling questioned the imperative delegation for ministerial rules on overmacht and burden of proof; the government replaced the wording and referred to the general rule of article 150 Rv.

The Afdeling advised dropping the exemption for outages under 24 hours because compensation also serves to compensate inconvenience; the government kept the exemption to address unequal treatment of suppliers.

The Afdeling said the experiment clause must concretely list the articles from which exemption may be granted; the government declined to change the clause but will list the relevant provisions in the general administrative measure.

The Afdeling pointed out that the emergency supplier regime may take over a grid operator not facing problems; the government amended article 12c so the emergency supplier takes over the grid only when the supplier is also grid operator.
Redactional and technical corrections proposed by the Afdeling were incorporated.

34732.s: The bill makes technical corrections and policy refinements to primary, secondary and special education laws concerning funding of inclusive education (passend onderwijs), including allowing the Inspectorate to approve individual deviations from required teaching hours for medical or psychological reasons. It also restores omitted delegation powers for setting funding amounts by ministerial regulation and corrects cross-references and terminology.
34732.j: The memorandum justifies the Inspectorate discretion by the need for tailored options for pupils who cannot attend school and by the requirement that the Inspectorate consent to each request, with conditions set in a policy rule.
q: On request of the competent authority, the Inspectorate may agree that, for physical or psychological reasons, individual pupils deviate from paragraph 9(b).
De inspectie kan op verzoek van het bevoegd gezag ermee instemmen dat om lichamelijke of psychische redenen voor individuele leerlingen wordt afgeweken van het negende lid, onderdeel b
d: funding amounts for pupils with support needs and age-based amounts
funding amount for pupils in special secondary education
funding amounts for secondary special education pupils
funding amounts for pupils in residential institutions
ARTIKEL I, A (art. 8, lid 12 WPO); ARTIKEL II, A (art. 6g, lid 7 WVO)
Inspectorate consent to individual deviation from teaching hours for medical or psychological reasons
p: ARTIKEL I, A (art. 8, lid 12 WPO); ARTIKEL II, A (art. 6g, lid 7 WVO); ARTIKEL III, A-C (WEC)
Allows the Inspectorate to approve individual exemptions from statutory teaching-hour requirements on request, with criteria set in an inspectorate policy rule rather than in statute.

parties: Asks whether the independence of supervision on inclusive education can be defined more clearly in the law and whether the government will make the board's enforcement power mandatory.
Has the government considered including this legislative change in this bill?
Heeft de regering overwogen deze wetswijziging in dit wetsvoorstel op te nemen?
Broadly supports the bill and welcomes the possibility of tailored deviation from teaching time for individual pupils.

The CDA members can agree with the main lines of this bill and are pleased with the possibility that individual pupils who temporarily or partly cannot attend school for physical or psychological reasons may deviate from the prescribed teaching time.

De leden van de CDA-fractie kunnen zich vinden in de hoofdlijnen van dit wetsvoorstel en zijn tevreden met de mogelijkheid dat voortaan voor individuele leerlingen, die vanwege lichamelijk of psychische redenen tijdelijk of gedeeltelijk niet naar school kunnen, kan worden afgeweken van de voorgeschreven onderwijstijd.
Asks how many pupils will use the new deviation option and whether the government will support the samenwerkingsverbanden in implementing it.
They therefore ask the government whether it will support the samenwerkingsverbanden in implementing this new statutory option and, if so, how.
Zij vragen de regering dan ook of zij de samenwerkingsverbanden gaat ondersteunen in het uitvoeren van deze nieuwe wettelijke mogelijkheid en zo ja, hoe.
Objects that only the samenwerkingsverband must consent to closing the last sbo school, since these bodies lack independent supervision and may not have full coverage of support.

They ask whether the government considers it desirable that these samenwerkingsverbanden have the final say on whether to close an sbo school, while there is evidently no independent supervision of, among other things, financial management.

Zij vragen of de regering het wenselijk vindt dat deze samenwerkingsverbanden het laatste woord hebben over het al dan niet sluiten van een sbo-school, terwijl er klaarblijkelijk geen onafhankelijk toezicht is op onder andere het financieel beheer.

Questions whether the rules are proportionate and whether pupils' right to education is protected, asking for limits on tailoring, the role of the leerplichtambtenaar, and the inspectorate's approval role.
They ask why, given the differences, much more room is not offered in regular education.
Zij vragen waarom gelet op de verschillen niet veel meer ruimte geboden wordt in het reguliere onderwijs.

34741.s: The bill allows education institutions to use the personal student number (PGN) once to generate a pseudonym, and to derive further pseudonyms (ketenID) for digital learning materials and digital testing, with rules set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation. It amends the primary, secondary, special, vocational, adult and higher education acts and requires an evaluation report within five years.
34741.j: The memorandum justifies ministerial regulation for security and duration conditions because these are administrative details that will change frequently with technology, and it notes that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and the Inspectie van het Onderwijs retain supervisory roles.
q: Delegation to a ministerial regulation is considered necessary because it concerns administrative rules and these conditions are expected to change often.
Delegatie naar ministeriële regeling wordt noodzakelijk geacht, omdat het administratieve voorschriften betreft en deze voorwaarden naar verwachting dikwijls zullen wijzigen.
d: other cases where a further pseudonym may be generated and recipient categories
conditions for generating and using pseudonyms, including duration and security
other cases where a further pseudonym may be generated and recipient categories
conditions for generating and using pseudonyms, including duration and security

conditions for generating and using pseudonyms, including duration and security
other cases where a further pseudonym may be generated and recipient categories
conditions for generating and using pseudonyms, including duration and security

parties: Asks whether security standards, controls on suppliers deleting data after contract end, and the lack of a prior-consultation clause in the AMvB power are adequate.
Article 1A, paragraph 13 of the bill creates the possibility that, by AMvB, other cases for other categories are designated for which a school could also generate a pseudonym.

In artikel 1A, lid 13 van het wetsvoorstel wordt de mogelijkheid gecreëerd dat bij AMvB 4 andere gevallen voor andere categorieën worden aangewezen waarvoor een school ook een pseudoniem zou kunnen genereren.

Supports pseudonymisation to protect pupils' privacy and asks why several parties, including the Inspectorate, the DPA and Edu-K, are given a role in supervising data provision and whether this adds administrative burden.
They would welcome further explanation and also ask whether this creates extra administrative burden for the institutions concerned.
Graag ontvangen zij een nadere toelichting en vragen zij tevens of dit voor de betrokken instellingen ook extra administratieve lastendruk oplevert.
Asks how pupils and parents can access the study and behaviour data held about them, which legal restrictions apply, and what security requirements suppliers must meet.
Can the government set out which legal restrictions exist regarding the groups of persons who have access to the education and behaviour data of education participants?

Kan de regering uiteenzetten welke wettelijke restricties bestaan ten aanzien van de groepen personen die inzicht hebben in de onderwijs- en gedragsgegevens van onderwijsdeelnemers, zo vragen de eerder genoemde leden.
Shares the data-minimisation principle but questions whether sharing first names and whether the convenant's attribute policy is enforceable, and asks why additional data sharing is not set in law.

The aforementioned members therefore ask the government whether it considered including provisions on sharing additional data in the law and, if so, what its considerations were for not doing so after all.

De voornoemde leden vragen de regering dan ook of zij overwogen heeft artikelen aangaande het delen van aanvullende gegevens in de wet op te nemen en zo ja, wat haar afwegingen waren dit toch niet op te nemen.

Worries that schools are left free to choose their own protection measures, producing several forms of protection, and asks how a motion to destroy pupils' data held by commercial firms will be implemented.
Does the government consider it desirable that multiple forms of protection of personal data will emerge?
Acht de regering het wenselijk dat er straks meerdere vormen van bescherming van persoonsgegevens ontstaan?
Asks how placing the conditions for ketenID use in a ministerial regulation does justice to the Dutch DPA's advice that pseudonyms based on the PGN require formal statute.
They ask whether the government can further explain how laying down the conditions under which a ketenID may be used in a ministerial regulation does justice to this consideration.
Zij vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten hoe de vastlegging van de voorwaarden waaronder een ketenID gebruikt mag worden in een ministeriële regeling, recht doet aan deze overweging.
