Argues the Council of State's point that it must be clear which additional data may be shared is not met, and asks whether a precautionary approach with clear conditions set in advance would be wiser.

Would it not be wise to apply the precautionary principle and set clear conditions in advance that could possibly be relaxed once it has become clear that the sector handles this data properly, ask these members.

Zou het niet verstandig zijn het voorzorgsprincipe te hanteren en vooraf heldere voorwaarden vast te stellen die eventueel versoepeld kunnen worden nadat gebleken is dat de sector op een goede wijze met deze gegevens omgaat, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks why the first ketenID for learning materials is fixed in the statute while later ketenIDs can be set by AMvB, and whether the choice should be uniform.
It seems more obvious to these members that the use of ketenIDs be regulated uniformly in all cases either in the formal statute or in a general administrative measure.
Het lijkt deze leden eerder voor de hand te liggen dat het gebruik van ketenID's in alle gevallen gelijkelijk ofwel in de formele wet ofwel in een algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt geregeld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised that the bill be sent to parliament but revised: the rules on conditions for using pseudonyms should be set at general administrative order level rather than ministerial regulation, and the supplementary personal data and recipient categories clarified. The government reply accepted the recipient categories at general administrative order level and added an evaluation clause, but declined to regulate additional data and retention in more detail, relying on sector self-regulation.
concerns: Delegation of rules on conditions for pseudonyms to ministerial regulation is not sufficiently justified; retention period, additional data and recipient categories should be set at general administrative order level.
Unclear which additional personal data may be combined with the pseudonym, risking re-identification of pupils contrary to the bill's data-minimisation aim.
The explanatory memorandum and the bill's provisions need to be aligned on the conditions to be set by ministerial regulation, including the duration of pseudonyms.

34813.s: The bill implements the EU Payment Services Directive II (PSD II) by amending the Wft and Dutch Civil Code Book 7 to introduce payment initiation and account information services, tighten licensing and supervision of payment institutions, and set rules on account access, unauthorised transactions and fees for payment instruments. It also reassigns supervisory duties, notably giving the ACM oversight of account access and certain consumer-fee rules, and allows information sharing between regulators.
34813.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to work out technical and security requirements in an algemene maatregel van bestuur that the directive requires, and to ensure efficient supervision.
q: The third paragraph of Article 1:5a creates a basis for rules, by or pursuant to a general administrative order, on the application of paragraphs k and l of the second paragraph.

Het derde lid van artikel 1:5a creëert een grondslag voor de mogelijkheid om bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur regels te stellen over de toepassing van de onderdelen k en l van het tweede lid
d: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 1:5a, derde lid Wft)
rules on scope exemptions for limited networks and telecom payments
ARTIKEL I, Wft art. 3:17 (new seventh paragraph)
access of payment service providers to personal data of users
operational, security and authentication requirements for payment institutions
p: Expands the grounds on which the supervisor may withdraw a payment institution's licence, including a threat to confidence in a payment system and failure to report material developments.
Gives De Nederlandsche Bank discretion to refuse licences based on conditions such as performing part of the business in the Netherlands and qualifying shareholder approval.
Allows account-servicing providers to deny third-party access to accounts for objectively justified fraud-related reasons, with notification to the supervisor afterwards.
ARTIKEL I, C and BB/CC (art. 1:25a, 1:79, 1:80 Wft)
Assigns supervision of account-access rules to the Authority for Consumers and Markets and adjusts enforcement powers applicable to it.

parties: Asks how the directive stays technology-neutral, whether small providers face disproportionate burdens, and how supervision is coordinated between EBA, ECB and national supervisors.
How is it prevented that parts of the supervision fall between two stools?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat delen van het toezicht tussen wal en schip vallen?
Asks how consumer privacy will be safeguarded under PSD II and how banks and new entrants will inform consumers about its consequences.
The PVV members further want to know how banks and new financial entrants will inform consumers about PSD II and its consequences.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen verder weten op welke wijze banken en financiële nieuwkomers consumenten zullen informeren over PSD II en over de gevolgen die het met zich meebrengt.
Worries about screen scraping, consent mechanics, consumer protection for vulnerable groups, and fragmented supervision across several authorities.
These members see great dangers lurking, in which unwitting consumers hand over data to criminals.
Deze leden zien hierbij grote gevaren op de loer liggen, waarbij onwetende consumenten aan criminelen gegevens verstrekken.
Welcomes the goals of competition and consumer protection but asks about personal data principles, consent, and whether supervisors are sufficiently equipped.
Does the government believe the supervisors are sufficiently equipped for this, both in legal mandate and in resources and staff?
Is de regering van mening dat de toezichthouders hiertoe voldoende geëquipeerd zijn, zowel in wettelijk mandaat als in middelen en mankracht?
Asks about the risk analysis, conflicts with the GDPR, the use of lower regulation and an order-in-council route for personal data rules, and whether parliament will receive pending information.
According to the government, what are the greatest risks of PSD II?
Wat zijn volgens de regering de grootste risico's van PSD II?
Strongly opposes the data-sharing regime, doubts readiness of supervisors and sector, questions privacy protection and calls for postponing entry into force until risks are covered.
They ask the government whether it is willing to delay entry into force until at least the known risks can be covered.
Zij vragen de regering of zij bereid is de inwerkingtreding te vertragen totdat op zijn minst de bekende risico's afgedekt kunnen worden.
Objects that banks lose their protective role and that personal payment data is commercialised, asking the state to take a protective role.
They have serious objections to this development and believe the government should instead take on a protective role.
Zij hebben ernstige bezwaren tegen die ontwikkeling en is van mening dat de overheid juist een beschermende rol zou moeten aannemen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the Dutch bill implementing PSD II, but flagged that the legal basis in Wft article 3:17(2) for the explicit-consent requirement for personal data does not clearly cover data protection, and recommended adding a basis or motivating its sufficiency. The Minister of Finance's reply states that a separate legal basis has been added and the editorial remarks have been incorporated.
concerns: Article 3:17(2) Wft does not provide a specific legal basis for regulating personal data protection, so the Afdeling advised motivating its sufficiency or creating an explicit basis.
Editorial remarks on article numbering, notification of amendments, and the transposition table were incorporated.

34822.s: The bill amends the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg to adjust the implant register bill, removing the last sentence of article 7a(1) and deleting articles IA and IB, which contained the ban on implants without a uniform barcode and its criminalisation under the Wet op de economische delicten. The remaining article IC is renumbered IA, and the law enters into force by royal decree.
34822.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by feasibility and conformity with European law, and by the intent of the amendment's proponents to speed up the bill and reduce administrative burdens.
q: Article IA contains the ban on using implants that do not carry a uniform identification code, as well as a basis for setting further rules on that code by general administrative order.

Artikel IA bevat het verbod op de toepassing van implantaten die niet zijn voorzien van een geüniformeerde identificatiecode, evenals een grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels over die code te stellen.

parties: Asks about the legal status of the sector agreement, possible sanctions, and the timing and parliamentary involvement in the forthcoming AMvB, while accepting the government's reasoning on feasibility.
These members ask what the legal status is of this "agreement document".</br>
Deze leden vragen wat de juridische status is van dit «afsprakendocument».
Objects to the government ignoring a majority amendment and asks it to withdraw the bill and implement the original amendment, arguing non-binding agreements cannot be enforced.
Why is a majority of the House being ignored here?
Waarom wordt een meerderheid van de Kamer hier genegeerd?
Supports the amended bill and the agreements with sector parties while asking whether the agreements are binding for all parties and by when all implants will be coded.
the extent to which the agreements with the parties involved on uniform coding of medical devices can be considered binding for all parties.
in hoeverre de afspraken met de betrokken partijen over eenduidige codering van medische hulpmiddelen voor alle partijen als bindend kan worden beschouwd.
Positive about the implant register and sector agreements, asking what happens if the agreed goals are not met and whether device availability is protected.
These members ask what happens if the goals from the agreements with the sector are not achieved.</br>
Genoemde leden informeren wat er gebeurt indien de doelen uit de afspraken met de sector niet worden behaald.
Supported the original amendment, asks whether the agreement is binding and whether sanctions apply, and questions why unrecorded implants are not banned given patient safety.
Is the document binding? What happens if one of the parties does not comply with the agreements, is there a sanction?
Is het document bindend? Wat gebeurt er als een van de partijen de afspraken niet nakomt, volgt dan een sanctie?

34831.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Dongeradeel, Ferwerderadiel, Kollumerland en Nieuwkruisland and establishes a new municipality, Noardeast-Fryslân, covering their territory. It also makes consequential amendments to the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II and the Wet veiligheidsregio's, and sets entry into force by royal decree.
34831.j: The memorandum gives no justification for delegation; it only describes the background of the municipal merger and the withdrawal of Dantumadiel.
q: Commands that this be published in the Staatsblad and that all ministries and authorities see to its exact execution.
Lasten en bevelen dat deze in het Staatsblad zal worden geplaatst
d: date of entry into force of the law

parties: Sees no reason for remarks or questions on the voluntary merger, which it views as driven by the municipalities' own wish to strengthen administration.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks the government to send the herindelingsadvies and the province's zienswijze to the House, since publication on a website does not equal submission to parliament.
These members are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn van mening, dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
Notes the merger came from below with large majorities in all municipalities and expects a more administratively capable municipality, with no further questions at this stage.
They read that this reorganisation took place from the bottom up and that the reorganisation advice was adopted with a large majority of votes in all municipalities.
Zij lezen dat deze herindeling van onderop heeft plaatsgevonden en het herin-delingsadvies in alle gemeenten met een grote meerderheid van stemmen is vastgesteld.

Questions whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and whether the merger is effectively forced by decentralisation pressures; also asks about the financial basis of expected efficiencies.
The SP faction has some questions about public support and urgency.
De SP-fractie heeft enkele vragen bij de het draagvlak en de urgentie.
Asks how residents, civil society and local politics were involved in preparing the merger and how accessibility of services will be guaranteed in a larger municipality.

These members ask the government to explain again in more detail how the residents, civil society organisations and local politics of the municipalities concerned were involved in preparing the municipal merger proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Endorses the proposed merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the proposed merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.

34903.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, adding supplementary budget amounts for Thermphos, reconstruction of Saba and Sint Eustatius, and climate measures from the coalition agreement. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 March 2018.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34912.s: The bill amends the Copyright Act, the Neighbouring Rights Act and the Database Act to add a new exception allowing reproduction, making available and import of works in accessible formats for people with reading disabilities, implementing EU Directive 2017/1564 and Regulation 2017/1563 and enabling ratification of the Marrakesh Treaty. It lets general administrative orders (AMvB) set a fair compensation regime and require rightholders to provide means to benefit from the exception where technical protection measures apply, subject to a pre-tabling procedure for parliament.
34912.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegations as allowing fair-compensation and technical-measure rules to be set after gaining practical experience, with parliament informed in advance so it can check that interests were weighed carefully.
q: Parliament will be informed of such an intention so that it can check whether the interests involved have been carefully weighed against each other.
Het parlement zal op de hoogte worden gesteld van een dergelijk voornemen om te kunnen controleren of de betrokken belangen zorgvuldig tegen elkaar zijn afgewogen.
d: fair compensation for conversion and cross-border making available
obliging rightholders to provide means to benefit from exception despite technical protection measures
ARTIKEL II, C (art. 19, lid 4 Wet op de naburige rechten)
obliging performers and producers to provide means to benefit from exception despite technical protection measures
obliging database producers to provide means to benefit from exception despite technical protection measures
p: Allows an AMvB to override rightholders' technical protection measures for beneficiaries of the reading-disability exception, subject to a pre-tabling procedure and an eight-week delay before entry into force.

parties: Asks how the Marrakesh Treaty relates to the UN Disability Convention, when the government knew of it, and whether it contains provisions binding on individuals under articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.

They have some questions about the relationship between the above-mentioned bill and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, which entered into force for the Netherlands in 2016.
Zij hebben enkele vragen over de relatie van bovengenoemd wetsvoorstel met het voor Nederland in 2016 in werking getreden VN-Verdrag inzake de rechten van personen met een handicap.
Supports the availability of published works for reading-impaired people and has no need for further explanation at this stage.
These members endorse the importance of the availability of published works for people with reading disabilities and express the hope that this act will contribute to that availability.
Deze leden onderschrijven het belang van de beschikbaarheid van gepubliceerde werken voor leesgehandicapten en spreken de hoop uit dat deze wet aan die beschikbaarheid bijdraagt.

34930.s: The bill abolishes bearer shares in the Netherlands and the Caribbean Netherlands by requiring their conversion into registered shares, with bearer shares not converted by 2020 transferred to the company or its directors and forfeited. It also bans bearer share certificates and sets out transitional and entry-into-force rules, with some provisions taking effect seven years later.
34930.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as necessary to curb misuse of bearer shares for tax evasion, money laundering and terrorist financing, and to enable identification of shareholders by investigators and supervisors.
q: Registered shareholders can be identified through the company's register.
Aandeelhouders op naam zijn via het register van de vennootschap te identificeren.

parties: Asks why the bill distinguishes between European Netherlands and the BES islands rather than applying one regime across the Kingdom.
This seems a good thing to these members, that the obligation for shareholders to keep physical bearer certificates themselves is being abolished.
Het lijkt deze leden een goede zaak dat de verplichting voor aandeelhouders om fysieke toonderstukken zelf te bewaren wordt afgeschaft.
Asks why the FATF recommendation for further dematerialisation was not followed and which FATF recommendations remain unmet.
Why was the amendment to the Securities Giro Act not chosen for further dematerialisation as recommended by the FATF?
Waarom is er bij de wetswijziging van de Wet giraal effectenverkeer niet gekozen voor verdere dematerialisatie zoals werd aanbevolen door de FATF?
Asks the government to clarify the size of the actual and expected risk of financial-economic crime the bill aims to prevent.
In that connection, the members ask what the scale of the current and expected risk of these forms of financial-economic crime is that the government seeks to prevent with this bill.

De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen in dat verband wat de omvang van het actuele en te verwachten risico is op voornoemde vormen van financieel-economische criminaliteit dat de regering met dit wetsvoorstel tracht te voorkomen.

Regrets the narrow scope, asks why other bearer securities and total abolition were not chosen, and doubts that all bearer share holders will be identified and that the five-year deadline is justified.
Why are bearer shares not abolished entirely, ask the members of the SP faction.
Waarom worden aandelen aan toonder niet in zijn geheel afgeschaft, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises the bill to be sent to parliament but raises remarks on the actual scale of bearer-share misuse, international coordination (including the Caribbean part of the Kingdom), the temporary suspension of shareholder rights, and the consequences for shares falling to the company. The minister's reply reports a tax-authority survey finding about 75 companies with bearer shares, describes measures in neighbouring jurisdictions, explains that rights are suspended rather than lost, and clarifies the co-directors' ownership and attachment questions.
concerns: The Council asks for an analysis of the actual scale of bearer-share use in the Netherlands to assess effectiveness and proportionality; the reply adds a tax-authority survey of notarial deeds.

The Council asks for attention to international coordination, including neighbouring countries of the Caribbean part of the Kingdom; the reply describes measures in Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the Cayman Islands.

The Council says suspension of shareholder rights under the transition period is an interference with property under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and Article 17 of the EU Charter and asks for justification; the reply argues it is suspension rather than loss, foreseeable, proportionate, and reversible, but the Council's concern is only partly met.

The Council asks the explanatory memorandum to address the private-law consequences for co-directors of shares falling to the company, including attachment, bankruptcy, death and dismissal, and the valuation basis; the reply addresses these points and the bill is to be adjusted where needed.
The Council gives redactional remarks, in particular placing the transitional provision at the end of the bill's main text; the reply states these were adopted.

35029.s: The bill makes fiscal green measures for 2019: it extends the energy investment deduction (EIA), MIA and Vamil horizon dates to 2024, lowers the EIA deduction rate, moves responsibility for the energy list to the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, raises bicycle, vehicle and environmental tax rates, and creates a new housing sustainability tax reduction for landlords. It also revises several tax rates and cross-references across the income tax, wage tax, car tax, heavy vehicle tax and environmental tax acts.
35029.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial designation of energy investments by an evaluation recommendation that the Economic Affairs ministry should be primarily responsible for the energy list.
q: With the proposed amendment to Article 3.42(2) of the Income Tax Act 2001, from 1 January 2019 the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, not the Minister of Finance, designates by ministerial regulation the investments in the interest of efficient energy use.

Met de voorgestelde wijziging in artikel 3.42, tweede lid, van de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 (Wet IB 2001) wordt geregeld dat vanaf 1 januari 2019 de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat – en niet de Minister van Financiën – bij ministeriële regeling de investeringen aanwijst die in het belang zijn van een doelmatig gebruik van energie
d: Artikel I A, 1 (art. 3.42 lid 2 Wet IB 2001)
Artikel I A, 3 (art. 3.42 lid 7 Wet IB 2001)
further rules on energy investment deduction
electronic notification of planned investments to the minister
categories and amounts of sustainability investments via general administrative order
commencement of WMW 2014 II amendments by royal decree
Artikel X (Wet uitwerking Autobrief II art. XXVII)
commencement date set by royal decree
p: Shifts responsibility for designating energy investments from the Finance Minister to the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, with inter-ministerial consultation.
Artikel XI B and C (WMW 2014 II)
Sets investment categories and amounts for housing sustainability relief by general administrative order, with fixed statutory amounts per category.
Leaves the commencement of the housing sustainability provisions to a royal decree, delaying legal effect until executive action.

parties: Wants the measures to remain affordable for everyone and asks about budget effects, effectiveness and administrative burden of the tax schemes.
They stress the importance of sustainability and CO2 reduction, but want the proposals to remain manageable and affordable for everyone.
Zij benadrukken het belang van verduurzaming en reductie van CO 2 , maar willen dat de voorstellen voor iedereen behapbaar en betaalbaar blijven.
Supports green taxation but insists tax incentives must be effective and proportionate and asks for quantitative underpinning and a behavioural handlingsperspectief.
Fiscal incentives should only be used when they are effective and proportionate.
Fiscale prikkels moeten alleen worden ingezet wanneer zij effectief en proportioneel zijn.
Welcomes greening the tax system under the polluter-pays principle and asks for the status of the flight tax and long-term revenue security.
Considers the green measures too limited and asks for compensation for regressive effects.
They consider the current fiscal greening measures still too limited.
Zij vinden de huidige fiscale vergroeningsmaatregelen nog te beperkt.
Argues the burden falls on ordinary people rather than the polluters and questions the justice of raising energy costs for households.
The bill does not or insufficiently place the bill with the real polluter, while ordinary people pay the costs.
De rekening komt niet of onvoldoende bij de echte vervuiler terecht, terwijl de gewone mens opdraait voor de kosten.
Asks why a flat-rate scheme rather than an exemption is used for company bicycles and how tenants can make the gas switch fairly.
They note that using a bicycle for commuting has major benefits for both the environment and personal health.
Zij merken daarbij op dat het gebruik van de fiets voor woon-werkverkeer grote voordelen kent, zowel voor het milieu als voor de persoonlijke gezondheid.
Welcomes the measures as a step but questions the 50,000 euro cap for electric cars and the 7% bicycle rate.
Given the lagging availability of affordable electric vehicles with large range, would it not be wiser to postpone the 50,000 euro cap by two years?

Zou het gezien de achterblijvende beschikbaarheid van betaalbare en zakelijk aantrekkelijke elektrische voertuigen met een grote range tot op heden niet verstandiger zijn de cap van € 50.000 bijvoorbeeld met twee jaar uit te stellen.
Supports polluter-pays but asks about Paris targets, implementation speed, and the regressive effect of energy tax changes on lower incomes.
Asks for budgetary figures and the rationale for lowering the energy tax reduction affecting lower incomes.
The DENK members ask about the budgetary impact of these three schemes.
De leden van de DENK-fractie informeren naar het budgettaire beslag van deze drie regelingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the government must justify why only the BPM refund scheme for taxis and public transport is abolished while comparable BPM and MRB exemptions are kept, and that the bill's explanation on VAT treatment of a company bicycle is unclear. The government's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on both points, noting the environmental rationale applies to other special schemes as well and adding VAT consequences for company bicycles.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must justify why only the BPM refund for taxis and public transport is abolished while comparable BPM and MRB schemes remain; the government added general reasoning but did not change the bill's scope.
The explanation of the company bicycle flat-rate must address how VAT applies to a company bicycle and its private use; the government added this to the explanatory memorandum.

35056.s: The bill adds Article 50a to the Vreemdelingenwet 2000, allowing border and immigration officers to stop, transfer and hold for up to six hours (or nine under a related pending law) foreigners with lawful residence who are being considered for detention, such as Dublin claimants. It also extends appeal rights against such holding to the immigration judge and adjusts cross-references to the pending Wet terugkeer en vreemdelingenbewaring.
35056.j: The memorandum justifies the new holding power as necessary to implement a Raad van State ruling that Dublin claimants may be subject to national implementing measures, so officers can decide on detention.
q: To assess whether detention under these provisions must be ordered, it may be necessary first to stop the foreigner, transfer them to a place for questioning and hold them there for some time.

Om te kunnen beoordelen of tot inbewaringstelling op grond van deze bepalingen moet worden overgegaan, kan het nodig zijn om de vreemdeling eerst staande te houden, over te brengen naar een plaats bestemd voor verhoor en aldaar enige tijd op te houden.
d: further rules on applying holding and search powers
p: Officers may stop, transfer and hold lawfully resident foreigners for up to six hours and search their clothing, body and belongings to prepare detention decisions, a new coercive power over people not suspected of illegal stay.
Holding under the new article is made appealable to the immigration judge, which strengthens judicial review of the new power.

parties: Asks how border and immigration officials currently operate before the law takes effect and what the consequences of that practice are.

They only have the question of which working method the officials responsible for border control and for supervising aliens currently apply until this law takes effect, and what the consequences of that method are.

Zij hebben nog enkel de vraag welke werkwijze de ambtenaren belast met de grensbewaking en de ambtenaren belast met het toezicht op vreemdelingen nu hanteren tot de inwerkingtreding van deze wet en wat de gevolgen zijn van deze werkwijze.
Wants broader detention of nuisance-causing asylum seekers and asks whether detention of Dublin claimants continued after a Council of State ruling.
In this context, the aforementioned members ask how many nuisance-causing asylum seekers have been identified and what percentage of them are classified as Dublin claimants.
Voornoemde leden vragen in dit kader hoeveel overlast gevende asielzoekers in beeld zijn en welk percentage daarvan als Dublinclaimant is aangemerkt.

Asks the government about negotiations to widen detention options and whether the EU rule requiring a significant risk of absconding is too strict, questioning the limits on detention and supervision.

Does the government share the view that Article 28(1) of the Dublin Regulation is at least too absolutely framed, and that for swift and effective implementation there must always be a certain period in which detention and supervision for transfer are regarded as one of the legitimate means?

Deelt de regering de opvatting dat in ieder geval artikel 28, eerste lid, van de Dublinverordening te absoluut is gesteld en dat er ten behoeve van een snelle en doeltreffende uitvoering van de verordening altijd een bepaalde tijdspanne moet zijn waarin bewaring en toezicht met het oog op de overdracht als een van de legitieme middelen worden beschouwd.

35065.s: The bill places the emergency call centres (meldkamers) of the emergency services under the police, limits their number to at most ten, and lets the Minister set the main lines of policy and management by regulation. It amends the Politiewet 2012, Wet veiligheidsregio's and Tijdelijke wet ambulancezorg accordingly.
35065.j: The memorandum justifies the new arrangement by the desire to reorganise the call centres of the emergency services and gives no separate justification for the delegated powers.
d: further rules on emergency call centres
main lines of policy and management of call centres
number, locations and work areas of call centres
agreement with police to run fire-service call function
p: The Minister acquires power to set main lines of policy and management of emergency call centres, which were previously a safety-region responsibility, after consulting the other ministers and bodies involved.
Responsibility for operating call centres shifts to the police, and the number and location of centres are set by general administrative order rather than by safety regions.

parties: Asks who checks whether the police's regional coordination and development of decentralised control rooms happens adequately, and what happens if ICT renewal lags.
Who checks whether this happens properly, and who intervenes if it does not happen sufficiently?
Wie controleert of dit goed gebeurt en wie grijpt in als dit onvoldoende gebeurt?
Asks how the government will prevent the balance between national uniformity and regional diversity from tipping too far, and asks why advice to anchor regional governance in law was set aside.
Why has the government set these advices aside?
Waarom heeft zij deze adviezen terzijde geschoven?
Asks why governance was not anchored in the law as the Veiligheidsberaad and regions unanimously advised, and how accountability for management spending is organised.
Why did the government not choose this solution?
Waarom is door de regering niet gekozen voor deze oplossing?
Focuses on guaranteeing staffing and reachability of control rooms and on technological safeguards against unauthorised communication, following the Amsterdam power outage.
What guarantees will there be that under the new structure similar problems, particularly around staffing of control rooms, will not arise?
Welke garanties zullen er zijn dat niet ook onder de nieuwe indeling dergelijke problemen, met name rond de bezetting van meldkamers, zullen ontstaan?
Asks why the governance at regional level is only minimally defined in the bill and whether the government will propose a clear legal basis for it.
The aforementioned members request the government to explain why it did not choose to include a clear legal basis for governance at regional level in the bill.
Voornoemde leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten, waarom niet is gekozen voor een duidelijke grondslag voor de governance op regionaal niveau op te nemen in het wetsvoorstel.
Worries that centralisation to at most ten locations distances control rooms from local mayors' responsibility for safety and disasters, and that criteria for the number of control rooms are absent.
Can it be further clarified what this precisely means according to the government?
Kan nader worden geduid wat dit volgens de regering precies betekent?
Asks how the bill affects democratic control at national and local level, given that municipal councils are closely involved with control rooms and that governance at regional level is unclear.

Since many municipal councils are very involved with the control room in their safety region, the aforementioned members ask how the amendment will affect democratic control at national and local level.

Aangezien veel gemeenteraden zeer betrokken zijn bij de meldkamer in hun veiligheidsregio vragen voornoemde leden hoe de wetswijziging de democratische controle op landelijk en lokaal niveau zal beïnvloeden.

35074.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Civil Code, the Waadi and social insurance financing laws to tighten on-call contracts, extend trial periods and chain-contract limits, add a cumulative dismissal ground, lower transition payments for long contracts, and introduce contract-dependent unemployment premiums while abolishing sector premiums. It also regulates payrolling so that agency workers receive equal terms to direct employees.
35074.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for employer flexibility, reducing the gap between permanent and flexible contracts, and avoiding unclear cases where agreements or regulations are needed for sector-specific differences.
q: It is expected that employers will be more willing to offer employees a permanent contract as a result of the proposed measure.
Naar verwachting zijn werkgevers door de voorgestelde maatregel eerder bereid om werknemers een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden.
d: defining when an on-call contract exists and exemptions
extending chain-contract limits by collective agreement or regulation by a competent administrative body
shortening intervals for designated seasonal functions at Stichting van de Arbeid request
rules on how the transition payment is calculated
rules on compensation for employers in certain cases
deviation from equal treatment by collective agreement
setting unemployment premium percentages by contract type
further rules on high and low premium and retroactive application
p: Lets an AMvB define which contracts count as on-call contracts and exempt certain arrangements from the on-call protections.
Extends chain-contract limits from 24 to 36 months and allows further extension by sector agreement or administrative regulation.
Expands permitted duration limits for payroll and temporary contracts through sector arrangements.
Adds a cumulative dismissal ground letting courts end employment on combined non-decisive grounds, subject to court review and a capped compensation.
Reduces the transition payment for long contracts and makes it payable from day one.
Replaces statutory sector premiums with a single contract-based premium set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks how the bill contributes to balance on the labour market, whether more measures are needed, and what risks exist during the gap before the self-employed legislation.
The VVD members ask the government to further explain how the measures in the bill advance the bill's objective.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de maatregelen in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel dichterbij brengt.
Welcomes the bill as a first step but asks when the complementary measures will be sent to parliament and how to prevent a rise in sham self-employment.
When does the government expect to be able to send these measures to the House in legislative proposals?
Wanneer denkt de regering deze maatregelen in wetgevingsvoorstellen naar de Kamer te kunnen sturen?
Supports the bill's aim and asks the government to reflect on the Council of State's point that it only tackles part of the institutional drivers of flexibilisation.
These members ask for a reflection on the Council of State's advice that the bill addresses only part of these institutional factors.
Genoemde leden vragen in dat kader om een reflectie op het advies van de Raad van State dat voorliggende wet slechts een deel van deze institutionele factoren aanpakt.

Argues the bill is insufficient and risks a waterbed effect unless all measures are taken simultaneously; requests a CPB labour market analysis before deciding and asks whether the bill should be postponed.
The Council of State and various experts also point to this.
Ook de Raad van State en verschillende deskundigen wijzen hierop.

Fears the bill will push workers further into insecure work, criticises the government for ignoring broad criticism and the Council of State's verdict, and questions the premise that permanent contracts are too costly.
They fear the bill will not restore balance on the labour market but will only push workers further into the swamp of insecure work.
Zij vrezen dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de balans op de arbeidsmarkt niet gaat herstellen, maar werknemers alleen maar verder in het moeras van onzeker werk zal drukken.

Sees both positive and negative measures; objects to weakening dismissal protection and asks why the government amends dismissal law before the Wwz evaluation, requesting an overview of delegation provisions and parliamentary review of lower regulation.
Welcomes necessary steps toward balance and a commission on the future of work, but asks how the bill relates to measures on self-employed workers and how to avoid more involuntary self-employment.
How does the government intend to prevent the measures in the bill from leading to a larger number of involuntary self-employed and undesirable work arrangements?
Hoe wil de regering voorkomen dat de maatregelen uit het wetsvoorstel Arbeidsmarkt in balans gaan leiden tot een nog groter aantal onvrijwillige zelfstandigen en ongewenste arbeidsconstructies?

Has serious objections to the new cumulation ground, reduced transition payment for older workers, extended chain rule and longer probation; argues the bill lacks an integrated vision and minimum protection level for all workers.
They believe that through the bill and its proposed measures, every worker becomes more or less a 'flexworker'.
Zij menen dat door het wetsvoorstel en de daarin voorgestelde maatregelen, iedere werkende min of meer een beetje «flexwerker» wordt.

Warns against a new phase of confusion and false security, questions whether a first step before fundamental reform is desirable, and asks about treatment of students, side jobs and the ketenbepaling exception for education.
These members consider it very important that the legislature prevents a new phase of confusion and false security.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat de wetgever een nieuwe fase van verwarring en schijnzekerheid voorkomt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division judges the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans proposal insufficient to restore labour-market balance, warning of waterbed effects and urging a fundamental approach across labour law, social security and tax, and advises against the payrolling and probation measures. The government's reply defends the package as a first step within a broader reform path, accepts some remarks (clarifying payrolling indicators, pension requirements, probation) and explains why others (cumulation ground, ketenregeling) are retained.
concerns: The Council doubts the proposal will achieve a real balance in the labour market and warns of waterbed effects; the government acknowledges the risk but maintains the package is a first step alongside further measures.

The Council questions whether extending the chain-of-temporary-contracts rule to three years will actually increase permanent jobs; the government responds that the effect is uncertain and the rule serves flexibility needs.
The Council doubts the effectiveness of the oproepcontracten and payrolling measures given employer avoidance options; the government stresses communication efforts and penalties as safeguards.
The Council finds the payrolling definition (allocation function, exclusive placement) unsuitable as a clear dividing line; the government adds indicators to the explanatory memorandum to clarify it.

The Council criticises the payrolling pension obligation as departing from the principle of social-partner autonomy and as unworkable for employers outside the StiPP scheme; the government clarifies the requirements and expects sectoral solutions.
The Council suggests merging the cumulation ground and the residual ground into a single open ontslaggrond; the government rejects this to preserve the closed system of dismissal grounds.
The Council questions whether the probation extension addresses a real employer problem, given existing fixed-term options, and notes the added uncertainty for workers.

35083.s: The bill creates a new Plant Health Act implementing EU Regulation 2016/2031 on plant protection measures and EU Regulation 2017/625 on official controls, designating the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality as competent authority and empowering the Minister to take phytosanitary measures, grant exemptions, register market operators and impose administrative fines. It also amends the Agricultural Quality Act, the Plant Protection Products and Biocides Act and the Economic Offences Act, and repeals the Plant Diseases Act.
35083.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to operationalise directly binding EU regulations whose detailed implementation is still pending, and presents the fines as a proportionate lighter alternative to criminal enforcement.
q: This bill only includes provisions that are necessary in addition to the European rules and important, for example, for operationalising Regulation 2016/2031.

In het wetsvoorstel zijn dan ook alleen die bepalingen opgenomen die in aanvulling op de Europese regels noodzakelijk zijn en bijvoorbeeld voor de operationalisering van Verordening 2016/2031 belangrijk zijn.
d: phytosanitary measures against EU quarantine organisms
stricter phytosanitary measures than EU rules
exemption from notification duty for known areas
designating competent authorities for specific tasks
registration of additional grower categories and register rules
rules on providing and retaining data
cases requiring plant passport or certificates
risk management plans and other prevention measures
fee rules and fee rates for controls
designating provisions whose breach is an offence
p: Inspectors may enter a dwelling without the occupant's consent, bringing equipment, going beyond the general powers of the General Administrative Law Act.
Anyone may be required to provide data and inspection of documents reasonably needed by the Minister, with a confidentiality exception and criminal sanction for non-compliance.
Persons must give full cooperation and truthful information on origin and trade of regulated plant material on first request of inspectors.
Introduces the Minister's power to impose administrative fines and enforcement orders and collect them by dwangbevel, with fines capped by criminal fine categories or 10 percent of turnover.
Minister may take temporary phytosanitary measures at the border beyond the EU list, notifying the Commission afterwards.

parties: Asks for clarity on which provisions are mandatory EU requirements versus national discretion, and wants the NVWA impact assessment shared with parliament before the report.

It is insufficiently clear which measures and provisions are a prescribed obligation under the European Regulation (EU) 2016/2031 and on which subjects there is policy room for individual member states.

Het is onvoldoende duidelijk welke maatregelen en bepalingen een voorgeschreven verplichting zijn vanuit de Europese Verordening (EU) 2016/2031 en op welke onderwerpen er beleidsruimte is voor de individuele lidstaten.
Questions the timing of the AMvB on task division and whether it will be submitted to parliament, and raises unclear distributor responsibilities and data use.
These members ask what the planning is for the creation of this AMvB and whether it will be submitted to the House prior to publication.
Deze leden vragen wat de planning is voor de totstandkoming van deze AMvB en of deze voor publicatie wordt voorgelegd aan de Kamer.
Asks how much detail remains to be worked out in later rules, such as the high-risk plant list, and what role the Kamer has in the European process.

Can the government indicate where in the negotiation process it departed from the cabinet position described in the BNC fiches? And how does the government expect the follow-up at European level to look? How is the government involved and what is the role of the House?

Kan de regering aangeven waar in het onderhandelingsproces is afgeweken van het kabinetsstandpunt zoals beschreven in de BNC-fiches? En hoe verwacht de regering dat het vervolg er op Europees niveau uit zal zien? Hoe is de regering hierbij betrokken en wat is de rol van de Kamer?
Asks for preliminary parliamentary review (voorhang) of delegated decisions on prevention measures, fees and administrative fines, and for the Adviescollege advice to be sent to the House.

The SGP members would like to hear whether the government is willing to include pre-consultation provisions (voorhang) in the bill concerning delegated decision-making on prevention measures, fees and administrative fines.

De leden van de SGP-fractie horen graag of de regering bereid is in het wetsvoorstel voorhangbepalingen op te nemen met betrekking tot de gedelegeerde besluitvorming over preventiemaatregelen, retributies en bestuurlijke boetes.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft Plant Health Act (Plantgezondheidswet), implementing EU Regulation 2016/2031 and Controle Regulation 2017/625, should designate a coordinating authority as required by EU law, plus several editorial and transposition-table remarks. The government's reply accepted the advice, designating the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality as coordinating authority in article 2 and adopting the editorial and transposition-table changes.
concerns: The bill lacked a provision designating the coordinating authority required under Controle Regulation 2017/625, and the Council asked that this be regulated.
Explanatory memorandum should be aligned with the bill text, including references to non-existent or incorrect provisions and the ministerial regulation for penalties.
The transposition table should give fuller reasons for the policy discretion chosen, and a transposition table for Controle Regulation 2017/625 should be added.

35092.s: The bill amends the Wind Energy at Sea Act to broaden the permitting procedures for offshore wind, adding subsidy, comparative test, financial-bid and auction procedures, chosen by ministerial regulation. It also adds performance guarantees, standardised application rules, and changes to how wind energy and wind parks are defined, with several ministerial regulations setting detailed rules.
35092.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that flexibility is needed to match developments in offshore wind, and that rules must suit the specific situation of each park.
q: For each wind park, a ministerial regulation chooses from the subsidy procedure, the comparative test, the comparative test with financial bid and/or the auction procedure.
Per windpark wordt in een ministeriële regeling gekozen uit de procedure met subsidie, de vergelijkende toets, de vergelijkende toets met financieel bod en/of de procedure van een veiling.
d: parcel decision rules moved from parcel decision to ministerial regulation
application period, application rules and fees for permit requests
period within which operations must start
choice of permit procedure(s) and order of processing applications
amount, deadline and period of guarantee or bank guarantee
amount forfeited on failure to carry out permitted activities
detailed and additional ranking criteria for comparative tests
ranking criteria and their weighting for financial-bid tests
auction rules: bidding, invalid bids, security, payment (after consultation with Finance Minister)
p: The minister may suspend auctions, exclude participants and choose the payment method through ministerial regulation, with limited statutory guidance.
The minister chooses which permit procedure applies to each wind park and the order in which applications are processed, with the choice left largely to ministerial regulation.
The statute lists two mandatory ranking criteria, but the minister may add further criteria, including location-specific or societal ones, by regulation.
The statute no longer provides for a separate subsidy-stage rejection and grant mechanism, with grants now managed through ministerial decision.

parties: Asks how fishing sector economic interests are protected and whether the auction guarantee (waarborgsom or bank guarantee) gives sufficient security against bids not being honoured.
These members ask whether, according to the government, this provides the required security and why it holds that view.
Deze leden vragen of dit volgens de regering de vereiste zekerheid biedt en waarom zij die mening is toegedaan.
Questions whether the bill really changes subsidy of offshore wind, the costs borne by government, and how bids are checked for realism before auctioning.
Before auctioning, is it checked whether the amounts bid are realistic? Who assesses this?
Wordt er – voordat er geveild wordt – getoetst of de ingezette bedragen reëel zijn? Wie beoordeelt dit?
Asks whether the auction mechanism increases risks for wind park builders and whether revising permit duration after award could give rise to equal-treatment and transparency challenges.
To what extent does an auction not create risks that the original Wind at Sea Act tried to remove, these members ask.
In hoeverre creëert een veiling nu geen risico die de oorspronkelijke wet wind op zee trachtte weg te nemen, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks about investment security, grid investment, electricity demand, and whether the government will wait for the Noordzee accord before amending the law.
The D66 members ask whether the government is willing to wait for the North Sea accord before amending the law so it can be incorporated into the amendment.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is om de wijziging van de wet te wachten op het akkoord voor de Noordzee opdat deze verwerkt kan worden in de wetswijziging.
Worries auctions encourage speculation on future power prices and that winners may not build; asks why the bill proceeds before the research and accords are completed.
Can the government indicate whether it is willing to hold this bill back until the research is done and the accords are concluded to give the wind sector more certainty?
Kan de regering aangeven of zij bereid is om dit wetsvoorstel aan te houden totdat het onderzoek is verricht en de akkoorden zijn gesloten om op die manier meer zekerheid te geven aan de windsector?
Supports the subsidy-free procedure but asks about effects on energy bills and the costs of the required infrastructure.
The SP members ask whether, and if so to what extent, subsidy-free operation leads to higher energy prices and higher energy bills.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of, en zo ja in hoeverre, het subsidieloos exploiteren tot een hogere energieprijs en hogere energierekeningen leidt.
Worries that auctions will make revenue the main criterion, pushing ecological and quality criteria to secondary importance; asks for restraint and for ecology to be a fixed selection criterion.
Various nature organisations ask for ecology to be included in the law as a fixed, always-applicable selection criterion rather than a possible additional one.
Diverse natuurorganisaties vragen om ecologie als vast en altijd geldend selectiecriterium in de wet op te nemen in plaats van als een mogelijk en aanvullend criterium.
Asks why ecology is not a fixed statutory selection criterion but is left to ministerial regulation, and how fisheries interests are weighed in the criteria.
They ask why ecology is not a fixed selection criterion in the law but is elaborated by ministerial regulation.
Zij vragen zich af waarom ecologie geen vastgesteld selectie selectiecriterium in de wet, maar wordt uitgewerkt bij ministeriële regeling.
Objects that removal of the 'kwaliteit van ontwerp' criterion lowers protection of nature and animals and asks for binding ecological and underwater noise norms.
With the proposed amendment the current level of protection is reduced because the assessment criterion 'quality of design' has been deleted.
Met de voorliggende wetswijziging wordt het huidige beschermingsniveau verminderd, doordat het toetsingscriterium «kwaliteit van ontwerp» is geschrapt.
Objects to dropping ranking criteria such as quality of design and asks for them to be retained in the law rather than left to ministerial regulation.
Is the government willing to include these ranking criteria in the law after all?
Is de regering bereid deze rangschikkingscriteria alsnog in de wet op te nemen?
Asks whether an independent party checks the cost calculations made by grid operator TenneT and what extra onshore grid costs arise.
Can the government indicate whether there is a party that checks these calculations?
Kan de regering aangeven of er een partij is die deze berekeningen controleert?
Asks about the status of the North Sea agreement and the joint research with the sector on offshore wind.
These members ask about the status of the agreement for the North Sea and the North Sea Transition Fund.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen naar de stand van zaken ten aanzien van het akkoord voor de Noordzee en het Noordzeetransitiefonds.
Asks whether the government will compare tender systems with the sector, consider permit extensions, and address price predictability and cannibalisation risk.
These members ask whether the government is willing to consider permit extension, which according to the sector could lower costs, and to explore it again with the sector.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is verlenging van vergunning, wat volgens de sector een verlaging tot kosten kan leiden, te overwegen en nogmaals te verkennen in samenwerking met de sector.
Argues market parties are not heard enough, asks for further consultation, and sees the auction system as creating a perverse incentive for higher energy prices, urging a study of societal costs.
Fears auctions shift financial risk to operators and higher costs to consumers, asks for an analysis of societal costs across tender systems, and prefers a 40-year permit term.
They fear that an auction system will create more financial risks for the operator and thus lead to higher financing costs that will be passed on to citizens.

Zij vrezen dat een systeem van veilingen zal zorgen voor meer financiële risico’s voor de exploitant en dus zal leiden tot hogere financieringskosten die weer op de burger afgewenteld zullen gaan worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet windenergie op zee, adding an auction procedure and extending permit validity, and asked for legal criteria on the choice of allocation method and on extensions to be anchored in the law. The government's reply accepted most points, added criteria and conditions to the bill and explanatory memorandum, and explained its discretion, with no remaining objection stated.
concerns: The choice of allocation procedure lacks legal criteria, so the Afdeling asked for clarification in the memorandum or statutory anchoring to secure predictability for applicants.
Extension of permit duration is a discretionary power without statutory limits or criteria, risking unequal treatment and transparency problems; the Afdeling asked for criteria to be set in law.
The Afdeling asked for reasons why conditions cannot be attached to a permit extension, given the economic benefit to the operator.
Redactional comments on the relation between articles 14 and 25f and on the wording were largely adopted.

35137.s: The bill amends the Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen so that Norway replaces Germany as the reference country for maximum medicine prices, and adjusts the exchange-rate basis for the reference calculation. Maximum prices already set under the old rules remain in force until the amendment takes effect on a date fixed by royal decree.
35137.j: The memorandum justifies the change by a CIBG study finding that Norway has a generally accepted price list that can be designated as reference list by ministerial regulation.
q: The study showed that a generally accepted price list is available in Norway.
Uit het onderzoek is naar voren gekomen dat er in Noorwegen een algemeen aanvaarde prijslijst beschikbaar is.
d: fixing the date the amendment takes effect

parties: Welcomes the reference-country change as a way to secure affordability and access, and asks clarifying questions on exchange-rate timing.
An adjustment of the reference countries is an improvement that secures the accessibility and affordability of medicines in the future.
Een aanpassing van de referentielanden is een verbetering die de toegankelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van geneesmiddelen in de toekomst borgt.
Asks whether the government obtained independent analysis of effects on availability and whether the KNMP can contribute to an impact analysis and monitor.
They ask whether the government has tried to obtain well-founded insight, through an independent party, into the possible consequences for the timely availability of medicines in the Netherlands.
Zij vragen of de regering via een onafhankelijke partij onderbouwd inzicht heeft geprobeerd te krijgen in de mogelijke gevolgen voor de (tijdige) beschikbaarheid van geneesmiddelen in Nederland.
Asks for justification of the choice and asks how and how often the House will be informed about monitoring results.
In what manner and how often will the House be informed about the results of this?
Op welke wijze en hoe vaak wordt de Kamer over de resultaten hiervan geïnformeerd?
Considers it unwise that the government does not adopt the Norwegian model to curb pharmaceutical industry power, and questions claims about solidarity and race-to-the-bottom effects.

find it unwise and disappointing that the government does not choose to amend the Medicine Prices Act by introducing the Norwegian model, in order to further curb the power of the pharmaceutical industry.

vinden het onverstandig en teleurstellend dat de regering niet kiest voor een aanpassing van de Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen door middel van invoering van het Noorse model, teneinde de macht van de farmaceutische industrie verder in te perken.
Criticises the choice not to adopt the Norwegian model and lower prices for specialités, questioning the policy goal and the cost-saving ambition.
These members do not understand why it is chosen to pay money to the pharmaceutical industry instead of realising savings that feed through into lower premiums for insured persons.
Deze leden begrijpen niet waarom ervoor gekozen wordt geld aan de farmaceutische industrie te betalen in plaats van een besparing te realiseren die doorwerkt in een lagere premie voor verzekerden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised submitting the bill amending the Medicine Prices Act (replacing Germany with Norway as reference country) but asked for a clearer explanation of the balance between affordability and availability of medicines, the objective grounds for the choice of reference countries under EU law, and why the number of reference countries was not expanded. The minister's reply adds clarification to the explanatory memorandum on the balance, EU-law grounds (Art. 168(7) TFEU, Directive 89/105), and the minimum-of-two-prices safeguard, and the advice is largely followed through textual additions rather than changes to the bill's substance.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a clearer, less ambiguous explanation of how the change serves the balance between affordability and availability of medicines, which the memorandum was revised to provide.
The Afdeling stressed that choosing reference countries must rest on objective grounds to avoid vulnerability under EU law; the reply explains objective, verifiable data and Art. 168(7) TFEU.
The Afdeling questioned why the number of reference countries was not expanded; the government rejected expansion as yielding a worse balance at higher cost.
The explanatory memorandum was supplemented to clarify that no maximum price is set if only one reference country lists a price, providing a sufficiently robust basis.

35146.s: The bill amends the Wet langdurige zorg so that people with a psychische stoornis who have a lasting need for permanent supervision or 24-hour care nearby become eligible for Wlz care, with a separate exclusion for minors under the Jeugdwet. It requires CIZ to assess eligibility for these persons before 1 January 2021 and allows the minister to set further rules by ministerial regulation.
35146.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power by the need to set detailed rules for the new group of entitled persons, and the broader change by equal treatment with other Wlz clients and advice from the Zorginstituut.
q: Further rules on entitlements, rights and obligations of insured persons whom CIZ determines to be in need of care due to a psychische stoornis may be set by ministerial regulation.

Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld ten aanzien van aanspraken, rechten en verplichtingen van verzekerden waarvan het CIZ vaststelt dat zij vanwege een psychische stoornis overeenkomstig artikel 3.2.1, eerste lid, van de Wet langdurige zorg zijn aangewezen op zorg.
d: further rules on entitlements, rights and obligations of insured persons with psychische stoornis
p: CIZ, an executive assessment body, is directed to determine entitlement to Wlz care for affected persons in a transitional indication decision before 2021.

parties: Wants clarity on implementation monitoring, possible course correction, and the uncertainty in instroom numbers and costs.
How will the House be informed about the progress of the implementation?
Hoe wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over het verloop van de implementatie?
Asks why under-18s are excluded despite meeting Wlz care criteria and how the government will ensure proper care for them.
Why does the government exclude young people under 18 from the Wlz, while they do meet the care-content criteria of the Wlz?
Waarom sluit de regering jeugdigen jonger dan 18 jaar uit van de Wlz, terwijl zij wel voldoen aan de zorginhoudelijke criteria van de Wlz?
Questions the reasoning for excluding young people with psychiatric disorders and the uncertainty about reassessment and indication.
Can the government explain why it chooses to support young people who need permanent supervision and/or 24-hour care nearby from the current Youth Act
Kan de regering aangeven waarom men ervoor kiest om jongeren die behoefte hebben aan permanent toezicht en/of 24 uur per dag zorg in de nabijheid te ondersteunen vanuit de huidige Jeugdwet
Doubts whether excluding young people on the basis of a psychiatric disorder is correct, citing the Zorginstituut advice on equal access.
These members have not yet accepted this choice and doubt whether it is correct to exclude young people from access to the Wlz on the basis of a psychiatric disorder.
Genoemde leden hebben deze keuze nog niet gemaakt en betwijfelen of het correct is om jeugdigen op basis van een psychische stoornis uit te sluiten van toegang tot de Wlz.
Asks about criteria for permanence, how reassessment and exit from Wlz works, and quality and continuity of care for young people.
Can the government describe the process by which it is checked whether someone still meets the criteria
Kan de regering omschrijven hoe het proces verloopt waarbij wordt gecontroleerd of iemand nog aan de criteria voldoet
Welcomes the bill but asks whether people can be forced out of Wlz and warns of legal inequality between youth and adults with similar problems.
How will it be prevented that legal inequality arises between young people and adults with a psychiatric disorder
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er rechtsongelijkheid ontstaat tussen jeugdigen en volwassenen met een psychische stoornis
Asks for explanation of excluding under-18s and how quality of care for them could be guaranteed.
ask for further explanation of why young people under 18 are excluded from this amendment
vragen om nadere uitleg waarom jongeren jonger dan 18 jaar worden uitgesloten van deze wetswijziging
Asks how the concept of permanence will be operationalised for people with psychiatric disorders and whether CIZ has sufficient expertise.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government how the concept of permanence in the Wlz is operationalised for people with a psychiatric disorder.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering hoe het begrip blijvendheid in de Wlz voor mensen met een psychische stoornis wordt geoperationaliseerd.
Asks about practical benefits, risks for young people and parents, and equality reasoning for excluding those with psychiatric disorders.
ask the government how, in light of the equality principle, it argues that young people with only an intellectual or physical disability do have access to the Wlz
vragen de regering hoe zij, in het licht van het gelijkheidsbeginsel, beargumenteert dat jeugdigen met alleen een verstandelijke of lichamelijke beperking wel toegang hebben tot de Wlz

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a nota van wijziging to the Wet langdurige zorg that gives access to people with a psychiatric disorder needing permanent supervision or 24-hour care, and repealing article 3.2.2 Wlz with transitional law. The Afdeling raised no remarks on the amendment as such but warned that the care-content criteria for access remain uncertain, and the Staatssecretaris replied that the explanatory memorandum had already been supplemented and asked approval to send the amendment to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The Afdeling notes that the care-content criteria for access to the Wlz remain uncertain despite the amendment, and asks that this be taken into account before submission to the Tweede Kamer.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against submitting the bill extending Wlz long-term care access to people with psychiatric disorders until the open questions were resolved, citing unclear practical necessity, definitional and eligibility uncertainty, financial and implementation risks, and unfinished transition elements. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport rejects the need for more time, explains the safeguards and implementation plan, and adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, but largely does not accept the core objection.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the practical necessity and added value of the bill for the target group insufficiently demonstrated, which the government rejects, citing reported problems and consultation support.
Unfinished transition elements (voortgezet verblijf, NZa advice on care profiles and tariffs) and uncertain financial effects; the government explains an implementation plan and dates for adjustment.
Lack of a legal definition of psychische stoornis and unclear demarcation of eligibility; the government adds reference to the Zorginstituut definition to the explanatory memorandum.
Risk of shifting costs from municipalities to the Wlz via the CIZ and macro budget; the government points to safeguards and municipal allocation through the beschermd wonen model.

Youth mental health: the Afdeling asked for explanation of the unfinished public debate on including minors; the government explains its choice to keep youth care in the Jeugdwet and adds this to the memorandum.
Drafting remark on the limited validity period of article IV; the government keeps the wording and clarifies the care scope in article 3.1.1 of the Wlz.

35155.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2016 Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU, its member states and Canada, as required by Article 91 of the Constitution. The memorandum explains the agreement's EU and member-state competences and its provisional application, and states that citizens can derive only limited direct rights from it.
q: According to the government, citizens can derive only limited direct rights from the Agreement, within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Aan de Overeenkomst kunnen, naar het oordeel van de regering, slechts beperkt rechtstreeks rechten worden ontleend door burgers, in de zin van artikel 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

parties: Asks whether the non-proliferation commitment under Article 3 creates a real obligation to sign treaties, whether the cooperation in Article 17 has military character, and whether the Joint Cooperation Committee can issue binding rulings.
Does the JCC have the authority to reach binding decisions in this regard?
Heeft het JCC hierbij de bevoegdheid tot bindende oordelen te komen?
Views the EU as an undemocratic institution gaining power at the expense of member states like the Netherlands and questions the added value and legal relationship of the partnership with CETA.

Supports the partnership and its link to CETA, but asks the government to explain the Council of State's point that the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom should fall under the agreement and what flanking national or bilateral measures are possible.
These members are positive about the strategic partnership agreement between the EU and Canada and see this agreement as inseparably linked to the free trade agreement CETA, also concluded.

Deze leden staan positief ten opzichte van de strategische partnerschapsovereenkomst tussen de EU en Canada en zien deze overeenkomst onlosmakelijk verbonden met het eveneens afgesloten vrijhandelsakkoord CETA.

Welcomes strategic cooperation with Canada as a progressive ally and asks which parts already apply provisionally since 2017, which parts still need ratification, and what effects the provisional application has had.
The D66 members note that parts of the EU-Canada Strategic Partnership Agreement falling under EU competence have been provisionally applied since 1 April 2017.

De leden van de D66-fractie lezen dat delen van de Strategische Partnerschapsovereenkomst tussen de EU en Canada die onder de bevoegdheid van de EU vallen, al voorlopig worden toegepast sinds 1 april 2017.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Strategic Partnership Agreement with Canada may affect the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, since it is closely linked to CETA and Canada has many ties with those territories, and asked for the explanatory memorandum to be supplemented. The government's reply rejects that conclusion, arguing that EU treaty provisions and case law show the agreement does not apply to the overseas countries and territories, and adds a passage to the memorandum while stating the agreement's tourism and capital provisions are limited in nature.
concerns: The Afdeling said the agreement could affect the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and that the explanatory memorandum should explain their involvement, which the government disputed on the basis of EU treaty law.
The government added a passage on the Kingdom position to part III of the explanatory memorandum in line with the advice.

35173.s: The bill amends the Dutch Embryo Act to allow sex selection of embryos where a child faces a serious hereditary condition with unequal sex incidence. It also permits surplus reproductive cells and embryos to be used for quality control of fertility care before destruction.
35173.j: The memorandum justifies the new uses by balancing the general interest in quality control against individual interests and by pointing to the IGJ's supervisory role.
q: In view of the foregoing, the present proposal strikes a balanced assessment between the general interest and the individual interests of those concerned.
Gelet op het voorgaande wordt met het onderhavige voorstel een evenwichtige afweging gemaakt tussen het algemeen belang en de individuele belangen van de betrokkenen.
p: Allows surplus reproductive material to be used for quality control in fertility care without the donors' consent, within a defined purpose.

parties: Welcomes widening of sex selection to reduce risks of serious hereditary conditions and asks about further ethical analysis and integrated embryo policy.
Said members consider it a good thing that the Embryo Act is widened for hereditary conditions with unequal sex incidence.
Genoemde leden vinden het een goede zaak dat de Embryowet wordt verruimd bij erfelijke aandoeningen met ongelijke geslachtsincidentie.
Asks why the list of conditions is not fixed in law or delegated legislation and why an explicit consent requirement for quality-control use was not included.
Supports the change in principle but asks why the quality-control definition in the bill is narrower than the EU directive.
These members ask why quality control is defined more narrowly in this article than in Directive 2006/86/EC, Article 2(c).
Deze leden vragen waarom kwaliteitsbewaking in dit artikel beperkter gedefinieerd is dan in Richtlijn 2006/86/EG, artikel 2, onderdeel c?
Asks about the status of the broad societal discussion, the ethical analysis, expected future extensions, and inspection (IGJ) capacity and complaints.
Said members ask what the status is of this broad societal discussion.
Genoemde leden vragen wat de stand van zaken is met betrekking tot deze brede maatschappelijke discussie.
Questions why the Health Council's advice was set aside and argues the added societal-discussion test is unnecessary and may stall research.
Can the government again explain at length why a balanced advice from the Health Council (and from many scientists in this field) is being set aside?
Kan de regering nog eens uitgebreid uiteenzetten waarom een evenwichtig advies van de Gezondheidsraad (en van vele wetenschappers die op dit terrein werken) terzijde geschoven wordt?
Asks why the two-condition limitation is in the explanatory memorandum but not in the statute, and why no consent requirement was included for quality control.
Said members ask the government why the limitation to these two hereditary conditions is not in the law, while it is mentioned in the explanatory memorandum.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering waarom de beperking tot deze twee erfelijke aandoeningen niet in de wet is opgenomen, terwijl de beperking wel in de memorie van toelichting wordt genoemd.
Warns the change is a shift that opens the door to further widening, questions the 'serious' classification of LHON, and asks for absolute limits and clarity on the decision process.
Does the government share the view of these members that this amendment involves a shift and that widening the Embryo Act opens the door to other possible widenings?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat met deze wetswijziging een wissel om gaat en dat de verruiming van de Embryowet de deur openzet voor andere mogelijke verruimingen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Embryo Act to allow sex selection for serious hereditary conditions with unequal sex incidence and to permit use of residual embryos and gametes for quality monitoring; it raised remarks on the threshold of unequal incidence, the scope of conditions, and the relation between the statutory duty and donor consent. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been clarified on each point, with the threshold assessed case by case by a multidisciplinary team.
concerns: The Council asked for clarification of the degree of unequal sex incidence required before sex selection is allowed; the government stated no general threshold can be set and clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify which conditions beyond LHON and hereditary breast cancer may qualify; the government clarified the case-by-case assessment under the PGD framework.

The Council noted unclear status of donor refusal for residual material used in quality monitoring given the statutory duty; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum and that agreements with donors can record consent or refusal.

35210-III.s: This is a first supplementary budget bill for 2019 that amends the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Office of the King, and the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services by raising spending appropriations. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat
