35218.s: The bill consolidates rules on electronic official publications into the Bekendmakingswet, creating mandatory electronic publication blades for decentralised bodies and the Staatscourant, and makes conforming amendments across organic and sectoral laws. It replaces decentralised publication rules in the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet, Waterschapswet and Wgr with a central framework and extends interbestuurlijk toezicht to waterschappen via the Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken.
35218.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technical detail on formats, costs and infrastructure, and justifies centralising toezicht by the Minister's control of the shared infrastructure and uniformity.
q: The cabinet considers that for systematic reasons there is reason to apply the regime of article 124b of the Gemeentewet within the Bekendmakingswet.
Het kabinet meent dat uit systematische overwegingen aanleiding bestaat om het regime van artikel 124b van de Gemeentewet bij de Bekendmakingswet toe te passen.
d: rules on issuance and continued availability of publication blades
substitute publication when electronic issuance is impossible
rules on keeping original copies of laws and royal decisions
detailed rules on publication format, storage, costs and integrity
manner of making consolidated texts available
rules on sending electronic notification messages and processing personal data
designation of information from decisions to be made available via DSO
p: Extends indeplaatsstelling (substitute intervention by the minister) for neglect of duty to waterschappen, placing their publication compliance under ministerial control.
Moves interbestuurlijk toezicht over Bekendmakingswet compliance from provinces to the Minister of Binnenlandse Zaken, centralising oversight of local publication duties.

parties: Welcomes uniform digital publication but asks about data reuse, the MijnOverheid timeline, the cost of the new website, and how the process for address changes and subscriptions is safeguarded.

It is good that all legally prescribed announcements, communications and notices of (proposed) decisions that are not addressed to one or more stakeholders are made in the official electronic publication gazettes of the public bodies.

Het is goed dat alle wettelijk voorgeschreven bekendmakingen, mededelingen en kennisgevingen van (voorgenomen) besluiten, die niet tot een of meer belanghebbenden zijn gericht, worden gedaan in de officiële elektronische publicatiebladen

Supports digital access but asks how full availability of digital information is guaranteed, warns against dropping analogue channels, and asks about the impact on local papers and on the duty to actually reach stakeholders.
These members find it undesirable if this bill aims at closing analogue media channels to reach citizens with publications.
Deze leden vinden het onwenselijk, als via dit wetsvoorstel wordt aangestuurd op het afsluiten van analoge mediakanalen om burgers te bereiken met publicaties.

Supports the goal but worries that standardisation may cost tailored service for citizens without digital skills; asks for evaluation provisions, monitoring, and a response to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens on unsolicited notifications.
How is it ensured that service at, for example, the town hall is also still adapted to people who for whatever reason are not digitally skilled?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat de dienstverlening op bijvoorbeeld het gemeentehuis óók nog ingesteld is op mensen die om wat voor reden dan ook niet digitaal vaardig zijn?

Worries about digitally excluded citizens losing access to official information, asks how the government will monitor decentralised authorities, requires publication in Frisian, Papiamento and English where applicable, and asks about waterboard tax notices and copyright limits.

That is why these members would like to know how the government will monitor this access and how to prevent people who are already less digitally skilled from having to fight their municipalities for an accessible way of announcement.

Daarom vernemen deze leden graag hoe de regering deze toegang zal gaan monitoren en hoe voorkomen wordt dat juist mensen die al niet zo digitaal vaardig zijn ook nog eens een «strijd» moeten gaan voeren met bijvoorbeeld hun gemeenten

35236.s: This is an incidental supplementary budget bill amending the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, with changes in commitments, expenditure and revenue, specifically to fund measures linked to the Urgenda climate case. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect from 1 July 2019, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2019
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2019

35245.s: The bill amends the Dutch anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing act (Wwft) to implement the EU Fifth Anti-Money Laundering Directive, extending integrity obligations to crypto exchange and custodial wallet providers, art dealers, and rental intermediaries, and requiring DNB registration for those providers. It also broadens information sharing between supervisors, law enforcement, parliamentary inquiry committees and the Algemene Rekenkamer, and sets enhanced due diligence for high-risk third countries.
35245.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to implement the EU directive's requirements and to allow risk-based flexibility across a broad range of institutions.
q: In addition to the prescribed list of mandatory enhanced due diligence measures, an illustrative list of countermeasures is included in the Wwft, which may be made mandatory by ministerial regulation.

Naast deze voorgeschreven lijst van verplichte aanvullende maatregelen van verscherpt cliëntenonderzoek, wordt er een «illustratieve» lijst van tegenmaatregelen in de Wwft opgenomen, die bij ministeriële regeling verplicht kunnen worden gesteld.
d: registration data and integrity rules for crypto providers
publication of national risk assessment statistics
additional countermeasures against high-risk third countries
further countermeasures designated by general administrative order
designating institutions that must apply countermeasures
further rules on data to be notified on qualifying holdings
rules on establishing reliability of persons
designating third countries whose supervised providers are exempt from ban
p: The minister may designate third countries whose providers are exempt from the prohibition on offering services in the Netherlands.
Ministerial regulation may impose countermeasures such as market-entry bans and termination of business relationships in designated states without parliamentary approval.
Supervisors may share confidential information with supervisory bodies, law enforcement and parliamentary inquiry committees, subject to purpose limits and secrecy duties.

parties: Asks about enforcement against non-Dutch crypto providers, the transition for providers, and the threshold of 15,000 euro for client due diligence.
How is compliance with this legislation then ensured and enforced?
Hoe wordt naleving van deze wetgeving dan geborgd en afgedwongen?
Asks whether the anti-money-laundering directive could be annulled as the data retention directive was, in light of the Data Protection Authority's proportionality concerns.
These members also ask whether the government considers it likely that the anti-money-laundering directive in its current form could also be declared invalid, as with the data retention directive.
Ook vragen deze leden of de regering het waarschijnlijk acht dat de anti-witwasrichtlijn in haar huidige vorm ook ongeldig verklaard kan worden zoals bij de dataretentierichtlijn.
Questions whether risk-based due diligence leads to excessive data collection contrary to the proportionality principle and privacy interests, and asks for evaluation.
Can the government indicate how it assesses this in light of the proportionality principle as defined in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij dit beoordelen in het licht van het evenredigheidsbeginsel zoals gedefinieerd in het Handvest van de Grondrechten van de Europese Unie?
Raises mass surveillance concerns, weak right of access and weak notification duty for the FIU, and asks how these could be improved.

The GroenLinks members ask whether the government shares the view that this bill involves mass surveillance, in which masses of EU citizens and third parties are monitored in the context of client due diligence?

De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen de regering of zij de opvatting deelt dat er in dit wetsvoorstel sprake is van «mass surveillance», waarbij massa’s EU-burgers en derden worden gemonitord in het kader van het cliëntenonderzoek?

Criticises the frequent use of ministerial regulations and AMvB provisions, asks for pre-consultation (voorhang) of all general administrative measures, and questions mass surveillance and the lack of evaluation.
They further ask the government to make all general administrative measures subject to pre-consultation in Parliament.
Zij vragen de regering bovendien om alle algemene maatregelen van bestuur voorhangend te maken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division objected to the bill's licensing requirement for virtual currency exchange and custodian wallet providers, arguing that the EU directive only permits registration, and advised against submission unless revised. The government's reply states that the licensing requirement was changed into a registration requirement, with the Afdeling's other remarks (mutual recognition, data use under Article 22b Wwft) also addressed.
concerns: The Afdeling held that the directive explicitly requires registration rather than licensing for virtual currency service providers, so a licensing requirement with prior review is not allowed and is not proportionate.

The Afdeling stressed the principle of mutual recognition and that providers registered in other member states should not be subjected to an additional licensing requirement when targeting the Dutch market.
The Afdeling considered that DNB and AFM support for licensing does not by itself make the measure proportionate to the burden on service providers.

The Afdeling noted that a separate prudential licensing regime outside the Wwft could be considered, and asked that data-use purposes under Article 22b Wwft be clarified in line with Article 57bis of the directive.

35254.s: The bill amends the Dutch Housing Act so that housing associations may, through local performance agreements with municipalities and tenant representatives, agree a maximum rent-increase percentage up to one percentage point above the nationally set ceiling, with the national ceiling set by ministerial regulation at inflation level. It also excludes home-improvement and harmonisation rent increases from the calculation of the average rent increase and reflects the ministerial power to set the threshold for administrative separation.
35254.j: The memorandum justifies the local deviation option by the differing investment needs of associations and municipalities, and the ministerial setting of the band as following the Sociaal Huurakkoord 2018.
q: The performance agreements can show that the income from this extra rent increase benefits the planned investments in availability, quality and sustainability.
In de prestatieafspraken kan inzichtelijk worden gemaakt dat de inkomsten uit deze extra huursomstijging ten goede komen aan de voorgenomen investeringen in beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en duurzaamheid
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B, onder 1 (Woningwet art. 54, eerste lid)
Artikel I, onderdeel B (Woningwet art. 54, tweede lid, en art. 54 eerste lid)
national maximum rent-increase percentage at inflation level
p: Allows a locally agreed rent-increase ceiling up to one percentage point higher, agreed in performance agreements between associations, tenants and municipalities, within a band set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks how the proposal accounts for differences in size between housing corporations, requesting worked examples for very small, average and large corporations.
They ask for an example of how the proposal works for a very small housing corporation, an average one and a large one.
Zij vragen om een voorbeeld hoe het voorstel uitwerkt voor een zeer kleine woningcorporatie, een gemiddelde woningcorporatie en een grote woningcorporatie.
Welcomes the social rent accord and supports the bill, stressing the importance of local options for housing policy with municipalities and tenants.
The changes now proposed are therefore endorsed by these members.
De thans voorgestane wijzigingen worden door deze leden dan ook onderschreven.

Asks what uniform conditions apply to municipalities and corporations for the local one-point deviation, the expected inflow to the disputes committee, and the measurable goal and monitoring of the law.
The D66 members ask to what extent uniform conditions apply to municipalities and corporations when deciding on a one-percentage-point increase in the rent sum rise.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen in hoeverre er uniforme voorwaarden gelden voor gemeenten en corporaties om te besluiten tot een 1%-punt verhoging van de huursomstijging over te gaan?

Welcomes the rent agreement but questions whether local rent increases for tenants are reasonable given corporations' financial burdens, asks why not all accord elements are legislated, and asks about the timing of evaluation.
These members wonder, however, whether it is really reasonable to leave the investment task to tenants by giving them an additional rent increase.
Deze leden vragen zich echter af of het wel zo redelijk is om de investeringsopgave voor rekening te laten van de huurders door hen een extra huurverhoging te geven.

Critical that the bill is adopted without knowing individual tenant effects, questions exemptions for re-letting harmonisation, and asks for tenant consent (instemmingsrecht) over local deviations and say over investment financing.
The SP members ask how a sound assessment can be made of this bill if the individual effects on tenants are not known.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe een gedegen afweging gemaakt kan worden over onderhavig wetsvoorstel als de individuele gevolgen voor huurders niet bekend zullen zijn.

35263.s: The bill creates a temporary legal basis (fifteen years) allowing, via general administrative orders (AMvB), time-limited experiments of up to three years that depart from the Dutch civil procedure code, bankruptcy law, court organisation act, Book 1 of the Civil Code, and in support also legal aid and court fee rules, to promote simpler, faster, more effective and de-escalating dispute resolution. Experiments must safeguard fundamental procedural guarantees, cannot depart from treaties or EU law, are reviewed by an independent Toetsingscommissie, and must be evaluated with a report to parliament.
35263.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated experimental powers by the need to test innovative procedures in practice before deciding on definitive statutory change, bounded by fundamental guarantees and evaluation.
q: The bill provides a statutory basis to experiment with innovative forms of adjudication in order to promote simple, fast, effective and de-escalating dispute resolution.

Het wetsvoorstel biedt een wettelijke grondslag om met het oog op het bevorderen van eenvoudige, snelle, effectieve en de-escalerende geschilbeslechting te kunnen experimenteren met innovatieve vormen van rechtspleging.
d: experimental departures from civil procedure, bankruptcy, court organisation, Civil Code Book 1 rules
experimental departures from legal aid and court fee rules
further rules on design, content and evaluation of experiments
appointment and remuneration of added expert judges in courts
composition and functioning of the Toetsingscommissie
rules on consequences of withdrawing an experiment
p: Allows the executive, by general administrative order, to depart from core procedural statutes for up to three years, bounded by a list of fundamental guarantees and a sunset clause.
Lets the executive withdraw an experiment immediately in case of serious unintended effects, with only notification to parliament afterwards.
Allows the minister, by regulation, to extend an experiment once by up to three years pending a bill.
Permits court boards to add lay expert members to chambers, a change in judicial composition subject to general guarantees.

parties: Questions the fifteen-year duration and proposes limiting the pilot to five years with possible early termination, and asks about transitional law and who may initiate experiments.
These members also ask about the possibility of limiting the duration of the law.
Tevens vragen deze leden naar de mogelijkheid van beperking van de tijdsduur van de wet.
Asks how appeal and cassation work within experiments, whether participation can be compelled, and whether forum shopping undermines comparability.
The aforementioned members ask whether it would not be better to allow experiments on appeal only if no experimental procedure was followed at first instance?
Voornoemde leden vragen of het niet beter zou zijn experimenten in hoger beroep slechts toe te staan indien er in eerste aanleg geen experimentele procedure gevolgd is?
Supports the experiments but asks about how the temporary power to experiment is regulated and about safeguards such as the ban on experiments driven by budget cuts.

Can the government explain why it considers it defensible within this bill that, despite those safeguards, deviation from court fees or legal aid remuneration to the detriment of the litigant or their assistant is still possible?

Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom zij het in het kader van dit wetsvoorstel verdedigbaar vindt dat er ondanks die waarborgen nog steeds ten nadele van de rechtzoekende of diens hulpverlener kan worden afgeweken van het griffierecht of de vergoeding voor de rechtsbijstand?

Raises doubts about necessity, legal certainty, the executive's power to change procedural rules at any time, the role of Parliament in approving experiments, and the independence of the Toetsingscommissie.
Can the government guarantee that there is sufficient time for both the Senate and the House of Representatives to scrutinize the experiments?
Kan de regering waarborgen dat er voldoende tijd is voor zowel de Eerste als de Tweede Kamer om de experimenten tegen het licht te houden?
Supports accessible justice but asks about the scope of derogation from the Wrb, the interests of all parties, and the workload and cost consequences for courts and lawyers.
Can the government explain how the interests of all parties involved in an experiment deviating from the Wrb under Article 1, first paragraph, will be taken into account?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe de belangen van alle betrokkenen bij een experiment in afwijking van de Wrb op grond van artikel 1, eerste lid, zullen worden betrokken?
Asks about legal certainty and knowability of rules, safeguards for hearing both sides when facts are added, and whether experiments should be limited to what is strictly necessary.
How is it prevented that litigants become confused or even take incorrect procedural steps with possibly far-reaching consequences?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de rechtzoekenden hierdoor in verwarring raken of zelfs onjuiste processtappen zetten met mogelijk verstrekkende consequenties?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises against positive advice on the Experimentenwet rechtspleging unless safeguards are tightened, such as a more concrete delegation, criteria for experiment design and evaluation, an independent experiments committee, and a sunset clause. The Minister's reply accepts most points, adopting an independent committee, evaluation criteria, a sunset clause after fifteen years, and clarifications, but keeps the hardship clause and extension by ministerial regulation.
concerns: The delegation to the AMvB should be made more concrete and should include criteria for experiment design and evaluation, which the government adopted in article 2.
Broad possibilities to deviate from procedural law require additional safeguards, including an independent commission reviewing proposed experiments, which the government adopted via article 6.
The law should have a temporary character, which the government implemented with a fifteen-year sunset clause in article 7.
Experiments with legal aid and court fees alone fall outside the purpose of the bill, which the government addressed by clarifying article 1 and the explanatory memorandum.
Extension of an experiment should be regulated by AMvB rather than ministerial regulation, which the government rejected for practical reasons.
Transitional law for ongoing experimental procedures should be regulated, which the government addressed with a statutory basis while retaining standard transitional rules.
The hardship clause is unnecessary and should be deleted unless further justified, which the government rejected, retaining it.

35272.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for the European citizens' initiative to align it with the new EU Regulation 2019/788, updating article references and the regulation's citation. It makes no substantive change to powers of the executive or checks.
35272.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as aligning Dutch law with the revised EU regulation and making the initiative procedure easier to use.
q: The article clarifies that support statements for initiatives may be collected online or on paper.
Het artikel is verduidelijkt dat steunbetuigingen voor initiatieven online of op papier mogen worden verzameld

parties: Asks what 'already implemented' means for the implementing act and how the mandatory central online collection system relates to the national system and the Digital Government Act not yet in force.
What is meant by the phrase that the new regulation has no substantive consequences for the Implementing Act on the EBI regulation?
Wat wordt bedoeld met de zinsnede dat de nieuwe verordening inhoudelijk geen gevolgen heeft voor de Uitvoeringswet verordening EBI
Welcomes making the citizens' initiative more accessible and asks the government to take the evaluation seriously and avoid another decade-long delay in adjusting the instrument if it underperforms.

The members however request the government to also prevent that adjusting this instrument again takes a decade, if the evaluation shows the new regulation still does not work well enough after introduction.
De leden verzoeken de regering echter ook te voorkomen dat de aanpassing van dit instrument weer een decennium in beslag neemt

Questions the usefulness of a European citizens' initiative since Europe is not a state, and asks for examples of initiatives that changed EU rules; also asks whether the voting-age decision will be concluded in time.
Can the government give examples of initiatives through which European rules have been changed?
Kan de regering voorbeelden noemen van initiatieven waardoor Europese regels zijn aangepast?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that amending the Uitvoeringsbesluit (an algemene maatregel van bestuur) through a wet is undesirable and that the changes should instead be made by a regulation of equal rank. The government's nader rapport reports that it removed the amendments from the bill and placed them in a separate besluit amending the Uitvoeringsbesluit.
concerns: Amending an algemene maatregel van bestuur through a wet is undesirable because it creates uncertainty about the status of the amended provision; the changes should be made by a regulation of equal rank.

35300-III.s: The bill formally adopts the 2020 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It sets expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as 1 January 2020.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) attached to this law for the year 2020 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that it has no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the various ministries and funds and recommends submitting them to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport announces only some technical amendments to several budgets, detailed in annexes.

35317.s: The bill amends the Dutch Act on supervision and dispute settlement of collective rights management organisations to strengthen the Supervisory Board's enforcement tools, including the ability to impose fines without prior advice and to accept binding commitments, and shifts half of the supervision costs to the sector. It also expands prior-notification duties and adds fit-and-proper testing of senior managers and supervisors of large organisations.
35317.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the 2016 evaluation finding that supervision should be more effective and efficient, and by the principle that sector beneficiaries should bear part of the costs.
q: The bill makes six changes to the Supervision Act that should enable the College to deploy its resources and capacity optimally.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in zes wijzigingen in de Wet toezicht, die het College in staat moeten stellen zijn middelen en capaciteit optimaal in te zetten.
d: rules on how reliability of persons is assessed
contribution of each organisation to supervision costs
p: The Supervisory Board may assess the reliability and suitability of managers and supervisors of organisations collecting over 50 million euro, based on their intentions, conduct and background.
The Supervisory Board may accept binding commitments in place of fines or penalty payments, removing its power to sanction once a commitment is declared binding.[truncated]
The Supervisory Board may require organisations to commission investigations or submit improvement plans when it has grounds to doubt proper conduct, at the organisation's cost.
Prior approval requirements are narrowed to general terms and tariff changes, and the Supervisory Board may extend its advice period by up to four weeks in special circumstances.

parties: Asks the government to explain what 'excessive' (buitensporig) tariff increases means and when extended advice deadlines apply, and how confidentiality of commercially sensitive agreements is protected.
These members ask the government to explain what is meant by the term 'excessive'.
Deze leden vragen de regering uiteen te zetten wat bedoeld wordt met de term «buitensporig».

Welcomes the College's expanded enforcement power but questions the narrowing of prior-approval scope, the use and outcomes of consent decisions, and whether the College has enough expertise for fitness tests.
These members find it strange that the bill is described as a clarification while it contains several changes, including restrictions on the scope of the College's preventive supervision.

Deze leden vinden het vreemd dat gesproken wordt over een verduidelijking, terwijl sprake is van verschillende wijzigingen, waaronder inperkingen van de reikwijdte van het preventief toezicht van het College.

Supports more effective supervision but questions whether the College's fitness-testing of managers fits the EU directive requiring balanced representation of rightholders, and asks how efficiency rewards and competitiveness effects will work.
Does the government not think it is for the rightholders themselves to determine who they consider suitable to represent them?
Is de regering niet van mening dat het aan de rechthebbenden zelf is te bepalen wie zij geschikt achten hen te vertegenwoordigen?

Stresses adequate rightholder control over collective management and worries that the College's fitness tests and the 50% cost burden may reduce payments to creators and clash with rightholder representation.
These members strongly value adequate protection of creators' rights, and collective management can serve that purpose.
Deze leden hechten sterk aan een adequate bescherming van de rechten van de makers en een collectief beheer kan daaraan dienstbaar zijn.

Argues that 50% funding of supervision by supervised parties endangers the regulator's independence, that after-the-fact notification weakens brancheorganisations' position, and that tariffs should be fully transparent and WOB-access preserved.
Does this not pose a danger to the independence of the supervisor, since a financial dependency relationship will arise between the rights organisations and the College?
Schuilt hierin niet een gevaar voor de onafhankelijkheid van de toezichthouder, doordat een financiële afhankelijkheidsrelatie zal ontstaan tussen de rechtenorganisaties en het College?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill clarifying the scope of preventive supervision by the College van Toezicht over collective management organisations should better justify retaining prior approval for unilateral tariff increases while replacing approval for model agreements with an information duty. The minister's nader rapport added justification (consumer protection against market power, Geschillencommissie advice) and amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for better justification of why unilateral tariff increases still require College approval while model agreements no longer do; the government added explanation based on market power and the role of the Geschillencommissie.
Redactional comments of the Afdeling were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35344.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Appingedam, Delfzijl and Loppersum and establishes a new municipality of Eemsdelta from their territory on a date set by royal decree. It also amends several laws, including the Crisis- en herstelwet, the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II and the Wet veiligheidsregio's, to replace the old municipal names with Eemsdelta.
35344.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by citing a COELO study showing the three municipalities are financially stable with no supervisory or audit concerns and comparable financial positions.
q: Research by COELO shows that the municipalities of Appingedam, Delfzijl and Loppersum are three financially stable municipalities.
Uit onderzoek van COELO blijkt dat de gemeenten Appingedam, Delfzijl en Loppersum drie financieel stabiele gemeenten zijn.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Sees no reason for comments or questions on the bill, which is initiated by the municipalities and aims at a capable municipality.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Objects that the merger advice and provincial view were not attached to the explanatory memorandum, and asks what size threshold the government uses for sending documents to the House.
The CDA members are surprised that the merger advice and the province's view were not included as annexes to the explanatory memorandum 'because of their size'.
Het verbaast de leden van de CDA-fractie dat het herindelingsadvies en de zienswijze van de provincie «vanwege de omvang» niet als bijlagen bij de memorie van toelichting zijn opgenomen.

In principle supports mergers where finances or capacity are weak, but stresses the need for public support and asks how the merged municipality will be administratively sound and handle complaints about earthquake damage.
Naturally, public support among the population is important in this respect.
Vanzelfsprekend is daarbij draagvlak onder de bevolking van belang.
Hopes the merger will benefit residents and raises concern about the financial position of the new municipality facing earthquake, shrinkage and nitrogen challenges.
The main concern of the ChristenUnie members is the financial position of the new municipality Eemsdelta.
Voornaamste punt van zorg van de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie is de financiële positie van de nieuwe gemeente Eemsdelta.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the bill merging the municipalities of Appingedam, Delfzijl and Loppersum and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations forwards the advice and asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent to parliament, with no substantive points requiring a reply.

35350-V.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by making the second supplementary budget adjustments in thousands of euros, effective from 1 December 2019. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or shift of powers, only budgetary reallocations among policy and non-policy articles.
q: This is mainly the result of the Dutch contribution to the UN for crisis management operations turning out lower than estimated.
Dit is met name het gevolg van het feit dat de Nederlandse contributie aan de VN voor crisisbeheersingsoperaties lager uitvalt dan geraamd.

35353.s: The bill amends the Huisvestingswet 2014 to give municipalities new tools to register, monitor and regulate tourist rental of residential space, including mandatory registration numbers, notification duties, night limits and permit requirements. It also adds enforcement powers such as penalty payments against platforms and binding orders against non-cooperating persons, and requires a review within five years.
35353.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by the difficulty of enforcement and the need to protect liveability and housing supply, with the council's democratic legitimacy and judicial review as checks.
q: To enforce, the municipality must know who offers which residential space for tourist rental.
Om te kunnen handhaven moet de gemeente weten door wie welke woonruimte wordt aangeboden voor toeristische verhuur.
d: municipal council may apply housing measures for tourist rental in housing ordinance
municipal council sets categories, areas, nights limits, notification and permit requirements in housing ordinance
rules on design of the registration system for registration numbers
p: Municipalities gain power to require registration, notification and permits for tourist rental of homes, restricting owners' use of their property, with the memorandum requiring justification of necessity and proportionality.
Mayor and aldermen may impose a binding order under administrative coercion on persons who refuse cooperation with inspectors.

parties: Asks whether municipalities need stronger data powers to enforce the law and whether a main-residence-only rule is possible, to combat unfair competition and housing fraud.
These members ask whether it is possible to include in the law that tourist rental of residential space is only possible by the main resident.
Ook vragen zij of het mogelijk is om in de wet op te nemen dat verhuur van toeristische woonruimte alleen mogelijk is door de hoofdbewoner.
Asks whether platforms can be obliged to refuse listings without a number and to share addresses with municipalities, and whether tax on rental income will be proposed.
They believe landlords seeking to evade the rules must be known to municipalities.
Zij menen dat verhuurders die de regels willen ontwijken bij gemeenten bekend moeten kunnen zijn.
Questions whether platforms bear sufficient responsibility and whether municipalities have the expertise to design permit allocation and registration systems.
However, these members wonder whether the bill sufficiently recognises the role of digital platforms and whether it should be supplemented on this point.
Echter vragen deze leden zich af of het wetsvoorstel de rol van digitale platforms voldoende erkent en op dit punt aangevuld moet worden.
Criticises that platforms get no extra obligations, questions the government's claim that EU law forbids it, and asks for disclosure of consultation with platforms.
On the other hand, the GroenLinks members are disappointed that under this bill platforms receive no additional obligations.
Anderzijds zijn de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks teleurgesteld dat met dit wetsvoorstel platforms geen extra verplichtingen krijgen.
Objects that platforms were consulted as equal partners, questions the dropping of a national registration obligation, and asks for consultation records and fairer fines.
The SP members are, to put it mildly, surprised that rental platforms were allowed to take part in the consultation on this draft bill.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn op zijn zachts gezegd verbaasd dat verhuurplatforms mee hebben mogen praten over onderhavige conceptwet.
Asks whether municipalities can substantiate local scarcity given court rulings that could annul housing ordinances, and whether platforms should share personal data.
Is it true that insufficient substantiation of local scarcity of affordable housing can lead the court to annul the entire housing ordinance?
Klopt het dat onvoldoende onderbouwing van lokale schaarste aan betaalbare woningen ertoe kan leiden dat de rechter de gehele huisvestingsverordening vernietigt?
Supports regulation but questions whether the registration obligation is enforceable and whether the evaluation period of five years is too long.
At the same time, a registration obligation only has real effect if non-compliance with it is verifiable.
Tegelijkertijd heeft een registratieverplichting enkel daadwerkelijk effect, wanneer het niet voldoen aan deze verplichting controleerbaar is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division (Afdeling advisering) raised no substantive objections to the draft bill on short-stay rental of housing (Huisvestingswet 2014), referring only to editorial remarks. The minister's reply reports that an evaluation clause was added, the night-based criterion replaced the day-based one, electronic application routes were opened, and minor editorial improvements were made.
concerns: The advisory division's editorial remarks in the attached annex were taken on board, including adding an evaluation provision to article 52 of the Huisvestingswet 2014.

35362.s: The bill simplifies how the non-payer contribution is provided to health insurers by restructuring Zorgverzekeringswet articles 18a-18c and 34a, and requires insurers to make proactive efforts and cooperate on debt recovery. It also extends the NZa's enforcement powers (penalty orders and administrative fines) to the new obligations.
35362.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulations by saying detailed administrative descriptions of efforts must be adjustable to new developments in premium collection.
q: In this way the sometimes detailed administrative description of the efforts can, where necessary, be adapted to new developments in premium collection.
Op die manier kan de soms gedetailleerde, administratieve beschrijving van de inspanningen indien nodig worden aangepast aan nieuwe ontwikkelingen voor de inning van de premie.
d: when sufficient premium collection efforts are deemed made
when sufficient cooperation with debt repayment is deemed given
period, amount, manner, reporting and administration for the contribution
p: Removal of the former subsection 3 narrows the statutory conditions and shifts detail to ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks how insurers remain involved in the NZa's regulatory framework and what the legal difference is between conditions and obligations.
Asks why the NZa's proposal to receive regulatory power over practice was not adopted and why secondary regulation is used for insurer obligations.
Can the government explain to these members why not?
Kan de regering aan deze leden uitleggen waarom niet?
Demands a sound motivation for the reversal of course, including the division of responsibilities between CAK and NZa in assessing and supervising insurers.
The members named now lack a sound justification for the proposed change of course.
Genoemde leden missen thans een deugdelijke motivering van de voorgenomen koerswijziging.
Argues that the defaulter problem reflects the health system's financing and asks whether converting conditions into obligations and flexibly norming insurer efforts is contradictory.
They ask why the amendment specifically aims to standardise and enforce insurers' efforts and cooperation in a flexible way.
Zij vragen waarom de wetswijziging juist beoogt de inspanningen en medewerking van de zorgverzekeraars op flexibele wijze te normeren en te handhaven.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Zorgverzekeringswet to simplify the wanbetalersbijdrage and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister for Medical Care responds by forwarding the bill and explanatory memorandum without substantive comment, as the advice gave no reason for substantive remarks.

35407.s: The bill amends the Dutch energy efficiency implementation act to implement Regulation (EU) 2017/1369 on energy labelling, letting the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate take corrective measures, impose administrative fines and enforcement orders, and pass on inspection costs to suppliers. It also renames the act and conforming references in the General Administrative Law Act and the Economic Offences Act.
35407.j: The memorandum justifies the new administrative sanctioning powers by the technical expertise of the NVWA, the effectiveness of administrative enforcement, and the EU regulation's requirement of effective, proportionate and dissuasive sanctions.
q: Administrative enforcement is considered first where the violation is easy to establish, there is no need for an investigation phase with coercive powers, and no heavy penalties are needed, not even as deterrence.

Bestuursrechtelijke handhaving komt allereerst in aanmerking indien de overtreding eenvoudig is vast te stellen, er geen behoefte is aan een opsporingsfase met bijbehorende dwangmiddelen en opsporingsbevoegdheden en er geen zware straffen nodig zijn, ook niet ter afschrikking.
d: Minister decides measures the EU regulation assigns to market surveillance authorities
further rules for implementing product-specific delegated acts
amounts and categories of administrative fines
amounts of cost recovery for document checks and physical tests
p: Gives the Minister a general competence to take measures the EU regulation leaves to market surveillance authorities, unless a statute provides otherwise.
Authorizes the Minister to impose enforcement orders under administrative coercion and penalty payments for listed obligations.
Allows the Minister to impose administrative fines directly, and lets low-category fines bypass prosecutorial referral, with amounts set by decree and capped by criminal fine category four.
Lets the Minister set cost-recovery amounts by ministerial regulation based on actual costs.

parties: The VVD has no additions or comments on the bill.
These members have no additions and/or comments.
Deze leden hebben geen aanvullingen en/of opmerkingen.

The CDA asks the government to clarify the division of tasks between the NVWA and ACM, including which authority designates inspection bodies, and asks about the NVWA's capacity to absorb extra enforcement workload.
These members ask the government to provide clarity on which authority is responsible for designating the inspection bodies.](The CDA also asks about the NVWA's capacity.)
Deze leden vragen de regering duidelijkheid te verschaffen over welke autoriteit verantwoordelijk is voor de aanwijzing van de keuringsinstellingen.

The SP questions whether the NVWA receives extra resources for its expanded enforcement tasks, warns it is already under strain, and asks how the dual administrative and criminal enforcement approach works in practice.
Does the NVWA receive extra funds for these new tasks?
Krijgt de NVWA extra middelen voor deze nieuwe taken?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU Regulation 2017/1369 on energy labelling, objecting that the delegation to set administrative fines by AMvB, without statutory criteria for choosing the low or high fine category, is too broad. The government's reply adopts the criteria (nature of the infringement and consequences for end users or the market) in the delegation provision and adds redactional changes.
concerns: The delegation to set fine categories by AMvB is too broad; the statute itself must specify the criteria determining low or high category fines.
Redactional corrections to articles 33c, 33d and a full transposition table were proposed; most were adopted, one wording change was not.

35416.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 6.6 million for consular services. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 23 March 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2020

35434.s: This temporary COVID-19 emergency bill suspends various procedural requirements for delegated regulations and allows fully or partly electronic court hearings, notarial deeds, meetings of companies and professional bodies, and corporate meetings. It also extends deadlines for taakstraffen, adjusts appeal formalities in immigration cases, and lets the Minister for Legal Protection extend sentence execution periods, and it expires on 1 September 2020.
35434.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension of procedures by the urgency of unacceptable consequences of the COVID-19 outbreak and the need for rapid action, with notification to parliament afterwards.
q: If immediately arising unacceptable consequences related to the COVID-19 outbreak necessitate the adoption of a general administrative order or ministerial regulation, statutory requirements aimed at advice, consultation, notice, parliamentary approval or involvement do not apply to it.

Indien terstond intredende onaanvaardbare gevolgen in verband met de uitbraak van COVID-19 noodzaken tot de vaststelling van een algemene maatregel van bestuur of ministeriële regeling, blijven ten aanzien van die algemene maatregel van bestuur of ministeriële regeling wettelijke voorschriften buiten toepassing
d: COVID-19 general measures and ministerial regulations bypassing consultation and parliamentary procedures
extension of taakstraf execution periods by up to twelve months
p: Suspends statutory advice, consultation, pre- and post-parliamentary approval and notice procedures for COVID-19 regulations, requiring only later motivated notification to parliament.
Allows the Minister for Legal Protection to extend sentence execution deadlines by up to twelve months, with notification to the convicted person.
Expressly gives the safety-region chair power to impose enforcement orders under bestuursdwang and dwangsom.
Gives a non-government appellant in immigration cases a chance to remedy missing grounds, a protection against the state, though it is limited to temporary cases.

parties: Asks about the duration of the suspension of consultation and pre-legislative procedures and about retroactive effect and the rule that the temporary powers should end.

They support all changes that are necessary during this crisis to safeguard as much as possible the continuity of the legislative process, the judiciary, the criminal justice chain and public administration.

Deze leden steunen voorts alle wijzigingen die tijdens deze crisis noodzakelijk zijn om de continuïteit van het wetgevingsproces, de rechtspraak, de strafrechtketen en het openbaar bestuur zoveel mogelijk te waarborgen.
Objects to easing appeal rules for foreign nationals and asks about suspended pre-trial detention and early release.
These members furthermore consider it inappropriate that the government is now misusing the coronavirus crisis to ease immigration policy.
Voornoemde leden vinden het voorts ongepast dat de coronacrisis nu door de regering misbruikt wordt om het vreemdelingenbeleid te versoepelen.
Asks for a broad report after the act ends on use of the emergency powers and restoration of rights, and questions the lack of pre-legislative safeguards.
This bill sets aside, under the circumstances, a number of usual (legal) safeguards for legislation, the judiciary and the implementation of laws.
Dit wetsvoorstel zet onder omstandigheden een aantal gebruikelijke (rechts)waarborgen voor wetgeving, rechtspraak en uitvoering van wetten opzij.
Stresses that the exception to open court hearings must be strictly limited and asks for live streaming and clarity on telephone hearings and equality of procedural parties.
These members attach importance to openness.
Deze leden hechten aan het belang van openbaarheid.
Worries that the default-to-silence rule in debt collection and the unclear letter to defendants may harm vulnerable debtors' right to a fair trial.
Is the government of the opinion that failure to respond may not simply be treated as agreement with the collection claim?
Is de regering van mening dat het uitblijven van een reactie niet zomaar mag gelden als een akkoord met de incasso?
Warns that replacing oral defence in small debt cases with written notice disadvantages low-literacy debtors and that unilateral extension of care orders without hearing reduces safeguards.

For that reason they do not consider it a good proposal that those wishing to defend themselves now have to make known via a separate letter, as a kind of addendum to the summons, that they can later give oral defence by telephone or email.

Om die reden vinden zij het geen goed voorstel om degenen die verweer willen voeren nu via een losse brief, waarmee bij wijze van addendum de dagvaarding als het ware aangepast wordt, te laten weten dat zij om later mondeling verweer te kunnen voeren dat via telefoon of email kenbaar kunnen maken.
Welcomes safeguards such as informing the oversight body when procedures are set aside and asks whether the arrangement will be evaluated.
Thus these members attach importance to the supervisory body being informed when it is decided to deviate from pre- or post-consultation procedures.
Zo hechten deze leden eraan dat het controlerend orgaan op de hoogte wordt gesteld wanneer besloten wordt af te wijken van voor- of nahangprocedures.
Asks whether the temporary law is only invoked when no other law provides powers, whether the Noodwet rechtspleging could be used, and asks for monitoring of experience.
First, these members ask whether the provisions of this temporary act may only be invoked if no measures under this temporary act can be taken on the basis of another act.

Allereerst vragen deze leden of de bepalingen in deze tijdelijke wet slechts worden ingeroepen indien op grond van het bepaalde bij of krachtens een andere wet geen voorzieningen als bedoeld in deze tijdelijke wet kunnen worden getroffen.
Asks whether people who cannot meet deadlines for objections for serious reasons, or who cannot use digital means, retain their rights.
These members ask whether there are sufficient safeguards that people who do not have that possibility can still fully exercise their rights.
Deze leden vragen of er wel voldoende waarborgen zijn dat mensen die daar niet de mogelijkheid toe hebben wel voluit van hun rechten gebruik kunnen blijven maken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Spoedwet COVID-19 Justitie en Veiligheid, an emergency omnibus bill with temporary procedural measures, raising concerns about open justice in electronic hearings, permanent provisions in a temporary law, and broad suspension of pre-legislative procedures for urgent delegated regulations. The government's nader rapport accepted most points by narrowing criteria, adding time limits and notification duties, but declined to adopt a general statutory overmacht rule or suspend Awb dwangsom and lex silencio positivo rules.
concerns: Electronic hearings without a physical session must be limited, with a clear COVID-19 link, to preserve the principle of open justice under Article 121 Grondwet and Article 6 EVRM.
Permanent provisions (speeksel/slijm powers and bestuursdwang/dwangsom powers) in a temporary act were inappropriate and were converted into temporary measures.
Suspending consultation and voor- en nahang for urgent delegated regulations is a significant procedural intrusion; the government narrowed the criterion and added a notification duty to Parliament.

A generic statutory deeming of overmacht for missed decision deadlines goes too far, though a time-limited suspension of dwangsom and lex silencio positivo could be considered; the government declined to adopt either.
Redactional comments were adopted and the sunset date for the Awb-related provisions was fixed in the bill.

35443.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of Kingdom Relations to add an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 135 million in liquidity support, mainly loans and guarantees, for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten amid the COVID-19 crisis. It also reallocates EUR 28.5 million for debt settlement for Curaçao and Sint Maarten and makes the law retroactive to 9 April 2020.
35443.j: The memorandum justifies the supplementary budget by the COVID-19 crisis and the request for solidarity under Article 36 of the Charter, based on advice from the supervisory colleges CAft and Cft.
q: The countries invoked solidarity within the Kingdom under Article 36 of the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
De landen hebben op grond van artikel 36 van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een beroep gedaan op de solidariteit binnen het Koninkrijk.

35452.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality as a third incidental supplementary budget, adding emergency funds for jobs and the economy and measures on nitrogen. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 8 May 2020 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2020

Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2020

35461.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to implement parts of EU Directive 2018/645 on professional competence of professional drivers, replacing national certificates with a qualification card (kwalificatiekaart bestuurder) issued by the Dienst Wegverkeer. It sets out rules on issuance, replacement, validity and invalidation of these cards, with detailed requirements to be set by ministerial regulation and general administrative order.
35461.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary implementation of the EU directive and to ensure correct execution of the regulations by CBR and RDW.
q: Driver qualification cards can be requested from the RDW and are also issued by the RDW.
Kwalificatiekaarten bestuurder kunnen worden aangevraagd bij de RDW en worden ook door de RDW afgegeven.
d: I-A (art. 1, eerste lid, onderdeel l); I-G (art. 151b); I-L (art. 151ia)
requirements for design, execution and content of the driver qualification card
I-L (art. 151ib, lid 1; art. 151ic lid 1; art. 151id lid 1)
rules for issuing, renewing and replacing driver qualification cards
rules on invalidation of driver qualification cards; ministerial rules on surrender of invalidated cards
rules on publication of certificate invalidation and surrender procedures
p: Allows the Dienst Wegverkeer to invalidate a card received as found property when return to the holder is not possible, expanding administrative discretion over holders' documents.
Lets the agency refuse to issue or hand over a new or replacement card if circumstances known between application and issuance would have led to refusal.

parties: Has no further questions or comments on the bill.
have taken note with interest of the bill on professional competence, training and retraining of drivers and have no further questions or comments on it.
hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel betreffende vakbekwaamheid, opleiding en nascholing van chauffeurs en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Views the bill as a blow to drivers, asking why the government did not act earlier to prevent drivers being burdened with costs.
why the bill is once again a slap in the face for drivers and why the government did not bang its fist on the table in the meantime
waarom het wetsvoorstel wederom een klap in het gezicht van de chauffeurs is en waarom de regering in de tussentijd niet met de vuist op tafel heeft geslagen
Asks about cost calculations, the reasons for omitting consultation and the scope for deviation, and the usability of the rules; questions the government's assessment of costs.
Can the government indicate how the calculations were substantiated?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe de berekeningen zijn onderbouwd?
Agrees with the purpose and elaboration of the bill and has no questions.
These members agree with the purpose and the elaboration of the proposal.
Deze leden kunnen zich vinden in het doel en de uitwerking van het voorstel.
Has no further questions at this time.
They currently have no further questions.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen verdere vragen.
Asks the government to send the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk advice to the Chamber and to do so routinely in future.
ask whether the government is willing to send the advice of the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) to the Chamber.
vragen of de regering bereid is het advies van het Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk (ATR) naar de Kamer te sturen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill amending the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to implement EU Directive 2018/645 on driver qualifications and driving licences, and found no substantive remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that the Afdeling made no substantive comments and that some minor detailed points in the bill and explanatory memorandum were sharpened.

35470-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the Dutch States General (IIA) by adjusting appropriations and outlays across the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer articles, as recorded in the attached budget statement. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35506.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2017/821 on conflict minerals due diligence by designating the Inspector-General for Environment and Transport as competent authority and empowering inspectors to impose periodic penalty orders. It also provides for public disclosure of such orders after a waiting period, with safeguards for privacy and interim relief.
35506.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary corrective measures the Commission prefers over punitive sanctions, and the disclosure as legitimising government policy and informing the public, with privacy safeguards.
q: The competent authority therefore receives in the Netherlands the power to impose a periodic penalty order.
De bevoegde autoriteit krijgt daarom in Nederland de bevoegdheid tot oplegging van een last onder dwangsom.
p: The competent authority may impose a periodic penalty order to enforce the regulation, a coercive power over importers subject to general administrative law limits.
The authority may publicly disclose enforcement decisions after a ten-day wait, with interim relief suspending publication and anonymisation options protecting privacy.

parties: Asks whether the regulation overlaps with existing sector covenants, how the supervisor identifies conflict minerals, and whether the regulation will be included in the evaluation of covenants.

The CDA members ask on the basis of which criteria and by which organisation(s) it is determined whether there are conflict minerals, and ask whether the Dutch supervisory authority has a role in qualifying the products.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op basis van welke criteria en door welke organisatie(s) wordt bepaald of er sprake is van conflictmineralen en vragen of de Nederlandse toezichtsautoriteit een rol heeft in de kwalificatie van de producten.
Asks how parliament will be informed about compliance and enforcement and to what extent civil society will be involved in supervision, and whether additional resources for the ILT are needed.
The D66 members would like to hear from the government how the House will be informed about compliance with and enforcement of the act.
De leden van de D66-fractie horen graag van de regering op welke manier de Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de naleving en handhaving van de wet?

Welcomes third-party reporting and co-supervision by civil society, asks for an earlier evaluation after one year, and questions the balance between protecting company names and preventing human rights abuses.
Does the government share the view of the GroenLinks members that the possibility for third parties to co-supervise compliance with the act is a valuable addition to the bill.
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie dat de mogelijkheid voor derden om mede-toezicht te houden op naleving van de wet een waardevolle toevoeging is aan het wetsvoorstel

Questions whether companies alone are left to determine scope, asks for public annual reports and transparency on penalties, and questions the choice of supervisor and the premature exclusion of punitive measures.
The SP members ask the government whether the assessment and scope are left solely to the companies themselves.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of de beoordeling en de reikwijdte alleen aan de bedrijven zelf wordt overgelaten?
Asks how the supervisor will identify companies, inform the public about corrective measures, enable dialogue with affected parties, and what the annual reports will contain.
According to the ChristenUnie members, how the role of the supervisor is precisely shaped is of great importance for the effectiveness of the conflict minerals regulation measures.

Volgens de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie is het voor de effectiviteit van de maatregelen uit de conflictmineralenverordening van groot belang hoe de rol van de toezichthouder precies vormgegeven gaat worden.
Asks how the government will ensure uniform interpretation and enforcement across EU member states to secure a level playing field, as emphasised by the ILT.

The aforementioned members ask whether the government can indicate whether it shares this call by the ILT and, if so, how the government intends to ensure that the interpretation and implementation of the bill by Dutch authorities does not differ from other member states.

De voorgenoemde leden vragen of de regering kan aangeven of zij deze oproep van de ILT deelt en zo ja, op welke wijze de regering voornemens is om te verzekeren dat de uitleg en uitvoering van het wetsvoorstel door de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet verschilt

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive objections to the draft bill implementing EU Regulation 2017/821 on due diligence for conflict minerals importers, and only proposed drafting and redactional changes, including adjusting the entry-into-force provision because of COVID-19 delays. The minister's reply states that the redactional comments have been incorporated and the bill is to be submitted to the Tweede Kamer.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed redactional changes to article 4 (adding 'natuurlijke of rechtspersonen' and replacing 'betrokken partijen') and adding a transposition table, which the government incorporated.

35515.s: The bill creates a legal basis for municipalities and health insurers to exchange personal and health data about parties for whom they have a justified belief of healthcare fraud, under a protocol approved by the Minister. It also establishes the Informatieknooppunt zorgfraude as a data-processing body (a foundation) to enrich fraud signals and analyse trends, and amends the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet to route data through the Inlichtingenbureau, while excluding data covered by medical confidentiality.
35515.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for efficient, practical fraud enforcement and by the need for detailed rules on protocols, data security and processes that are better set in general measures.
q: Legislation is necessary to remove the bottlenecks, consisting of the lack of sufficient legal bases for and obligation to necessary exchange of personal data, unclarity about powers and securing the role of the IKZ cooperation.

Wetgeving is noodzakelijk teneinde de knelpunten, die bestaan uit het ontbreken van voldoende grondslagen voor en verplichting tot noodzakelijke uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens, onduidelijkheid over bevoegdheden en de borging van de rol van het samenwerkingsverband IKZ, weg te nemen.
d: protocol requirements, approval and safeguards for fraud data exchange
retention periods and data subject rights
data to be supplied to the information point and conditions for supply
enrichment and forwarding of signals to suitable institutions, incl. tax data
timing and manner of reporting trends and statistics to the Minister
management, accountability, funding and designation of the information point; Minister may issue directions
designation of the Informatieknooppunt zorgfraude and Inlichtingenbureau by the Minister
p: Institutions including the Inspectie SZW, FIOD and tax authority must supply data to a central ministry-designated body that enriches and forwards it, bypassing bilateral legal bases, with the Minister holding directive powers over it.
Municipalities and insurers may exchange personal and health data on suspicion of fraud, with safeguards including a protocol reviewed by the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens and ministerial approval.
Profiling of persons is expressly excluded for the information point's analysis tasks.

parties: Welcomes the bill and balance between fraud fighting and privacy; asks about how signals reach the register in time and time allocation between trend-spotting and enforcement.
They have a few further questions on this.
Zij hebben hierbij nog enkele vragen.

Questions proportionality of the register, the vague 'gerechtvaardigde overtuiging' standard instead of a court ruling, many delegations to AMvBs, and the risk of unjust consequences without judicial finding.
Without the judge having ruled whether fraud occurred, the consequences for the organisation concerned can be very large.
Zonder dat de rechter geoordeeld heeft of sprake is van fraude kunnen de consequenties voor de organisatie die het betreft heel groot zijn.
Worries the warning register could function as a blacklist, asks about burden of proof reversal, legal basis for data sharing and who controls the exchange.
ask about the risk that the Waarschuwingsregister will in fact function as a blacklist
vragen naar het risico dat het genoemde Waarschuwingsregister in feite zal gaan functioneren als een zwarte lijst
Asks whether persons are placed on the register on mere suspicion and treated as guilty without a judge, and who supervises data exchange.
Does a judge get involved, or is someone treated as guilty already upon suspicion of fraud?
Komt hier nog een rechter aan te pas of wordt iemand bij het vermoeden van fraude al als schuldig behandeld
Demands safeguards against a new toeslagenaffaire, asks what remedies exist for those wrongly listed, and questions the lack of legal regulation of implementation via AMvBs.
How will a new toeslagenaffaire be prevented, so that persons or care providers are wrongly convicted or refused on grounds for which they are being examined?
Hoe wordt een nieuwe toeslagenaffaire voorkomen, zodat personen of zorgaanbieders onterecht veroordeeld of geweigerd kunnen worden op gronden waarvoor ze bekeken worden?
Welcomes the register but asks why only suspicions rather than established fraud are included, and argues profiling and disclosure of medical data should be allowed in fraud detection.
Should someone convicted of care fraud not precisely be in the Waarschuwingsregister?
Zou iemand met een veroordeling wegens zorgfraude niet juist in het Waarschuwingsregister moeten staan?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill establishing an information hub (IKZ) and a warning register against healthcare fraud, raising points on the fraud definition, the warning register and data-subject rights, overlap with existing data grounds, profiling, the foundation's accountability, the processing role of the IB, and sub-delegation. The minister's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, adding a fraud definition, clarifying the instruments and their relationship, excluding profiling, strengthening ministerial steering, and narrowing sub-delegation.
concerns: A statutory definition of fraud is needed to fix the scope of the law, and the government adds the definition to the wording of article 1.1.

The warning register's consequences are serious and data subjects may not be informed, so safeguards and remedies must be explained, with the government expanding the explanatory memorandum but not changing the statute.
The relationship and possible sequencing between the warning register and the IKZ must be clarified, which the government does in the explanatory memorandum.
The overlap between the new data-sharing basis for the IKZ and existing sectoral grounds needs clarifying; the government explains the new basis coexists with existing ones without amending them.
Possible profiling by the IKZ must be excluded or accompanied by stronger safeguards; the government expressly excludes profiling in article 2.5.

Ministerial responsibility over the foundation as data controller is unclear and the accountability mechanisms are insufficient; the government adds statutory and statute-level steering instruments but keeps the foundation form.
The IB's controller role is hard to reconcile with its facilitating function; the government clarifies the role in the memorandum rather than changing it.
Sub-delegation to a ministerial regulation should not cover legal protection matters such as retention periods and data-subject rights; the bill is amended so these require an AMvB.

35533.s: The bill amends the Dutch Constitution so that the second reading of constitutional amendments is handled by the States General in joint session (verenigde vergadering) rather than by each chamber separately, keeping the two-thirds majority requirement. It also adds transitional provisions and changes the joint-session rules for splitting amendments and for consequential adjustments under Article 138.
35533.j: The memorandum justifies the change as removing a vulnerability in the current procedure while retaining safeguards such as two readings, an intervening election, and a two-thirds majority.
q: It is proposed that the second reading of constitutional amendments be handled in a joint session of the two chambers rather than separately by each chamber.
Voorgesteld wordt om de tweede lezing van Grondwetswijzigingen voortaan in een verenigde vergadering te behandelen en niet meer in de beide Kamers afzonderlijk.
p: Moves the second reading of constitutional amendments and the power to split a proposal from the separate chambers into a joint session of the States General, altering the institutional role of the Eerste Kamer as a separate check.

parties: Supports keeping the two-reading procedure, two-thirds majority and Eerste Kamer involvement, and asks whether separate voting could be retained within a joint session.
The members of the VVD faction consider it a good thing that these main elements are retained.
Het behoud van deze hoofdelementen achten de leden van de VVD-fractie een goede zaak.
Asks how the Staatscommissie's view on Tweede Kamer weight squares with the government's concern about a minority in the Eerste Kamer blocking amendments.
The CDA members ask the government to further justify why it is desirable for a constitutional amendment to proceed when a majority of the Eerste Kamer opposes it.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nader te onderbouwen, waarom het wenselijk is dat een grondwetswijziging doorgang vindt, waar een meerderheid van de Eerste Kamer tegen stemt.

Supports shifting weight to the directly elected Tweede Kamer, sees the indirectly elected Eerste Kamer as lacking representativeness, and asks about alternatives such as Tweede Kamer-only second reading.

These members consider it right that the bill shifts the balance between Tweede and Eerste Kamer members, so the centre of gravity in amending the Constitution will likely move towards the directly and freshly elected Tweede Kamer.

Deze leden achten het juist dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de balans tussen Tweede en Eerste Kamerleden verschuift, waardoor het zwaartepunt bij het wijzigen van de Grondwet in de praktijk waarschijnlijk meer bij de direct en hernieuwd gekozen Tweede Kamer komt te liggen.
Asks for the reasons and empirical basis for the change, the Kingdom-level implications under the Statute, and how the roles of both chambers are safeguarded.
What exactly is the reason the government considers the current procedure problematic?
Wat is precies de reden waarom de regering de huidige behandelingswijze problematisch acht?
Acknowledges the current procedure is cumbersome and asks how the bill relates to other Eerste Kamer reform bills and to the Raad van State's call for further justification.
They also ask for a reflection on the advice of the Council of State, which requests further justification for this bill.
Tevens vragen zij om een beschouwing over het advies van de Raad van State, die vraagt om een nadere onderbouwing van dit wetsvoorstel.
Supports keeping a second reading and the two-thirds majority so that constitutional changes are not dependent on a single political majority, and asks for historical data on rejected amendments.
Such often far-reaching legislative changes require careful deliberation that should not depend solely on a political majority at one particular moment.
Dergelijke veelal ingrijpende wetswijzigingen vergen immers een goede afweging die niet enkel afhankelijk mag zijn van een politiek meerderheid op één bepaald moment.

Asks the government to explain the value of two-reading procedure, the Eerste Kamer as chamber of reflection, and the qualified majority, and whether a minority blocking power is intrinsic to the procedure.

In particular, the ChristenUnie members ask whether it is not intrinsic to our constitutional procedure that importance is attached to a (relatively large) minority being able to block an amendment, thereby preventing a dictatorship of a modest majority.

In het bijzonder vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie of niet intrinsiek aan onze grondwetsprocedure is dat er belang wordt gehecht aan het gegeven dat een (relatief grote) minderheid een wijziging kan tegenhouden, waarmee een «dictatuur» van een bescheiden meerderheid wordt voorkomen.
Sees an inner tension between the democratic primacy of the Tweede Kamer and the role of the Eerste Kamer, questions the legal basis and role of the joint session, and doubts the justification given.

Setting aside the question of the necessity of the bill, these members perceive an inner tension in the bill regarding the democratic primacy of the Tweede Kamer and its position in the second reading.

Nog afgezien van de vraag naar de noodzaak van het wetsvoorstel menen deze leden een innerlijke spanning in het wetsvoorstel op te merken als het gaat om het democratisch primaat van de Tweede Kamer en de bijbehorende positie van deze Kamer in de tweede lezing.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises against changing the constitutional amendment procedure so that the second reading is handled in joint session, unless necessity and added value are convincingly justified, and raises concerns about related constitutional provisions and a co-occurrence clause. The government's reply accepts that the change is constitutionally possible, expands the justification, aligns article 138 with the joint-session approach, and revises the transitional provision, though it does not substantially alter the core proposal.
concerns: The Council questions whether shifting the balance between the Tweede Kamer and Eerste Kamer in second reading is adequately justified given the Eerste Kamer's role as a chamber of reconsideration.
The Council argues the explanatory memorandum fails to show why the balance in the amendment procedure must be reconsidered and does not sufficiently weigh alternatives.

The Council finds that a joint-session second reading does not clearly meet the 1983 criterion that the subject must be such that divergent chamber decisions would be undesirable, and that the constitutional fit needs fuller reasoning.
The Council asks that related amendment provisions (article 91(3) and 138(1)(a)) be addressed, and the government extended article 138 to joint-session treatment accordingly.

The Council finds the co-occurrence provisions in the additional article IV and article IV complex and hard to understand, and the government added a fourth paragraph clarifying when the additional article applies.

The Council notes the connection with other pending proposals affecting the Eerste Kamer, such as its election method and a possible return power, which the explanatory memorandum does not discuss in depth; the government refers to a separate reply.

35542.s: This is a supplementary budget bill that amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, changing appropriations for employment, social assistance, childcare and other items by roughly 2.5 billion euros in commitments and expenditure. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the act effective from 31 August 2020 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
