35551.s: The bill amends the Dutch Burial and Cremation Act to allow electronic transmission of death notifications, reports and cause-of-death statements to municipal coroners, regional review committees and Statistics Netherlands, and adds a burial service number to cause-of-death forms. It lets the Minister of Health prescribe electronic transmission by regulation and the Statistics Netherlands/coroner channels are subject to the general administrative law framework with some exceptions.
35551.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power to mandate electronic transmission by saying it avoids future legislative amendments once digitisation becomes widespread and affects only a limited professional group.
q: If over time the electronic route is mostly used, mandating this route can remove redundant work.
Indien op den duur merendeels de elektronische weg wordt gebruikt kan het verplichten van deze weg overbodig werk wegnemen.
d: mandatory electronic transmission of notification and report to coroner
mandatory electronic transmission of reports to regional review committees, departing from Awb 2:15(1)
mandatory electronic transmission of cause-of-death statements to Statistics Netherlands, departing from Awb 2:15(1)
Statistics Netherlands prescribes secure electronic transmission method
municipal coroner may set requirements on electronic transmission method
regional review committees designate electronic transmission method
p: Electronic transmission channels are set by administrative bodies and the Minister, with confidentiality and reliability requirements attached but limited parliamentary involvement.

parties: Asks how the minister's power to mandate digital submission by ministerial regulation would be used, when, and whether provisions would be removed if systems work well, and asks about cybersecurity and data leaks.
The bill offers the possibility that, in time, the Minister of VWS can determine by ministerial regulation that the information must be sent digitally.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt de mogelijkheid dat op termijn de Minister van VWS kan bepalen dat de verzending van de informatie wel digitaal moet plaatsvinden (ministeriële regeling).
Asks how the Chamber will be involved in assessing feasibility and necessity of mandatory electronic submission, given it would be imposed by ministerial regulation.
The CDA members ask how the Chamber will be involved in assessing feasibility and necessity, now that the obligation is to be imposed by ministerial regulation.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op welke wijze de Kamer wordt betrokken bij de beoordeling van haalbaarheid en noodzakelijkheid, nu wordt voorgesteld de verplichting op te leggen bij ministeriële regeling.
Asks when the government would consider mandating electronic submission by ministerial regulation and on what criteria, and whether the BES islands will be included.
Can the government indicate when it will consider prescribing the electronic route exclusively by ministerial regulation?
Kan de regering aangeven wanneer zij zal overwegen om bij ministeriële regeling de elektronische weg wel uitsluitend voor te schrijven?
Questions why a ban on written cause-of-death reporting should not appear in the statute itself or at least in an general administrative order (AMvB) rather than a ministerial regulation.
These members ask why such a decision should not appear in the statute itself or at least be set by general administrative order.
Deze leden vragen waarom een dergelijk besluit niet uit de wet zelf zou moeten blijken dan wel ten minste bij algemene maatregel van bestuur bepaald zou moeten worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised that the explanatory memorandum on the bill for electronic submission of cause-of-death data and Wtl euthanasia reports should address the status of ICT system connections and the financial consequences. The government's reply states the memorandum was supplemented with the status of pilot projects and clarified that the ministry funds certain interface work, and the redactional remarks were followed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to report on the status of ICT system connections between CBS, care providers, municipal coroners and RTEs, which the government supplemented.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the financial consequences for adapting ICT systems and of the support offered, which the government clarified in the memorandum.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on the transitional and combination provisions, which the government followed.

35605.s: The bill simplifies the funding basis for personnel and operating costs of primary schools and school partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) by replacing many parameters with a lump-sum system based on calendar-year funding and a new 1 February counting date, and amends the WPO, WEC, WPO BES, WVO and related laws accordingly. It introduces a transitional arrangement to cushion redistribution effects and adds powers for the Minister to grant additional funding and set rules by ministerial regulation and AMvB.
35605.j: The memorandum justifies delegations by the need for technical, flexible and detailed funding rules that can be adjusted without amending the statute.
q: Further rules implementing the first paragraph are set by or pursuant to a general administrative order.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld ter uitvoering van het eerste lid.
d: further rules implementing funding of schools and partnerships
rules for additional resources outside education funding
rules on school funding use and borrowing
annual amounts of school funding and price adjustment
conditions and amounts of extra school funding
additional funding for exceptional developments and funding ceiling
additional funding for exceptional circumstances and funding ceiling
amounts per pupil for partnership support funding
municipal physical education hours and funding
municipal council schemes for facilities of non-municipal schools
ARTIKEL I, R (art. 102 lid 1 onder i)
municipal regulation on number of pupil groups
partnership decisions on admission to special primary schools
p: The Minister sets the amounts so they meet the reasonable needs of a school in normal circumstances, with discretion over how wage developments are applied subject to the state of public finances.
The Minister may grant additional funding for exceptional developments or circumstances and may set funding ceilings, with rules largely left to ministerial regulation.
Detailed implementing rules are set by AMvB, which parliament can reject or ask to be regulated by statute within four weeks.

parties: Asks how regions and small schools adversely affected by the new funding model are protected, and how large the negative effects are.

In addition, these members ask which regions suffer adverse consequences from this funding model, how large those consequences are, and how they are being mitigated as far as possible within this bill, they ask.

Daarnaast vragen deze leden welke regio's nadelige gevolgen ondervinden door de komst van dit bekostigingsmodel, hoe groot zijn die nadelige gevolgen en op welke manier worden die effecten zoveel als mogelijk ondervangen binnen dit wetsvoorstel, zo vragen de leden.
Supports the bill in outline but asks how the Algemene Rekenkamer's point about late cost adjustments and unpredictability is addressed, and how school boards will be supported.
The aforementioned members ask how in practice the transition from moving the count date from 1 October to 1 February will work after this act takes effect.
Voornoemde leden vragen hoe in de praktijk de overgang van het verschuiven van de teldatum van 1 oktober naar 1 februari zal gaan na inwerkingtreding van deze wet.

Argues funding should go directly to schools rather than boards, questions whether the reform meets its simplification and transparency goals, and asks about the monitoring the Chamber requested on teacher age.
These members ask the government what role this monitor has played in shaping this act.
Deze leden vragen de regering welke rol deze monitor heeft gespeeld bij de vorming van deze wet.
Asks whether simplification reduces visibility over how education money is spent and accounted for, and whether spending norms or ex-post accountability will be introduced.
The aforementioned members also miss accountability afterwards.
Voornoemde leden missen ook de verantwoording achteraf.
Finds the lack of insight into board spending under lump-sum funding undesirable, cites the Algemene Rekenkamer, and asks why spending norms were not chosen.
These members find it undesirable that there is little insight into how school boards spend funding because of lump-sum financing.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het onwenselijk dat er weinig zicht is op de besteding van de bekostiging door schoolbesturen vanwege de lumpsumfinanciering.
Wants earmarking within the education budget and a stronger Inspectie, objects that the government relies on trust regarding the GGL motion, and asks whether oversight is being pushed out of view.
Does this mean that the factions that voted for the motion at the time must now simply rely on the government's trust, these members ask.
Betekent dit dat de fracties die destijds vóór de motie stemden, nu zomaar moeten afgaan op het vertrouwen van de regering, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks what the bill's effects are on the distribution of funding components.
The members of the SGP faction ask whether the government can indicate what the consequences of the bill are for the distribution of the funding components.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven wat de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel zijn voor de verdeling van de bekostigingsonderdelen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill simplifying primary school and special-needs partnership funding (vereenvoudiging bekostiging po) raises no substantive remarks and may be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister's reply notes only minor redactional and legal-technical corrections, including coordination with the Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020.
concerns: The Afdeling noted some redactional and legal-technical improvements, which the government incorporated into the bill, including arranging legal coordination with the Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020.

35614.s: The bill amends the Wet stichting administratiekantoor beheer financiële instellingen so that, for the purposes of the Algemene Rekenkamer's audit powers under the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, shares held by the administratiekantoor are treated as state-held shares. It also requires the Rekenkamer to use information available from the administratiekantoor first where possible, to safeguard the confidentiality of inside information under the EU Market Abuse Regulation, and to inform the Minister of its findings.
35614.j: The memorandum justifies the new audit powers by reference to earlier advice from the Raad van State and gaps in the Rekenkamer's powers over state-held financial institutions, and the confidentiality rules by EU market abuse law.
p: Extends the Algemene Rekenkamer's audit reach to financial institutions held through the administratiekantoor, with a proportionality requirement to use information from the administratiekantoor first.
Requires the Rekenkamer to safeguard confidentiality of inside information and to report its findings to the Minister, with a chance for the company to disclose first.

parties: Asks what legal consequences follow if the Algemene Rekenkamer holds inside information that could constrain the Minister of Finance's share-sale decisions, and how safeguards against insider knowledge are ensured.

Can the Minister of Finance freely decide on selling shares if insider knowledge exists elsewhere in the legal person the State of the Netherlands, of which the Algemene Rekenkamer forms part as a High State Body?

Kan de Minister van Financiën in vrijheid een besluit nemen over verkoop van aandelen als elders in de rechtspersoon Staat der Nederlanden – waarvan de Algemene Rekenkamer als Hoog College van Staat deel uitmaakt – voorwetenschap aanwezig is?
Asks for a clear delimitation of the new investigative powers and who determines whether their use is proportional, stressing the proportionality limit on audit-office powers.
The PVV members ask in what way and by whom it is determined when the relevant investigative powers are proportionate.](Note: translation of the question about who determines proportionality.)
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen op welke manier en door wie bepaald wordt wanneer de betreffende onderzoeksbevoegdheden proportioneel zijn.

Welcomes closing the gap in audit powers but questions why the bill took so long, whether the Algemene Rekenkamer requested such oversight since 2011, and whether the scope of audit is non-exhaustive.
These members think it good that after a long time an end is being made to the gap regarding the investigative powers of the Algemene Rekenkamer.
Deze leden vinden het goed dat na lange tijd een einde wordt gemaakt aan de lacune voor wat betreft onderzoeksbevoegdheden van de Algemene Rekenkamer.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on a bill amending the Wet NLFI so that the Algemene Rekenkamer's investigative powers over state holdings managed by NLFI include confidentiality of market-sensitive information and informing the Minister, and questions whether these matters belong in the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 instead. The government's reply accepts the remark, adds a passage on the direct applicability of the Market Abuse Regulation to the explanatory memorandum, and commits to considering the point in a future amendment of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
concerns: The Afdeling suggests a provision confirming that the Algemene Rekenkamer is bound by confidentiality duties of the directly applicable Market Abuse Regulation, and the government added explanatory text on that regulation's direct applicability.

The Afdeling advises that the scope should not be limited to NLFI holdings and that these rules should be placed in the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, which the government accepts in principle but defers to a future occasion.

35623.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Weesp and adds its territory to Amsterdam from the herindeling date of 24 March 2022, deviating from the standard 1 January date to align with the 2022 regular council elections. It also sets transitional rules for financial allocations, electoral districts, judicial and safety regions, and shared arrangements, treating the two municipalities as one for 2022 funding purposes.
35623.j: The memorandum justifies the deviating herindeling date by the wish of both municipalities to hold merger elections together with the regular 2022 council elections, and neutralises the financial effect on other municipalities.

parties: Asks whether the Weesp district committee with its own budget creates an extra governance layer and how it relates to the Amsterdam council's budget rights.
Requests that the advisory documents be attached to the explanatory memorandum and questions the claim of voluntary initiative and the claimed administrative capacity gains.

These members request the government to add the merger advice with the accompanying documents and the province's opinion as annexes to the response memorandum.](The CDA also questions the unsupported claim of voluntary initiative.)
Deze leden verzoeken de regering het herindelingsadvies met de bijbehorende documenten en de zienswijze van de provincie alsnog als bijlagen op te nemen bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag.
Asks why no referendum was held in the participating municipalities and why more administrative capacity is needed.
The SP members ask whether the question of why no referendum was held in the participating municipalities can be explained further.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of er nader kan worden ingegaan op de vraag waarom er geen referendum in de deelnemende gemeenten is gehouden.
Welcomes the careful process and the timing of the elections, and asks whether simultaneous merger elections could be held more often.
These members understand the choice to hold the merger elections on 18 March 2022, together with the national municipal council elections.
Genoemde leden hebben begrip voor de keuze om de herindelingsverkiezingen plaats te laten vinden op 18 maart 2022, tezamen met de landelijke gemeenteraadsverkiezingen.
Asks about safeguards for the open landscape, the geographic position of Diemen, and precedent effects of moving the election date.
These members ask to what extent granting the request could further strengthen precedent effects.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre het inwilligen van het verzoek die precedentwerking verder kan versterken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division issued an opinion on the bill to merge the municipalities of Amsterdam and Weesp, stating it has no remarks and advises submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer. The text includes no separate government reply beyond the minister's transmittal letter, which forwards the bill without substantive comment.

35641.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement for Kingdom Relations to add the fifth supplementary budget, mainly funding a third tranche of liquidity support for Curaçao and Aruba under the COVID-19 crisis. It makes the amended budget effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 2 November 2020.
35641.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by reference to prior notifications to parliament and the Rijksministerraad decisions on conditions for liquidity support.
q: This is done in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
Hiermee wordt gehandeld conform lid 2 van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016.

35650-IIA.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the States General (Parliament), mainly by reallocating funds within the parliamentary budget and releasing unallocated amounts. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift power away from checks on the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the States General for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35704.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by an incidental supplementary budget, mainly to fund the restoration of childcare benefit (toeslagen) arrangements, adding about 876 million euro in expenditure. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 29 January 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35722.s: The bill extends the operation of article 8, paragraphs 1 and 3, of the Wet buitengewone bevoegdheden burgerlijk gezag, which lets the Minister of Justice and Security restrict outdoor presence and set rules on it. It is the legally required bill that follows the 22 January 2021 royal decree putting that article into effect.
35722.j: The memorandum justifies the extension as a legal requirement under article 1(2) Wbbbg that parliament approve the continued operation of the emergency provisions, which it treats as a safeguard that powers are used only with the government's explicit endorsement.
q: The Wbbbg provides that articles conferring extraordinary powers on the designated authorities must not only have entered into force but also been put into effect by royal decree.

De Wbbbg kent de systematiek dat artikelen die buitengewone bevoegdheden toekennen aan de daarin aangewezen autoriteiten, niet alleen in werking getreden maar ook bij koninklijk besluit in werking gesteld moeten zijn.
d: restricting outdoor presence and setting rules on it
p: Extends for a further period the minister's emergency power to restrict people's presence in the open air, a power that otherwise lapses with the royal decree rescinding it.

parties: Asks whether Parliament should be able to approve or disapprove, afterwards, ministers' use of powers to suspend AMvB's, and whether the state-emergency law modernisation will address this.
Does the government agree that when ministers use their powers to suspend AMvBs, Parliament should be able to approve or disapprove of this afterwards?

Deelt de regering dat het in algemene zin wenselijk is dat wanneer ministers gebruik maken van hun bevoegdheden AMvB's buiten werking te stellen, de Kamer dit achteraf zou moeten kunnen goed- of afkeuren?

Doubts the government's justification for using state-emergency law (Wbbbg) instead of amending the Twm or using regional emergency ordinances, and asks what options Parliament has if it judges the conditions no longer exist.
These members have reservations about the government's reasoning on this point.
Deze leden hebben bedenkingen bij de argumentatie van de regering op dit punt.
Asks what 'onverwijld' (without delay) means given the bill was sent ten days after the curfew took effect, and how the curfew would be extended if needed.
Can the government explain what it understands by 'without delay'?
Kan de regering toelichten wat zij verstaat onder «onverwijld»?

Stresses the serious infringement of personal liberties and demands concrete facts and figures justifying necessity and proportionality; questions the choice of Wbbbg over the Twm and the lack of consultation.
This places a heavy responsibility on the government to justify the necessity of such measures with concrete facts, figures and circumstances.
Dat roept voor de regering de zware verantwoordelijkheid op aan de hand van concrete feiten, cijfers en omstandigheden de noodzaak van dergelijke maatregelen te onderbouwen.
Asks why the Twm was not used and whether the Wbbbg route, chosen under time pressure, bypasses an orderly democratic process for restricting fundamental rights.
Does the government consider the legal emergency measure now used via the Wbbbg consistent with a careful democratic process for increasingly intrusive restrictions on fundamental rights?
Acht de regering de nu gebruikte juridische noodgreep via de Wbbbg passend binnen een zorgvuldig democratisch proces van het steeds verder ingrijpen in grondrechten?
Questions proportionality given the mental-health and social harm of the curfew, asks for the balancing done beforehand, and argues the bypass of the Raad van State and Eerste Kamer is unlawful.
In these members' view this is contrary to the design of the restriction system in the Constitution and therefore unlawful.
Naar de mening van deze leden is dat in strijd met de opzet van de beperkingssystematiek uit de Grondwet en daarmee onrechtmatig.

Finds it troubling that the 1953 AMvB was fully suspended rather than amended, fearing the democratic process is circumvented; asks why no exemption for MPs and political activity and why there is no time horizon.
They fear that in this way the democratic process is too easily circumvented.
Zij vrezen dat op deze manier het democratisch proces te gemakkelijk omzeild wordt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill extending the validity of article 8 of the Wbbbg (the curfew provision), raising concerns about the chosen procedure, the outdated AMvB, the lack of exemption for MPs, and the fixed end date. The government's reply accepts the redrafting of article 1 and the removal of the fixed end date while defending its procedural choices.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the chosen procedure of debating with the Tweede Kamer before bringing the curfew into force fits the Wbbbg's emergency framework, which assumes parliamentary approval cannot await; the government defended the procedure as permissible.
The Afdeling questioned why the emergency Wbbbg was chosen over amending the Twm, and the government justified it by the lack of existing statutory basis and the slowness of emergency legislation.

The Afdeling objected to the outdated 1953 AMvB being wholly set aside without explanation, and the government explained the integral suspension was needed given enforceability and the lack of time for careful adaptation.
The Afdeling noted the absence of a general exemption for members of the Houses of Parliament, and the government replied that MPs remain able to rely on the work exemption.
The Afdeling objected to the fixed end date in the bill, since it would require restarting the Wbbbg procedure if the curfew was still needed, and the government removed the end date from article 1.

35731.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising the commitment amount for general and supplementary grants to €27.839 billion, with an incidental supplementary budget of €98.1 million for COVID-19 measures. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 January 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment to the budget of the municipal fund for 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2021

35740.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by adding extra funds for the national education programme in response to COVID-19, including for pre-school, primary, secondary and vocational education. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 22 February 2021.
q: To make up for backlogs in the short term, extra funds are being made available for additional applications.
Om op korte termijn achterstanden in te halen worden extra middelen vrijgemaakt voor aanvullende aanvragen.

35812.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by adding 56.4 million euros under the Toeslagen article to forgive private debts of childcare-benefit victims enrolled in debt-rescheduling procedures (WSNP/MSNP). It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 20 April 2021, with retroactive effect where publication occurs later.
q: Amendment of the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) (Third incidental supplementary budget on forgiveness of private debts of childcare-benefit victims in WSNP/MSNP procedures)

Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2021 (Derde incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake Kwijtschelding private schulden Toeslagengedupeerden in WSNP/MSNP-trajecten)

35830-IIA.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) by adjusting appropriations and realised figures for the parliamentary articles, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December 2020. It records budget mutations and closing differences without delegating rule-making or shifting powers.
q: The budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35902.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget schedule (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment via a third incidental supplementary budget, adjusting spending and commitment appropriations across policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 31 August 2021, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget schedule of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2021

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Socialen Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV), alle voor het jaar 2021

35920.s: The bill expands the Minister of Education's enforcement powers over school and institution governing bodies, adding a power to issue urgent directions (spoedaanwijzing) for governance failings, extending grounds for withholding funding, and allowing suspension of examination or diploma rights at non-funded vocational institutions. It also shortens the period before inspection reports are published and introduces an administrative fine for unauthorised offering of vocational training.
35920.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new urgent powers by the need to prevent serious harm to pupils and students faster than the existing instruments allow, and points to safeguards such as subsidiarity, proportionality and appeal to the courts.
q: That these are not purely theoretical situations is also shown by supervisory practice: there are known cases of failing governance combined with seriously deficient educational quality.
Dat het hier niet gaat om louter theoretische situaties blijkt ook de toezichtspraktijk: er zijn casus bekend van falend bestuur in combinatie met ernstig tekortschietende onderwijskwaliteit.
d: urgent interim measures directed at school governing body
p: Artikel 163b WPO, 145a WEC, 103g WVO, 9.1.4a WEB, 9.9a, 10.3e and 11.7a WHW, 128 WPO BES, 183 WVO BES
The Minister may order governing bodies to take measures when a broadened list of mismanagement grounds, including security and civic-education failings, is met after an inspection report.
Artikel 163b1 WPO and similar spoedaanwijzing provisions
Urgent directions can be issued with a short procedure and a validity of at most six months, bypassing the regular process where urgency is found.
The Minister may suspend examination or diploma rights of non-funded vocational institutions for up to six months where the value of diplomas is at risk.
Inspection reports underlying urgent directions are published the day after the directive is issued, shortening the standard publication period.

parties: Asks how long a school board has after an inspectorate talk, how the Minister's urgent-instruction powers are bounded in time, and whether the threshold of objective facts is met.
How much time does a board get after such a conversation with the inspectorate to actually take action?
Hoeveel tijd krijgt een bestuur na een dergelijk gesprek met de inspectie om daadwerkelijk tot actie over te gaan?
Asks how a 'serious suspicion' of mismanagement is defined and questions the lack of legality safeguards and specification of measures the Council of State flagged.
Can the government explain how it defines 'a serious suspicion of mismanagement'?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe zij «een ernstig vermoeden bij wanbeheer» definieert?
Asks how arbitrariness is prevented given no prior judicial review of the urgent instruction, how proportionality is tested, and how academic freedom is safeguarded.
How then can it be objectified when this instrument is or is not correctly applied, these members ask?
Hoe kan dan geobjectiveerd worden wanneer dit instrument wel of niet correct wordt toegepast, zo vragen deze leden?
Doubts that the current instruments are insufficient, questions proportionality given reliance on a few incidents, and asks how the bill affects horizontal and external supervision.
Finds the necessity unclear, notes alternatives were barely explored, and argues the expansion should prompt stronger legal protection for institutions against inspectorate reports.
The SGP members do not consider it a gain that the bill removed the duty for the Minister to motivate decisions adequately.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vinden het geen winst dat in het wetsvoorstel de plicht is geschrapt voor de Minister om deugdelijk te motiveren.
Has serious doubts about expanding the Minister's enforcement powers, does not understand why current instruments fall short, and fears targeting of Islamic schools.
The BIJ1 member has serious doubts about extending the Minister's enforcement powers over competent authorities of schools and institutions.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie heeft ernstige twijfels bij een uitbreiding van de handhavingsbevoegdheden van de Minister ten aanzien van het bevoegd gezag van scholen en instellingen.
Insists on a properly motivated problem analysis and specification of measures as the Council of State demands, and rejects the government setting aside that advice.
The BBB member therefore cannot accept that the government sets this advice aside.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie kan dan ook niet accepteren dat de regering dit advies naast zich neerlegt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the bill to expand the Minister's sanction and intervention powers over schools and institutions, citing no adequate problem analysis or evaluation of existing instruments, and advised narrowing the spoedaanwijzing, removing the civic duty and social safety grounds, and dropping the mbo social responsibility duty. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the points on the spoedaanwijzing threshold, judicial safeguards, and dropping the mbo duty, but rejected the call for an evaluation and kept the expanded grounds with narrower definitions.
concerns: The Afdeling found necessity and proportionality insufficiently shown given no adequate problem analysis or evaluation of the existing instruments, and advised against submission until this is done; the government declined to commission an evaluation.

The Afdeling argued that intrusions on school autonomy and freedom of education were summarily justified; the government added justification and narrowed the grounds but kept the expanded definition of wanbeheer.

The Afdeling argued that the regular aanwijzing should require an actual breach of statutory requirements, and the government added this condition to the spoedaanwijzing and clarified the link to legal norms.

The Afdeling advised dropping the civic duty and social safety grounds from the definition of wanbeheer because of risks to school autonomy and conflicting fundamental rights; the government kept them but narrowed them substantially.
The Afdeling advised replacing the redelijk vermoeden threshold with ernstig vermoeden for spoedaanwijzing, which the government accepted.

The Afdeling advised adding a judicial interim relief safeguard so publication of the inspection report is suspended pending a court ruling; the government adopted automatic suspension of publication upon a request for interim relief.
The Afdeling found the mbo duty to promote social responsibility unjustified as it extended beyond education and into freedom of expression and religion; the government dropped the duty.

The Afdeling argued the possible measures under an aanwijzing or spoedaanwijzing must be specified in the law or an amvb under the legality principle; the government declined, relying on flexibility and effectiveness.

The Afdeling asked for attention to the irreversible consequences of immediate publication of inspection reports, and the government moved the publication timing and clarified reversibility of measures.
The government dropped the minimum four-week comment period, relying on the general Awb rule, and made technical and linguistic amendments.

35975-I.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget of the Royal Household (begrotingsstaat van de Koning), adding 33 thousand euros in expenditure to the functional expenditures of the King and leaving receipts unchanged. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making or decision power to the executive.
q: There are no revenue changes.
Er zijn geen ontvangstenmutaties.

36028.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure (Rv) and the Caribbean Netherlands code (Rv BES) to implement the 2004 UN Convention on State Immunity for default judgments against foreign states. It requires courts to wait at least four months after service before entering default or judgment against a non-appearing foreign state, and gives foreign states four months to file objection.
36028.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural rules as implementing the UN Convention's requirements and notes that ex officio immunity review is already customary practice.
q: The deviating period for granting default and issuing a judgment against a non-appearing defendant also does not lead to additional workload.
Ook de afwijkende termijn voor het verlenen van verstek en het wijzen van een uitspraak tegen een niet verschenen verweerder leidt niet tot extra werklast.
p: Artikel I A (artikel 139 lid 2 Rv), Artikel II A, Artikel III A
Courts must verify treaty conditions and a four-month waiting period before entering default against a foreign state, which constrains judicial discretion rather than executive power.

parties: The VVD asks whether the Adviescommissie voor burgerlijk procesrecht's advice can be shared and how the government responded to the Raad van State's and the commission's advice, pressing for scrutiny of the bill's consultation.
Can the advice of the Advisory Committee on Civil Procedure Law be shared with the House?
Kan het advies van de Adviescommissie voor burgerlijk procesrecht met de Kamer worden gedeeld?

36055.s: The bill amends the Woningwet to revise the rescue (sanering) framework for approved housing associations, creating an independent advisory committee on necessary DAEB activities that advises on whether a struggling association's activities should be taken over by neighbouring associations. It also gives the Minister a new power to direct associations to continue necessary activities or merge, subject to conditions.
36055.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial direction power as a last resort needed in the general interest to secure housing provision and the viability of the rescue scheme, with proportionality criteria and appeal open against directions.
q: Objection and appeal are open against a directive or the decision on a rescue subsidy application, so that legal protection for all interested parties is guaranteed.

Tegen het geven van een aanwijzing of het besluit op de aanvraag om saneringssubsidie staat bezwaar en (hoger) beroep open, zodat langs die weg de rechtsbescherming voor alle belanghebbenden gewaarborgd is.
d: rules on organisation, working method and remuneration of the advisory committee
further rules on the situation of an association not fully meeting financial continuity norms
further rules on application of the ministerial direction power
p: Gives the Minister a new power to direct a housing association to take over necessary activities or merge with a distressed association, restricting property and association autonomy, bounded by conditions and a consultation requirement.
Voids contractual or security restrictions on pledges over assets of associations linked to DAEB work, limiting private contractual protections.
Creates an independent advisory committee whose advice is authoritative in rescue applications, while the Minister may depart from it with reasons.

parties: Asks how the separation between the advisory committee's advice and the associations' recovery plan will work in practice and be safeguarded.
Can the government explain how this distinction will work in practice and how it will be safeguarded?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe dit onderscheid er in de praktijk uit gaat zien en hoe dit onderscheid wordt gewaarborgd?
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
They have no questions or comments.
Zij hebben geen vragen of opmerkingen.
Questions why the 2015 framework was kept unchanged, asks for wider rescue support, and asks whether cross-regional help is possible if regional associations are too weak.
These members ask whether it is not in fact necessary that cross-regional help can be provided.
Deze leden vragen of het juist niet noodzakelijk is dat regio-overstijgend hulp kan worden geboden.
Asks how the ministerial instruction power fits the private character of associations and whether it could be used to impose a European procurement obligation.
Can the government rule out that the instruction power will be cited as an argument to make the procurement obligation applicable to housing associations after all?
Kan de regering uitsluiten dat de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid aangehaald zal worden als argument om de aanbestedingsplicht alsnog van toepassing te laten zijn voor woningcorporaties?
Asks whether the minister must obtain advice before issuing an instruction and what say the taking-over association has in the process.
Is it correct that also in the case of an instruction the board first asks for advice and only then an instruction can be given?
Klopt het dat ook in het geval van een aanwijzing het bestuur eerst om een advies vraagt en dat daarna pas een aanwijzing kan worden gegeven?

Criticises market-driven incentives and the financial pressure from government policy, arguing the framework weakens associations' social housing role and calling for public housing without market logic.
To what extent is this cause of financial pressure taken into account in the position?
In hoeverre wordt deze oorzaak van financiële druk meegenomen in de zienswijze?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill amending the Housing Act (Woningwet) to adjust the remediation framework, recommending it be submitted to parliament with only redactional remarks. The minister's reply adopts the suggested renaming of the advisory committee and clarifies the scope of the restriction on security rights over DAEB housing held by housing associations.
concerns: The advisory division suggested a redactional improvement to the name of the newly established advisory committee, which the minister adopted.

36064.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (second incidental supplementary budget), adjusting spending and commitments in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 18 March 2022 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36073.s: The bill removes provisions on data reporting services providers from the Dutch Wft and the Wet op de economische delicten, because these rules now sit directly in the EU MiFIR regulation and supervision moves largely to ESMA. It also adjusts related cross-references and gives the AFM and the Minister of Finance a consistent framework for the remaining national supervisory role.
36073.j: The memorandum justifies removing the national provisions by pointing to the directly applicable MiFIR regulation and the transfer of supervision to ESMA, with an implementing decree to adjust lower regulation.
q: Because the rules on data reporting service providers that are removed from the directive are now contained in the directly applicable MiFIR regulation, no gap has arisen in the regulatory framework for those firms.

Omdat de regels omtrent datarapporteringsdienstverleners die in de richtlijn komen te vervallen nu zijn opgenomen in de rechtstreeks werkende MiFIR-verordening is er geen lacune ontstaan in het regelgevend kader voor desbetreffende ondernemingen.
d: fit and proper requirements for data reporting service providers

parties: Asks whether a period of unclear competence arises before delegated acts are adopted, and what financial risks and guarantees exist for providers falling between supervisors.
Is it correct that this creates a period in which it is unclear which supervisor is competent?
Klopt het dat er hierdoor een periode ontstaat waarin onduidelijk is welke toezichthouder bevoegd is?

Asks for an evaluation of the effects of earlier ESFS legislation in the Netherlands, for the timing of restoring administrative fines by the AFM, and for the Dutch position on national supervisors' competence under the delegated acts.
Asks what consequences the transfer to ESMA has for the five Dutch data reporting service providers, what new powers ESMA gains, and how the Netherlands will handle the unclear period of competence.
Is it correct that until the delegated acts are adopted it is not yet clear when ESMA and when the national supervisor is competent?
Klopt het dat tot de vaststelling van de gedelegeerde handelingen het nog niet duidelijk is wanneer ESMA en wanneer de nationale toezichthouder bevoegd is?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill implementing EU Directive 2019/2177 and Regulation 2019/2175 on the European system of financial supervision, and found no remarks. The Minister of Finance transmitted the advice and a reply, with a minor redactional correction made to the transposition table in the explanatory memorandum.

36082.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science through the sixth supplementary budget, covering culture, school ventilation and the National Education Programme. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 20 April 2022.

36091.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Defence by adding supplementary appropriations, with changes in obligations, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect on 1 May 2022 and may apply retroactively if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2022

36136.s: The bill anchors the 'leeruitkomsten' (learning outcomes) experiment in the Higher Education and Scientific Research Act, allowing part-time and dual programmes in higher education to be built from learning-outcome units rather than fixed courses, and lets institutions deviate from certain statutory rules such as the propaedeutic phase for such programmes. It also requires individual study plans per student and extends the same flexibility to universities, plus an evaluation report within five years.
36136.j: The memorandum justifies the new institutional discretion by the experiment's positive results on enrolment and stakeholder satisfaction, and by the need for flexible education tailored to students' circumstances.
q: This bill therefore provides that the institutional board of a higher vocational bachelor programme consisting entirely of a coherent set of learning-outcome units may choose not to set up a propaedeutic phase.

Dit wetsvoorstel regelt daarom dat het instellingsbestuur van een hbo-bacheloropleiding die volledig bestaat uit een samenhangend geheel van eenheden van leeruitkomsten ervoor kan kiezen om geen propedeutische fase in te stellen.
d: Artikel I, E (artikel 7.13 WHW, OER content)
content of institutional examination regulations for learning-outcome programmes
Artikel I, D (artikel 7.8 WHW, propaedeutic phase)
institutional board may choose not to set up a propaedeutic phase
p: Institutional boards gain discretion to omit the statutory propaedeutic phase in higher vocational bachelor programmes built entirely from learning-outcome units.
Institutions set individual study plans in consultation with students, with minimal statutory content requirements and a flexible, non-statutory format.

parties: Asks why full-time hbo is excluded and whether students should decide the study form themselves; supportive of flexibility if final-level testing is sound.

The members favour education that offers students flexibility and the option to deviate from the traditional path with fixed course components, provided it is clear that the final level can be tested in a sound way.

De leden zijn voorstander van onderwijs dat de student flexibiliteit biedt en daarnaast de mogelijkheid biedt van het traditionele pad met vaste onderwijsonderdelen af te wijken, mits duidelijk is dat het eindniveau op een degelijke manier getoetst kan worden.
Sees opportunities in flexibilisation but stresses student guidance, clear communication and the binding study advice; asks about participation rights for student councils.
What options does the government see to stimulate and safeguard student guidance, clear communication to students and the studyability of programmes?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om de studentbegeleiding, heldere communicatie richting studenten en studeerbaarheid van opleidingen te stimuleren en te borgen?
Supports embedding learning outcomes for working students; questions why universities were added and whether lack of experience poses a risk.
They see the importance of flexibilisation of higher education and support anchoring units of learning outcomes in law.
Zij zien het belang van flexibilsering van het hoger onderwijs en zijn voorstander van het verankeren van eenheden van leeruitkomsten in de wet.
Worries about curriculum coherence and basic knowledge in flexible tracks, asks to await the final evaluation, and wants programme committees to have consent rights rather than advisory rights.
The members ask the government to wait with this bill until after the final evaluation.
De leden vragen de regering om te wachten met deze wet tot na de eindevaluatie.
Doubts about extending to full-time and university programmes, the heavy load on examination boards, and programme committees having only advisory rights over the study plan.
Can the government explain in more detail the considerations underlying this?
Kan de regering nader toelichten welke overwegingen hieraan ten grondslag liggen?
Calls the embedding premature without an adequate final evaluation, criticises the Council of State's warnings, and questions weak student protection under study agreements and university extension.
These members would like the government first to investigate how the experiment works out for university students and the workload in academic education.
Deze leden zien graag dat de regering eerst onderzoekt hoe het experiment zich uitpakt voor universitaire studenten en de werkdruk in het wetenschappelijk onderwijs.
Asks why the final evaluation was not awaited, and raises the socialising function of education and the risk of reduced teacher-student bonding.
The members ask the government why it did not await the actual final evaluation.
De leden vragen de regering waarom zij niet de daadwerkelijke eindevaluatie heeft afgewacht.
Asks for clearer definitions of learning outcomes versus course units and assurance that outcomes are the same regardless of route; wants clarity on the purpose of the bill.
With a view to safeguarding quality, they consider it important that learning results are achieved in all cases, regardless of the learning route.
Met het oog op het borgen van de kwaliteit vinden zij het van belang dat de leerresultaten in alle gevallen worden bereikt, ongeacht de leerweg.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against enacting the Wet leeruitkomsten hoger onderwijs as drafted, since the experiment was evaluated too early and its extension to full-time higher vocational and academic education and to incomplete programmes raises quality-assurance and feasibility concerns, advising limiting the bill to part-time and dual vocational education. The government's nader rapport largely disagrees on the evaluation and scope, keeps full-time and academic extension in the bill, and adds clarifications and commitments on quality assurance, accreditation protocols and costs.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that the blurring of the 'opleiding' concept and the hybrid nature of leeruitkomsten create legal and definitional uncertainty in the WHW, which the government addresses by clarifying the explanatory memorandum without changing the core concept.
The Afdeling considers the experiment evaluated prematurely so that permanent embedding is premature, while the government maintains that the evaluation provides sufficient basis for enactment.

The Afdeling advises against extending the experiment powers to full-time vocational and academic education because leerwegonafhankelijk education may not suit all students, which the government rejects by keeping the extension in the bill.

The Afdeling finds no justification for permanently allowing incomplete programmes given the experiment showed no effect, and the government retains the option citing shortages of teachers and quality safeguards.
The Afdeling asks for insight into transition costs, teacher workload and financing, which the government addresses by clarifying the costs in the memorandum while arguing existing budgets suffice.

The Afdeling asks that the examencommissie's role in supervising leerwegonafhankelijke assessment be explained, which the government addresses by stating its powers are unchanged and that it may issue richtlijnen.

36154.s: The bill lets pension holders who choose a lump-sum partial buy-out of their old-age pension defer the payment to the January after they reach the AOW pension age, with a settlement to the estate if they die in between. It also amends the Wft, the Income Tax Act 2001, and the Wage Tax Act 1964 to make this lump-sum option administratively workable.
36154.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as improving the workability and explainability of the lump-sum option and gives no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas it is desirable to revise the possibility of partial buy-out of old-age pension as a lump sum in order to make it more feasible to implement and easier to explain.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is om de mogelijkheid tot gedeeltelijke afkoop van ouderdomspensioen in de vorm van een bedrag ineens te herzien om deze beter uitvoerbaar en uitlegbaar te maken

parties: Asks whether the narrowed deferral group is disadvantaged and whether the entry-into-force date is feasible for pension administrators; questions how the constitutional two-thirds requirement for politicians' allowances applies.
Can the government clarify the size of the group for whom the scheme is no longer accessible as a result of this change?
Kan de regering duidelijkheid scheppen over de omvang van de groep voor wie de regeling als gevolg van deze wijziging niet langer toegankelijk is?
Asks about interaction with the Wtp, informing participants, complaint routes (Ombudsman Pensioenen, the planned complaints institute) and AFM supervision of communication.

Given the planned complaints and disputes institute in the Wtp alongside the existing Ombudsman Pensioenen, these members ask where participants should go if they disagree with the calculation of the lump sum.

Met het oog op de introductie van een klachten- en geschilleninstituut in de Wtp, naast de Ombudsman Pensioenen die al bestaat, vragen deze leden waar deelnemers naartoe moeten gaan als zij het oneens zijn met (de berekening van) het bedrag ineens.
Argues the 1 July 2023 date is too tight for implementation and asks for safeguards against tax back-assessments and benefit losses for the lowest incomes.
Are there other safeguards that could be introduced within tax rules, such as not counting the one-off payment in the toetsvermogen for benefit assessment?
Zijn er bijvoorbeeld andere waarborgen die kunnen worden geïntroduceerd binnen de fiscale regelgeving (zoals de eenmalige uitkering niet meetellen in het toetsvermogen)?
Objects that the lump sum is not paid if a retiree dies shortly after retirement, calls for thorough personal information, and asks for compensation for the reduced pension.
After a lifetime of hard work, a person should at least be able to leave something to surviving relatives and loved ones if they die shortly after retirement.

Na een leven lang hard werken zou iemand toch op zijn minst de mogelijkheid moeten hebben om de nabestaanden en geliefden iets achter te laten in het vreselijke geval dat iemand kort na pensionering komt te overlijden.
Questions the unequal treatment of workers in heavy physical jobs who face higher AOW premium burdens and asks for compensation options.
Does the government agree with these members that people who have worked in heavy physical jobs their whole lives should be protected rather than disadvantaged?
Is de regering het eens met deze leden dat mensen die hun hele leven een zwaar fysiek beroep hebben uitgeoefend juist beschermd in plaats van benadeeld moeten worden?
Shares the PvdA concern about unequal tax burden for heavy-job workers and asks about implementation effects together with Wtp invaren.
Does the government agree with these members that people who have worked in heavy physical jobs their whole lives should be protected rather than disadvantaged?
Is de regering het eens met deze leden dat mensen die hun hele leven een zwaar fysiek beroep hebben uitgeoefend juist beschermd in plaats van benadeeld moeten worden?
Warns that narrowing the group may undermine the law's purpose and that participants will often pay more tax and lose benefits, asking how they are informed and who is responsible.

Calls the legislative process sloppy, says the explanatory memorandum omits net-outcome and legal-consistency assessments, and asks for a revised memorandum and amendments exempting the lump sum from huurtoeslag.
The member Omtzigt therefore asks the government to write a new explanatory memorandum that presents an honest picture of the consequences.
Daarom verzoekt het lid Omtzigt de regering een nieuwe memorie van toelichting te schrijven, waarin gewoon een eerlijk beeld geschetst wordt van de gevolgen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet herziening bedrag ineens, raising no substantive objections but giving two drafting remarks on the postponement request wording and the inheritance payment provisions. The minister's reply accepts both remarks, adds clarifications and a technical amendment to the Wet op de loonbelasting, and sets the entry-into-force date at 1 July 2023.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to clarify that the postponement request must be made before the old-age pension start date, which the government added to the articles.
The Afdeling asked to align the statutory text on a one-off payment to joint heirs with the explanatory notes, which the government corrected to refer to the estate of the pensioner or consumer.

36163.s: The bill adds a paragraph to Book 7 of the Civil Code so that, in consumer sales of live animals, a defect appearing within six months of delivery is presumed to have existed at delivery, reversing the burden of proof unless the seller shows otherwise. It also sets transitional rules for contracts concluded before entry into force and preserves the consumer authority's enforcement powers for pre-entry violations.
36163.j: The memorandum justifies the reversed burden of proof by the difficulty consumers face proving a defect existed at delivery, and the delegated entry-into-force date is justified by the need for speed before the summer recess.
q: The reversal period for the burden of proof concerns consumers' evidential position against the seller in legal proceedings, not a substantive right to which a consumer is entitled.

Het gaat bij de termijn van omkering van de bewijslast om de bewijspositie van consumenten jegens de verkoper tijdens een juridische procedure en niet om een materieel recht waarop een consument aanspraak heeft.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether relevant parties were adequately consulted on the transitional arrangement and how foreign regimes compare.
Were the relevant parties in practice adequately involved in drawing up the proposed transitional arrangement?
Zijn de relevante partijen in de praktijk adequaat betrokken geweest bij de totstandkoming van de voorgestelde overgangsregeling?
Questions why consumer legal protection is reduced for living animals and why the six-month period is justified when the government previously kept one uniform term.
Why does the government cut into consumer legal protection in favour of sellers?
Waarom snijdt de regering in de rechtsbescherming van consumenten ten gunste van verkopers?
Argues a six-month period is too short because hereditary defects often appear later, harming consumer protection and animal welfare, and asks about the lack of consultation.
Does the government share the view that shortening the reversal period from one year to six months will in practice mean many defects only manifest after the six-month period has expired?

Deelt de regering de mening dat een verkorting van de termijn voor de omkering van de bewijslast van een jaar naar een half jaar in de praktijk zal betekenen dat veel gebreken zich pas zullen manifesteren nadat de termijn van een half jaar verstreken is?
Shares concerns that a shorter reversal period weakens consumer protection and welfare safeguards and asks why no consultation was held with KNMvD or LID.
These members are of the view that the comparison between living animals and other goods does not hold.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de vergelijking tussen levende dieren en «andere goederen» niet opgaat.
Supports implementing the motion and amendment and has no need for further questions.
The aforementioned members endorse the implementation of the motion, which elaborates the amendment by Ellian (VVD) that these members supported.
voornoemde leden onderschrijven de uitvoering van de motie, welke een uitwerking is van het door deze leden gesteunde amendement van het lid Ellian (VVD)

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill shortening the burden-of-proof reversal period for consumer sales of live animals from one year to six months needs its own reasoning on necessity and a justified transitional rule with immediate effect that disadvantages consumers. The government's reply added a standalone justification and motivated the immediate effect, though it kept the retroactive-style transition for contracts since 27 April 2022.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum relied only on parliamentary debate outcomes and did not independently justify necessity; the government added a standalone reasoning section on necessity and the balance between buyer and seller.

Immediate effect of the shorter period disadvantages consumers already in contracts since 27 April 2022; the government acknowledged this but retained immediate effect to avoid two transitional regimes.
The reference to general transitional principles for presumptions in the Civil Code was clarified to cover all presumptions rather than only consumer ones.

36172.s: The bill adds duties for directors of legal entities dissolved without assets to file a balance sheet and explanation with the registers within fourteen days and to notify creditors, and allows the court on prosecutors' request to impose a directors' ban where creditors go unpaid. It also gives creditors a conditional right to inspect the entity's records and extends existing ban grounds, with the changes temporary and an evaluation required before any permanent introduction.
36172.j: The memorandum justifies the new duties and ban by the growth of dissolutions without assets and the risk of misuse harming creditors and trade.
q: This bill does not intend to enter into any doctrine of distribution.
Dit wetsvoorstel beoogt niet in enig verdelingsleerstuk te treden.
p: A court may impose a directors' ban on prosecutors' request, with the court weighing the circumstances, which expands judicial discretion against private individuals rather than the executive.

parties: Asks whether creditor legal protection is guaranteed and whether the temporary nature and lack of private enforcement options leave gaps, and asks what oversight and control can be intensified.
Asks about interim and structural evaluations of the two-year law and what creditors can do to contest incomplete filings.
They ask the government whether interim evaluations take place during these two years.
Zij vragen de regering of er in deze twee jaar ook tussentijdse evaluaties plaatsvinden.
Asks about the scale of abuse and whether the disclosure duty for entities without debts creates an unnecessarily high threshold.
Does the government have insight into the extent of the abuse currently occurring?
Heeft de regering zicht op de omvang van het misbruik dat zich nu voordoet?

Argues the law is a toothless tiger without independent control of filed documents, proposes a curator role, asks for a single offence to trigger a director ban and for individual creditors to be able to request one, and questions the transitional rule.

Questions why the law is temporary rather than permanent, notes the Council for Regulatory Pressure advised against it, and asks why individual creditors should not also be able to seek a director ban.
These members recall that the temporary nature of the proposal even led the ATR to advise against submitting it.
Voornoemde leden brengen in herinnering dat de tijdelijkheid van het voorstel het ATR er zelfs toe bracht te adviseren voorliggend voorstel niet in te dienen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Temporary Act on transparency for turboliquidation, raising concerns about the limited private enforcement options for creditors, the temporary nature of a structural problem, and the lack of a separate section on higher law. The government's reply accepted the temporary-nature and higher-law remarks in part and explained why it did not add private enforcement mechanisms, deferring that question to the evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of the public enforcement route and advises exploring additional private enforcement options for creditors, which the government declined to introduce for now.
The Afdeling advises clearly separating the structural need for reform from the temporary COVID-19 justification, and the government adjusted the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling advises adding a separate section on the relationship with higher law (freedom of enterprise, data protection under the GDPR), which the government added in paragraph 4.

36181.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security, through a fifth incidental supplementary budget for medical care for displaced persons from Ukraine. It sets the budget unit as thousands of euros and fixes entry into force at 1 July 2022, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

36190.s: The bill amends the Huisvestingswet 2014 to strengthen municipalities' housing allocation powers, including priority for vital occupational groups, mandatory permits for sale-housing resale and livability-based stock management, and a provincial advisory role on housing ordinances. It also makes technical amendments and requires a report to parliament within five years.
36190.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by housing scarcity and the need to keep vital professions in local communities, and requires municipalities to substantiate measures in ordinances and housing visions.
q: To allow occupational groups vital to the (local and regional) community to be given priority in granting a housing permit, article 14 is amended so that the municipal council can give priority to vital occupations.
Om beroepsgroepen met een vitaal belang voor de (lokale en regionale) samenleving voorrang te kunnen geven bij het verlenen van een huisvestingsvergunning wordt artikel 14 zodanig gewijzigd
d: municipal housing ordinance criteria and provincial advice
municipal priority for vital occupational groups in housing ordinance
municipal designation of forms of letting requiring permit
municipal designation of sale-housing subject to permit
p: Municipalities may give priority in housing permits to vital occupational groups, narrowing access for other applicants, subject to justification in the ordinance and provincial advice.
Municipalities may require housing permits for resale of sale-housing below the NHG cost limit.
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 11c) and onderdeel L/R
Municipalities gain wider powers over conversion and letting permits, with requirements to justify measures in the housing vision.
Provinces receive a mandatory advisory role on municipal housing ordinances, though the municipal council may depart from the advice with reasons.

parties: Asks how the 50% local-binding allocation is regulated, controlled and made transparent, and whether administrative burdens of the maatschappelijke binding definition can be reduced.
These members ask the government how the 50% allocation to the local population is arranged and monitored in practice.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe de 50% toewijzing aan de lokale bevolking in de praktijk wordt geregeld en gecontroleerd.
Questions why the 50% cap was chosen without awaiting evaluation of the earlier 30% step, and whether freedom of movement and settlement is unduly restricted.
Does the government agree that the amendment must avoid restricting people's freedom too much?
Deelt de regering de mening dat moet worden voorkomen dat de wijzing van de wet de vrijheid van mensen te veel inperkt?
Asks how legal protection and appeal work when a housing corporation takes over the municipality's urgency allocation under delegation.
How is this arranged when the housing corporation steps in place of the municipality?
Hoe is dit geregeld als de corporatie «in de plaats van de gemeente treedt»?
Asks whether the broad power to define vital occupations and to require permits for social owner-occupied homes leaves too much discretion to municipalities and affects property sale.
Does the current amendment not give municipalities too much scope to determine in detail which occupations they want in their municipalities?
Geeft de huidige wetswijziging gemeenten niet te veel mogelijkheid om tot op detail niveau te bepalen welke beroepen zij in hun gemeenten willen hebben?

Argues the measures may disadvantage homeless people, people with disabilities and those with binding to the region outside the municipality, and questions whether the impact has been adequately analysed.
Large groups of housing seekers are, through this bill, denied access or at least strongly hindered in municipalities where this rule is introduced.
Grote groepen woningzoekenden worden door dit wetsvoorstel in gemeenten waar deze regel wordt ingevoerd de toegang tot de gemeente ontzegd of in elk geval sterk bemoeilijkt.

Supports the opkoopbescherming and vital-occupation priority but asks whether the Rijk should define vital occupations to prevent arbitrariness and whether provinces need stronger enforcement power over municipal housing visions.
These members ask whether it would not be wiser for the national government to define vital occupations to prevent arbitrariness.
Deze leden vragen zich af of het niet verstandiger is om het Rijk te laten bepalen wat vitale beroepen zijn om willekeur te voorkomen.
Criticises counting urgency categories within the 50% cap, the one-size NHG price limit, and the added provincial advice requirement as bureaucratic, and asks for regional flexibility.
These members therefore prefer that urgencies not count within the room for local customisation.
Deze leden zien daarom graag dat urgenties niet meetellen binnen de ruimte voor lokaal maatwerk.

Welcomes the reform as necessary but asks whether municipal discretion in defining vital occupations may create inequality, willingness-based abuse such as job-hopping, and a larger infringement of freedom of settlement.
These members ask whether this criterion will not lead to differences between municipalities and thus legal inequality.
Deze leden vragen zich af of deze aanmerking niet tot verschillen tussen gemeenten en daarmee rechtsongelijkheid zal gaan leiden.

Warns that the bill restricts fundamental rights on equal treatment and property, questions the Raad van State's concerns being brushed aside, and fears the bill opens the way to further state intrusion on ownership.
Asks how the government addressed the Raad van State's criticism and objections, which the explanatory note says were met only by supplementing the explanation.
Can the government explain more generally how it has responded to the questions and objections of the Raad van State?
Kan de regering meer algemeen toelichten hoe tegemoet is gekomen aan de vragen en bezwaren van de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Council of State's Advisory Division advised on the draft amendment to the Housing Act 2014 (post-evaluation), raising concerns about the problem analysis, justification of the extended local-binding priority and priority for professional groups under freedom of movement and settlement, the proportionality of extending the allocation regime to social owner-occupied homes (property rights, price-raising effects, private-law consequences, supervision), and EU-law, cost and drafting issues. The minister's reply (nader rapport) accepts nearly all points, amending the explanatory memorandum and the bill (e.g. clarifying the advice role of provinces and the scope of the professional-group priority), though some points are addressed only by clarification or deferred to the Omgevingswet.
concerns: The Advisory Division found the justification and proportionality of restricting freedom of settlement via expanded local-binding priority insufficiently argued, and the government added reasoning in the explanatory memorandum.

The extension of the allocation regime to social owner-occupied homes restricts property rights (Article 1 First Protocol ECHR) and the justification lacked a fair balance analysis, which the government supplemented.

The problem analysis was thin and did not address the wider housing crisis or possible price-raising effects of the NHG-linked social owner-occupation rule; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum but the analysis remains largely referential to the evaluation.
The explanatory memorandum omitted free movement of capital and services and EU equal-treatment rules; the government extended the EU-law section accordingly.

Unclear status of the provincial input (advice versus zienswijze), inconsistent scope of the professional-group priority, unclear time scope of the housing-stock management requirement, and the absence of a co-application provision with the Omgevingswet were pointed out and largely addressed in the bill and memorandum.

Enforcement, supervision, administrative burden and private-law consequences of the owner-occupation rule were insufficiently addressed; the government supplemented these, though the co-application issue was deferred to the Omgevingswet.

36200-III.s: This bill fixes the 2023 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket advice on the 2023 budget bills for the Ministry of General Affairs, the King's Cabinet and the Intelligence Oversight Commission, raising no remarks and advising submission to parliament. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets need amendment and refers to annexed changes.

36208.s: The bill abolishes the income support for AOW pensioners (IOAOW) in the General Old Age Act and related laws, offsetting this through a higher AOW benefit. It temporarily raises the child-related budget in 2023 and then phases down its amounts in steps from 2024 to 2028.
36208.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing the IOAOW by stating that the higher AOW benefit fully compensates for its loss, so a separate income support is no longer needed.
q: Because a special increase of the minimum wage, and thereby of the AOW benefit, is provided by general administrative order, which exceeds the income loss from abolishing the IOAOW, the abolition of the IOAOW is fully compensated.

Doordat – zoals hiervoor aangegeven – bij algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt voorzien in een bijzondere verhoging van het minimumloon en daarmee ook van de AOW-uitkering, die groter is dan de inkomensachteruitgang ten gevolge van de afschaffing van de IOAOW, wordt de afschaffing van de IOAOW volledig gecompenseerd.

parties: Asks the government to explain the urgency of reforming the allowance system and the timing of the IOAOW abolition, which is not fixed in the bill text.
Why is the date of 1 January 2025 not fixed in the bill?
Waarom wordt de datum van 1 januari 2025 niet vastgelegd in het wetsvoorstel?
Supports targeted support for vulnerable groups and the phased pension path, but asks about long-term affordability of the AOW and instruments for pensioners' purchasing power.
The members do ask for the government's view on the long-term affordability of the AOW.
Wel vragen de leden naar het beeld van de regering over de betaalbaarheid van de AOW op langere termijn.
Asks for the government's explanation of the 8.05 percent AOW increase and the net gain for AOW recipients.
Can the government explain why the explanatory memorandum refers to an 8.05 percent rise from 1 January 2023 rather than ten percent?
Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven waarom er in de memorie van toelichting wordt gesproken over een stijging van 8,05 procent per 1 januari 2023 en niet van tien procent?
Welcomes the higher child benefit for large families and asks about households losing entitlement and net income effects of the IOAOW abolition.
These members ask whether there is also a group of households that loses entitlement to the child benefit as a result of a higher statutory minimum wage.
Deze leden vragen of er ook een groep huishoudens is die minder recht op kgb heeft als gevolg van een hoger wettelijk minimumloon.

Questions the temporary nature of the child-benefit increase, the tax authority and SVB implementation risks, and the recovery of benefits that could resemble the childcare-benefits scandal; presses for more government reflection on recovery and error-proneness.

The GroenLinks and PvdA members also ask whether the government can make efforts to prevent recoveries."}, De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie en PvdA-fractie vragen daarnaast of de regering zich kan inspannen om terugvorderingen tegen te gaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division asked the government to explain in the explanatory memorandum why the IOAOW abolition is phased (reduced in 2023-2024 and abolished in 2025 by royal decree) rather than abolished with the AOW increase on 1 January 2023, and why the timing is left to a royal decree. The government's reply defends the phased approach on distributional and koopkracht grounds, adds explanation to paragraph 2.2, and revises the entry-into-force provision.
