concerns: The Afdeling asked that the timing of the IOAOW abolition, including its phasing and the entry-into-force by royal decree, be clarified in the explanatory memorandum and the bill adjusted where necessary.
The entry-into-force provision was reworded to make clear that entry into force by royal decree is the starting point.

36217.s: The bill extends the mayor's and the island governor's power to close a dwelling, a non-public premises or its land when public order is disturbed or threatened by serious violence or the finding of a weapon, and adds the matching power for landlords to dissolve tenancies out of court and for expropriation. It also aligns the Civil Code and Expropriation Act provisions and extends the closure power to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
36217.j: The memorandum justifies the new closure power by the inadequacy of existing powers after shootings and weapon finds and by the need for a specific statutory basis under Article 10 of the Constitution.
q: It is further desirable to introduce a specific statutory power that makes it possible to close a dwelling where public order in the surroundings is disturbed or seriously feared to be disturbed when a weapon is found there.

Het is verder wenselijk een specifieke wettelijke bevoegdheid te introduceren die het mogelijk maakt om een woning te sluiten in geval de openbare orde in de omgeving wordt verstoord of daarvoor ernstige vrees bestaat wanneer daar een wapen wordt aangetroffen.
d: mayor's power to close dwelling or premises for public order
p: Mayor gains a specific statutory power to close homes and premises after serious violence, threats or weapon finds, reducing residents' protection of their home.
Island governors of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba receive the same closure power over homes and premises.
Landlords may dissolve tenancies out of court after closures on the new grounds, with the civil judge able to review fair use of that power.
Expropriation becomes possible after closure on the extended grounds where use or management measures fail to restore public order.

parties: Asks how mayors can be supported and whether a request to waive the grace period for b- and c-grounds should be reconsidered, while stressing the need for strong instruments.
Can the government explain this decision further?
Kan de regering dit besluit nader toelichten?
Worries that broad discretionary powers restrict fundamental rights and asks how misuse of the mayor's discretion will be prevented and whether the power should lie with an investigating judge.
Given the restriction of fundamental rights, it must be legally clear in which cases such a restriction is justified.
Gezien de inperking van grondrechten dient wettelijk duidelijk te zijn afgebakend in welke gevallen deze inperking gerechtvaardigd is.
Supports the bill against organised crime but asks how closure affects co-residents not involved in a weapon and whether the scope is clear enough under Article 8 ECHR.
These members ask how this right relates to the situation where several people live in a home where a weapon is found and the home is closed.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit recht zich verhoudt tot de situatie waarin meerdere personen woonachtig zijn in een woning waar een wapen wordt gevonden en de woning wordt gesloten.

Argues criminal matters should be handled by police, prosecutors and judges rather than through administrative closure, questions the lack of national guidelines and the effectiveness of the instrument.
Doubts proportionality and causal link, fearing innocent residents or victims will lose their homes and asks what alternative housing will be provided.
Warns that the administrative law instrument risks replacing criminal law as ultimum remedium and asks how children and innocent parties will be protected from double harm.
With this, administrative law, rather than criminal law, threatens to be used as the ultimum remedium.
Daarmee dreigt ook het bestuursrecht, in plaats van het strafrecht, als ultimum remedium te worden ingezet.

Asks about the scope of the term 'lokaal', the objectification of serious suspicion, whether follow-up measures like expropriation should extend to the Caribbean Netherlands, and government support for innocent residents.
Does the government consider it fair that in such situations the municipality would suffice by pointing to the residents' own responsibility to find replacement housing when a home is closed?

Vindt de regering het billijk dat de gemeente in zulke situaties bij sluiting van de woning zou volstaan met het wijzen op de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van betrokkenen om vervangende woonruimte te vinden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division endorses the bill expanding the mayor's power to close homes to maintain public order (serious violence, threats, or weapons found in a home), but asks for stronger constitutional justification under Article 10 of the Constitution, explicit 'serious' disturbance in the statutory text, differentiation between weapon types, practical support for mayors, and a concrete plan to reorder public order law. The government reply accepts the constitutional justification and specification points in part, but declines to add 'serious' to the existing a-ground and to restructure public order powers, while adding clarifications on weapons and support for mayors.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for fuller explanation in the memorie of toelichting of Article 10 Constitution and the democratic legitimacy of restricting privacy, which the government adopted by expanding the explanation and considerans.

The Afdeling advises the statutory text to state explicitly that closure is only possible for serious public order disturbance; the government did not amend the text in that way for the a-ground but adds the requirement via proportionality, so this is only partly followed.

The Afdeling asks the explanation to distinguish between types of weapons whose finding could justify closure; the government added examples such as explosives and firearms and referred to proportionality.
The Afdeling asks how practical usability of the mayor's powers can be improved; the government added a description of support by the Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid.
The Afdeling asks for a concrete plan and timeline for reordering public order law; the government declined a structural restructuring and referred to a future assessment framework by end 2022.

36235.s: The bill introduces a temporary windfall solidarity levy of 33% on excess profits above 120% of the reference profit for companies active in crude oil, natural gas and petroleum refining, retroactive to 1 January 2022. It sets filing and payment deadlines of 17 months, a seven-year limitation period and administrative fines, and expires on a date set by royal decree.
36235.j: The memorandum justifies the open-ended expiry by royal decree by saying it is unclear when the levy will become definitive because it is tied to the corporate tax base.
q: Proposed article 8.1, first paragraph, provides that this Act lapses at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Daarnaast wordt in het voorgestelde artikel 8.1, eerste lid, geregeld dat deze wet vervalt op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: setting the expiry date of the levy law by royal decree
setting the date for repealing article 7.2 by royal decree
setting the interest percentage on additional assessments via general administrative order
p: The expiry of the levy and the repeal of article 7.2 are left to a royal decree instead of being fixed in the statute.
The inspector sets the filing deadline, which is then fixed at seventeen months under the statute.

parties: Asks about retroactive taxation, legal admissibility, relation to cijns increase, investment climate and energy security.
Asks whether extending liability and formal provisions carries legal risk and whether the levy is proportionate.
These members ask whether there is no legal risk in adjusting the formal-law provisions for the solidarity contribution.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of er geen juridisch risico bestaat aan het aanpassen van de formeelrechtelijke bepalingen voor de solidariteitsheffing.
Asks the government to reflect on retroactivity, precedent and expected legal challenges.
Can the government indicate to the PVV members to what extent it expects legal proceedings objecting to the retroactive effect?
Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven in hoeverre zij juridische procedures verwacht die bezwaar maken tegen de terugwerkende kracht?
Supports the levy but asks about overlap with the mining law and effects on gas extraction investment.
Furthermore, the CDA members ask how it will be prevented that investments in gas extraction, for example in the North Sea, are slowed or halted by this measure.
Voorts vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie hoe wordt voorkomen dat investeringen in gaswinning op bijvoorbeeld de Noordzee afgeremd worden of stilvallen door deze maatregel.
Welcomes the step but questions the scope, the threshold and the choice of instrument.
They welcome this cautious step by the government but do have some remarks and questions on excess profits, the scope of the bill and the height of the levy.

Zij verwelkomen deze voorzichtige stap van de regering maar hebben evenwel enkele opmerkingen en vragen over het verschijnsel overwinst, de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel en de hoogte van de heffing.
Supports taxing excess profits and asks about the 33 percent rate and comparison with other member states.
These members can agree with the intention to tax excess profits and are pleased with the steps taken at European level.
Deze leden kunnen zich vinden in het voornemen om overwinsten te belasten en zijn blij met de stappen die op Europees vlak zijn gezet.
Asks whether the 33 percent marginal rate is proportionate and why the broader base is not kept for 2023.
The GroenLinks members ask whether the government can explain why it considers a marginal rate of 33 percent proportionate, while the EU regulation allows more room.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten waarom zij een marginaal tarief van 33 procent, terwijl de EU-verordening meer ruimte biedt, proportioneel vindt.
Argues a one-off contribution is insufficient and calls for a structural cost-raising levy.
The PvdD members believe a structural cost-raising levy should be introduced that prevents pollution, instead of taxing afterwards.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie zijn van mening dat er een structurele kostprijsverhogende heffing moet komen, die vervuiling voorkomt, in plaats van achteraf belast.
Supports the levy but asks about treatment of incidental gains and losses and deviation from the EU regulation.
These members ask the government to explain whether and how incidental profits or losses are taken into account.
Deze leden vragen de regering om toe te lichten of en hoe hierbij rekening wordt gehouden met incidentele winsten of verliezen.
Asks whether the measure is in substance a tax, whether it sets an EU tax precedent, and whether the Landsadvocaat advised on retroactivity.
Does the government share the view of these members that this measure must not have consequences for European taxes and must not set a precedent?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat deze maatregel geen gevolgen mag hebben op het gebied van Europese belastingen en ook geen precedent mag scheppen.
Asks for a timeline of decisions, whether a statutory basis would have helped, and whether an evaluation is planned.
In this context, can the government provide a timeline of the decisions taken since March on levying a temporary solidarity levy on excess profits resulting from a crisis?
Kan de regering in dit kader een tijdlijn geven van de besluiten die sinds maart zijn genomen over het heffen van een tijdelijke solidariteitsheffing over overwinsten als gevolg van een crisis?
Fully supports the aim but asks how revenue will be spent and what the EU rules imply for future tax powers.
Can the government explain whether this regulation concerns a new European tax, whereby the European Commission may decide by majority vote on its continuation?

Kan de regering toelichten of we met deze verordening spreken over een nieuwe Europese belasting, waardoor de Europese Commissie met meerderheid van stemmen (en niet met unanimiteit) mag beslissen over het voortzetten ervan?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet tijdelijke solidariteitsbijdrage, a one-off windfall levy on fossil-sector firms implementing an EU emergency regulation, raising concerns about retroactivity, the choice of a self-assessment tax, the broad joint liability within fiscal unities, and missing consultation, evaluation and comparative justification. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, adding justification for retroactivity, self-assessment, and the joint liability, aligned the wording and added a consultation paragraph, while declining an evaluation clause.
concerns: Retroactive effect of the levy over 2022 requires explicit fair-balance reasoning against legitimate expectations of taxpayers, which the government expanded in the explanatory memorandum.

The broad joint and several liability of all fiscal unity members not themselves liable for the levy needs a balancing of interests and justification as necessary and proportionate, added to the memorandum and the bill text corrected.
Justification for choosing a self-assessment levy with deviating limitation and penalty periods and terminology is requested and was added.
An evaluation of the levy's effectiveness is advised, which the government declined because of the one-off nature and complexity of the sector.

Consultation of external parties and comparison with measures taken by other countries should be explained, and a consultation paragraph was added while comparison with other countries was not possible yet.

36250-V.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (second supplementary budget), raising total expenditure and commitments by about 278,987 thousand euros in the second supplementary budget. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2022

36271.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate through an incidental supplementary budget, adding commitments and expenditure for gas storage at Bergermeer and a guarantee scheme for the Porthos CCS project. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 January 2023 (retroactively if published later).
36271.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the need to fund gas storage filling measures and the Porthos guarantee, without any delegation of power.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2023

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2023

36280.s: The bill introduces a new criminal offence of intentional espionage-type conduct on behalf of a foreign power, carrying up to eight years' imprisonment, and raises penalties by one third for certain computer offences and related offences when committed for a foreign power. It also extends the investigative powers in the Code of Criminal Procedure to the new offence.
36280.j: The memorandum justifies the new offence by the need to protect Dutch interests, allies and international organisations against espionage, and the extended powers by their availability for investigating offences against the state.
q: to broaden the possibilities for criminal prosecution of espionage activities by introducing a separate criminal offence
om de mogelijkheden om strafrechtelijk op te kunnen treden tegen spionageactiviteiten te verruimen door een afzonderlijke strafbaarstelling te introduceren
p: The new offence is added to the list of offences against the state for which broader investigative powers (seizure, forced entry to places) become available to investigating officers.
The offence uses broad, open-textured terms such as 'safety of the state' and 'vital infrastructure', leaving prosecutorial and judicial interpretation to define its scope.

parties: Asks whether the 'in heimelijke betrokkenheid' wording may narrow the offence too much, and whether the culpable variant and the definition of 'buitenlandse mogendheid' are sufficiently broad.
These members ask how broadly the term 'foreign power' in the offence definition should be understood.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe ruim het begrip «buitenlandse mogendheid» in de delictsomschrijving moet worden opgevat.
Questions whether the broad harmful-acts category and criminalisation of preparation conflict with the lex certa principle and legal certainty, and asks for concrete examples.
Does the government agree with these members that criminalising the preparation of not very explicitly and precisely described harmful acts is at odds with the lex certa principle?

Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat het strafbaar stellen van de voorbereiding van niet zeer expliciet en nauwkeurig omschreven schadetoebrengende handelingen, op gespannen voet staat met het lex certa-beginsel?
Asks how prosecutors and courts handle the difficulty of proving covert espionage and whether investigative obstacles such as encrypted communications exist.
These members ask how the Public Prosecution Service and the criminal court deal with the difficult provability of espionage activities.
Deze leden vragen hoe het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de strafrechter omgaan met de lastige bewijsbaarheid van de spionageactiviteiten.
Warns that the measure should not lead to excessive collection and storage of information about residents' own population, protecting citizens' privacy.
However, these members state that the reverse also applies and that it must be prevented that unnecessarily too much information about their own residents is collected and stored.
Deze leden stellen echter dat dit omgekeerd ook het geval is en er voorkomen moet worden dat onnodig te veel informatie over eigen inwoners moet worden verzameld en bewaard.
Questions the vagueness of the protected interests and undefined terms, arguing that broad open norms strain the criminal-law legality principle and asking for clearer definitions.
They hope the answers to these questions can contribute to clearer definition of terms so that the proposal stands in a better relation to the criminal-law legality principle.

Zij hopen dat de antwoorden op die vragen kunnen bijdragen aan een duidelijkere definiëring van begrippen en dat het voorstel daarmee in een betere verhouding tot het strafrechtelijke legaliteitsbeginsel komt te staan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the proposed broad criminalisation of acts performed for a foreign power (art. 98d Sr) lacks sufficient legal certainty and needs more precise definition, and that the added value over existing secrecy offences for passing information to a foreign power must be better explained. The government's nader rapport reports that the offence was narrowed by requiring covert involvement with a foreign power and a harmful act, and that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on added value.
concerns: The broad and vaguely worded offence for acts performed for a foreign power does not sufficiently meet the principle of legality and must be defined more precisely.
The added value of criminalising passing non-secret information to a foreign power over existing offences is insufficiently explained and must be substantiated.
The Afdeling asked that the redactional remark on Artikel II, Onderdeel E be corrected by identifying the article of the Wetboek van Strafrecht BES concerned.

36307.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence by an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 1.24 billion, mainly on the Inzet artikel and the unallocated line. It takes effect on 17 February 2023 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2023

36316.s: The bill repeals article 2.10 of the Waterwet (Water Act), which currently seems to require that water quality norms be set only by general administrative order (amvb) under chapter 5 of the Environmental Management Act. The explanatory memorandum says this clarifies the law so existing practice of setting water quality norms through various instruments can continue.
36316.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal as clarifying legislation so that water quality norms can continue to be set through existing instruments, following Raad van State rulings that created confusion about the legal basis.
q: This bill aims to amend the Waterwet so that the current practice of setting norms for water quality can be continued.
Dit wetsvoorstel beoogt de Waterwet zodanig te wijzigen dat de huidige praktijk van het vaststellen van normen met betrekking tot de waterkwaliteit kan worden voortgezet.

parties: The Raad van State found the amended article indefinite for water quality, and the CDA asks which norms are relevant and why the provision is not clearer.
According to the Raad van State, the article is therefore, insofar as water quality is concerned, indeterminate.
Volgens de Raad van State is het artikel daarmee, voor zover het gaat om de waterkwaliteit, onbepaald.
The PvdA asks about water shortages, allocation between agriculture, industry and households, and rainwater reuse, without raising a check concern.
These members note that water shortages in several provinces such as Groningen, Overijssel and Gelderland are already acute.
Deze leden constateren dat de watertekorten in verschillende provincies zoals Groningen, Overijssel en Gelderland nu al nijpend zijn.
The party questions the fragmented legal framework for water quality standards and asks for a clear, exhaustive list of laws and decrees, and for a legal anchor for the non-shifting principle.
These members ask the government to more clearly justify why it does not choose to nonetheless build a separate framework for water quality requirements in the Waterwet.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering om duidelijker te motiveren waarom er niet wordt gekozen om alsnog een apart kader voor de waterkwaliteitseisen in de Waterwet uit te werken.
The ChristenUnie has no additional questions on the bill.
They have no additional questions about this.
Zij hebben daarover geen aanvullende vragen.
The BBB is concerned about legal certainty for agriculture and horticulture if the Omgevingswet entry into force is postponed again, and asks for guarantees against adverse effects.

This member is therefore concerned about providing guarantees that there are no adverse consequences for agriculture and horticulture should the entry into force of the Omgevingswet be postponed again.

Dit lid heeft dan ook zorgen over het bieden van garanties dat er géén nadelige gevolgen zijn voor de land- en tuinbouw in het geval (onverhoopt) de inwerkingtreding van de Omgevingswet wederom uitgesteld wordt.
The D66 welcomes the amendment and has no further questions.
They think it good that this legislative amendment takes place and have no further questions about it.
Zij vinden het goed dat deze wetswijziging plaatsvindt en hebben hier geen verdere vragen over.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the proposed amendment to article 2.10 of the Waterwet is unclear and too open-ended because of the word 'mede', so the scope of the water quality test for permit applications should be specified. In its reply the minister states that article 2.10 has been removed entirely as it has no legal meaning, and explains that the existing Waterwet already covers water quality through the objectives of article 2.1 and the Wet milieubeheer standards.
concerns: The wording of the proposed amendment, especially the word 'mede', is unclear and indeterminate, which harms legal certainty and needs to be specified.
The provision is unfortunately formulated and reverses the intended relationship between the environmental quality standards and the Waterwet objective.

36334.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act to introduce a licence requirement and a notification duty for handling certain types of poliovirus, with the Minister empowered to grant, attach conditions to, suspend or revoke licences. It also makes related changes on STI control funding, laboratory reporting, and the IGJ's role as National Authority for Containment under the Health Act.
36334.j: The memorandum justifies the licence and notification regime as necessary to protect public health and to meet WHO containment obligations, and says the AMvB will be consulted and that appeal under the Awb remains open.
q: The purpose of the licence requirement is therefore the protection of public health, by minimising as far as possible the risk that the infectious poliovirus escapes from a facility, whether intentionally or not.

Het doel van de vergunningplicht is derhalve gelegen in bescherming van de volksgezondheid, door het risico op het vrijkomen van het betreffende infectieuze poliovirus uit een faciliteit, bedoeld of onbedoeld, zo klein als mogelijk te maken.
d: designation of poliovirus types and containment requirements for handling
transitional exemptions from the licence requirement
licence validity period and application rules by ministerial regulation
notification duty for specified poliovirus handling
additional laboratory data to report to the GGD
content of exposure reports to the inspectorate
rules on personal data disclosure for NAC tasks
p: The Minister gains broad discretion to grant, condition, suspend or revoke licences for handling poliovirus, with detailed requirements left to an AMvB.
The Minister may impose administrative enforcement, orders under coercion and administrative fines of up to the fifth-category amount for violations.
The IGJ receives the NAC task and enforceable inspection powers, including entry and information demands, over facilities.

parties: Asks how a licensing requirement would apply to newly emerging poliovirus variants, whether transitional arrangements exist, and how personal data processing would be handled.
Could this licensing requirement, for example, also apply to suddenly emerging new variants of the poliovirus?
Kan deze vergunningplicht bijvoorbeeld ook gelden voor plotseling opkomende nieuwe varianten van het poliovirus?
Asks about the number of facilities lacking essential or GAP-compliant status, current capacity and budget for sexual health care, and vaccination coverage trends.
Does the government currently see, unlike the GGDs themselves, enough capacity and budget to carry out this function as a low-threshold supplement?
Ziet de regering op dit moment, in tegenstelling tot de GGD’en zelf, genoeg capaciteit en budget om deze functie als laagdrempelige aanvulling uit te kunnen voeren?
Asks why the government will not legally anchor licensing and notification for all A-disease pathogens now, and why other countries' approaches and municipal information rights are not set in law.

The CDA members ask whether the government can further explain why it does not already provide, at least a legal basis, for such a licensing and notification requirement for all A-disease pathogens in this bill.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten waarom zij een dergelijke vergunning- en meldplicht naar alle verwekkers van A-ziekten niet nu al met dit wetsvoorstel op zijn minst van een grondslag voorziet.
Questions whether the government will adequately finance GGD sexual health care now that the task is written into the Wpg, as the GGD-GHOR warns funding is insufficient.
Is the government willing to adequately finance sexual health care by the GGDs now that this task is also being laid down in the Wpg?
Is de regering bereid om de seksuele gezondheidszorg van de GGD’en wel voldoende te gaan financieren, nu deze taak ook in de Wpg wordt vastgelegd?
Questions whether the WHO certification gaps justify a national licensing requirement given administrative burden, and asks for a European comparison.
If not, how does the government then weigh the introduction of a licensing requirement, given the administrative burden it would entail?
Zo nee, hoe weegt de regering dan de invoering van een vergunningsplicht, gezien de administratieve lasten die het met zich mee zou brengen?
Asks why two unrelated subjects are combined in one bill, whether lighter alternatives than licensing exist, and whether national requirements will exceed WHO certification standards.
The SGP members ask whether the government plans to set national requirements in the licence that go beyond what is needed to qualify for a WHO certificate.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering van plan is om nationaal verdergaande eisen te stellen in de vergunning dan nodig is om in aanmerking te komen voor een WHO-certificaat.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against the proposed licensing requirement for polio virus work, finding its necessity and proportionality insufficiently justified, and also objected to the discretionary exemption power, vague licence conditions, licensing without a WHO certificate, and the DAEB-based specific grant for GGD sexual health services. The minister's reply rejects the necessity objection, accepts the points on exemptions, licence conditions and the grant, and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced the licensing requirement is necessary, since the existing WHO certification system functions, and asks for a substantiated justification or withdrawal of the requirement.
The explanatory memorandum does not adequately explain why less restrictive instruments, such as direct national GAP-based rules with sanctions, would not suffice.
The licensing requirement must satisfy the Services Directive's overriding reason of general interest and subsidiarity test, which the explanatory memorandum must address.
The open-ended power in an AMvB to create exemptions from the licensing requirement is too broad and must be substantively limited in the Act itself; the exemption power is dropped.
The bill's wording allows licence conditions beyond WHO requirements, which contradicts the stated policy; the text is amended to tie conditions to the WHO resolution.
Licensing without a WHO certificate may conflict with WHO policy over time; the government explains the case of facilities relocating or merging and amends the memorandum.

The specific grant for GGD sexual health services raises questions on legal status of GGDs, state aid/DAEB treatment and the RIVM's role, which the explanatory memorandum must clarify or the component be dropped.

36352.s: The bill extends the childcare benefits scandal recovery act (Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen) to ex-partners, surviving partners and children of deceased applicants, and to surviving relatives of deceased children, offering compensation, tegemoetkomingen, debt takeover or forgiveness, and in-country or remigration support. It also adds recovery powers and a route for municipal broad support, with ministers and the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen empowered to set detailed rules by general administrative order and ministerial decision.
36352.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as needed to make recovery workable and to reach ex-partners and relatives missed by earlier rules, and it notes that rights of appeal to the administrative courts remain available.
q: The reclamation power will be applied with restraint, so that good-faith applicants do not suffer consequences from this measure.
De terugvorderingsbevoegdheid zal met terughoudendheid worden toegepast, zodat goedwillende aanvragers geen gevolgen ondervinden van deze maatregel.
d: special allowance for hardship cases for children, partners and parents of deceased applicants
municipal broad support for ex-partners and deceased applicants' partners and children
p: Minister may grant additional compensation for actual damage on request, a discretionary extension of executive payment power, subject to civil damages standards and appeal rights.

Belastingdienst/Toeslagen and the Minister may reclaim compensation, allowances and debt relief from ex-partners and relatives if they gave deliberately false information or knew or should have known they were not entitled, with the burden of proof on the administration.although the reclamation power is to be applied with restraint, it gives the executive new recovery powers against beneficiaries."}],
Application and decision deadlines are set, with extensions of six months available to the executive, lengthening the time before applicants get decisions.

parties: Asks how eligibility, the definition of ex-partner, the flat payment rationale and reclaiming of misused benefits will be defined and applied in practice.
The VVD members consider it important that involved ex-partners receive redress under the childcare benefits restoration operation.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het belangrijk dat betrokken ex-partners herstel krijgen in de hersteloperatie toeslagen.
Questions the one-year duration criterion as arbitrary and notes there is no hardship clause for the ex-partner definition, which it finds doubtful.
Is it correct that no hardship clause applies to the definition of ex-partner?
Klopt het dat op de definitie van ex-partner geen hardheidsclausule van toepassing is?
Supports recognition of ex-partners but worries about legal inequality, proportionality of generous compensation and legal sustainability of the scheme.
These members do have some difficulty with the generic design of the compensation, where room is limited due to earlier promises made by the government.
Deze leden hebben wel enige moeite met de generieke vormgeving van de compensatie, waarbij de ruimte beperkt is vanwege eerder door het regering gedane beloften.

Argues the scheme should have covered the whole household from the start, questions outsourcing of werkelijke schade assessment and why next of kin are not informed, and urges a directer, less bureaucratic procedure for families.
The SP members urgently call on the government not to subject the families covered by this bill to the intimidating procedure of the restoration operation and organisation that currently exists.

De leden van de SP-fractie roepen de regering met klem op om de gezinnen die vallen onder dit wetsvoorstel niet de afschrikwekkende procedure van de hersteloperatie en -organisatie te geven die nu bestaat.
Asks whether the government can keep the expectations raised by the bill and is seeking clarity on when persons not contacted by the tax authority can apply.
They therefore first want to ask the government whether it can deliver on the expectations raised by this bill.
Daarom willen zij de regering in de eerste plaats vragen of de regering de gewekte verwachtingen uit dit wetsvoorstel waar kan maken.
Worried about high complexity and asks how citizens can navigate the many schemes, organisations and counters, and requests a tabular overview of situations.
How does the government ensure that affected persons can find their way through all the different schemes, organisations and counters?
Hoe waarborgt de regering dat gedupeerden de weg kunnen vinden in alle verschillende regelingen, organisaties en loketten?
Welcomes the extension of debt relief but doubts the flat payment for ex-partners, fearing inequality with couples who stayed together and questioning interaction with bankruptcy law.
At the same time these members have doubts about the flat payment of ten thousand euros for ex-partners.
Tegelijkertijd hebben deze leden twijfels bij de forfaitaire uitkering van tienduizend euro voor ex-partners.
Critical of the bill, notes it may create unbalanced outcomes and delays for other victims, and asks whether legal deadlines and wider legal rules are respected.
The members point out that it is legally required to meet these deadlines.
De leden wijzen erop dat het wettelijk verplicht is om deze termijnen te halen.
Fears the scheme's definitions are too broad and will create inequality and legal vulnerability, echoing the Council of State's warning on equality, and questions outsourcing of werkelijke schade.

Member Omtzigt endorses the Council of State's conclusion that the new proposal not only puts further pressure on implementation through the new stream of applications, but also increases the (legal) risks, especially regarding the equality principle.

Het lid Omtzigt onderschrijft de conclusie van de Raad van State dat het nieuwe voorstel niet alleen de uitvoering verder onder druk zet door de nieuwe stroom aanvragen, maar ook dat dit wetsvoorstel de (juridische) risico's – vooral waar het gaat om het gelijkheidsbeginsel – groter maakt.
Expresses frustration with the government's repeated broken promises on the affair but welcomes the proposed measures and asks for the basis of the 10,000 euro amount and the six-month term.
That is why this member is pleased with the present proposal with additional restoration measures.
Daarom is dit lid blij met voorliggend voorstel met aanvullende herstelmaatregelen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a bill extending the childcare benefits (toeslagen) remediation scheme to ex-partners, children, and bereaved relatives, warning of implementation risks, unequal outcomes, and the shift to a non-damages recognition-of-suffering scheme for bereaved parents of deceased children, and advising reconsideration. The government's reply accepts the concerns in part, explains the design trade-offs for implementability and generosity, and amends the bill in several technical respects while not fundamentally changing the scheme.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced that timely and careful implementation of the expanded scheme is assured given staffing and capacity risks; the government acknowledges the risk and explains phasing and outsourcing measures.

Expanding the group deemed to be victims by fiction and forfaitaire amounts increases inequality and legal vulnerability, particularly regarding the principle of equality; the government defends the trade-off for implementability.

The recognition-of-suffering scheme for bereaved parents of deceased children lacks a separate, convincing justification as a moral obligation and loses the damages link underpinning the scheme; the government provides a justification but the Afdeling's call for a standalone rationale is only partly met.

Ex-partner forfaitaire compensation may produce uneven outcomes between ex-partners and between ex-partners and current partners; the government explains it prefers independent entitlement to avoid private-law disputes.

Beneficiary rules for bereaved relatives create perverse incentives and unequal sharing of amounts; the government explains the choice to base shares on applicants rather than all eligible persons for feasibility reasons.

Uitbesteding of the ex-partner damages scheme to an external executor needs clearer specification of tasks and the legal basis for mandating decisions; the government clarifies mandating arrangements and retained ministerial responsibility.

36360-IIB.s: This Slotwet amends the 2022 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, recording supplementary budgets and final realisation figures. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the other High Councils of State, Governors' Cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for the year 2022 is amended.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd

36410-X.s: This bill sets the 2024 departmental budget for the Ministry of Defence and the 2024 budget statement for the Paresto agency, in thousands of euros. It fixes appropriations, commitments and receipts per article and includes the explanatory memorandum on budget transfers and evaluation agendas.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2024 attached to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on 11 September 2023 on the draft 2024 budget act for the Ministry of Defence (X), finding no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The opinion was transmitted with a nader rapport dated 18 September 2023 from the Minister of Finance on behalf of the Minister of Defence.

36415.s: The bill makes a large set of technical and substantive amendments across social security and labour laws, including removing references to a criminal-law provision, changing working-hours assumptions, revising posted-worker documentation rules, adjusting minimum wage calculation, and adding income-exemption rules for loonkostensubsidie recipients. It also repeals the Brexit delegation chapter and adds cross-references to a pending equal-opportunities recruitment bill.
36415.j: The memorandum justifies the fixed 40-hour assumption as avoiding the need for UWV to request and check full-time contract hours, and notes the Arbeidsinspectie confirmed enforceability of the changes.
q: This ensures that UWV does not have to repeatedly ask for and check the standard hours of a full-time employment contract.
Hiermee wordt bereikt dat het UWV niet steeds de normomvang van een fulltime arbeidsovereenkomst hoeft uit te vragen en te controleren.
d: ARTIKEL XII / XIII (Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere en gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte werkloze werknemers / gewezen zelfstandigen, art. 8 lid 11 and 15)
adjusting income exemption amounts in line with Participatiewet amounts
ARTIKEL XVI (Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag, art. 11)
minimum wage payment periods under collective agreements or public regulations

parties: Asks one in-depth question about how much deviation in hours is needed to change a working pattern under the minimum wage act.
How much deviation from the number of hours worked is needed to bring about a change in the working pattern?
Hoeveel afwijking van het aantal gewerkte uren is er nodig om een wijziging in het arbeidspatroon te bewerkstelligen?
Asks how large differences between municipalities in IOAW/IOAZ earnings-exemption judgements will be prevented and how reassessment burdens are kept proportionate.
These members ask how it will be prevented that large differences arise between these judgements across municipalities.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat er grote verschillen ontstaan tussen deze oordelen tussen gemeenten.
Asks for the policy basis of the 5-hour threshold and whether the incorrect application since 2013 harmed people, and how many.
The PvdA and GroenLinks members ask whether the incorrect application (remaining working hours) since 2013 has led to adverse consequences for persons.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie en de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of de verkeerde toepassing (resterende arbeidsuren) sinds 2013 heeft geleid tot nadelige gevolgen voor personen.
Shares PvdA's questions on the 5-hour threshold basis and on individuals harmed by the misapplication since 2013.
The PvdA and GroenLinks members ask about the policy justification for the 5-hour threshold.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie en de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen naar de beleidsmatige onderbouwing van de 5-uur grens.
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
These members have no questions or comments on the proposed bill.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen of opmerkingen bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the Verzamelwet SZW 2024 and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport reports only drafting changes, clarifications on minimum wage assessment at individual level, Arbeidsinspectie practice, and DUO screening arrangements.

36424.s: The bill grants an ex officio compensation to taxpayers whose income tax returns for 2012-2019 were selected for manual review at the gate (Selectie aan de Poort) without a demonstrable fiscal reason, and whose assessed taxable income was raised as a result. Compensation equals the amount of the income increase plus a flat-rate interest payment, with an additional compensation claim available for proven direct harm and a binding decision subject to ordinary objection and appeal.
36424.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to restore harm from discriminatory or fiscally unjustified selection, citing Supreme Court case law and the PwC report on the gate selection process.
q: The compensation referred to in Article 2, first, second and third paragraphs, is determined by an appealable decision.
De compensatie, bedoeld in artikel 2, eerste, tweede en derde lid, wordt vastgesteld bij voor bezwaar vatbare beschikking.
d: processing of special categories and criminal personal data by the inspector
p: The inspector must ex officio compensate taxpayers whose returns were selected without a fiscal basis, strengthening citizens' protection against the tax administration's selection practices.
Compensation decisions are made by appealable decision and subject to chapter V AWR objection and appeal rights, preserving judicial review for citizens.
The inspector may process special categories and criminal-law personal data where necessary, subject to safeguards that privacy is not disproportionately harmed.

parties: Asks how the government will handle a possibly large number of objections and ensure timely decisions on compensation.
How is it ensured that these people receive a clear decision on their objection within a reasonable period, so they receive what they are entitled to under the scheme?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat deze mensen binnen een redelijke termijn een duidelijke uitspraak krijgen over hun bezwaar, zodat zij ontvangen waar zij op basis van de regeling recht op hebben?
Questions whether taxpayers can understand the complex review procedure and whether the Tax Authority's files are sufficient for fair assessments.
These members ask whether the government sees added value in producing a clear and understandable summary for taxpayers who will receive a decision and must be able to weigh whether to object.

Deze leden vragen of de regering meerwaarde ziet in het maken van een overzichtelijke en begrijpelijke samenvatting, bedoeld voor belastingplichtigen die uiteindelijk een beschikking zullen ontvangen en een goede afweging moeten kunnen maken om daartegen al dan niet bezwaar aan te tekenen.
Worries that taxpayers must themselves prove additional direct harm and may lack the knowledge to do so, and questions the choice of gross rather than fixed compensation.

Is it a realistic assessment that all those involved have sufficient knowledge of taxes and allowances to judge themselves whether they suffered disadvantage from a higher assessment than they had submitted?

Is het een realistische inschatting dat alle betrokkenen voldoende kennis bezitten van belastingen en toeslagen om zelf in te kunnen schatten of zij nadeel hebben ondervonden aan een hogere aanslag van het verzamelinkomen dan dat zij zelf hebben aangeleverd?

Strongly critical that the government decides who is compensated without disclosing with whom the illegally stored data were shared and what consequences followed; demands answers under the article 68 obligation.
Member Omtzigt is quite surprised that the government thinks it can now decide who should be compensated, without addressing the illegal storage of personal data and the legal consequences that had.

Het lid Omtzigt is behoorlijk verbaasd dat de regering denkt nu te kunnen bepalen wie er gecompenseerd dient te worden en niet voor het illegaal opslaan van persoonsgegevens en de rechtsgevolgen die dat gehad heeft.
Shares the government's aim of swiftly compensating wrongly selected citizens and asks about over- or undercompensation.
The D66 members share the government's importance attached to quickly compensating citizens who were wrongly selected for extra supervision.
De leden van de D66-fractie delen het belang dat de regering hecht aan het snel compenseren van burgers die op onterechte gronden geselecteerd zijn voor extra toezicht.
Questions whether individual case-by-case compensation is workable versus a fixed amount, echoing the Council of State's advice to weigh that alternative.
The Council of State advises that the explanatory memorandum address this further, weighing the alternative of a fixed-amount payment and adjusting the proposal if necessary.

De Raad van State adviseert om in de toelichting nader op het voorgaande in te gaan, daarbij het alternatief van tegemoetkoming in de vorm van een vast bedrag te wegen en zo nodig het voorstel aan te passen.
Has no further questions at this stage.
The SP members have taken note of the present bill and have no further questions about it at this time.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en hebben daar op dit moment geen verdere vragen over.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet compensatie wegens selectie aan de poort, which compensates taxpayers whose returns were selected on non-fiscal, possibly discriminatory grounds; it raised concerns about the compensation formula rewarding incorrect returns, unclear selection criteria, unaddressed bezwaar volumes, data-protection basis for special category data, and the decision to include the bill in the Belastingplan 2024 package with early entry into force. The government's nader rapport accepted the criticism on the dilemma and data protection, added examples and a legal basis for special data, but kept the 1 January 2024 entry into force and the Belastingplan inclusion.
concerns: Compensation at 100% of the gross correction rewards incorrect returns; the Afdeling suggested a fixed amount instead, which the government did not adopt but justified in the memorie van toelichting.
The criteria of relevant, suitable and objectively justified selection were unclear and lacked casus examples; examples and criteria were added to the explanatory memorandum.
Expected objection volumes and behavioural responses were underexplored; the government explained its 1% estimate and a margin in the uitvoeringstoets.
Processing of special category and criminal data lacked an explicit legal basis; an explicit basis under Article 9(2)(g) GDPR was added.
Advice to remove the bill from the Belastingplan 2024 package and postpone entry into force was not followed; the government kept 1 January 2024 to compensate affected taxpayers sooner.

36433.s: The bill adds a new paragraph f to article 288 of Book 3 of the Dutch Civil Code (and the Caribbean Netherlands equivalent) giving claims for child maintenance and maintenance of young adults under 21 in study a statutory preference ranking. It is a civil-law priority rule with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
36433.j: The memorandum justifies the preference by noting that parents often fall financially behind after separation, and leaves the application of the preference in bankruptcy to the discretion of the judge-commissioner.
q: In a new subsection f of article 3:288 of the Civil Code, a preference is granted to claims for owed child maintenance.
In een nieuw onderdeel f van artikel 3:288 BW wordt aan de vordering ter zake van verschuldigde kinderalimentatie preferentie toegekend.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to WODC and Expertgroep advice, whether the Kortmann commission advice against expanding preferential claims was considered, and whether transitional law and consultation partners were properly addressed.
An expansion of the number of preferential claims leads to a worsening of the position of concurrent creditors, including for example creditors with a claim for damages from a tort.

Een uitbreiding van het aantal bevoorrechte vorderingen leidt tot een verslechtering van de positie van de concurrente schuldeisers, waaronder bijvoorbeeld schuldeisers met een vordering wegens schadevergoeding uit onrechtmatige daad.

Asks whether the government can allow a different ranking in concrete cases after a balancing of interests, notes that vulnerable other creditors are affected, and asks about the absence of an evaluation clause and about support for the paying parent.
According to the government, are there possibilities to nevertheless apply a different order in a concrete case if a balancing of interests shows that this is important?
Zijn er volgens de regering mogelijkheden om in een concreet geval toch een andere volgorde aan te houden als een belangenafweging uitwijst dat dat belangrijk is?
Welcomes the bill as implementing a fifteen-year-old motion calling for preferential child maintenance claims.
With this bill, fifteen years after the Anker et al. motion, effect is given to the motion requesting that alimony legislation be amended so that the child maintenance claim becomes preferential.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt na 15 jaar invulling gegeven aan de motie Anker c.s., waarin werd verzocht de alimentatiewetgeving zodanig te wijzigen dat de kinderalimentatievordering preferent wordt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending Book 3 of the Dutch Civil Code (and BES equivalent) to give priority to claims for maintenance benefits owed to minor children and young adults, and found no remarks to make. The minister for Legal Protection forwarded the advice and proposed bill to the King with no substantive reply needed.

36442.s: The bill amends the Wft and related laws to tighten supervision of trust offices, extend the bonus ban to all supranational public financial support, add DNB approval for asset-intensive reinsurance and a prudent-person investment rule for insurers, and make smaller changes including new supervisory powers over crowdfunding providers. It also lets DNB and the resolution directorate jointly bring failing-or-likely-to-fail determinations to the board.
36442.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as needed to protect policyholders and investors, to make enforcement of trust-office rules workable, and to align Dutch law with EU directives and regulations.
q: With the bill, two changes to the prudential framework for insurers are proposed.
Met het wetsvoorstel wordt een tweetal wijzigingen in het prudentieel raamwerk voor verzekeraars voorgesteld
d: supervisory powers over crowdfunding providers under EU regulation
rules on prudent-person investment regime and reinsurance data
p: Supervisors gain power to suspend or ban crowdfunding offers and services for up to ten working days on reasonable grounds of infringement, with the grounds tied to the EU regulation.
DNB must consent to reinsurance arrangements that let an insurer hold assets in non-member states, subject to conditions it may attach.
The directorate may re-vote on failing-or-likely-to-fail determinations raised by a single director, reducing the usual voting threshold for that case.

parties: Questions why the government rejected a total ban on trust offices giving tax advice, doubts enforcement effectiveness, and asks for evaluation and disclosure of official advice.
These members are very critical of this.
Deze leden zijn hier zeer kritisch op.
Asks the government to justify disagreeing with the Raad van State criticism of the prudent-person rule and whether DNB notification is sufficient supervision.
Can the government indicate more precisely on which legal bases the proposal is consistent with EU law provisions on free movement of capital?
Kan de regering preciezer aangeven op basis van welke juridische grondslagen het voorstel in lijn is met Unierechtelijke bepalingen voor het vrij verkeer van kapitaal?
Welcomes removal of the insurer disciplinary provision after Raad van State advice, and asks how the new trust rules and bonus ban will be enforced and applied.
These members are pleased that, following the Council of State advice on the amendment act, the government decided to drop the disciplinary law component for insurers.

Het stemt deze leden positief dat de regering, naar aanleiding van het advies dat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft uitgebracht over de Wijzigingswet, heeft besloten om het onderdeel over tuchtrecht voor verzekeraars te laten vervallen.
Asks how easily the new tax-advice documentation requirement could be circumvented through an extra intermediary company.
These members ask the government how easy it would be to circumvent this obligation by creating an extra intermediary company outside the trust office's group.

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe eenvoudig het zou zijn om deze verplichting te omzeilen door het creëren van een extra tussenpersoon/vennootschap die geen onderdeel uitmaakt van dezelfde groep als het trustkantoor in kwestie.
Broadly agrees with the amendments and asks the government to study easing mortgage access for starters with student debt.
They can largely agree with the proposed amendments and have a single question.
Zij kunnen zich in grote lijnen vinden in de voorgestelde wijzigingen en hebben een enkele vraag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised scrapping the proposed statutory disciplinary law for insurers, questioning its necessity, proportionality and form, and asked for better justification of the enhanced supervision on insurers and of EU-law compatibility. The minister's reply dropped the disciplinary provision and defended the remaining prior-consent and EU-law points at length, adding some clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether statutory disciplinary law for insurers is necessary and proportionate, since the problem identified in the late-settlement research does not follow from it; the government dropped the provision.

The Afdeling found the design of the proposed disciplinary law, which targets undertakings rather than individuals, conceptually problematic and at odds with other disciplinary regimes; the government dropped the provision.

The Afdeling found the added value of prior DNB consent for asset-intensive reinsurance and the consent requirement for listing insufficiently motivated; the government defended both with reasons but clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked why the measures were not pursued at EU level and how they relate to EU free-movement principles; the government explained the EU negotiation history and justified the measures as proportionate.

36451.s: The bill implements the EU Data Governance Regulation in Dutch law by designating competent bodies, the Autoriteit Consument en Markt as supervisor for data intermediaries and data altruism organisations, and sanction powers including fines up to 10% of turnover. It also allows the executive to set by general administrative order the criteria for re-use fees and registration fees, and to designate the central information point by ministerial decision.
36451.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the technical complexity and likely frequent change of fee methods and the need for flexibility in an emerging market.
q: Regulation may need to be detailed and changed with some regularity, so a lower level is therefore more appropriate.
Regelgeving moet mogelijk gedetailleerd worden en met enige regelmaat worden gewijzigd, een lager niveau is daarom passender.
d: designation of competent bodies for re-use assistance and their scope and costs
designation of central information point by ministerial decision
criteria and method for calculating re-use fees
fees for registration of data intermediation services providers
time limit for ACM request for advice to the Data Protection Authority
p: The ACM may impose administrative fines up to 10% of annual turnover or a penalty payment, with a fine cap referenced to criminal categories rather than a fixed statutory ceiling.

parties: Asks for a list of conflicts between the bill and the GDPR, and a fuller response to the Council of State and ACOI advice; also questions the absence of an evaluation.
Can an overview of these conflicting points be provided, with the justification for why the GDPR prevailing could lead to conflict?
Kan een overzicht van deze conflicterende punten worden opgeleverd met de onderbouwing waarom het prevaleren van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming tot conflict zou kunnen leiden?
Objects to companies reusing sensitive data for profit and asks which financial incentives and conditions apply to private reuse.
They find it inappropriate for companies to reuse sensitive data to make more profit, because people are then sold products made from their own data.
Zij vinden het niet gepast als bedrijven gevoelige data hergebruiken om meer winst te maken, omdat mensen dan producten worden verkocht die tot stand zijn gekomen door hun eigen data.
Asks how the government responds to Council of State criticism of the ACM-AP relationship and how the AI Act affects the bill.
Can you specifically address the criticism regarding the proposed relationship between the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP)?
Kunt u hier specifiek ingaan op de kritiek met betrekking tot de voorgestelde verhouding tussen de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP)?
Asks for clarification on the role of the national contact point, the division of ministerial responsibilities, and the late implementation.
The NSC members request an explanation of why the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate was chosen to be responsible for data intermediation services.
De leden van de NSC-fractie verzoeken om toelichting waarom is gekozen om de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat verantwoordelijk te maken voor de databemiddelingsdiensten.
Asks why the Council of State advice to drop mandatory cooperation between the AP and ACM was not followed, and how cross-border enforcement against EU companies works.
The D66 members would like a more extensive explanation from the government of why the Council of State's advice to drop the mandatory cooperation between the AP and ACM is not being followed.

De leden van de D66-fractie zien graag een meer uitgebreide toelichting van de regering waarom het advies van de Raad van State om de verplichte samenwerking tussen de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) te schrappen, niet wordt opgevolgd.
Questions enforcement against data intermediaries in countries that ignore fines and the workload and FTE implications for the AP.

The members ask the government whether account has been taken of how the ACM would deal with data intermediation services located in countries where fines are frequently not paid and sanctions are ignored.

De leden vragen de regering of er rekening mee is gehouden met de vraag, wanneer databemiddelingsdiensten die zich bevinden in landen waarin boetes frequent niet betaald worden en sancties worden genegeerd, hoe de ACM hiermee om kan gaan.
Opposes privatisation of public data and sale of personal data, and asks whether public bodies may decide themselves whether to anonymise personal data.
they have fundamental objections to the privatisation of public data and the sale of personal data that could take place through this regulation.
hebben zij fundamentele bezwaren tegen de privatisering van publieke data en verkoop van persoonsgegevens die plaats kan vinden door deze verordening.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Dutch implementing act for the EU Data Governance Act, raising concerns about unclear relationships with other EU laws, a complex supervisory structure, mandatory AP advice to the ACM, transparency, lex certa, purpose limitation, the Woo/Open Data relationship, and the term 'openbaar lichaam'. The minister's reply accepted several points (e.g. replacing the term, adding a deadline and clarifying advice) while rejecting or only partly adopting others, such as removing the mandatory AP advice and the binding-instruction suggestion.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clearer explanation of the relationship between the Data Governance Act and the AVG, DMA, DSA, Data Act and AI Act, and the government added a section on these relations but maintained that AVG clarity will emerge in practice.

The Afdeling asked that the complex, layered supervisory structure be better explained and reconsidered; the government argued this is not unique to digital regulation and largely stood by its approach.

The Afdeling advised removing the mandatory advice of the AP to the ACM because it could create conflicts and precedent; the government made the advice procedure more flexible but kept a statutory advice obligation.

Lex certa concerns about vague norms that must be concretised in practice; the government will press at EU level for clarity and added explanation of the ACM's binding-instruction powers instead of creating a new one.
Purpose limitation under the AVG may be undermined by re-use of personal data for other purposes; the explanatory memorandum was amended to explain the compatibility criteria.
The term 'openbaar lichaam' conflicts with Dutch constitutional terminology and should be replaced by 'met een publieke taak belaste instelling', which was adopted.
Differences between Woo article 5.7 and the Regulation's re-use conditions mean public bodies may not yet publish conditions as required; the government clarified the text but did not change the law.
Requested more detail on the transparency of supervisory bodies and on the Woo/Open Data Directive distinction; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with references and examples.

36460.s: The bill raises the statutory maximum penalty for participation in a terrorist organisation to twenty years' imprisonment or a fifth-category fine where the organisation aims to commit terrorist offences carrying life imprisonment. It adds a new second paragraph to Article 140a of the Criminal Code and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: Article II: This act enters into force on a date to be set by royal decree.
Artikel II Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Questions whether a higher maximum is needed or merely symbolic, given that the existing 15-year maximum has never been imposed, and asks for case law evidence and comparison with EU member states.
These members note that the currently applicable maximum of 15 years has never been imposed for the existing article 140a of the Criminal Code.
Deze leden lezen immers dat het huidig geldend strafmaximum van 15 jaar nog nooit is opgelegd voor het bestaande artikel 140a Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Supports a penalty maximum proportionate to the gravity of terrorist participation and asks for the government's view on the threat level and on the distinction introduced in the bill.
These members share the government's view that participation in terrorist organisations should carry an extra heavy maximum penalty.
Deze leden delen het standpunt van de regering dat deelneming aan terroristische organisaties van een extra zwaar strafmaximum moet worden voorzien.
Asks why an increase is considered necessary when the judiciary reports that courts manage within the current maximum, citing the Council for the Judiciary and Bar Association advice.

Since the advice of the Council for the Judiciary shows that where article 140a was proven and no other offences were charged, no sentence higher than 7 years was imposed in practice, these members ask why the government considers raising the maximum from 15 to 20 years necessary.

Nu uit het advies van de Rvdr blijkt dat bij een bewezenverklaring van artikel 140a Wetboek van Strafrecht in zaken waarin daarnaast geen andere strafbare feiten ten laste waren gelegd, in de praktijk geen hogere gevangenisstraf is opgelegd dan 7 jaar, vragen deze leden waarom de regering een verhoging van het strafmaximum van 15 naar 20 jaar nodig acht.
Questions whether the increase is symbolic politics since judges rarely impose more than 6-7 years, and suggests minimum sentences as an alternative.
According to the Council of State, it therefore does not appear that raising the maximum penalty is necessary.
Volgens de Afdeling blijkt daarom niet dat verhoging van het strafmaximum noodzakelijk is.
Supports a stricter penalty, even a 20-year maximum, given the threat to national security and the rule of law, and asks two questions on online radicalisation.
According to these members, an increase of the maximum penalty to 20 years is therefore also reasonable.
Een verhoging van de maximumstraf naar 20 jaar ligt volgens deze leden daarom ook in de rede.
Asks the government to resubmit the fundamentally changed bill to the Council of State and questions the added value of the new paragraph given sentencing practice.
Also in view of the earlier critical advice of the Council of State, these members therefore ask the government to resubmit the new proposal for advice to the Council of State.
Mede gezien het eerdere kritische advies van de Afdeling vragen genoemde leden de regering daarom het nieuwe voorstel opnieuw voor te leggen voor advies aan de Afdeling.
Misses a clear and convincing justification for raising the maximum and says public pressure alone cannot justify it; asks what evidence from the judiciary prompted the bill.
Does the government agree with these members that public pressure alone cannot be a reason to raise the maximum penalty for an offence?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat enkel «maatschappelijke druk» op zichzelf niet een reden kan zijn om het strafmaximum voor een misdrijf te verhogen?
Notes the bill was changed after criticism from the Council of State and insufficiently motivated, and requests a new advisory round on the amended text.
They request the government to submit the amended proposal to the Council of State for advice.
Zij verzoeken de regering het aangepaste voorstel ter advisering aan de Afdeling voor te leggen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against the proposed increase of the maximum sentence for participation in a terrorist organisation from fifteen to twenty years, finding the need insufficiently justified, the sentence out of proportion with other offences, and the proposal at odds with the statute's systematics. The government's reply narrowed the proposal to a new second paragraph raising the maximum to twenty years only where the organisation aims at crimes punishable with life imprisonment, and defended the change on systematic and societal grounds.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of raising the maximum insufficiently motivated given the case law showing sentences well below the current maximum; the government answered that maxima are reserved for the gravest scenarios and narrowed the proposal to the most serious terrorist crimes.

The Afdeling considered the proposed twenty-year maximum disproportionate relative to penalties for other offences; the government retained a higher maximum but limited it to organisations aiming at life-sentence-level terrorist offences.

The Afdeling argued the offence is a collective preparatory offence whose systematics do not fit a maximum tied to attempt or complicity; the government disputed full systematic alignment but adjusted the design to a differentiated second paragraph.

36505.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by an incidental supplementary budget of 295,000 thousand euros, mainly for the European Union contribution, as part of a mid-term revision of the Multi-Annual Financial Framework. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 March 2024 with retroactive effect for later publication.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

36541.s: The bill introduces a mandatory periodic registration system for retailers selling tobacco and related products, administered by the Minister of Health. Registration details and validity are to be set by ministerial regulation, and non-compliance can be sanctioned with administrative fines.
36541.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for an up-to-date overview of retail outlets to enable supervision and enforcement by the NVWA, with detailed data requirements left to ministerial regulation.
q: Rules on the manner of registration and the validity of registration are set by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de wijze van registreren en de geldigheid van de registratie
d: manner of registration, validity, and data to be provided
p: The Minister is empowered to process personal data provided for registration, limited to supervision and enforcement of the Act's rules.

parties: Asks how enforcement of the registration will be simplified and whether NVWA has sufficient capacity and powers to tackle illegal sellers.
The NVWA notes that limited capacity is available for supervising compliance with the registration obligation.
De NVWA merkt op dat voor het houden van toezicht op de naleving van de registratieplicht beperkte capaciteit beschikbaar is.
Asks whether the registration is enforceable and whether enforcement capacity should be increased, and compares it with a licensing scheme.

Can the government further address whether the registration obligation and sales ban will be effective enough in reducing outlets and whether other more effective measures, such as a licensing requirement, are conceivable?

Kan de regering nader ingaan op de vraag of de registratieplicht en het verkoopverbod voldoende effectief zullen zijn in het verminderen van de verkooppunten en of er geen andere meer effectieve maatregelen denkbaar zijn (zoals vergunningplicht)?
Asks how monitoring accuracy fits with the statement that compliance is not an aim in itself, and about sales through channels other than registered outlets.
The VVD asks how this relates to the response to the Council of State's advice that compliance with the registration obligation is not an aim in itself.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe dit zich verhoudt met de reactie op het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State dat naleving van de registratieplicht geen doel op zich is.
Questions whether the register will be complete and enforceable given NVWA staffing, and whether earlier intervention or a licensing scheme is needed.
Moreover, the Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) has indicated that it does not have sufficient manpower to enforce it.
Bovendien heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) aangegeven dat zij niet over voldoende mankracht beschikt voor de handhaving ervan.
Asks how the registration will contribute to supervising outlets currently outside view and how new outlets will be prevented.
The D66 members also ask how the registration obligation contributes to supervising outlets that are currently out of view.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen voorts op welke wijze de registratieplicht bijdraagt aan het toezicht houden op verkooppunten die nu buiten beeld zijn.

Asks whether the registration will lead to checks on unregistered and online sellers, whether NVWA has the powers to act against them, and whether its capacity can be increased; also questions the annual registration burden.
The BBB members further ask what powers the NVWA has to enforce against such illegal sellers.
Verder vragen de leden van de BBB-fractie welke bevoegdheid de NVWA heeft voor het handhaven op dergelijke illegale verkopers?
Supports the bill as necessary toward a smoke-free generation and asks for district-level monitoring and whether a licensing scheme (Kuik motion) would make registration redundant.
The CDA members support the objectives of the National Prevention Agreement toward a smoke-free generation by 2040 and are concerned that these goals are slipping out of sight.
De leden van de CDA-fractie ondersteunen de doelstellingen uit het Nationaal Preventieakkoord richting een rookvrije generatie in 2040 en maken zich zorgen dat deze doelen uit zicht raken.
Asks which regulations the enforcement purpose refers to and how the registration will help enforce the new sales ban in supermarkets.
If it also concerns enforcing the sales ban at certain locations, how does the government expect the registration obligation to contribute to that?
Indien het ook gaat om het handhaven op het verkoopverbod op bepaalde plaatsen, hoe verwacht de regering dat de registratieplicht daaraan bij zal dragen?
Supports gradually reducing outlet numbers and asks whether non-registered purchases are punishable and whether existing track-and-trace registrations can be reused to reduce burden.
The SGP faction is in favour of gradually reducing the number of sales outlets.
De SGP-fractie is voorstander van het stapsgewijs verminderen van het aantal verkooppunten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises, on a bill introducing a registration duty for tobacco retail points alongside a related decree banning tobacco sales in supermarkets and hospitality, that the government further consider whether the sales ban and registration duty will be effective enough or whether extra measures are needed, and address enforcement capacity concerns. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely rejects the alternative of a licensing system as premature and argues the registration duty has separate goals of supporting enforcement, while clarifying the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asks whether the sales ban and registration duty will be effective enough or whether a licensing system or other measures are needed to control the number of outlets, given expected shifts in supply and RIVM projections.

The Afdeling questions whether the supervisory authority has sufficient capacity and whether compliance with the registration duty will be complete, given limited enforcement resources and expected unregistered outlets.
The Afdeling advises clarifying the explanatory memorandum on the relationship between the bill and the decree and on the enforcement rationale, and the government made editorial changes.
