36550-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the States General (parliament) through a first supplementary budget, raising appropriations by about EUR 50.6 million, mainly for the Tweede Kamer's institutional arrangements, fraction support and renovation-related costs. It makes the amendment retroactive to 1 June 2024 and does not delegate rule-making power to the executive.
36550-IIA.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget increases by the need for a fraction support budget regulation and replacement investments due to the delayed renovation of the Binnenhof.
q: This concerns the financial arrangement for the fractions' support budget.
Dit betreft de financiële regeling ondersteuningsbudget fracties.

36604.s: The bill amends several Caribbean Netherlands tax laws for 2025: it raises the hotel property tax rate, changes the general consumption tax small-business scheme, tightens income tax and wage tax rules (identification duty for employees, new wage-tax tables, eindheffing regime), and adjusts excise and customs rules. It mostly sets fixed rates and rules, with several ministerial-regulation delegations for tables, administration and identification details.
36604.j: The memorandum justifies ministerial delegations as a way to respond quickly to changing circumstances and technical possibilities.
q: That also gives the possibility to respond, where necessary, to rapidly changing circumstances and technical possibilities.
Dat geeft ook de mogelijkheid zo nodig in te spelen op snel veranderende omstandigheden en technische mogelijkheden.
d: Artikel I D (Belastingwet BES, art. 6.22 lid 8)
replacing fixed monetary amounts each year using tax table correction factor
Artikel III S (Wet LB BES, art. 19 lid 1)
rules on wage administration, employee identity checks and end of withholding duty
Artikel III T (Wet LB BES, art. 19a lid 1)
Artikel III J (Wet LB BES, art. 8a lid 2)
wage-tax tables for pay periods other than a year
Artikel III J (Wet LB BES, art. 8b lid 1)
wage-tax table for bonuses and special payments
Artikel III O (Wet LB BES, art. 21b lid 1)
tables for flat-rate eindheffing on benefits
Artikel IV A (Douane- en Accijnswet BES, art. 2.37 lid 1)
rules on preferential origin and registered exporters (REX)
conditions and restrictions for excise refunds
p: Artikel III J (Wet LB BES, art. 8a lid 4)
Allows the minister to issue new wage-tax tables by regulation to correct accumulated deviations, shifting detailed rate-setting to the executive.
Artikel III S (Wet LB BES, art. 19 lid 1 sub e)
Requires employers to verify employee identity and keep copies of identity documents, with details left to ministerial regulation, expanding executive control over personal data handling.

parties: Asks the government to respond to the Raad van State advice and to the island bodies' objections, and questions how the islands were involved in drafting.
These members therefore ask how the government reflects on the Council of State's advice to remove this bill from the Tax Plan 2025 package.
Deze leden vragen daarom hoe de regering reflecteert op het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State om het voorliggende wetsvoorstel uit het pakket Belastingplan 2025 te halen.
Asks whether the islands had their own implementation test and how discretionary room differs across the three islands under one tax plan.
The NSC members note that there is one tax plan for three different islands.
De leden van de NSC-fractie constateren dat er één belastingplan is voor drie verschillende eilanden.
Asks why an internet consultation is not standardly held and whether all stakeholders are actually heard.
Why is an internet consultation not chosen as the standard?
Waarom wordt er niet standaard gekozen om een internetconsultatie te houden?
Questions whether the consultation was skipped against normal legislative procedure and asks how island bodies were involved; also asks about income effects on low-income households.
Is it correct that on the basis of this expectation the regular legislative procedure was departed from?
Klopt het dat op basis van deze verwachting in is gegaan tegen de reguliere wetgevingsprocedure?
Asks what stakeholders were consulted in place of an internet consultation and how the budgetary system and tax burden compare with the rest of the Netherlands.
In addition, these members ask which stakeholders were consulted on the Tax Plan BES islands 2025 in place of an internet consultation?
Daarnaast vragen deze leden met welke stakeholders is gesproken over het belastingplan BES-eilanden 2025 als vervanging van de internetconsultatie?
Asks how the advice of the Centraal Dialoog Bonaire and the joint response of the island authorities were weighed, and for a purchasing-power analysis of the new income threshold.

Can the government explain to the D66 members how the advice of the Centraal Dialoog Bonaire and the joint response of the executive boards, island councils and island governors of the three public bodies were weighed?

Kan de regering aan de leden van de D66-fractie toelichten op welke wijze het advies van de Centraal Dialoog Bonaire en de gezamenlijke reactie van de bestuurscolleges, de eilandsraden en de gezaghebbers van de drie openbare lichamen zijn meegewogen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raises no substantive objections to the Belastingplan BES-eilanden 2025 but advises removing it from the Belastingplan package, giving it a more fitting title, introducing it as a separate bill via a regular track, and putting it to internet consultation, and also asks for more time for the identification obligation at the workplace. The government's reply largely declines to remove the bill from the package and explains why consultation took another form, but accepts clarifying the timing of the identification duty.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the bill, despite its title, lacks the character of a Belastingplan and advises removing it from the package and giving it a more appropriate citation title such as a fiscal maintenance act.

The Afdeling advises the explanatory memorandum address whether there is enough time for employers and employees to prepare for the identification obligation, and to set an entry-into-force date giving adequate preparation time.
The Afdeling advises putting the bill to internet consultation for transparency rather than relying on stakeholder consultation on the islands.

36613-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal) through a September supplementary budget, changing appropriations for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint parliamentary items in thousands of euros. It sets the commencement date and states that the amendment takes effect retroactively from 17 September 2023.
q: The budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36703.s: The bill distinguishes refugees from beneficiaries of subsidiary protection and limits family reunification for subsidiary protection holders to the core family (spouse, minor children, and certain parents or siblings of unaccompanied minors), adding an income and housing requirement. It also renames the Minister as Minister of Asylum and Migration and creates a new Article 29a granting residence to subsidiary protection holders with delegated rules by general administrative order.
36703.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the detailed rules on sufficient means will align with regular residence cases, and that the measure is needed to relieve pressure on the migration chain and the IND.
q: Detailed rules on what counts as independently and durably having sufficient means of subsistence will be set by general administrative order.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld over wat wordt verstaan onder het zelfstandig en duurzaam beschikken over voldoende middelen van bestaan.
d: rules on residence permits for family members under the family reunification provisions
rules on residence permits for subsidiary protection holders and cases in which a permit is granted
p: Family reunification for subsidiary protection holders is restricted to a narrow core family and made conditional on income, housing and timing requirements, with the detailed meaning of sufficient means left to a general administrative order.

parties: Supports stricter conditions on family reunification to reduce asylum inflow and pressure on housing, care and public order.
With an inflow share of 42% of family reunification migrants, it is necessary to curb this.
Met een instroompercentage van 42% aan nareizigers is het noodzakelijk dat dit aan banden wordt gelegd.
Questions the effectiveness of the measures, notes warnings from the Raad van State and other bodies, and asks for evidence on effects and integration impacts.

The Council for the Judiciary, the Council of State's administrative jurisdiction division and the Dutch Bar advised against submitting the bill, partly because of the expected counterproductive effect of the measures.

De Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr), de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State en de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (NOvA) adviseerden zelfs het wetsvoorstel niet in te dienen onder meer vanwege het verwachte contraproductieve effect van de maatregelen.
Asks how experiences from other countries are used and whether the conditions will withstand court review.
The VVD is curious how the government uses experiences from other countries such as Sweden and Austria to introduce the system as effectively and efficiently as possible.

Hierbij zijn de leden van de VVD-fractie benieuwd naar op welke manier de regering ervaringen van andere landen, zoals Zweden en Oostenrijk, die een tweestatusstelsel hebben of hadden, gebruikt om dit stelsel zo effectief en efficiënt mogelijk in te voeren.
Supports the distinction and conditions but asks how implementation risks, legal vulnerability and fundamental rights are safeguarded, and expects many appeals.
These members want legislation that reduces inflow but consider that attention is needed for feasibility and protecting fundamental rights.
Deze leden willen wetgeving die bijdraagt aan het verminderen van de instroom en zijn van oordeel dat dit aandacht vereist voor de uitvoerbaarheid en het beschermen van fundamentele rechten.
Worries about longer procedures, more litigation and legal certainty; asks for an evaluation clause after three years and parliamentary involvement in implementation tests.
These members ask the government to include an evaluation provision to review the law after three years.
Deze leden vragen de regering een evaluatiebepaling op te nemen om de wet na drie jaar te evalueren.
Asks whether appeals against subsidiary status can be made harder, why no transitional law is included, and how the rule of law and legal certainty are respected.
In practice this may lead to outcomes that conflict with the principles of legal certainty and equal treatment.
In de praktijk kan dit tot resultaten leiden die op gespannen voet staan met de beginselen van rechtszekerheid en gelijke behandeling.
Asks for disclosure of the information given to coalition parties and ministers and for the AMvB on income and housing requirements to be available before plenary debate.
Questions the short consultation, the child's best interests and whether restrictions on unmarried partners and minors are unjustified discrimination.
Has the best interests of the child been considered in this legislation?
Is het belang van het kind in deze wetgeving meegewogen?
Expresses alarm and asks for the scientific basis of the claim that asylum policy will reduce arrivals.
Can the government state on what it bases its claim that its asylum policy will ensure fewer asylum seekers come to the Netherlands?
Kan de regering aangeven waarop zij haar bewering baseert dat haar asielbeleid ervoor zal zorgen dat minder asielzoekers naar Nederland zullen komen?
Raises serious concerns about proportionality, EVRM Article 8 rights, the child's interests and the lack of evidence for the measures.
How does the government account for the right to private and family life under Article 8 ECHR in relation to the additional conditions for family reunification?
Hoe geeft de regering rekenschap van het recht op privéleven en family life zoals verwoord in artikel 8 EVRM in relatie tot de aanvullende voorwaarden voor nareis?
Asks whether the housing requirement is an insurmountable barrier and how individual circumstances are considered before applying the conditions.
Does the government agree it is wiser to treat those under the old rules to prevent nuisance?
Deelt de regering de mening dat het verstandiger is om die volgens de oude regels te behandelen om overlast te voorkomen.
Supports reducing inflow but asks about the interaction with the EU migration pact, ex ante implementation tests, the ex officio EVRM review and risks of waterbed effects.
For that reason it is no more than logical that work is made of decisive asylum and migration policy, limiting asylum inflow.
Om die reden is het niet meer dan logisch dat werk wordt gemaakt van daadkrachtig asiel- en migratiebeleid, waarbij de asielinstroom wordt beperkt.

Asks whether the bill meets ECHR Article 8 requirements for effective family life, criticises the two-year waiting period for unaccompanied minors, and questions immediate entry into force given legal certainty and equal treatment.
Can the government still specifically respond to the Council of State's criticism of the disproportionality of the two-year waiting period for unaccompanied minor foreigners?
Kan de regering alsnog specifiek ingaan op de kritiek van de Afdeling over de disproportionaliteit van de wachttermijn van twee jaar voor alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen?
Asks whether restricting reunification to the core family conflicts with equal treatment and non-discrimination, and whether exceptions are needed.

Does the government believe that conflicts with fundamental rights can be adequately prevented in this way, or does it see the need to specifically exempt such cases from the core-family restriction in the law?

Is de regering van mening dat daarmee strijdigheid met grondrechten afdoende kan worden voorkomen, of ziet de regering de noodzaak om voorkomende gevallen specifiek uit te zonderen in de wet van de beperking tot het kerngezin?

Requests disclosure of internal documents and demands that the government explicitly weigh fundamental rights, children's rights, and non-discrimination, noting no such balancing appears in the explanatory memorandum.
These members ask the government whether they must conclude that the government has not carried out a balancing of interests regarding fundamental rights.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij moeten concluderen dat de regering geen belangenafweging met betrekking tot grondrechten heeft gemaakt.
Notes the advisory committee's advice without raising questions.
There are no questions about this.

Asks for explicit per-measure balancing of rights, questions implementation risks causing delays and rights violations, objects to abolishing the objection phase, and questions immediate effect's impact on legal certainty and equal treatment.

Does the government share the view that the legislator itself has an important role in ensuring that laws comply with fundamental rights and that this cannot be left solely to implementation and the courts?

Deelt de regering de mening dat de wetgever zélf een belangrijke rol heeft om ervoor te zorgen dat wetten in overeenstemming zijn met de grondrechten en dit niet slechts kan worden overgelaten aan de uitvoering en de rechter?

Asks for justification of the two-year waiting period, warns of discriminatory effects of the core-family rule, questions proportionality and the lack of per-measure balancing, and asks how Article 8 ECHR's effectiveness requirement is met.

How does the government justify merely naming the intended social purpose of the proposed measures without addressing the interference with fundamental rights and the balancing of interests this requires?

Hoe verantwoordt de regering het enkel benoemen van het beoogde maatschappelijke doel van de voorgestelde maatregelen, zonder in te gaan op de inmenging in grondrechten en de belangenafweging die dit vraagt?
Asks the government to reflect on the advisory committee's finding that proper balancing was insufficient and to justify the absence of transitional law regarding legal certainty and equal treatment.
Can the government substantiate that there is no conflict with the legal certainty principle and equal treatment by not applying transitional law?
Kan de regering onderbouwen dat er geen sprake is van strijd met het rechtzekerheidsbeginsel en gelijke behandeling door geen overgangsrecht toe te passen?

Asks for legal assessment of the advisory committee's view on legal certainty when delays are attributed to refugees, the governing jurisprudence on immediate effect, and the relevance of excluding subsidiary protection holders from the Family Reunification Directive.
The CDA members ask the government to explain how it legally assesses the advice of the TCGCT.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering uiteen te zetten hoe zij het advies van de TCGCT juridisch beoordeelt

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the Wet invoering tweestatusstelsel in its current form, citing weak evidence of effectiveness, likely increased burden on the IND and courts, misalignment with the EU Asylum and Migration Pact, rushed preparation, and legal-certainty and discrimination concerns on immediate effect, family reunification limits and the two-year waiting period. The minister's reply rejects most objections, defends immediate effect and the waiting period, and retains the minimum age exemption only partly, while promising to add data on subsidiary protection recipients and updated cost figures.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the explanatory memorandum does not show the measures will reduce asylum inflow or speed up procedures; the minister argues a significant inflow effect is expected based on a package of measures and comparison with Sweden.

The Afdeling warns the measures will increase the workload of the IND and courts, with insufficient budget and no completed implementation test; the minister added updated cost figures and projections but defers extra funding to the spring memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that the bill be aligned with the EU Asylum and Migration Pact (applicable June 2026) and considered for merger with the implementing bill; the minister declines to change the bill but adds the explanatory note on alignment and will adjust the implementing bill.

The Afdeling objects to immediate effect without transitional rules, which creates unequal treatment and legal uncertainty for pending family reunification applications; the minister defends immediate effect as necessary to relieve pressure and states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The Afdeling warns that limiting reunification to the core family and the two-year waiting period may discriminate (e.g. unmarried partners in countries where marriage is impossible) and be disproportionate for unaccompanied minors; the minister states Article 8 ECHR remains available and keeps the waiting period for minors, while adding clarification to the memorandum.
The Afdeling questions the necessity and proportionality of the waiting period when the income and housing conditions are already met; the minister considers the waiting period indispensable.

The Afdeling notes the waiting period starts on grant of residence permit rather than lawful residence, contrary to the Family Reunification Directive; the minister acknowledges the difference but does not change it.

The Afdeling criticizes the rushed consultation of only one week with a limited set of bodies and no internet consultation; the minister defends the limited consultation and says extra inbreng was addressed in the amended memorandum.

36820-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate) by a net reduction of EUR 1.566 thousand in expenditure, with the unallocated amount of EUR 11.001 thousand moved out and redistributed across the parliamentary budget articles. It also makes a technical adjustment for wage and price indexation and a deferral of ICT hardware funds from 2025 to 2026.
q: This concerns the allocation of the 2025 wage and price adjustment tranche.
Dit betreft de toedeling van de loon- en prijsbijstelling tranche 2025.

36901.s: The bill amends the Plant Health Act so that ministerial regulations imposing measures against plant pests can take effect immediately upon publication on the internet, rather than after publication in the Staatscourant. It applies only where an immediate measure is needed to prevent a pest from entering, establishing or spreading.
36901.j: The memorandum justifies the bypass by arguing that Staatscourant publication often cannot occur on the same day a pest is detected, while rapid measures are needed to prevent damage.
q: A ministerial regulation, however, usually only takes effect after publication in the Staatscourant. Publication in the Staatscourant can take more than a day.
Een ministeriële regeling wordt in de regel echter pas van kracht na publicatie in de Staatscourant. Publicatie in de Staatscourant kan meer dan een dag kosten.
d: immediate entry into force of pest-control measures
publication by alternative means than the Bekendmakingswet
p: The minister may decide that regulations take effect immediately upon publication, bypassing the standard Staatscourant publication rule, when an urgent need is judged to exist.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill allowing deviation from the standard publication rules (Bekendmakingswet) for emergency plant-pest measures needs a more substantiated justification of the necessity and time gained. The government's reply expanded the explanatory memorandum with the circumstances, time savings and criteria justifying deviation, and made a technical wording change.
concerns: Deviation from the uniform publication rules must be exceptional and properly motivated on relevant criteria, which the government addressed by clarifying criteria in the explanatory memorandum.

The necessity of departing from the Bekendmakingswet was only briefly motivated and needed more insight into circumstances and time gained weighed against disadvantages, which the government supplemented.
A purely legal-technical remark was incorporated into article I, parts A and B, and an unnecessary definition was deleted.
